1525 def _zh_node_kill_listener():
1526     """Best-effort kill of whatever holds :48484 (wedged Node after blocking probe)."""
1527     import subprocess
1528     if not sys.platform.startswith("win"):
1529         return False
1530     try:
1531         # netstat -ano: find LISTENING pid on our port
1532         out = subprocess.check_output(
1533             ["netstat", "-ano"],
1534             text=True,
1535             timeout=5,
1536             creationflags=0x08000000 if sys.platform.startswith("win") else 0,
1537         )
1538     except Exception as e:
1539         _logger.warning("ensure_zh_node: netstat failed: %s", e)
1540         return False
1541     killed = False
1542     needle = f":{_ZH_NODE_PORT}"
1543     for line in out.splitlines():
1544         if "LISTENING" not in line.upper() and "LISTEN" not in line.upper():
1545             continue
1546         if needle not in line:
1547             continue
1548         parts = line.split()
1549         if not parts:
1550             continue
1551         try:
1552             pid = int(parts[-1])
1553         except ValueError:
1554             continue
1555         if pid <= 0:
1556             continue
1557         try:
1558             subprocess.run(
1559                 ["taskkill", "/F", "/PID", str(pid)],
1560                 capture_output=True,
1561                 timeout=8,
1562                 creationflags=0x08000000 if sys.platform.startswith("win") else 0,
1563             )
1564             _logger.warning("ensure_zh_node: killed wedged listener pid=%s", pid)
1565             killed = True
1566         except Exception as e:
1567             _logger.warning("ensure_zh_node: taskkill pid=%s failed: %s", pid, e)
1568     return killed
1569 
1570 
1571 #: Consecutive failed (re)starts before the ZH-node breaker OPENS.
1572 _ZH_NODE_MAX_RETRIES = 3
1573 #: Backoff between attempts: 5s, 20s, 80s (capped), then the breaker opens.
1574 _ZH_NODE_BACKOFF_BASE_S = 5.0
1575 _ZH_NODE_BACKOFF_CAP_S = 120.0
1576 #: How long the breaker stays open before allowing one probe again.
1577 _ZH_NODE_COOLDOWN_S = 600.0
1578 
1579 #: Breaker state. Guarded by ``_zh_node_start_lock`` at every mutation site.
1580 _zh_node_breaker = {"fails": 0, "next_attempt_at": 0.0, "open_until": 0.0}
1581 
1582 
1583 def _zh_node_breaker_reset():
1584     """The radar answered — forget the failure history."""
1585     if _zh_node_breaker["fails"]:
1586         _logger.info("ensure_zh_node: healthy again — breaker reset after %s failure(s)",
1587                      _zh_node_breaker["fails"])
1588     _zh_node_breaker["fails"] = 0
1589     _zh_node_breaker["next_attempt_at"] = 0.0
1590     _zh_node_breaker["open_until"] = 0.0
1591 
1592 
1593 def _zh_node_breaker_fail():
1594     """One more failed (re)start: back off, and open the breaker at the cap."""
1595     _zh_node_breaker["fails"] += 1
1596     n = _zh_node_breaker["fails"]
1597     delay = min(_ZH_NODE_BACKOFF_CAP_S, _ZH_NODE_BACKOFF_BASE_S * (4 ** (n - 1)))
1598     _zh_node_breaker["next_attempt_at"] = time.time() + delay
1599     if n >= _ZH_NODE_MAX_RETRIES:
1600         _zh_node_breaker["open_until"] = time.time() + _ZH_NODE_COOLDOWN_S
1601         _logger.error(
1602             "ensure_zh_node: %s consecutive failed starts — breaker OPEN for %.0fs. "
1603             "The Zombie Hunter radar is DOWN and will not be respawned until then; "
1604             "check `node %s` by hand.",
1605             n, _ZH_NODE_COOLDOWN_S, _ZH_NODE_SERVER_PATH,
1606         )
1607     else:
1608         _logger.warning(
1609             "ensure_zh_node: start failed (%s/%s) — next attempt in %.0fs",
1610             n, _ZH_NODE_MAX_RETRIES, delay,
1611         )
1612 
1613 
1614 def zh_node_breaker_state():
1615     """Honest read of the breaker for status surfaces/tests."""
1616     now = time.time()
1617     return {
1618         "fails": _zh_node_breaker["fails"],
1619         "open": _zh_node_breaker["open_until"] > now,
1620         "open_for_s": max(0.0, _zh_node_breaker["open_until"] - now),
1621         "next_attempt_in_s": max(0.0, _zh_node_breaker["next_attempt_at"] - now),
1622     }
1623 
1624 
1625 def _ensure_zh_node_server(wait_s=10.0):
1626     """Start the ZH Node radar if it is down; wait until it accepts connections.
1627 
1628     After a host restart the Anchor boot path fire-and-forgets ``node server.js``.
1629     Opening the Zombie Hunter button before listen completes (or if the spawn
1630     failed) used to surface ``Error connecting … timed out``. This helper is
1631     the proxy's safety net: start once, poll briefly, return readiness.
1632 
1633     Also recycles a **wedged** listener: port open but HTTP timed out (classic
1634     blocking freeze-capability probe on the old Node build).
1635     """
1636     import subprocess
1637     if _zh_node_is_up(timeout=0.8) and not _zh_node_is_stale(timeout=0.8):
1638         return True
1639     with _zh_node_start_lock:
1640         if _zh_node_is_up(timeout=0.8):
1641             if not _zh_node_is_stale(timeout=0.8):
1642                 _zh_node_breaker_reset()
1643                 return True
1644             # (2026-09-04) a live but STALE hunter: retire it and fall through to
1645             # the spawn below (it comes back on the current server.js + prefs env).
1646             _logger.warning("ensure_zh_node: hunter GUI runs an older server.js than on disk — recycling")
1647             _zh_node_kill_listener()
1648             time.sleep(0.4)
1649         # CIRCUIT BREAKER (2026-07-26 hardening, P0.6). This recycle loop had no
1650         # backoff and no give-up: logs/errors.log shows 74 cycles of
1651         # "listening but /api/state dead -> killed wedged listener -> launched
1652         # server.js" at 6-8 second intervals, forking a Node process each time.
1653         # It was the loudest error in the log — in the very subsystem meant to
1654         # look trustworthy. Now: exponential backoff between attempts, and after
1655         # _ZH_NODE_MAX_RETRIES consecutive failures the breaker OPENS and stays
1656         # open for a cooldown, reporting honestly instead of thrashing.
1657         now = time.time()
1658         if _zh_node_breaker["open_until"] > now:
1659             _logger.debug(
1660                 "ensure_zh_node: breaker OPEN for another %.0fs after %s "
1661                 "consecutive failures — not respawning",
1662                 _zh_node_breaker["open_until"] - now, _zh_node_breaker["fails"],
1663             )
1664             return False
1665         if now < _zh_node_breaker["next_attempt_at"]:
1666             return False  # inside the backoff window; stay quiet
1667         # Port held but unresponsive → kill and re-spawn with current server.js
1668         if _zh_node_port_listening():
1669             _logger.warning(
1670                 "ensure_zh_node: port %s listening but /api/state dead — recycling "
1671                 "(attempt %s/%s)",
1672                 _ZH_NODE_PORT, _zh_node_breaker["fails"] + 1, _ZH_NODE_MAX_RETRIES,
1673             )
1674             _zh_node_kill_listener()
1675             time.sleep(0.4)
1676         try:
1677             if os.path.exists(_ZH_NODE_SERVER_PATH):
1678                 creationflags = 0x08000000 if sys.platform.startswith("win") else 0
1679                 # (2026-09-04) the hunter's engine picker reads the dashboard's
1680                 # families (ANCHOR_DEFAULT_CLI / CODING_FAMILY / REVIEW_FAMILY) —
1681                 # hand it the same prefs env every spawned seat gets.
1682                 try:
1683                     _zh_env = {**os.environ, **_aset.export_env_overrides()}
1684                 except Exception:
1685                     _zh_env = None
1686                 subprocess.Popen(
1687                     ["node", _ZH_NODE_SERVER_PATH],
1688                     creationflags=creationflags,
1689                     cwd=os.path.dirname(_ZH_NODE_SERVER_PATH),
1690                     env=_zh_env,
1691                 )
1692                 _logger.info("ensure_zh_node: launched server.js on port %s", _ZH_NODE_PORT)
1693             else:
1694                 _logger.error("ensure_zh_node: missing %s", _ZH_NODE_SERVER_PATH)
1695                 return False
1696         except Exception as e:
1697             _logger.error("ensure_zh_node: spawn failed: %s", e)
1698             return False
1699         deadline = time.time() + max(0.5, float(wait_s))
1700         while time.time() < deadline:
1701             if _zh_node_is_up(timeout=0.8):
1702                 _zh_node_breaker_reset()
1703                 return True
1704             time.sleep(0.35)
1705         if _zh_node_is_up(timeout=1.0):
1706             _zh_node_breaker_reset()
1707             return True
1708         _zh_node_breaker_fail()
1709         return False
1710 
1711 
1712 def _trigger_project_summary(folder_path, project_id, force: bool = False):
1713     """Kick off proactive project-summary generation WITHOUT blocking the caller.
1714 
1715     Wave 5 (v3): the accurate cached project summary is generated proactively on
1716     rescan through the runner seam (``ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD`` → never live claude),
1717     in a background daemon thread so the rescan/render path is never blocked by a
1718     model run. All errors are swallowed — a failed generation just leaves the row
1719     on its blurb fallback (and never poisons the cache, per summarizer FIX 2).
1720 
1721     No-op unless proactive generation is enabled (the live server enables it; see
1722     ``_PROACTIVE_SUMMARY_ENABLED``) so unit tests that merely register/open a
1723     project never spawn a background model job.
1724     """
1725     if not _PROACTIVE_SUMMARY_ENABLED:
1726         return
1727     # Snapshot the runner-seam env at TRIGGER time so a late daemon thread uses
1728     # the runner/counter configured now — not whatever the process env is when it
1729     # finally runs. (Forwarded to the spawned job via job_runner.launch(env=...).
1730     # In production this is just ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD; in tests it also carries the
1731     # STUB_* vars so a leaked thread can't bump a later test's call counter.)
1732     runner_env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items()
1733                   if k == "ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD" or k.startswith("STUB_")
1734                   or k.startswith("FAKE_")}
1735 
1736     def _run():
1737         try:
1738             _summarizer.summarize_project(folder_path, project_id, force=force,
1739                                           runner_env=(runner_env or None))
1740         except Exception:
1741             pass
1742     try:
1743         threading.Thread(target=_run, daemon=True).start()
1744     except Exception:
1745         pass
1746 
1747 
1748 # ── Gandalf integration (v1) — proactive first-scan + manual re-run ───────────
1749 # Per-project locks/guards live in-process (a server owns its subprocess jobs).
1750 # ``_GANDALF_FIRSTSCAN_LOCKS`` serializes the first-scan check-and-set so two
1751 # concurrent rescans can't both schedule the first run (TOCTOU double-fire).
1752 # Track in-flight Gandalf runs per-project to prevent duplicates and expose status.
1753 _GANDALF_LOCKS_GUARD = threading.Lock()
1754 _GANDALF_FIRSTSCAN_LOCKS = {}
1755 _GANDALF_INFLIGHT_GUARD = threading.Lock()
1756 _GANDALF_INFLIGHT = {}
1757 
1758 #: Projects whose post-registration setup (brownfield adopt, then the honest
1759 #: first read) is still running. Surfaced on the dashboard card through the
1760 #: SAME bulk poll the Gandalf badge uses, so a freshly created project is
1761 #: never a silent blank tile — the failure that made "+ New project" look
1762 #: broken and produced duplicate clicks (2026-08-27).
1763 _PROJECT_SETUP = {}
1764 _PROJECT_SETUP_GUARD = threading.Lock()
1765 
1766 
1767 def set_project_setup_status(project_id, status):
1768     """Set (or clear, with a falsy status) a project's setup message."""
1769     with _PROJECT_SETUP_GUARD:
1770         if status:
1771             _PROJECT_SETUP[project_id] = {"status": str(status),
1772                                           "ts": time.time()}
1773         else:
1774             _PROJECT_SETUP.pop(project_id, None)
1775 
1776 
1777 def _gandalf_inflight_ids():
1778     """Projects with a Gandalf read in flight.
1779 
1780     A read is up to a dozen jobs walking the tree for minutes, and it is NOT a
1781     managed session — so ``project_move.has_live_sessions`` does not see it and
1782     nothing else would stop a ``shutil.move`` out from under it.
1783     """
1784     with _GANDALF_INFLIGHT_GUARD:
1785         return set(_GANDALF_INFLIGHT)
1786 
1787 
1788 def project_setup_statuses():
1789     """Live setup messages, dropping anything older than the 30-min sweep."""
1790     now = time.time()
1791     out = {}
1792     with _PROJECT_SETUP_GUARD:
1793         for pid, rec in list(_PROJECT_SETUP.items()):
1794             if now - rec.get("ts", 0) > 1800:
1795                 _PROJECT_SETUP.pop(pid, None)
1796                 continue
1797             out[pid] = rec.get("status") or ""
1798     return {k: v for k, v in out.items() if v}
1799 
1800 
1801 def _gandalf_firstscan_lock(project_id):
1802     """Return the per-project first-scan lock (created once)."""
1803     with _GANDALF_LOCKS_GUARD:
1804         lk = _GANDALF_FIRSTSCAN_LOCKS.get(project_id)
1805         if lk is None:
1806             lk = threading.Lock()
1807             _GANDALF_FIRSTSCAN_LOCKS[project_id] = lk
1808         return lk
1809 
1810 
1811 def _gandalf_runner_env():
1812     """Snapshot the runner-seam env at trigger time (mirror of the summary
1813     triggers) so a late daemon thread uses the runner configured NOW. Also
1814     forwards the Gandalf-specific seams so a forwarded job grades through the
1815     same host/skill/timeout, PLUS the trio model/driver/tier seams so the Claude
1816     reasoner + Gemini checker resolve at the chosen tier on the real host (the
1817     explicit-driver-init rule): TRIO_TIER (heavy→fable-5 / standard→opus-4-8),
1818     CLAUDE_MODEL[_ROLE], ANTHROPIC_MODEL, GEMINI_MODEL, TRIO_MODEL[_ROLE],
1819     TRIO_DRIVER[_ROLE], CRUCIBLE_AGENT_LIVE."""
1820     _prefixes = ("STUB_", "FAKE_", "ANCHOR_GANDALF_",
1821                  "CLAUDE_MODEL", "TRIO_MODEL", "TRIO_DRIVER")
1822     _keys = {"ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD", "TRIO_TIER", "ANTHROPIC_MODEL",
1823              "GEMINI_MODEL", "CRUCIBLE_AGENT_LIVE"}
1824     return {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items()
1825             if k in _keys or any(k.startswith(p) for p in _prefixes)}
1826 
1827 
1828 def _trigger_gandalf(folder_path, project_id, *, manual=False, first_scan=False,
1829                      tier="standard", preclaimed=False):
1830     """Schedule a Gandalf run in a daemon thread WITHOUT blocking the caller.
1831 
1832     Mirrors ``_trigger_project_summary``: snapshots the runner-seam env at
1833     trigger time and forwards it to the spawned job, runs in a background daemon
1834     thread, swallows all errors. Per-project in-flight guard prevents a duplicate
1835     pile-up.
1836 
1837     - ``manual=True`` (the explicit ``POST /api/rnd/gandalf_run``) is NOT gated by
1838       ``_PROACTIVE_SUMMARY_ENABLED`` — a manual re-run is always honored.
1839     - ``first_scan=True`` is the proactive register/open/rescan hook: gated by the
1840       module flag (off in tests) AND first-run-ONLY via ``run_gandalf_if_absent``.
1841 
1842     Returns ``True`` if a run was scheduled, ``False`` if suppressed (gate off, or
1843     already in-flight).
1844     """
1845     # The run is always RECORDED against the registry folder (store_folder) — the
1846     # read path (`GET /api/rnd/gandalf`, the panel render, archive/delete) resolves
1847     # the index off the registry folder, so storing anywhere else makes a finished
1848     # run permanently invisible (the 2026-06-29→07-02 __dashboard__ regression: five
1849     # ok-runs stranded under ANCHOR_DIR/dev while the UI polled an empty index).
1850     # The ANALYSIS scope for __dashboard__ is the registry folder too (the whole
1851     # workspace): the Wave-9 map-reduce shards a big heterogeneous tree by
1852     # top-level component (12-shard cap), which is exactly the honest "what's
1853     # really going on across my workspace" read — the old ANCHOR_DIR/dev inbox
1854     # re-scope produced reports about IDE junk and stranded them besides.
1855     store_folder = str(folder_path)
1856     if first_scan and not _PROACTIVE_SUMMARY_ENABLED:
1857         return False
1858     # In-flight guard: at most one scheduled-but-unfinished run per project.
1859     # ``preclaimed`` means the first-scan hook already took this slot under the
1860     # global cap's lock — re-checking here would see its own claim and refuse.
1861     if not preclaimed:
1862         with _GANDALF_INFLIGHT_GUARD:
1863             if project_id in _GANDALF_INFLIGHT:
1864                 rec = _GANDALF_INFLIGHT[project_id]
1865                 if isinstance(rec, dict) and time.time() - rec.get("ts", 0) > 1800:
1866                     _GANDALF_INFLIGHT.pop(project_id, None)
1867                 else:
1868                     return False
1869             _GANDALF_INFLIGHT[project_id] = {"status": "Starting...",
1870                                              "ts": time.time()}
1871 
1872     runner_env = _gandalf_runner_env()
1873 
1874     def _run():
1875         def _cb(msg):
1876             with _GANDALF_INFLIGHT_GUARD:
1877                 if project_id in _GANDALF_INFLIGHT:
1878                     _GANDALF_INFLIGHT[project_id] = {"status": msg, "ts": time.time()}
1879         try:
1880             if first_scan:
1881                 _gandalf.run_gandalf_if_absent(folder_path, project_id,
1882                                                env=(runner_env or None), status_cb=_cb,
1883                                                store_folder=store_folder, tier=tier)
1884             else:
1885                 _gandalf.run_gandalf(folder_path, project_id,
1886                                      env=(runner_env or None), status_cb=_cb,
1887                                      store_folder=store_folder, tier=tier)
1888         except Exception:
1889             pass
1890         finally:
1891             with _GANDALF_INFLIGHT_GUARD:
1892                 _GANDALF_INFLIGHT.pop(project_id, None)
1893 
1894     try:
1895         threading.Thread(target=_run, daemon=True).start()
1896         return True
1897     except Exception:
1898         with _GANDALF_INFLIGHT_GUARD:
1899             _GANDALF_INFLIGHT.pop(project_id, None)
1900         return False
1901 
1902 
1903 def _trigger_gandalf_first_scan(folder_path, project_id):
1904     """First-scan hook (register/open/rescan). First-run-ONLY, no TOCTOU.
1905 
1906     Claim-and-hold under ONE lock: expire stale claims, refuse if ANY other
1907     project's automatic read is in flight, refuse if this project's already is,
1908     else claim the slot. Every early exit after the claim releases it.
1909 
1910     The global cap is the 2026-08-26 fix: the guard used to be per-project, so
1911     three registrations in a row started three whole-tree map-reduces at once —
1912     each fanning out to ~12 parallel model jobs. That saturated the machine, the
1913     create POST couldn't get a response out, and "+ New project" looked broken
1914     (which produced the extra clicks that produced the extra swarms). One
1915     automatic read at a time, machine-wide; a MANUAL run is never gated by this.
1916 
1917     Gated by ``_PROACTIVE_SUMMARY_ENABLED`` (off in tests) so a bare
1918     register/open never spawns a model job. Never raises.
1919     """
1920     if not _PROACTIVE_SUMMARY_ENABLED:
1921         return False
1922     with _GANDALF_INFLIGHT_GUARD:
1923         for pid, rec in list(_GANDALF_INFLIGHT.items()):
1924             # a wedged run whose finally never ran must not suppress every
1925             # other project's read until the server restarts
1926             if isinstance(rec, dict) and time.time() - rec.get("ts", 0) > 1800:
1927                 _GANDALF_INFLIGHT.pop(pid, None)
1928                 continue
1929             if pid != project_id:
1930                 log_change(
1931                     f"R&D: deferred the automatic first-scan read for "
1932                     f"{project_id} — another project's read is still running "
1933                     f"(one at a time keeps the machine usable); the project "
1934                     f"window's Gandalf button runs it on demand")
1935                 # SAY it on the card. Without this the setup message clears
1936                 # when the read is merely SCHEDULED, so projects 2 and 3 of a
1937                 # rapid triple-create went silently blank again — the very
1938                 # failure the setup status exists to prevent.
1939                 set_project_setup_status(
1940                     project_id,
1941                     "Read deferred — another project's read is running; "
1942                     "use the Gandalf button when you want it")
1943             return False
1944         _GANDALF_INFLIGHT[project_id] = {"status": "Starting...",
1945                                          "ts": time.time()}
1946 
1947     def _release():
1948         with _GANDALF_INFLIGHT_GUARD:
1949             _GANDALF_INFLIGHT.pop(project_id, None)
1950 
1951     lk = _gandalf_firstscan_lock(project_id)
1952     with lk:
1953         try:
1954             if _gandalf.list_runs(folder_path, project_id):
1955                 _release()
1956                 return False  # a prior run exists — not a first scan
1957         except Exception:
1958             _release()
1959             return False
1960         ok = _trigger_gandalf(folder_path, project_id, first_scan=True,
1961                               preclaimed=True)
1962         if not ok:
1963             _release()
1964         return ok
1965 
1966 
1967 def _reconcile_gandalf_boot_runs() -> int:
1968     """Boot hook (2026-07 durability Wave 3): reconcile dangling Gandalf runs.
1969 
1970     Right after ``job_runner.reconcile_on_startup()``, iterate the registered
1971     projects and reconcile each project's Gandalf index
1972     (``gandalf.reconcile_dangling_runs``) so an ``in_progress`` row orphaned by
1973     a restart goes honestly terminal (``failed / interrupted-by-restart``)
1974     instead of showing a perpetual "running" state. Best-effort per project,
1975     logged via the boot logger. Returns the total reconciled count; never
1976     raises."""
1977     total = 0
1978     try:
1979         projects = list(_rnd.list_projects())
1980     except Exception as e:
1981         _logger.error(f"gandalf boot reconcile: list_projects failed: {e}")
1982         projects = []
1983     # The synthetic __dashboard__ project (the dashboard's own "project window")
1984     # is fabricated on demand and is NOT in the registry, so list_projects never
1985     # returns it. Its Gandalf runs (e.g. a Heavy self-read) would therefore never
1986     # get boot-reconciled — a restart mid-run left a perpetual "running" ghost.
1987     # Fold it in explicitly so its dangling in_progress rows heal too.
1988     try:
1989         _dash = _rnd.get_project("__dashboard__")
1990         if _dash and not any(p.get("id") == "__dashboard__" for p in projects):
1991             projects.append(_dash)
1992     except Exception:
1993         pass
1994     for proj in projects:
1995         pid = proj.get("id") or ""
1996         folder = proj.get("folder_path") or ""
1997         if not pid or not folder:
1998             continue
1999         try:
2000             n = _gandalf.reconcile_dangling_runs(folder, pid)
2001         except Exception as e:
2002             _logger.error(f"gandalf boot reconcile failed for {pid}: {e}")
2003             continue
2004         if n:
2005             _logger.info(
2006                 f"gandalf boot reconcile: {n} dangling run(s) → "
2007                 f"failed/interrupted-by-restart for {pid}")
2008             total += n
2009     return total
2010 
2011 
2012 def _trigger_session_summary(folder_path, project_id, lane, session,
2013                              force: bool = False):
2014     """Kick off proactive SESSION-summary generation WITHOUT blocking (Wave 6).
2015 
2016     Mirror of ``_trigger_project_summary``: generates one session's cached,
2017     validated summary through the runner seam in a background daemon thread, so
2018     neither the render path nor the read-only ``/api/rnd/session_summary``
2019     endpoint ever blocks on a model run. No-op unless proactive generation is
2020     enabled (``_PROACTIVE_SUMMARY_ENABLED``) so unit tests that merely
2021     register/open a project never spawn a background model job. Errors are
2022     swallowed (a failed run never poisons the cache, per summarizer FIX 2).
2023 
2024     The runner-seam env is snapshotted at trigger time (same isolation rationale
2025     as the project-summary trigger) and forwarded to ``job_runner.launch``.
2026     """
2027     if not _PROACTIVE_SUMMARY_ENABLED:
2028         return
2029     runner_env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items()
2030                   if k == "ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD" or k.startswith("STUB_")
2031                   or k.startswith("FAKE_")}
2032     if runner_env:
2033         os.environ.setdefault("_ANCHOR_SESS_SUMMARY_ENV", "1")
2034 
2035     def _run():
2036         try:
2037             # Forward the snapshotted runner env onto the spawned job for test
2038             # isolation. summarize_session resolves the runner from the process
2039             # env; in production this is just ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD (already set).
2040             prev = {}
2041             for k, v in runner_env.items():
2042                 prev[k] = os.environ.get(k)
2043                 os.environ[k] = v
2044             try:
2045                 _summarizer.summarize_session(folder_path, project_id, lane,
2046                                               session, force=force)
2047             finally:
2048                 for k, old in prev.items():
2049                     if old is None:
2050                         os.environ.pop(k, None)
2051                     else:
2052                         os.environ[k] = old
2053         except Exception:
2054             pass
2055     try:
2056         threading.Thread(target=_run, daemon=True).start()
2057     except Exception:
2058         pass
2059 
2060 
2061 def _resolve_finished_session(folder, project_id, lane, session_id):
2062     """Resolve the durable SESSION dict for a finished managed session (v8 Wave 5).
2063 
2064     A managed terminal session (the killed one) keys off a bare registry id, but
2065     the documents it PRODUCED were persisted (Wave 2 ``persist_session_docs``) as
2066     DISCOVERED efforts that group — in ``sessions.list_sessions`` — under their
2067     common parent directory, NOT under the bare managed id. So a kill's durable
2068     summary/detail must TIE the managed session to its produced docs explicitly:
2069 
2070       1. Prefer an exact ``sessions.list_sessions`` match on the managed id (a RUN
2071          session adopted under the same id, e.g. a discover→adopt flow).
2072       2. Else SYNTHESIZE a session dict from the lane efforts tagged with this
2073          managed ``session_id`` (``effort_history.efforts_for_session_id``) — the
2074          persisted produced docs. This is the no-loss tie: the killed session now
2075          resolves to a lane SESSION carrying {its id, its produced docs}, so the
2076          summarizer seeds skill/prompts/actions off the REAL docs (not empty).
2077 
2078     Returns a session dict (with ``member_files``) when the managed session has
2079     resolvable produced docs, else ``None`` (honest — nothing was produced).
2080     Never raises.
2081     """
2082     try:
2083         for s in _sessions.list_sessions(folder, project_id, lane):
2084             if s.get("session_id") == session_id:
2085                 return s
2086     except Exception:
2087         pass
2088     try:
2089         members = _eh.efforts_for_session_id(folder, project_id, lane,
2090                                              session_id)
2091     except Exception:
2092         members = []
2093     if not members:
2094         return None
2095     # Synthesize a session dict keyed to the MANAGED id so its cached summary
2096     # (and the detail view, which fetches by that id) carries these exact docs.
2097     discovered = all(_eh.is_discovered(m) for m in members)
2098     try:
2099         ts = max(float(m.get("created_at", 0.0) or 0.0) for m in members)
2100     except (TypeError, ValueError):
2101         ts = 0.0
2102     skill = ""
2103     title = ""
2104     for m in members:
2105         if not skill and m.get("skill"):
2106             skill = m["skill"]
2107         if not title and (m.get("title") or "").strip():
2108             title = (m.get("title") or "").strip()
2109     return {
2110         "session_id": session_id,
2111         "lane": _eh._resolve_subdir(lane),
2112         "skill": skill,
2113         "timestamp": ts,
2114         "title": title,
2115         "member_files": members,
2116         "provenance": "imported" if discovered else "run",
2117         "summary_ref": None,
2118     }
2119 
2120 
2121 def _trigger_session_summary_on_finish(project_id, lane, session_id):
2122     """Best-effort: schedule a BACKGROUND session-summary for a session that just
2123     reached a terminal state (v7 Wave 2 — kill / finish→build / reconcile-dead).
2124 
2125     Resolves the project folder + the effort-history ``session`` dict (the shape
2126     ``_trigger_session_summary`` needs) from ``session_id`` and kicks off the
2127     existing background generator. NON-BLOCKING and IDEMPOTENT:
2128 
2129       - returns immediately (the generation runs on a daemon thread);
2130       - skips when the session already has a CACHED summary (so a second finish /
2131         a repeated reconcile poll never re-runs the model);
2132       - a failed generation never poisons the cache (the summarizer surfaces
2133         ``error`` WITHOUT writing, per FIX 2).
2134 
2135     No-op unless ``_PROACTIVE_SUMMARY_ENABLED`` (the live server enables it; tests
2136     opt in). Never raises — any resolution failure is swallowed so it can never
2137     delay or break the finish (kill / finish→build / reconcile) response.
2138     """
2139     if not _PROACTIVE_SUMMARY_ENABLED:
2140         return
2141     try:
2142         if not project_id or not lane or not session_id:
2143             return
2144         # reports-links W3: a SHELL runner session has no model transcript to
2145         # summarize — the summarize-on-finish hook no-ops for it.
2146         try:
2147             _rec = _sessreg.get_session(session_id)
2148         except Exception:
2149             _rec = None
2150         if _rec is not None and ((_rec.get("backend") or "") == \
2151                 getattr(_sessreg, "BACKEND_SHELL", "shell") or _rec.get("plain")):
2152             return
2153         proj = _rnd.get_project(project_id)
2154         if proj is None:
2155             return
2156         folder = proj.get("folder_path", "")
2157         if not folder:
2158             return
2159         store_lane = _eh._resolve_subdir(lane)
2160         # Idempotent: a session that already has a cache is left alone (the
2161         # summarizer would no-op it too, but skip the thread spin-up entirely).
2162         try:
2163             if _summarizer.load_cached(folder, project_id, store_lane,
2164                                        session_id) is not None:
2165                 return
2166         except Exception:
2167             pass
2168         # v8 Wave 5 — TIE the finished managed session to the docs it PRODUCED.
2169         # The Wave-2 keystone persists those docs tagged with this session_id, so
2170         # the durable summary keyed to the managed id seeds skill/prompts/actions
2171         # off the REAL produced docs (no-loss), not an empty record.
2172         session = _resolve_finished_session(folder, project_id, lane, session_id)
2173         if session is None:
2174             # The session produced no resolvable docs (e.g. nothing was written)
2175             # — seed a minimal record off the registry so the summarizer still has
2176             # a session_id/title to key the (honest, empty) cache to.
2177             session = {"session_id": session_id}
2178         _trigger_session_summary(folder, project_id, lane, session)
2179     except Exception:
2180         pass
2181

2183 def _auto_push_on_finish(project_id):
2184     """Best-effort: auto-push the project's repo when a session reaches a terminal
2185     state (v8 Wave 3 — wired into the kill/finish path AFTER the produced docs are
2186     persisted/committed by Wave 2's capture-before-reap).
2187 
2188     Delegates to :func:`project_remote.auto_push_if_opted`, which pushes ONLY when
2189     the project is BOTH linked to a remote AND opted-in to auto-push. A non-linked
2190     or non-opted project never pushes. NON-BLOCKING + never raises — any failure is
2191     swallowed so it can never delay or break the finish response. In tests the
2192     configured ``origin`` is a LOCAL BARE repo (``file://``) so there is NO network.
2193     """
2194     try:
2195         if not project_id:
2196             return
2197         _remote.auto_push_if_opted(project_id)
2198     except Exception:
2199         pass

2202 #: Max chars of prior-session context folded into a continue-live seed (bounded).
2203 _MAX_CONTINUE_SEED_CHARS = 4000
2204 
2205 
2206 #: Trio/store lane → the trio skill a resumed effort should load (W3 #6 backend).
2207 _RESUME_LANE_SKILL = {
2208     "research": "researchPrime",
2209     "plan": "Crucible",
2210     "planning": "Crucible",
2211     "build": "Foreman",
2212 }
2213 
2214 
2215 def _resume_skill_for_lane(lane: str) -> str:
2216     """The trio skill a resumed effort in ``lane`` should load (W3 #6 backend).
2217 
2218     Maps a trio/store lane to its skill — research→researchPrime, plan→Crucible,
2219     build→Foreman. Returns ``""`` for an unknown lane (honest — no skill claimed).
2220     """
2221     return _RESUME_LANE_SKILL.get((lane or "").strip(), "")
2222 
2223 
2224 def _detect_resume_phase(store_lane: str, doc_rels) -> str:
2225     """Detect the phase a discovered effort is at from its on-disk docs (W3 #6).
2226 
2227     Reads only the document filenames (NO model call) and returns a human phase
2228     label so a synthesized resume seed orients the turn:
2229 
2230       - planning: an IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN → ``"implementation plan (Stage 2)"``; a
2231         MASTER-PLAN → ``"master plan (Stage 1)"``; a NORTH-STAR → ``"intake /
2232         North Star (Stage 0)"``; else ``"planning"``.
2233       - build: an EXECUTION-LOG present → ``"build in progress"``; else ``"build"``.
2234       - research: ``"research investigation"``.
2235 
2236     Falls back to the store-lane name for an unknown lane. Never raises.
2237     """
2238     blob = " ".join(str(r or "").upper().replace("\\", "/")
2239                     for r in (doc_rels or []))
2240     sl = (store_lane or "").strip()
2241     if sl == "planning":
2242         if "IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN" in blob:
2243             return "implementation plan (Stage 2)"
2244         if "MASTER-PLAN" in blob:
2245             return "master plan (Stage 1)"
2246         if "NORTH-STAR" in blob:
2247             return "intake / North Star (Stage 0)"
2248         return "planning"
2249     if sl == "build":
2250         if "EXECUTION-LOG" in blob:
2251             return "build in progress"
2252         return "build"
2253     if sl == "research":
2254         return "research investigation"
2255     return sl or "work"
2256 
2257 
2258 def _synthesize_discovered_seed(lane, store_lane, members):
2259     """Synthesize a resume seed for a DISCOVERED/brownfield effort (W3 #6 backend).
2260 
2261     When a discovered effort has NO registry record and NO cached summary, the
2262     seed is built from the documents on disk so the resumed turn opens WARM, not
2263     cold: the detected phase, the trio skill to load, and the enumerated document
2264     list. Returns a list of seed-text blocks (the caller appends them to the seed
2265     ``parts``); ``[]`` when there are no documents to synthesize from.
2266     """
2267     docs = []
2268     for m in members or []:
2269         rel = (m.get("artifact_path") or "").strip().replace("\\", "/")
2270         if not rel:
2271             continue
2272         docs.append((rel, (m.get("title") or "").strip()))
2273     if not docs:
2274         return []
2275     skill = _resume_skill_for_lane(lane) or _resume_skill_for_lane(store_lane)
2276     phase = _detect_resume_phase(store_lane, [r for r, _ in docs])
2277     blocks = ["Lane: " + str(lane) + " · Phase: " + phase]
2278     if skill:
2279         blocks.append("Skill to load: " + skill)
2280     doc_lines = ["Documents on disk (read these first to recover context):"]
2281     for rel, title in docs:
2282         doc_lines.append("- " + rel + ((" — " + title) if title else ""))
2283     blocks.append("\n".join(doc_lines))
2284     blocks.append(
2285         "Read the documents listed above to recover the full context, then load "
2286         "the " + (skill or "appropriate trio") + " skill and continue the "
2287         + phase + " work where it left off.")
2288     return blocks
2289 
2290 
2291 def _build_continue_seed(folder_path, project_id, lane, source_session_id):
2292     """Build the seed_context text for "Continue in a live session" (v5 Wave 2).
2293 
2294     READ-ONLY: resolves the prior (done/historical) session and assembles a
2295     compact context string from its CACHED summary, preferring (in order):
2296 
2297       1. the cached summary's rendered markdown (``markdown``), else
2298       2. a deterministic digest of the cached summary's structured fields
2299          (skill · what-was-asked · north-star · prompts · files produced), else
2300       3. the live session record's intent (``what_was_asked`` / ``title``).
2301 
2302     NEVER mutates the original session/summary (Risk R2) — every access is a read.
2303     Returns a bounded string (or ``""`` when nothing resolves, in which case the
2304     new session is started bare-seeded with just the lane skill). Stdlib only;
2305     never raises.
2306     """
2307     store_lane = _eh._resolve_subdir(lane)
2308     cached = None
2309     try:
2310         cached = _summarizer.load_cached(folder_path, project_id, store_lane,
2311                                          source_session_id)
2312     except Exception:
2313         cached = None
2314 
2315     parts = ["This is a continuation of an earlier session in the "
2316              + str(lane) + " lane. Here is its summary so you can pick up the "
2317              "work:"]
2318     if isinstance(cached, dict):
2319         md = (cached.get("markdown") or "").strip()
2320         if md:
2321             parts.append(md)
2322         else:
2323             skill = (cached.get("skill") or "").strip()
2324             if skill:
2325                 parts.append("Skill: " + skill)
2326             asked = (cached.get("what_was_asked") or "").strip()
2327             if asked:
2328                 parts.append("Originally asked: " + asked)
2329             ns = (cached.get("north_star") or "").strip()
2330             if ns:
2331                 parts.append("North Star: " + ns)
2332             prompts = cached.get("prompts") or []
2333             if prompts:
2334                 parts.append("Prompts asked: "
2335                              + " | ".join(str(p) for p in prompts))
2336             actions = cached.get("actions") or []
2337             labels = []
2338             for a in actions:
2339                 if isinstance(a, dict):
2340                     lbl = (a.get("label") or a.get("rel")
2341                            or a.get("job_id") or "").strip()
2342                 else:
2343                     lbl = str(a).strip()
2344                 if lbl:
2345                     labels.append(lbl)
2346             if labels:
2347                 parts.append("Files produced: " + ", ".join(labels))
2348     else:
2349         # No cached summary. Resolve the source session from disk. For a
2350         # DISCOVERED/brownfield effort (no registry record AND no cached summary),
2351         # SYNTHESIZE an orienting seed from the documents on disk — the detected
2352         # phase, the trio skill to load, and the enumerated document list (W3 #6
2353         # backend) — so the resumed turn opens WARM, not cold. Otherwise fall back
2354         # to the session record's bare intent (its title).
2355         session = None
2356         try:
2357             for s in _sessions.list_sessions(folder_path, project_id, lane):
2358                 if s.get("session_id") == source_session_id:
2359                     session = s
2360                     break
2361         except Exception:
2362             session = None
2363         if session:
2364             members = session.get("member_files", []) or []
2365             discovered = bool(members) and all(
2366                 _eh.is_discovered(m) for m in members)
2367             synth = []
2368             if discovered:
2369                 try:
2370                     synth = _synthesize_discovered_seed(
2371                         lane, store_lane, members)
2372                 except Exception:
2373                     synth = []
2374             if synth:
2375                 # Replace the generic "here is its summary" lead-in with a
2376                 # discovered-specific one — there is genuinely no prior session
2377                 # summary; the context below is synthesized from on-disk docs.
2378                 parts[0] = ("This is a brownfield/discovered effort in the "
2379                             + str(lane) + " lane being resumed as a live "
2380                             "session. There is no prior Anchor session summary, "
2381                             "so this orienting context is synthesized from the "
2382                             "documents already on disk:")
2383                 parts.extend(synth)
2384             else:
2385                 asked = (session.get("title") or "").strip()
2386                 if asked:
2387                     parts.append("Originally: " + asked)
2388 
2389     text = "\n\n".join(p for p in parts if p and p.strip()).strip()
2390     # If we never resolved any real prior context (only the lead-in line), return
2391     # empty so the new session is started bare-seeded (just the lane skill).
2392     if len(parts) <= 1:
2393         return ""
2394     return text[:_MAX_CONTINUE_SEED_CHARS]
2395 
2396 
2397 def _trigger_project_session_summaries(folder_path, project_id):
2398     """Proactively generate summaries for all of a project's sessions lacking a
2399     cache (Wave 6) — bounded, background, gated like the project-summary trigger.
2400 
2401     Walks each trio lane's sessions (skipping the defensive ``loose::`` wrappers),
2402     and for any session WITHOUT a cached summary kicks off a background
2403     generation. No-op unless ``_PROACTIVE_SUMMARY_ENABLED``. Best-effort: any
2404     error per lane/session is swallowed so a rescan is never blocked or broken.
2405     """
2406     if not _PROACTIVE_SUMMARY_ENABLED:
2407         return
2408     try:
2409         # Exclude grass (workbench-only) AND general (bare terminals — proactively
2410         # summarizing the many ad-hoc general sessions would add needless
2411         # background load; the general tile shows its label without a cached blurb).
2412         lanes = [c[0] for c in _KANBAN_COLUMNS if c[0] not in ("grass", "general")]
2413     except Exception:
2414         lanes = ["research", "plan", "build", "deliverables"]
2415     for trio_lane in lanes:
2416         try:
2417             sess_list = _sessions.list_sessions(folder_path, project_id, trio_lane)
2418         except Exception:
2419             continue
2420         for s in sess_list:
2421             sid = (s.get("session_id") or "")
2422             if not sid or sid.startswith("loose::"):
2423                 continue
2424             store_lane = _eh._resolve_subdir(trio_lane)
2425             try:
2426                 if _summarizer.load_cached(folder_path, project_id, store_lane,
2427                                            sid) is not None:
2428                     continue
2429             except Exception:
2430                 pass
2431             _trigger_session_summary(folder_path, project_id, trio_lane, s)
2432

2434 def render_status_line_html(project_id: str) -> str:
2435     """Render the per-lane SESSION summary line (Research/Planning/Build/Deliv).
2436 
2437     Wave 3 contract: ``rnd_registry.status_line`` returns per-lane counts +
2438     provenance, so the line reads e.g.
2439     ``Research: 1 · Planning: 2 (1 imported) · Build: 1 · Deliverables: 1`` —
2440     a lane with sessions NEVER renders as ``import`` or ``none-yet``. A lane with
2441     zero sessions shows a dimmed ``0``; an imported count adds a small
2442     ``(N imported)`` provenance chip; a live job adds ``• N running``.
2443     """
2444     line = _rnd.status_line(project_id)
2445     chips = []
2446     for lane in _rnd.STATUS_LANES:
2447         counts = line.get(lane) or {}
2448         n = int(counts.get("count", 0) or 0)
2449         n_imp = int(counts.get("imported", 0) or 0)
2450         n_run = int(counts.get("running", 0) or 0)
2451         label = lane.capitalize()
2452         prov = (f' <span class="rnd-imported">({n_imp} imported)</span>'
2453                 if n_imp else '')
2454         run = (f' <span class="rnd-running">&bull; {n_run} running</span>'
2455                if n_run else '')
2456         dim = ' rnd-lane-empty' if n == 0 else ''
2457         chips.append(
2458             f'<span class="rnd-lane{dim}">'
2459             f'{html_lib.escape(label)}: {n}{prov}{run}</span>'
2460         )
2461     return '<div class="rnd-status-line">' + "".join(chips) + "</div>"
2462

2464 def _project_summary_text(entry: dict) -> tuple:
2465     """Return ``(summary_text, source)`` for a project's thin-row summary.
2466 
2467     Wave 5 (v3): the row's summary is the accurate CACHED project summary when
2468     present (``summarizer.load_cached_project`` — read-only, NEVER runs the model
2469     on the render path), else the existing blurb (seeded once from CLAUDE.md/
2470     README/Anchor.md), else "". ``source`` is ``"summary"`` | ``"blurb"`` | ``""``.
2471     """
2472     pid_raw = entry.get("id", "")
2473     folder = entry.get("folder_path", "")
2474     # 1. Cached project summary (read-only — no model run on the render path).
2475     if folder:
2476         try:
2477             cached = _summarizer.load_cached_project(folder, pid_raw)
2478             if cached:
2479                 txt = (cached.get("summary_text") or "").strip()
2480                 if txt:
2481                     # v7 Wave 1: normalize the cached summary to a clean, capped
2482                     # plain-text short line for the row (strip markdown/glyphs).
2483                     return _summarizer.short_summary_text(txt), "summary"
2484         except Exception:
2485             pass
2486     # 2. Fall back to the blurb (seed once if empty).
2487     blurb = entry.get("blurb", "") or ""
2488     if not blurb.strip():
2489         try:
2490             seeded = _rnd.seed_blurb(pid_raw)
2491             if seeded:
2492                 blurb = seeded.get("blurb", "") or ""
2493         except Exception:
2494             pass
2495     if blurb.strip():
2496         return blurb.strip(), "blurb"
2497     return "", ""
2498

2500 def _project_status_dot(entry: dict, status_line: dict, registry_running: int = 0) -> str:
2501     """Pick the row's status-dot class (kept simple + documented, Wave 5).
2502 
2503     Mapping: green if ANY lane has a running session; for inactive projects
2504     (archived/future/retired) a dimmed grey; otherwise a neutral idle grey. The
2505     dot is purely advisory (the per-lane mini-counts carry the detail).
2506 
2507     v10.1 FIX 3 — ``status_line.running`` counts ONLY effort-history/job_runner
2508     sessions; a live MANAGED terminal/ConPTY session registers in
2509     ``session_registry`` as RUNNING with NO job_runner record, so it left the dot
2510     grey. ``registry_running`` (the count from the SAME registry read the
2511     activity line already does, ZERO new rnd_jobs/ scans) greens the dot when any
2512     managed session is running. (A running general/grass managed session greens
2513     the dot too — a defensible "is anything running" signal.)"""
2514     state = entry.get("state", "active")
2515     if state in ("archived", "future", "retired"):
2516         return "rnd-dot-idle"
2517     try:
2518         if int(registry_running or 0) > 0:
2519             return "rnd-dot-running"
2520         if any(int((status_line.get(l) or {}).get("running", 0) or 0) > 0
2521                for l in status_line):
2522             return "rnd-dot-running"
2523     except Exception:
2524         pass
2525     return "rnd-dot-idle"
2526

2528 # Map a registry session status → the locked status-light color word, mirroring

2530 # four colors). Used by the home-row "what's happening" line (Wave 7).
2531 _SESSION_STATUS_COLOR = {

2538     # reopenable tile (like idle); a reaped orphan is a spent grey tile.
2539     _sessreg.STATUS_PARKED_WARM: "grey",
2540     _sessreg.STATUS_REAPED_ORPHAN: "grey",

2544 def _project_activity_reflection(pid_raw: str) -> dict:
2545     """Return a CACHE/REGISTRY-only activity reflection for a home-dashboard row
2546     (v6 Wave 7). Reads ONLY ``session_registry`` (no model call, no PTY) so it is
2547     safe on the render path.
2548 
2549     Returns ``{running: int, latest: {lane, label, status, color, age} | None}``:
2550     - ``running`` — how many of the project's managed sessions are RUNNING;
2551     - ``latest`` — the newest session (by ``created_at``) with a human label, its
2552       lane, status, status-color word, and a compact age — for the "latest:
2553       planning · Crucible pipeline plan (running)" line. ``None`` when the
2554       project has no managed sessions at all (honest — never fabricated).
2555     Never raises (a registry hiccup degrades to ``{running:0, latest:None}``).
2556     """
2557     out = {"running": 0, "latest": None}
2558     try:
2559         sessions = _sessreg.list_sessions(project_id=pid_raw)
2560     except Exception:
2561         return out
2562     if not sessions:
2563         return out
2564     out["running"] = sum(1 for s in sessions
2565                          if s.get("status") == _sessreg.STATUS_RUNNING)
2566     # list_sessions is already newest-first by created_at, so [0] is the newest.
2567     newest = sessions[0]
2568     lane = (newest.get("lane") or "").strip()
2569     status = (newest.get("status") or _sessreg.STATUS_IDLE).strip()
2570     # A friendly title: the session's own label if it set one, else the lane name.
2571     label = (newest.get("label") or "").strip() or (lane.capitalize() or "session")
2572     # v12 W10 — the EFFORT's current_stage (research/plan/build) is the truthful
2573     # "where this effort is" signal (the lane flips as an effort advances, but it
2574     # always reflects the most-advanced stage). Prefer it for the home-row line;
2575     # fall back to the lane when this is not a v12 effort. Cache/registry-only.
2576     stage = (newest.get("current_stage") or "").strip()
2577     out["latest"] = {
2578         "lane": lane,
2579         "stage": stage,
2580         "label": label,
2581         "status": status,
2582         "color": _SESSION_STATUS_COLOR.get(status, "grey"),
2583         "age": _fmt_age(newest.get("created_at")),
2584     }
2585     return out
2586

2588 def _render_activity_reflection_html(refl: dict) -> str:
2589     """Render the per-row activity-reflection block (v6 Wave 7): a running
2590     indicator/count + a "what's happening" latest-session line. Honest empty
2591     state ("idle — no sessions") when the project has none. Pure formatting of
2592     the cache/registry-sourced ``refl`` dict; never runs the model."""
2593     running = int(refl.get("running", 0) or 0)
2594     latest = refl.get("latest")
2595     parts = []
2596     if running > 0:
2597         # A live indicator (the pulsing dot CSS) + the count.
2598         parts.append(
2599             f'<span class="rnd-act-running" title="live sessions">'
2600             f'<span class="rnd-act-pulse" aria-hidden="true"></span>'
2601             f'running: {running}</span>'
2602         )
2603     if latest:
2604         lane = latest.get("lane") or ""
2605         # v12 W10 — show the effort's current_stage when present (research/plan/
2606         # build), else the lane (honest fallback for non-effort sessions).
2607         stage = (latest.get("stage") or "").strip()
2608         lane_lbl = html_lib.escape(
2609             (stage or lane).capitalize() or "session")
2610         title = html_lib.escape(latest.get("label") or "")
2611         status = html_lib.escape(latest.get("status") or "")
2612         color = html_lib.escape(latest.get("color") or "grey")
2613         age = html_lib.escape(latest.get("age") or "")
2614         age_txt = f' · {age}' if age else ""
2615         # (2026-09-05, John) the lane's skill mark rides the project list line
2616         _lane_icon = {"research": "research-prime-icon.jpg", "plan": "crucible-icon.svg",
2617                       "planning": "crucible-icon.svg", "build": "foreman-icon.svg",
2618                       "gandalf": "gandalf-icon.jpg"}.get((stage or lane).lower(), "")
2619         if not _lane_icon and "gandalf" in (latest.get("label") or "").lower():
2620             _lane_icon = "gandalf-icon.jpg"
2621         lane_mark = (f'<img class="skico" src="/vendor/brand/{_lane_icon}" alt="" '
2622                      f'style="width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:4px;object-fit:cover;'
2623                      f'vertical-align:-3px;margin-right:4px">' if _lane_icon else "")
2624         parts.append(
2625             f'<span class="rnd-act-latest">latest: '
2626             f'{lane_mark}<span class="rnd-act-lane">{lane_lbl}</span> · '
2627             f'<span class="rnd-act-title">{title}</span> '
2628             f'<span class="rnd-act-status rnd-act-{color}">'
2629             f'({status})</span>{age_txt}</span>'
2630         )
2631     if not parts:
2632         # Honest placeholder — never fabricate activity.
2633         parts.append('<span class="rnd-act-latest rnd-dim">'
2634                      'idle — no sessions yet</span>')
2635     return '<div class="rnd-row-activity">' + "".join(parts) + "</div>"

2638 def _steward_status_tile_line(entry: dict, summary=None, age=None) -> str:
2639     """The cockpit's persisted 10-minute status for a project row (steward
2640     cutover 2026-08-25): ONE targeted stat+read of
2641     ``<folder>/.ecgberht/status-summary.json`` — the universal file the
2642     steward engine's cadence writes — so peeking at the dashboard shows the
2643     10-minute summary without opening the project. Zero scans (the GET /
2644     perf invariant holds), honest empty when the project has no cockpit
2645     campaign; after 15 minutes the row names the status as stale instead of
2646     replaying yesterday's activity as current truth."""
2647     folder = (entry.get("folder_path") or "").strip()
2648     if not folder:
2649         return ""
2650     if isinstance(summary, dict) and age is not None:
2651         # W1a (High Seat, 2026-09-26): the page read this file once already (home_rows)
2652         age_seconds, data = float(age), summary
2653     else:
2654         f = Path(folder) / ".ecgberht" / "status-summary.json"
2655         try:
2656             age_seconds = time.time() - f.stat().st_mtime
2657             data = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
2658         except Exception:
2659             return ""
2660     if age_seconds > 900:
2661         return "steward status stale · last update %d minutes ago" % max(
2662             15, int(age_seconds // 60))
2663     if not isinstance(data, dict):
2664         return ""
2665     now_lines = [str(x).strip() for x in (data.get("now") or []) if str(x).strip()]
2666     plan = data.get("plan") or {}
2667     from steward_cockpit.steward_campaign import lead_line   # the ONE lead template (pane, top bar, tile)
2668     lead = lead_line(plan)
2669     if str(plan.get("next") or "").strip():
2670         return ("⏱ %s · %s" % (str(data.get("at", ""))[-5:], lead))[:200]
2671     # Same concise facts the cockpit status pane shows. Fall back to the older
2672     # running/slice/wait join when a record predates the facts list.
2673     facts = (data.get("compact") or {}).get("facts") if isinstance(data.get("compact"), dict) else None
2674     bits = []
2675     if isinstance(facts, list) and facts:
2676         wanted = ("Doing", "Status", "To do", "Blocker")
2677         for fact in facts:
2678             if not isinstance(fact, dict):
2679                 continue
2680             label = str(fact.get("label") or "")
2681             value = str(fact.get("value") or "").strip()
2682             if label in wanted and value and value not in ("—", "none"):
2683                 bits.append(value)
2684     if not bits:
2685         run = data.get("running") or {}
2686         sl = data.get("slice") or {}
2687         if str(run.get("label") or "").strip():
2688             bits.append(str(run["label"]).strip())
2689         elif now_lines:
2690             bits.append(now_lines[0])
2691         if str(sl.get("name") or "").strip():
2692             bits.append("slice %s/%s · %s" % (sl.get("n", "?"), sl.get("total", "?"),
2693                                               str(sl["name"]).strip()))
2694         else:
2695             step = str(plan.get("step") or "").strip()
2696             if step and step != "(no active step)":
2697                 bits.append("step %s/%s · %s" % (plan.get("steps_done", 0),
2698                                                  plan.get("steps_total", 0), step))
2699         wait = str(plan.get("waiting_on_you") or "").strip()
2700         if wait:
2701             bits.append("waiting on you: " + wait)
2702         eta = str(data.get("eta") or "").strip()
2703         if eta:
2704             bits.append("ETA " + eta)
2705     if not bits:
2706         return ""
2707     return ("⏱ %s · %s" % (str(data.get("at", ""))[-5:],
2708                             " · ".join(bits)))[:200]
2709 
2710 
2711 def render_project_tile_html(entry: dict, facts=None, chrome: bool = True) -> str:
2712     """Render a THIN, full-width project ROW (v3 Wave 5, IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN
2713     lines 124-141): ``name · accurate cached project summary · per-lane
2714     mini-counts · status dot``. Clicking the row opens the project window;
2715     lifecycle controls (P1/P2, rescan, blurb, notes, archive/retire/reactivate)
2716     moved OFF the row into a kebab/hover menu so the row stays one line. This
2717     REPLACES the old square ``.rnd-tile``.
2718 
2719     ``chrome=False`` (the High Seat's Projects tile, 2026-09-27) leaves off the
2720     pieces that need this page's script — the kebab menu, the cost rollup, the
2721     boneyard button, the drag grip and ``draggable`` — the row is then the
2722     look and the click only."""
2723     pid_raw = entry.get("id", "")
2724     pid = html_lib.escape(pid_raw)
2725     name = html_lib.escape(entry.get("name", ""))
2726     pr = entry.get("priority", 2)
2727     state = html_lib.escape(entry.get("state", "active"))
2728     notes = entry.get("notes", "") or ""
2729     notes_attr = html_lib.escape(notes, quote=True)
2730     folder = entry.get("folder_path", "")
2731 
2732     # Row summary text: cached project summary, else blurb (read-only path).
2733     summary_text, _src = _project_summary_text(entry)
2734     summary_attr = html_lib.escape(summary_text, quote=True)
2735     summary_block = (f'<span class="rnd-row-summary" title="{summary_attr}">'
2736                      f'{html_lib.escape(summary_text)}</span>'
2737                      if summary_text else
2738                      '<span class="rnd-row-summary rnd-dim">No summary yet</span>')
2739     # data-blurb keeps the kebab "Blurb" prompt seeded with the editable blurb.
2740     blurb = entry.get("blurb", "") or ""
2741     blurb_attr = html_lib.escape(blurb, quote=True)
2742 
2743     # v6 Wave 7 — timely activity reflection (running count + newest-session
2744     # "what's happening" line), sourced from the session registry ONLY (no model
2745     # call on the render path). Honest "idle — no sessions yet" placeholder when
2746     # the project has none.
2747     # v10.1 FIX 3 — capture the reflection ONCE (it carries the registry running
2748     # count) so the status dot can reuse it (the SAME single registry read; ZERO
2749     # new rnd_jobs/ scans, GET / perf invariant holds).
2750     refl = _project_activity_reflection(pid_raw)
2751     activity_block = _render_activity_reflection_html(refl)
2752 
2753     # Steward cutover 2026-08-25 — the cockpit's persisted 10-minute status
2754     # rides the home row (one targeted read; '' when absent/stale).
2755     # W1a (High Seat, 2026-09-26): the row's facts come from ONE pass over the records for the whole
2756     # page (home_rows.all_project_facts, handed in); a lone row (the refresh route) reads its own.
2757     import home_rows as _hr
2758     try:
2759         _facts = facts if isinstance(facts, dict) else _hr.project_facts(entry)
2760     except Exception:
2761         _facts = {}
2762     _stw_line = _steward_status_tile_line(entry, summary=_facts.get("summary"), age=_facts.get("summary_age_s"))
2763     if not _stw_line and _facts.get("next"):
2764         # probe 3 — a named project's next step, from the strip when no status line was persisted
2765         _stw_line = ("next: " + str(_facts["next"]) + ((" — " + str(_facts["why"])) if _facts.get("why") else ""))[:160]
2766     steward_block = (
2767         f'<span class="rnd-row-steward" '
2768         f'title="{html_lib.escape(_stw_line, quote=True)}">'
2769         f'{html_lib.escape(_stw_line)}</span>'
2770     ) if _stw_line else ""
2771 
2772     # W1a (High Seat, 2026-09-26): the nearest dated open step rides the row — one roadmap read,
2773     # the same fact the rail's rows are raised from; nothing when no step carries a date.
2774     due_block = ""
2775     try:
2776         if _facts.get("dated"):
2777             _d = _facts["dated"][0]
2778             _lab = _hr.due_label(_d["due"])
2779             due_block = (f'<span class="rnd-row-due" title="{html_lib.escape(_d["name"], quote=True)}" '
2780                          f'style="color:{"#f0b35b" if _lab.startswith("overdue") or _lab == "due today" else "var(--faint,#8b93a7)"};'
2781                          f'font-size:11.5px;white-space:nowrap;margin-left:6px">'
2782                          f'&middot; {html_lib.escape(_lab)}</span>')
2783     except Exception:
2784         due_block = ""
2785     # Per-lane mini-counts (compact form of the status line) + status dot.
2786     status = render_status_line_html(pid_raw)
2787     try:
2788         sline = _rnd.status_line(pid_raw)
2789     except Exception:
2790         sline = {}
2791     # v10.1 FIX 3 — pass the registry running count so a live MANAGED terminal
2792     # session (no job_runner record → status_line.running == 0) still greens the
2793     # home-row dot.
2794     dot_cls = _project_status_dot(
2795         entry, sline, registry_running=int(refl.get("running", 0) or 0))
2796 
2797     # Per-row cost/tokens/time rollup (v4 Wave 8, MASTER-PLAN cockpit dashboard
2798     # rows). Reuses the Wave-3 `effort_history.project_effort_rollup` (RUN-session
2799     # totals only — imported/discovered contribute 0, never fabricated) and the
2800     # shared `_fmt_rollup_line` formatter. Rendered at LIFETIME by default; the
2801     # R&D view's single global lifetime/30-day toggle (rndRowsRollupWindow) swaps
2802     # every row's text in place via the read-only `/api/rnd/project_rollup`
2803     # endpoint, so a no-JS view still shows lifetime totals. Never raises.
2804     rate = {}
2805     try:
2806         rate = _rollhon.project_capture_rate(pid_raw, window="lifetime") or {}
2807     except Exception:
2808         rate = {}
2809     try:
2810         roll = _eh.project_effort_rollup(pid_raw, window=_eh.WINDOW_LIFETIME)
2811     except Exception:
2812         roll = {"tokens": 0, "cost_usd": 0.0, "wall_clock_ms": 0, "sessions": 0}
2813     live_n = _live_session_count(pid_raw)
2814     try:
2815         roll_txt = html_lib.escape(
2816             _fmt_project_usage_line(roll, rate=rate, live_count=live_n,
2817                                     project_id=pid_raw))
2818     except Exception:
2819         roll_txt = html_lib.escape("Σ no run sessions yet")
2820     # Honesty stamp: measured vs unmeasured (incl. Grok wall-clock-only).
2821     cap_note = ""
2822     try:
2823         if int(rate.get("total", 0) or 0) > 0:
2824             cap_note = " · " + html_lib.escape(
2825                 _rollhon.capture_rate_text(rate)
2826                 if hasattr(_rollhon, "capture_rate_text")
2827                 else _fmt_capture_rate_short(rate))
2828     except Exception:
2829         cap_note = ""
2830     rollup_block = (
2831         f'<span class="rnd-row-roll" data-pid="{pid}" data-window="lifetime" '
2832         f'title="Run-session costs stay separate from steward cockpit usage. '
2833         f'ChatGPT/Grok subscription turns have no per-turn dollar amount; '
2834         f'token updates alone do not increase a reported subtotal."'
2835         f'>{roll_txt}{cap_note}</span>'
2836     )
2837 
2838     is_active = state in ("active", "path-missing")
2839     rescan_btn = (f'<button class="rnd-mini" onclick="rndRescan(\'{pid}\')" '
2840                   f'title="Re-scan the folder for trio artifacts">Rescan</button>')
2841     if is_active:
2842         lifecycle = (
2843             f'{rescan_btn}'
2844             f'<button class="rnd-mini" onclick="rndBlurb(\'{pid}\')" title="Edit blurb (what this project is)">Blurb</button>'
2845             f'<button class="rnd-mini" onclick="rndNotes(\'{pid}\')" title="Edit notes">Notes</button>'
2846         )
2847     else:
2848         lifecycle = (
2849             f'<button class="rnd-mini rnd-accent" onclick="rndReactivate(\'{pid}\')" title="Make active again">Reactivate</button>'
2850             f'{rescan_btn}'
2851             f'<button class="rnd-mini" onclick="rndBlurb(\'{pid}\')" title="Edit blurb (what this project is)">Blurb</button>'
2852             f'<button class="rnd-mini" onclick="rndNotes(\'{pid}\')" title="Edit notes">Notes</button>'
2853         )
2854     # (2026-09-03, John) the gravestone at the END of every project row under
2855     # the steward's seal: an active project retires to the Archive view (kept,
2856     # reviewable — nothing deleted); a resting one offers the way back.
2857     if is_active:
2858         grave = (f'<button class="rnd-mini rnd-grave" '
2859                  f'onclick="event.stopPropagation();rndArchive(\'{pid}\')" '
2860                  f'title="Retire this project to the archive (boneyard) — reactivate any time">'
2861                  f'&#129702;</button>')
2862     else:
2863         grave = (f'<button class="rnd-mini rnd-accent rnd-grave" '
2864                  f'onclick="event.stopPropagation();rndReactivate(\'{pid}\')" '
2865                  f'title="Resurrect: make this project active again">resurrect</button>')
2866     # Kebab menu holds all lifecycle controls so the row stays thin. The row
2867     # itself (click anywhere not on the kebab) opens the project window.
2868     kebab = "" if not chrome else (
2869         f'<div class="rnd-kebab" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">'
2870         f'<button class="rnd-kebab-btn" onclick="rndToggleKebab(event,\'{pid}\')" '
2871         f'title="Project actions" aria-label="Project actions">&#8942;</button>'
2872         f'<div class="rnd-kebab-menu" id="rnd-kebab-{pid}">'
2873         f'{lifecycle}'
2874         f'</div>'
2875         f'</div>'
2876     )
2877     # v9 Wave 3 — drag-to-group: the row is draggable and carries its current
2878     # group so the drag handlers can call /api/rnd/set_group (dashboard-only; NO
2879     # disk move). The ⋮⋮ grip is the drag affordance. The on-disk folder path is
2880     # deliberately NOT stamped on the row (it lives on the project-window header;
2881     # the v8 no-path-on-dashboard invariant holds — the Wave-4 move dialog reads
2882     # the path server-side, not from the row).
2883     group = entry.get("group", "") or ""
2884     group_attr = html_lib.escape(group, quote=True)
2885     if not chrome:   # no script for them on the High Seat: the kebab (above), the rollup, the boneyard button, the drag
2886         grave = rollup_block = ""
2887     drag_attr = 'draggable="true" ' if chrome else ''
2888     grip = ('<span class="rnd-grip" aria-hidden="true" '
2889             'title="Drag into a folder">&#8942;&#8942;</span>') if chrome else ''
2890     return (
2891         f'<div class="rnd-row" data-project-id="{pid}" data-notes="{notes_attr}" '
2892         f'data-blurb="{blurb_attr}" data-group="{group_attr}" '
2893         f'{drag_attr}tabindex="0" role="button" '
2894         f'onclick="openProjectWindow(\'{pid}\')" '
2895         f'title="Open {name}">'
2896         f'{grip}'
2897         f'<span class="rnd-dot {dot_cls}" aria-hidden="true"></span>'
2898         # setup / read status slot (2026-08-27): the bulk badge poll writes
2899         # here, so a freshly created project says what it is doing instead of
2900         # sitting blank — the silence that produced duplicate "Create" clicks
2901         f'<span class="gandalf-card-status" hidden aria-live="polite">'
2902         f'<span class="gcs-spin"></span><span class="gcs-text"></span></span>'
2903         f'<img class="rnd-seal-ico" src="{_steward_seal_icon_src()}" alt="" '
2904         f'onerror="this.style.display=\'none\'" />'
2905         f'<span class="rnd-name">{name}</span>'
2906         f'<span class="rnd-badge rnd-state-{state}">{state}</span>'
2907         f'{summary_block}'
2908         f'{activity_block}'
2909         f'{steward_block}'
2910         f'{due_block}'
2911         f'<span class="rnd-row-counts">{status}</span>'
2912         f'{rollup_block}'
2913         f'{grave}'
2914         f'{kebab}'
2915         f'</div>'
2916     )

2919 def _home_grass_tile_html() -> str:
2920     """Render the canonical Dashboard Grasscatcher on the home page.
2921 
2922     The home request reads only ``__dashboard__``'s dedicated effort-history
2923     store.  It must not rediscover every Steward effort in the workspace as an
2924     empty-state fallback: that is a second source of truth and makes first paint
2925     proportional to the number of sibling directories.
2926     """
2927     ideas = []
2928     try:
2929         # ``__dashboard__`` is a synthetic project returned by ``get_project``;
2930         # it is deliberately absent from ``list_projects``.  Looking for it in
2931         # the registry therefore made the home tile permanently empty even when
2932         # the workspace Grasscatcher contained ideas.
2933         e = _rnd.get_project("__dashboard__") or {}
2934         pid = e.get("id") or ""
2935         folder = e.get("folder_path") or ""
2936         if pid and folder:
2937             ideas = _eh.grass_workbench_data(folder, pid) or []
2938     except Exception:
2939         ideas = []
2940     rows = []
2941     for i in ideas[:40]:
2942         title = html_lib.escape(str(i.get("title") or i.get("text") or "(untitled)"))
2943         when = html_lib.escape(str(i.get("when") or i.get("created_at") or ""))
2944         src = html_lib.escape(str(i.get("source") or i.get("status") or ""))
2945         rows.append(
2946             f'<div class="grass-home-row">'
2947             f'<span class="gh-when">{when}</span>'
2948             f'<span class="gh-text">{title}</span>'
2949             f'<span class="gh-src">{src}</span></div>'
2950         )
2951     body = "".join(rows) if rows else (
2952         '<div class="empty-msg">Nothing caught yet — say “later: …” in a session.</div>'
2953     )
2954     n = len(ideas)
2955     return (
2956         f'<details class="dash-tile" id="tile-grass">'
2957         f'<summary><span class="tile-glyph" aria-hidden="true">&#127793;</span> '
2958         f'Grasscatcher'
2959         f'<span class="tile-count">{n} idea{"s" if n != 1 else ""}</span>'
2960         f'<span class="tile-hint"></span></summary>'
2961         f'<div class="tile-body">{body}</div></details>'
2962     )
2963

2965 def _render_folder_groups(groups: dict) -> str:
2966     """Render a FLAT one-line ROW list for the dashboard (v4 Wave 8 — archive view).
2967 
2968     The per-folder directory header is GONE on the FLAT path; projects render as
2969     a single flat list of thin rows. Still used by the Archive view, which has no
2970     group concept. The ACTIVE home dashboard now uses
2971     :func:`_render_group_folders` (v9 Wave 3 collapsible folders) instead.
2972     """
2973     rows = []
2974     for folder in sorted(groups):
2975         rows.extend(render_project_tile_html(e) for e in groups[folder])
2976     return ('<div class="rnd-projects">'
2977             '<div class="rnd-folder-rows">' + "".join(rows) + '</div>'
2978             '</div>')

2981 def _group_folder_path(entries: list) -> str:
2982     """If every project in a group shares one on-disk parent/path, return it.
2983 
2984     The mockup shows a folder's real on-disk path in the header only when it is
2985     uniform across the group's projects. Returns "" when the group is empty or
2986     its projects live in different folders (heterogeneous → no path shown).
2987     """
2988     paths = {(e.get("folder_path") or "") for e in entries if e.get("folder_path")}
2989     if len(paths) == 1:
2990         return next(iter(paths))
2991     return ""

2994 def _render_group_folders(groups, facts=None, chrome: bool = True) -> str:
2995     """Render the home dashboard's COLLAPSIBLE FOLDERS (v9 Wave 3).
2996 
2997     ``groups`` is keyed by GROUP NAME (from ``rnd_registry.group_by_group``) →
2998     list of project entries; the empty-group bucket is keyed ``Ungrouped`` and
2999     always renders last (it is the drop target for "remove from a folder").
3000 
3001     Each folder is a header (▸/▾ twisty · name · count · uniform on-disk path)
3002     over a body of the group's thin project rows. Folders are a drop target for
3003     drag-to-group; collapse state is persisted client-side (localStorage) by the
3004     home dashboard JS (``rndFolderInit``). Organization ONLY — no disk move.
3005     """
3006     ungrouped_label = getattr(_rnd, "UNGROUPED_LABEL", "Ungrouped")
3007     # Order: named groups as given (group_by_group already sorts them), with
3008     # Ungrouped last regardless of dict order.
3009     names = [g for g in groups if g != ungrouped_label]
3010     if ungrouped_label in groups:
3011         names.append(ungrouped_label)
3012 
3013     folders = []
3014     for gname in names:
3015         entries = groups.get(gname, [])
3016         rows = "".join(render_project_tile_html(e, (facts or {}).get(e.get("id")), chrome=chrome) for e in entries)
3017         name_esc = html_lib.escape(gname)
3018         name_attr = html_lib.escape(gname, quote=True)
3019         is_ungrouped = (gname == ungrouped_label)
3020         # The Ungrouped bucket is a catch-all, not a real on-disk folder → never
3021         # stamp a path on it (even if its members happen to share a dir).
3022         fpath = "" if is_ungrouped else _group_folder_path(entries)
3023         path_block = (f'<span class="rnd-fpath">{html_lib.escape(fpath)}</span>'
3024                       if fpath else '')
3025         drop_hint = ('<span class="rnd-fdrop-hint">drop here to remove '
3026                      'from a folder</span>' if (is_ungrouped and chrome) else '')   # no drop without the drag (High Seat)
3027         # (2026-09-01, John) Folders open CLOSED by default — opening the Projects
3028         # tile used to fan out every project in every folder. The server renders
3029         # the collapsed state (no flash of expanded rows before JS runs); the JS
3030         # re-opens only the folders John opened last time (localStorage, see
3031         # rndToggleFolder / the restore loop keyed on RND_FOLDER_LS).
3032         folders.append(
3033             f'<div class="rnd-folder rnd-collapsed" data-group="{name_attr}" '
3034             f'data-ungrouped="{"1" if is_ungrouped else "0"}">'
3035             f'<div class="rnd-folder-head" '
3036             f'onclick="rndToggleFolder(this)" role="button" tabindex="0" '
3037             f'title="Collapse / expand folder">'
3038             f'<span class="rnd-tw" aria-hidden="true">▸</span>'
3039             f'<span class="rnd-fname">{name_esc}</span>'
3040             f'<span class="rnd-fcount">({len(entries)})</span>'
3041             f'{path_block}'
3042             f'<span class="rnd-fsp"></span>'
3043             f'{drop_hint}'
3044             f'</div>'
3045             f'<div class="rnd-folder-body">{rows}</div>'
3046             f'</div>'
3047         )
3048     return ('<div class="rnd-projects">'
3049             '<div class="rnd-folder-list" id="rndFolderList">'
3050             + "".join(folders) +
3051             '</div></div>')
