3143 def _fmt_age(created_at) -> str:
3144     """Compact relative age ("now", "5m", "2h", "3d", "1w") from an epoch ts."""
3145     try:
3146         ts = float(created_at or 0)
3147     except (TypeError, ValueError):
3148         return ""
3149     if ts <= 0:
3150         return ""
3151     delta = max(0.0, time.time() - ts)
3152     if delta < 60:
3153         return "now"
3154     if delta < 3600:
3155         return f"{int(delta // 60)}m"
3156     if delta < 86400:
3157         return f"{int(delta // 3600)}h"
3158     if delta < 604800:
3159         return f"{int(delta // 86400)}d"
3160     return f"{int(delta // 604800)}w"
3161 
3162 
3163 # v4 Wave 4 — Paradigm-2 lane-tile status light.
3164 #
3165 # Map a session's representative effort view → the LOCKED status-light bucket
3166 # (session_registry status constants → colors, MASTER-PLAN §E):
3167 #   running                       → green  (live PTY / job producing output)
3168 #   needs-attention / done        → amber  (come look — waiting on you or finished)
3169 #   failed / cancelled / interrupted → red
3170 #   idle / unknown / discovered   → grey
3171 # This mirrors the JS ``_statusColor`` (which maps the registry status strings):
3172 # a single source of truth for the four colors, applied here at the lane-tile
3173 # render and there at the live session-bar / panel render.
3174 def _session_light_class(ev):
3175     """Return the lane-tile status-light color class ('green'|'amber'|'red'|
3176     'grey') for a session's representative effort view ``ev``."""
3177     if not ev:
3178         return "grey"
3179     if ev.get("needs_input"):
3180         return "amber"          # needs-attention (awaiting input)
3181     if ev.get("is_live"):
3182         return "green"          # running
3183     status = (ev.get("status") or "").strip()
3184     if ev.get("is_done") or status == _jr.STATUS_DONE:
3185         return "amber"          # done → amber (finished; awaiting your review)
3186     if status in (_jr.STATUS_FAILED, _jr.STATUS_INTERRUPTED, _jr.STATUS_CANCELLED):
3187         return "red"
3188     return "grey"               # idle / discovered / unknown
3189 
3190 
3191 # Map a job record's status/state to the board state-pill class + label.
3192 def _effort_pill(status, gate_state):
3193     """Return ``(pill_class, pill_label, is_live, needs_input)`` for an effort."""
3194     if gate_state == "awaiting-input":
3195         return ("input", "needs input", True, True)
3196     if status == _jr.STATUS_RUNNING:
3197         return ("run", "running", True, False)
3198     if status == _jr.STATUS_DONE:
3199         return ("done", "done", False, False)
3200     if status in (_jr.STATUS_FAILED, _jr.STATUS_INTERRUPTED, _jr.STATUS_CANCELLED):
3201         label = "failed" if status == _jr.STATUS_FAILED else status
3202         return ("fail", label, False, False)
3203     return ("", status or "queued", False, False)
3204

3206 def _gather_project_efforts(folder_path, project_id):
3207     """Join each lane's effort pointer-records with their live job records.
3208 
3209     Returns ``{column_lane: [effort_view, ...]}`` newest-first, where an
3210     ``effort_view`` carries everything the board needs (already HTML-escaped
3211     where it lands in attributes/text) plus the live status/gate.
3212     """
3213     # Gather each lane's efforts ONCE, then load ONLY the job records those
3214     # efforts actually reference (targeted load_record per job_id) — instead of
3215     # scanning the entire global rnd_jobs/ dir via list_records() for every
3216     # project-lane. That full scan made the dashboard O(projects x lanes x
3217     # all-jobs); once rnd_jobs/ grew to ~1k records it pushed GET / past the
3218     # health check's 5s timeout (the red banner). The lookup only ever needs the
3219     # records for THIS project's efforts, so load exactly those.
3220     efforts_by_lane = {}
3221     needed_jids = set()
3222     for trio_lane, _subdir, _label, _glyph, _addlabel in _KANBAN_COLUMNS:
3223         try:
3224             lane_efforts = _eh.list_efforts(folder_path, project_id, trio_lane)
3225         except Exception:
3226             lane_efforts = []
3227         efforts_by_lane[trio_lane] = lane_efforts
3228         for _e in lane_efforts:
3229             _jid = _e.get("job_id")
3230             if _jid:
3231                 needed_jids.add(_jid)
3232     jobs_by_id = {}
3233     for _jid in needed_jids:
3234         try:
3235             _rec = _jr.load_record(_jid)
3236         except Exception:
3237             _rec = None
3238         if _rec:
3239             jobs_by_id[_jid] = _rec
3240     out = {}
3241     for trio_lane, _subdir, _label, _glyph, _addlabel in _KANBAN_COLUMNS:
3242         efforts = efforts_by_lane.get(trio_lane, [])
3243         views = []
3244         # Version numbering (vN) is computed over NON-DISCOVERED (real) efforts
3245         # ONLY (honesty contract): a discovered card gets NO vN. So the newest
3246         # REAL effort is v<real_count>, descending; discovered cards are skipped
3247         # in the version counter and instead carry an "imported" marker.
3248         real_total = sum(1 for e in efforts if not _eh.is_discovered(e))
3249         real_seen = 0
3250         for idx, eff in enumerate(efforts):
3251             jid = eff.get("job_id", "")
3252             job = jobs_by_id.get(jid, {})
3253             discovered = _eh.is_discovered(eff)
3254             status = job.get("status") or eff.get("status") or ""
3255             gate_state = job.get("state")
3256             pill_cls, pill_lbl, is_live, needs_input = _effort_pill(
3257                 status, gate_state)
3258             if discovered:
3259                 # No vN; an "imported" marker instead. Discovered records are
3260                 # never live and never link to a report viewer route.
3261                 ver = ""
3262                 is_live = needs_input = False
3263                 pill_cls, pill_lbl = "", ""
3264             else:
3265                 # Newest real effort = v<real_total>, descending by recency.
3266                 real_seen += 1
3267                 ver = f"v{real_total - real_seen + 1}" if real_total else "v1"
3268             skill = eff.get("skill") or job.get("skill") or ""
3269             seed = eff.get("prompt_seed") or ""
3270             hint = seed.strip().splitlines()[0] if seed.strip() else ""
3271             sub = " · ".join(p for p in (skill, hint) if p)
3272             # A manual/promoted Grass Catchers idea (Wave 5) carries its text as
3273             # the title; surface it so the card body shows the idea, not a blank.
3274             if not discovered and eff.get("kind") == "idea":
3275                 idea_text = (eff.get("title") or "").strip()
3276                 if idea_text:
3277                     sub = idea_text
3278             cost = (eff.get("cost") or {})
3279             raw_cost = cost.get("total_cost_usd")
3280             try:
3281                 cost_usd = float(raw_cost) if raw_cost is not None else None
3282             except (TypeError, ValueError):
3283                 cost_usd = None
3284             if cost.get("cost_state") == "subscription_covered":
3285                 cost_label = "(subscription)"
3286             elif cost.get("cost_state") == "no_seat_started":
3287                 cost_label = "no seat started"
3288             elif cost_usd is not None and (
3289                     cost_usd > 0 or cost.get("cost_state") == "engine_reported"):
3290                 cost_label = f"${cost_usd:.4f}"
3291             else:
3292                 cost_label = ""
3293             views.append({
3294                 "job_id": jid,
3295                 "trio_lane": trio_lane,
3296                 "ver": ver,
3297                 "status": status,
3298                 "pill_cls": pill_cls,
3299                 "pill_lbl": pill_lbl,
3300                 "is_live": is_live,
3301                 "needs_input": needs_input,
3302                 "is_done": (not discovered) and status == _jr.STATUS_DONE,
3303                 "age": _fmt_age(eff.get("created_at")),
3304                 "skill": skill,
3305                 "sub": sub,
3306                 "cost_usd": None if discovered else cost_usd,
3307                 "cost_label": "" if discovered else cost_label,
3308                 "discovered": discovered,
3309                 "artifact_path": eff.get("artifact_path", "") if discovered else "",
3310                 "title": eff.get("title", "") if discovered else "",
3311                 "kind": eff.get("kind", "") if discovered else "",
3312                 # real epoch for the Layout-D newest-first cross-lane merge (v12 W2,
3313                 # Reviewer F1): without this the plan/build merge had no recency key
3314                 # and demoted the newest build under an older plan.
3315                 "_eff_created_at": float(eff.get("created_at") or 0.0),
3316             })
3317         out[trio_lane] = views
3318     return out
3319

3321 def _render_effort_card(ev, store_lane, project_id):
3322     """Render ONE effort card. Done efforts link to the report viewer; live ones
3323     carry the data hooks the console uses to attach. Every dynamic field is
3324     HTML-escaped (XSS-safe)."""
3325     jid = ev["job_id"]
3326     jid_esc = html_lib.escape(jid, quote=True)
3327     ver = html_lib.escape(ev["ver"])
3328     age = html_lib.escape(ev["age"])
3329     sub = html_lib.escape(ev["sub"]) if ev["sub"] else ""
3330 
3331     # ── Discovered (brownfield-imported) card: subtle, honest, no vN ──────────
3332     # It carries data-discovered="1" + a small dot + an "imported" marker, and
3333     # links to the REAL on-disk file via /artifact/<pid>?path=<rel>. It is NEVER
3334     # masqueraded as an Anchor-run session (no vN, no cost, no live hooks).
3335     if ev.get("discovered"):
3336         rel = ev.get("artifact_path", "")
3337         title = ev.get("title", "") or rel
3338         kind = ev.get("kind", "")
3339         title_esc = html_lib.escape(title)
3340         kind_esc = html_lib.escape(kind)
3341         data = (
3342             f" data-job-id=\"{jid_esc}\""
3343             f" data-lane=\"{html_lib.escape(store_lane, quote=True)}\""
3344             f" data-trio-lane=\"{html_lib.escape(ev['trio_lane'], quote=True)}\""
3345             f" data-discovered=\"1\" data-live=\"0\""
3346             f" data-artifact-path=\"{html_lib.escape(rel, quote=True)}\""
3347         )
3348         marker = ("<span class='imported'><span class='dotdisc'></span>"
3349                   "imported</span>")
3350         inner = (
3351             f"<div class='er'>{marker}"
3352             f"<span class='age'>{age}</span></div>"
3353             f"<div class='sub'>{title_esc}"
3354             + (f" <span class='dkind'>{kind_esc}</span>" if kind_esc else "")
3355             + "</div>"
3356         )
3357         if rel:
3358             href = (f"/artifact/{html_lib.escape(project_id, quote=True)}"
3359                     f"?path={url_quote(rel, safe='')}")
3360             return (f"<div class='effort discovered'{data} "
3361                     f"onclick=\"openReport('{html_lib.escape(href, quote=True)}')\">"
3362                     f"{inner}</div>")
3363         return f"<div class='effort discovered'{data}>{inner}</div>"
3364 
3365     pill = ""
3366     if ev["pill_cls"]:
3367         dot = ""
3368         if ev["pill_cls"] == "run":
3369             dot = "<span class='dotpulse'></span>"
3370         elif ev["pill_cls"] == "input":
3371             dot = "<span class='dotwarn'></span>"
3372         pill = (f"<span class='statepill {ev['pill_cls']}'>{dot}"
3373                 f"{html_lib.escape(ev['pill_lbl'])}</span>")
3374     cost_bit = ""
3375     if ev.get("cost_label"):
3376         cost_bit = (f"<span class='ecost'>"
3377                     f"{html_lib.escape(ev['cost_label'])}</span>")
3378     # Classes + data hooks. A live/needs-input card is clickable to attach the
3379     # console; a done card links to its report.
3380     cls = "effort"
3381     data = (f" data-job-id=\"{jid_esc}\" data-lane=\"{html_lib.escape(store_lane, quote=True)}\""
3382             f" data-trio-lane=\"{html_lib.escape(ev['trio_lane'], quote=True)}\""
3383             f" data-ver=\"{ver}\" data-live=\"{'1' if ev['is_live'] else '0'}\"")
3384     inner = (
3385         f"<div class='er'><span class='ver'>{ver}</span>{pill}"
3386         f"<span class='age'>{age}</span></div>"
3387         + (f"<div class='sub'>{sub}{cost_bit}</div>" if (sub or cost_bit) else "")
3388     )
3389     if ev["is_done"] and jid:
3390         # Link a done effort to the report viewer route.
3391         href = (f"/report/{html_lib.escape(project_id, quote=True)}/"
3392                 f"{html_lib.escape(ev['trio_lane'], quote=True)}/{jid_esc}")
3393         return (f"<div class='{cls}'{data} onclick=\"openReport('{href}')\">"
3394                 f"{inner}</div>")
3395     if ev["is_live"] and jid:
3396         return (f"<div class='{cls}' id='effort_{jid_esc}'{data} "
3397                 f"onclick=\"attachSession('{jid_esc}')\">{inner}</div>")
3398     return f"<div class='{cls}'{data}>{inner}</div>"

3401 # v7 Wave 3 — bridge LIVE managed sessions (session_registry) into the board.
3402 #
3403 # The board's trio columns are keyed by the trio-lane values in _KANBAN_COLUMNS
3404 # (research / plan / build / deliverables / grass). A registry record's ``lane``
3405 # may use the store form (``planning``) or the trio form (``plan``); both map to
3406 # the ``plan`` board column. ``general`` now maps to its OWN board column (a
3407 # bare-terminal zone); ``grass``/``grass-dev`` remain EXCLUDED (workbench-only).
3408 _REGISTRY_LANE_TO_COLUMN = {
3409     "research": "research",
3410     "plan": "plan",
3411     "planning": "plan",
3412     "build": "build",
3413     "deliverables": "deliverables",
3414     # General sessions now get a board zone (a bare-terminal lane, rendered as its
3415     # own Layout-D column). grass/grass-dev are still excluded (workbench-only).
3416     "general": "general",
3417 }
3418 
3419 # ── v12 Wave 1: effort board-routing accessor ───────────────────────────────
3420 #
3421 # Layout-D routes an effort to a zone by ``current_stage``/``kind`` ONLY (the
3422 # record's ``lane`` flips with the stage, so it must NOT be the routing key —
3423 # Skeptic SK-8). A trio effort in research → the Research zone; in plan/build →
3424 # the Plan/Build zone; a general/grass-dev effort → no trio zone.
3425 #
3426 # RENDER UNCHANGED this wave (the 5-col board still renders); this accessor is
3427 # added + unit-tested only. Its live render consumer arrives in W10.
3428 _EFFORT_ZONE_RESEARCH = "Research"
3429 _EFFORT_ZONE_PLAN_BUILD = "Plan/Build"
3430 
3431 
3432 def _effort_zone(record):
3433     """Return the Layout-D board zone for an effort record (v12 Wave 1).
3434 
3435     Routes by ``current_stage``/``kind`` only (never ``lane``, which flips):
3436 
3437     - ``current_stage == "research"`` → :data:`_EFFORT_ZONE_RESEARCH`.
3438     - ``current_stage in {"plan", "build"}`` → :data:`_EFFORT_ZONE_PLAN_BUILD`.
3439     - ``kind in {"general", "grass-dev"}`` → ``None`` (never a trio zone).
3440     - anything else → ``None``.
3441 
3442     ``record`` is a normalized session record (dict). Pure / read-only.
3443     """
3444     if not isinstance(record, dict):
3445         return None
3446     kind = (record.get("kind") or "").strip()
3447     if kind in ("general", "grass-dev"):
3448         return None
3449     stage = (record.get("current_stage") or "").strip()
3450     if stage == "research":
3451         return _EFFORT_ZONE_RESEARCH
3452     if stage in ("plan", "build"):
3453         return _EFFORT_ZONE_PLAN_BUILD
3454     return None
3455 
3456 
3457 #: session_registry status → the locked light-color bucket (mirrors
3458 #: :func:`_session_light_class`; running=green, needs-attention=amber,
3459 #: done=amber, failed=red, idle/unknown=grey).
3460 _REG_STATUS_LIGHT = {
3461     _sessreg.STATUS_RUNNING: "green",
3462     _sessreg.STATUS_NEEDS_ATTENTION: "amber",
3463     _sessreg.STATUS_DONE: "amber",
3464     _sessreg.STATUS_FAILED: "red",
3465     _sessreg.STATUS_IDLE: "grey",
3466     # Wave 5: the split of the overloaded idle — both render grey (parked-warm is
3467     # a reopenable tile like idle; a reaped orphan is a spent grey tile).
3468     _sessreg.STATUS_PARKED_WARM: "grey",
3469     _sessreg.STATUS_REAPED_ORPHAN: "grey",
3470 }
3471 
3472 
3473 def _registry_session_view(rec):
3474     """Build a single board ``effort_view``-shaped dict from a LIVE managed
3475     session record (``session_registry``), so a started session can render as a
3476     lane tile BEFORE it has any effort-history rows (v7 Wave 3).
3477 
3478     SAFE: reads only the projection-safe fields (session_id, lane, status,
3479     label, created_at) — NEVER ``worktree_path`` / ``branch`` (those must not
3480     leak into the page). The shape carries the same keys ``_render_lane_tile`` /
3481     ``_session_state_text`` / ``_session_light_class`` read off a representative
3482     effort view, plus the registry ``status`` and a ``from_registry`` marker so
3483     the merge can keep the live status when deduping against an effort view.
3484     """
3485     status = (rec.get("status") or "").strip()
3486     is_live = status == _sessreg.STATUS_RUNNING
3487     needs_input = status == _sessreg.STATUS_NEEDS_ATTENTION
3488     is_done = status in _sessreg.TERMINAL_STATUSES
3489     if status == _sessreg.STATUS_RUNNING:
3490         pill_cls, pill_lbl = "run", "running"
3491     elif status == _sessreg.STATUS_NEEDS_ATTENTION:
3492         pill_cls, pill_lbl = "input", "needs input"
3493     elif status == _sessreg.STATUS_DONE:
3494         pill_cls, pill_lbl = "done", "done"
3495     elif status == _sessreg.STATUS_FAILED:
3496         # codex-discipline-2026-09-15 Wave 1.4: the reason rides on the tile
3497         # (mirrored from the job record; before this it was a bare "failed").
3498         reason = str(rec.get("failure_reason") or "").strip()[:60]
3499         pill_cls, pill_lbl = "fail", ("failed · " + reason if reason else "failed")
3500     elif status == _sessreg.STATUS_PARKED_WARM:
3501         # Wave 5: a parked-warm session is the reopenable grey tile the pre-split
3502         # STATUS_IDLE produced — keep the same "idle" pill so a migrated record
3503         # renders identically.
3504         pill_cls, pill_lbl = "", "idle"
3505     else:
3506         pill_cls, pill_lbl = "", (status or "idle")
3507     label = (rec.get("label") or "").strip()
3508     return {
3509         "job_id": "",
3510         "trio_lane": _REGISTRY_LANE_TO_COLUMN.get(
3511             (rec.get("lane") or "").strip(), ""),
3512         "ver": "",
3513         "status": status,
3514         "pill_cls": pill_cls,
3515         "pill_lbl": pill_lbl,
3516         "is_live": is_live,
3517         "needs_input": needs_input,
3518         "is_done": is_done,
3519         "age": _fmt_age(rec.get("created_at")),
3520         "skill": "",
3521         "sub": label,
3522         "cost_usd": 0.0,
3523         "discovered": False,
3524         "artifact_path": "",
3525         "title": label,
3526         "kind": "",
3527         # v10 Wave 4: grass→project lineage stamp. Just an idea id — SAFE (never
3528         # worktree_path/branch). Lets a board tile show the "from grass: <idea>"
3529         # back-link chip when this session's chain traces back to a grass idea.
3530         "grass_origin": (rec.get("grass_origin") or ""),
3531         # v12 W7: the effort_managed discriminator on the rep, so a board tile can
3532         # emit data-effort-managed and the JS advance-bar guard goes live for the
3533         # historical/synth path too (W7-R2-01). SAFE (a bool).
3534         "effort_managed": bool(rec.get("effort_managed", False)),
3535         # v7 Wave 3 merge markers (consumed only by _gather_project_sessions):
3536         "from_registry": True,
3537         "_reg_session_id": rec.get("session_id") or "",
3538         "_reg_created_at": rec.get("created_at") or 0.0,
3539         "_reg_status": status,
3540         "_reg_light": _REG_STATUS_LIGHT.get(status, "grey"),
3541     }
3542 
3543 
3544 def _strip_session_prefix(sid: str) -> str:
3545     """Strip the effort session_id namespacing prefix (``run::`` / ``loose::`` /
3546     ``discovered::`` …) to recover the bare id, for cross-form dedupe with a
3547     managed registry session id (v7 Wave 3)."""
3548     s = str(sid or "")
3549     idx = s.find("::")
3550     return s[idx + 2:] if idx >= 0 else s
3551 
3552 
3553 def _merge_registry_sessions(session_views, trio_lane, reg_by_column):
3554     """Merge the LIVE managed sessions for ``trio_lane`` into the effort-derived
3555     ``session_views`` (v7 Wave 3), deduped by session_id and ordered newest-first.
3556 
3557     - A registry session whose id ALREADY appears as an effort session keeps the
3558       richer effort view but adopts the LIVE registry status (so a just-started
3559       run shows running even before its effort rows land).
3560     - A registry session with no effort counterpart becomes a synthetic
3561       single-member session_view.
3562     - Ordered newest-first by created_at (registry ``created_at`` for synthetic
3563       rows; the effort rep's already-newest order is preserved by sort-stability).
3564 
3565     Returns the merged, newest-first list. ``general`` / ``grass`` never reach
3566     here (not in ``_REGISTRY_LANE_TO_COLUMN`` values for the trio columns).
3567     """
3568     reg_rows = reg_by_column.get(trio_lane, [])
3569     if not reg_rows:
3570         return session_views
3571     # Index existing effort session_views by id for dedupe + live-status adoption.
3572     # An effort session derived from a run job is keyed ``run::<job_id>`` (and a
3573     # defensive loose view ``loose::<job_id>``), while a managed registry session
3574     # is keyed by the BARE session id — which equals that job_id when the session
3575     # was adopted (terminal_session reuses the pty/session id as the job id). So
3576     # we index BOTH the full key AND the prefix-stripped tail to dedupe across
3577     # those two forms.
3578     by_sid = {}
3579     for sv in session_views:
3580         sid = sv.get("session_id") or ""
3581         by_sid.setdefault(sid, sv)
3582         tail = _strip_session_prefix(sid)
3583         if tail and tail != sid:
3584             by_sid.setdefault(tail, sv)
3585     merged = list(session_views)
3586     # Stamp created_at onto each existing view for the newest-first sort (the
3587     # rep member carries the effort age, not an epoch; fall back to 0 → sorts
3588     # after timestamped registry rows of equal recency, which is fine).
3589     order = {id(sv): i for i, sv in enumerate(merged)}
3590     sort_ts = {id(sv): _sv_created_at(sv) for sv in merged}
3591     for rv in reg_rows:
3592         sid = rv.get("_reg_session_id") or ""
3593         existing = by_sid.get(sid)
3594         if existing is not None:
3595             # DEDUPE: keep the richer effort view, adopt the live registry status
3596             # onto its representative member so the tile light/state is current.
3597             rep = (existing.get("members") or [None])[0]
3598             if isinstance(rep, dict):
3599                 rep["is_live"] = rv["is_live"]
3600                 rep["needs_input"] = rv["needs_input"]
3601                 rep["is_done"] = rep.get("is_done") or rv["is_done"]
3602                 if rv["status"]:
3603                     rep["status"] = rv["status"]
3604                 rep["pill_cls"] = rv["pill_cls"]
3605                 rep["pill_lbl"] = rv["pill_lbl"]
3606             sort_ts[id(existing)] = max(
3607                 sort_ts.get(id(existing), 0.0), rv.get("_reg_created_at") or 0.0)
3608             continue
3609         sv = {"session_id": sid, "members": [rv]}
3610         merged.append(sv)
3611         by_sid[sid] = sv
3612         order[id(sv)] = len(order)
3613         sort_ts[id(sv)] = rv.get("_reg_created_at") or 0.0
3614     # Newest-first by created_at; stable on ties (preserves original ordering).
3615     merged.sort(key=lambda sv: (-(sort_ts.get(id(sv), 0.0)), order.get(id(sv), 0)))
3616     return merged
3617 
3618 
3619 def _sv_created_at(sv):
3620     """Best-effort epoch created_at for a session_view (for the merge sort).
3621 
3622     A registry-sourced view carries ``_reg_created_at``; an effort view carries
3623     ``_eff_created_at`` (the effort record's real epoch, v12 W2). Either gives a
3624     true recency key for the newest-first / cross-lane merge; 0.0 only if neither."""
3625     rep = (sv.get("members") or [None])[0]
3626     if isinstance(rep, dict):
3627         ts = rep.get("_reg_created_at") or rep.get("_eff_created_at")
3628         if ts:
3629             return float(ts or 0.0)
3630     return 0.0
3631 
3632 
3633 def _gather_project_sessions(folder_path, project_id, efforts_by_lane=None):
3634     """Group each lane's effort views into SESSIONS (v2 Wave 4, MASTER-PLAN §A).
3635 
3636     Wraps :func:`sessions.list_sessions` (Wave 1) — one trio run = one session —
3637     and joins each session to the per-effort views produced by
3638     :func:`_gather_project_efforts`. Returns ``{trio_lane: [session_view, ...]}``
3639     newest-first, where a ``session_view`` is::
3640 
3641         {"session_id", "members": [effort_view, ...]}
3642 
3643     ``members`` are the session's effort views, newest-first (the representative
3644     card = ``members[0]``). Member views not found (defensive) are skipped.
3645     """
3646     if efforts_by_lane is None:
3647         efforts_by_lane = _gather_project_efforts(folder_path, project_id)
3648     # v7 Wave 3 — pull the project's LIVE managed sessions ONCE and bucket them
3649     # by board column (research/plan/build/deliverables). ``general``/``grass``
3650     # are excluded (not in _REGISTRY_LANE_TO_COLUMN). Registry-only (no model
3651     # call); never leaks worktree_path/branch (see _registry_session_view).
3652     reg_by_column = {}
3653     try:
3654         for rec in _sessreg.list_sessions(project_id=project_id):
3655             # v8 Wave 6: a CONTAINED grass-workbench develop session keeps its
3656             # research/plan lane (so its trio skill seeds) but must NOT render as
3657             # a board tile — it lives only in the workbench pane. Its label marker
3658             # excludes it here (and the JS never adds it to MANAGED/the top strip).
3659             if _eh.is_grass_dev_label(rec.get("label")):
3660                 continue
3661             col = _REGISTRY_LANE_TO_COLUMN.get((rec.get("lane") or "").strip())
3662             if not col:
3663                 continue
3664             reg_by_column.setdefault(col, []).append(_registry_session_view(rec))
3665     except Exception:
3666         reg_by_column = {}
3667     out = {}
3668     for trio_lane, _subdir, _label, _glyph, _addlabel in _KANBAN_COLUMNS:
3669         views = efforts_by_lane.get(trio_lane, [])
3670         # Index this lane's effort views by job_id for the session→view join.
3671         by_jid = {}
3672         for v in views:
3673             jid = v.get("job_id") or ""
3674             by_jid.setdefault(jid, v)
3675         try:
3676             sess_list = _sessions.list_sessions(folder_path, project_id, trio_lane)
3677         except Exception:
3678             sess_list = []
3679         session_views = []
3680         claimed = set()
3681         for s in sess_list:
3682             members = []
3683             for m in s.get("member_files", []):
3684                 jid = (m.get("job_id") or "").strip()
3685                 v = by_jid.get(jid)
3686                 if v is not None:
3687                     members.append(v)
3688                     claimed.add(jid)
3689             if not members:
3690                 continue
3691             # Keep members newest-first (the effort views already arrive
3692             # newest-first from list_efforts; preserve that ordering).
3693             session_views.append({
3694                 "session_id": s.get("session_id", ""),
3695                 "members": members,
3696             })
3697         # Defensive: surface any effort view not claimed by a session as its own
3698         # single-member session so nothing silently disappears from the board.
3699         for v in views:
3700             jid = v.get("job_id") or ""
3701             if jid not in claimed:
3702                 claimed.add(jid)
3703                 session_views.append({
3704                     "session_id": f"loose::{jid}",
3705                     "members": [v],
3706                 })
3707         # v7 Wave 3 — bridge in the LIVE managed sessions for this column,
3708         # deduped by session_id + ordered newest-first (the most-recent becomes
3709         # the prominent tile, older ones the expander).
3710         session_views = _merge_registry_sessions(
3711             session_views, trio_lane, reg_by_column)
3712         out[trio_lane] = session_views
3713     # Build→Planning tie: a BUILD session whose source directory equals a PLANNING
3714     # session's source directory (the Foreman EXECUTION-LOG lives under
3715     # planning/<version>/ next to the plan docs) is the SAME trio run's build
3716     # stage — tie them so the build tile can link back to the plan it executed.
3717     # Honest: only an unambiguous (single-planning-session-per-dir) match links;
3718     # no match → no link (nothing fabricated). Discovered/effort sessions only —
3719     # live managed sessions carry their own v6 parent/chain lineage.
3720     _attach_build_planning_tie(out)
3721     return out
3722 
3723 
3724 def _gather_efforts(project_id):
3725     """Return the project's EFFORT view (v12 Wave 9) for the render layer.
3726 
3727     Thin accessor over :func:`effort_view.build_effort_view` — groups the
3728     project's registry chains AND new single-session efforts into one uniform
3729     list of efforts (one per chain, deduped against the migration overlap, no
3730     ghost stage for a deleted member), REBUILT from the registry on every call.
3731     Consumed by the W10/W11 render layer. The legacy
3732     :func:`_gather_project_sessions` is RETAINED as the fallback (not removed).
3733 
3734     Resolves the project's folder from the registry; honest ``[]`` for an unknown
3735     project or any failure (never raises — best-effort, like the legacy gather).
3736     """
3737     try:
3738         entry = _rnd.get_project(project_id)
3739     except Exception:
3740         entry = None
3741     folder_path = (entry or {}).get("folder_path", "") if entry else ""
3742     try:
3743         return _effview.build_effort_view(folder_path, project_id)
3744     except Exception:
3745         return []

3748 def _sv_source_dir(sv) -> str:
3749     """The folder-relative POSIX source directory of a discovered session view,
3750     from its representative member's ``artifact_path`` (``""`` if none/loose)."""
3751     for m in sv.get("members", []) or []:
3752         ap = (m.get("artifact_path") or "").strip().replace("\\", "/")
3753         if ap and "/" in ap:
3754             return ap.rsplit("/", 1)[0]
3755     return ""

3757 
3758 def _attach_build_planning_tie(out) -> None:
3759     """Attach ``linked_planning`` = ``{"session_id", "label"}`` to each BUILD
3760     session that shares a source directory with exactly one PLANNING session.
3761 
3762     Mutates ``out`` in place. The planning ``session_id`` is the real
3763     (un-qualified) ``dir::…`` id whose tile lives in the Planning column, so a
3764     chip/breadcrumb click resolves to that tile via ``openPanel``. ``label`` is
3765     the version dir basename (e.g. ``rnd-v4``).
3766     """
3767     planning_by_dir = {}        # source_dir -> session_id (None marks ambiguous)
3768     # NB: the planning column's key in ``out`` is the trio-lane "plan" (its
3769     # store-lane is "planning"); see _KANBAN_COLUMNS.
3770     for sv in out.get("plan", []) or []:
3771         d = _sv_source_dir(sv)
3772         if not d:
3773             continue
3774         sid = sv.get("session_id") or ""
3775         if not sid:
3776             continue
3777         planning_by_dir[d] = None if d in planning_by_dir else sid
3778     for sv in out.get("build", []) or []:
3779         d = _sv_source_dir(sv)
3780         if not d:
3781             continue
3782         sid = planning_by_dir.get(d)
3783         if not sid:
3784             continue   # no match, or ambiguous (>1 planning session in that dir)
3785         label = d.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] or d
3786         sv["linked_planning"] = {"session_id": sid, "label": label}
3787

3789 def _idea_source_label(eff) -> str:

3792     Reads the effort record (NOT the trimmed view) so it can see the honest
3793     provenance markers ``promoted_from`` / discovered / manual-add.
3794     """
3795     if _eh.is_discovered(eff):
3796         return "discovered"
3797     if (eff.get("promoted_from") or "") == "inbox":
3798         return "from inbox"
3799     return "manual"

3804     _eh.GRASS_RAW: "raw",

3806     _eh.GRASS_PROMOTED: "promoted",

3810 # v10 Wave 7 — Boneyard: human label for each locked source (D3).
3811 _BONEYARD_SOURCE_LABEL = {
3812     _boneyard.SOURCE_KILLED: "killed",
3813     _boneyard.SOURCE_DELETED: "deleted",
3814     _boneyard.SOURCE_GRASS_DELETED: "grass-deleted",

3817 
3818 def _boneyard_entry_view(project_id, entry) -> dict:
3819     """SAFE projection of a Boneyard entry + server-built traversal-safe doc links.
3820 
3821     The entry comes from ``boneyard.list_entries`` / ``boneyard.search``, already a
3822     SAFE projection (only the public ``_SAFE_KEYS`` — never an absolute path /
3823     worktree / branch). We add ``doc_links`` (``[{name, href}]``) by routing EVERY
3824     ``doc_rel`` through the existing traversal-safe ``/artifact?path=<rel>`` route
3825     (W7 routing decision: the produced docs survive on disk by their main-folder
3826     rel path under Option A regardless of source — killed/deleted/grass-deleted —
3827     so /artifact is ALWAYS resolvable and consistent; no fragile /report job_id
3828     resolution from a content-addressed effort id). The href is path+query escaped;
3829     the route itself rejects ``..``/absolute/symlink-escape. No absolute path /
3830     worktree / branch is ever emitted.
3831     """
3832     e = entry or {}
3833     pid_q = url_quote(str(project_id), safe="")
3834     links = []
3835     for rel in (e.get("doc_rels", []) or []):
3836         rel = str(rel or "").strip()
3837         if not rel:
3838             continue
3839         name = rel.replace("\\", "/").rsplit("/", 1)[-1] or rel
3840         href = f"/artifact/{pid_q}?path={url_quote(rel, safe='')}"
3841         links.append({"name": name, "href": href})
3842     # ``when_display`` is the formatted, LOCAL-tz timestamp string computed ONCE on
3843     # the server (v10 Wave 7 fix). BOTH the server initial render
3844     # (_render_boneyard_entry_html) AND the client live-search render
3845     # (_boneyardEntryHtml) use it verbatim, so the displayed time is byte-identical
3846     # across the initial paint and a post-search re-render (the client used to
3847     # re-format ``when`` in UTC, causing a ~tz-offset jump on the first search).
3848     # ``when`` (raw epoch) is kept too for any ordering/raw use. SAFE: a formatted
3849     # string only — no path / worktree / branch.
3850     when_raw = e.get("when", 0)
3851     when_display = ""
3852     try:
3853         if when_raw:
3854             when_display = datetime.fromtimestamp(
3855                 float(when_raw)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
3856     except (TypeError, ValueError, OSError):
3857         when_display = ""
3858     return {
3859         "entry_id": e.get("entry_id", ""),
3860         "source": e.get("source", ""),
3861         "source_label": _BONEYARD_SOURCE_LABEL.get(e.get("source", ""),
3862                                                    e.get("source", "")),
3863         "session_id": e.get("session_id", ""),
3864         "lane": e.get("lane", ""),
3865         "title": e.get("title", ""),
3866         "summary_excerpt": e.get("summary_excerpt", ""),
3867         "idea_text": e.get("idea_text", ""),
3868         "when": when_raw,
3869         "when_display": when_display,
3870         "doc_links": links,
3871     }
3872 
3873 
3874 def _render_boneyard_entry_html(view) -> str:
3875     """Render ONE Boneyard entry as a ``.byentry`` (collapsed; expands to summary +
3876     doc links). All engine/user content HTML-escaped. ``view`` is the
3877     ``_boneyard_entry_view`` shape (SAFE projection + ``doc_links``)."""
3878     src = view.get("source", "")
3879     src_lbl = html_lib.escape(view.get("source_label", src) or src)
3880     src_cls = html_lib.escape(src, quote=True)
3881     # RAW title escaped EXACTLY ONCE (quote-safe). ``title`` here is the escaped
3882     # string reused below; we must NOT re-escape it (the v10-W7 double-escape bug
3883     # turned ``A & B`` into ``A &amp;amp; B`` because the already-escaped value was
3884     # passed back through html.escape on the data-title attribute).
3885     title_raw = view.get("title", "") or "(untitled)"
3886     title = html_lib.escape(title_raw, quote=True)
3887     lane = (view.get("lane", "") or "").strip()
3888     lane_chip = (f"<span class='bylanechip'>{html_lib.escape(lane)}</span>"
3889                  if lane else "")
3890     # The displayed timestamp is the server-computed, LOCAL-tz ``when_display`` from
3891     # the SAFE projection — the SAME string the client live-search render uses, so
3892     # the initial paint and a post-search re-render are byte-identical (no tz jump).
3893     when_txt = view.get("when_display", "") or ""
3894     when_chip = (f"<span class='bywhen'>{html_lib.escape(when_txt)}</span>"
3895                  if when_txt else "")
3896     # The expand body: full summary/idea text + doc links.
3897     summary = (view.get("summary_excerpt", "") or "").strip()
3898     idea = (view.get("idea_text", "") or "").strip()
3899     body_text = summary or idea
3900     if body_text:
3901         sum_html = (f"<div class='bysum'>{html_lib.escape(body_text)}</div>")
3902     else:
3903         sum_html = ("<div class='bysum dim'>No summary captured.</div>")
3904     # A short collapsed excerpt (the first line of whatever body we have).
3905     excerpt = body_text.splitlines()[0] if body_text else ""
3906     exc_html = (f"<div class='byexc'>{html_lib.escape(excerpt)}</div>"
3907                 if excerpt else "")
3908     links = view.get("doc_links", []) or []
3909     if links:
3910         rows = "".join(
3911             f"<a class='bydoc' href='{html_lib.escape(l['href'], quote=True)}' "
3912             f"target='anchor_report_window' rel='noopener'>"
3913             f"{html_lib.escape(l['name'])}</a>"
3914             for l in links)
3915         docs_html = (f"<div class='bydocs'><div class='h'>Documents</div>"
3916                      f"{rows}</div>")
3917     else:
3918         docs_html = ("<div class='bydocs'><div class='h'>Documents</div>"
3919                      "<span class='none'>No documents.</span></div>")
3920     eid = html_lib.escape(view.get("entry_id", ""), quote=True)
3921     return (
3922         f"<div class='byentry' data-byentry=\"{eid}\" data-source='{src_cls}' "
3923         f"data-title=\"{title}\" "
3924         f"onclick='toggleBoneyardEntry(this)'>"

4108 def _render_kanban_html(folder_path, project_id):
4109     """Render the Paradigm-2 lane board: 5 ``.p2col`` columns (Research|Planning|
4110     Build|Deliverables|Grass) inside a ``.p2lanes`` grid (v4.1 cockpit-render).
4111 
4112     Each content lane (research/plan/build) renders GENUINE Paradigm-2 ``.tile``
4113     cards — the MOST-RECENT session is the visible tile (status light + click-to-
4114     -openPanel hook); the remaining sessions sit behind a "previous sessions (N)"
4115     ``<details>`` expander, ALSO rendered as tiles (NOT effort cards, NO report
4116     links / summary accordions / file expanders — that detail lives in the opened
4117     panel). The Deliverables lane renders launch-by-type tiles; the Grass lane is
4118     the idea board. Each column has an ``<h4>`` header (glyph + label + a live/attn
4119     lane badge) and a "+ new <lane>" launcher.
4120     """
4121     efforts_by_lane = _gather_project_efforts(folder_path, project_id)
4122     sessions_by_lane = _gather_project_sessions(
4123         folder_path, project_id, efforts_by_lane)
4124     cols = []
4125     for trio_lane, store_lane, label, glyph, add_label in _KANBAN_COLUMNS:
4126         views = efforts_by_lane.get(trio_lane, [])
4127         session_views = sessions_by_lane.get(trio_lane, [])
4128         any_live = any(v["is_live"] and not v["needs_input"] for v in views)
4129         any_input = any(v["needs_input"] for v in views)
4130         # The lane header badge is a small status light (mockup: <span class="lt">
4131         # in the <h4>): amber when a session needs you, a pulsing green when one is
4132         # live, otherwise nothing.
4133         badge = ""
4134         if any_input:
4135             badge = "<span class='lt amber' title='needs you'></span>"
4136         elif any_live:
4137             badge = "<span class='lt green' title='running'></span>"
4138         if trio_lane == "grass":
4139             # v5 Wave 5: the grass lane column shows ONE tile that opens the
4140             # full-width two-pane B+C hybrid workbench panel (the column is too
4141             # narrow for the two-pane workbench). The old single-column idea-board
4142             # markup is gone; the workbench template is appended after the board.
4143             cards = _render_grass_column_tile(folder_path, project_id)
4144         elif trio_lane == "deliverables":
4145             # The deliverables lane is launch-by-type TILES (mockup Paradigm-2),
4146             # NOT session/effort cards: a tile per pinned deliverable whose click
4147             # launches it per its type contract.
4148             cards = _render_deliverable_lane_tiles(folder_path, project_id)
4149         else:
4150             cards = _render_lane_sessions(
4151                 session_views, store_lane, project_id, trio_lane, folder_path)
4152         # The "+ new <lane>" launcher. All lanes launch on Claude by default
4153         # (the locked model policy: Claude is the default engine; the 5:1
4154         # Claude-orchestrates-Gemini split lives at the skill/session layer; and
4155         # Foreman/build code-writing is pinned to Claude). Gemini is reachable
4156         # only via the per-session engine toggle — never as a launch default.
4157         # deliverables are config-driven (no launch); grass gets manual add +
4158         # promote-from-INBOX.
4159         if trio_lane == "deliverables":
4160             add = ""
4161         elif trio_lane == "grass":
4162             add = (
4163                 f"<span class='addnew' onclick=\"addIdea()\">"
4164                 f"{html_lib.escape(add_label)}</span> "
4165                 f"<span class='addnew' onclick=\"promoteInbox()\">"
4166                 f"+ From inbox</span>"
4167             )
4168         elif trio_lane == "research":
4169             add = (
4170                 "<span class='addnew' onclick=\"newTermSession('research','claude')\">"
4171                 f"{html_lib.escape(add_label)}</span>"
4172             )
4173         else:
4174             add = (f"<span class='addnew' onclick=\"newTermSession('{trio_lane}')\">"
4175                    f"{html_lib.escape(add_label)}</span>")
4176         lane_attr = html_lib.escape(trio_lane, quote=True)
4177         cols.append(
4178             f"<div class='p2col' data-col-lane='{lane_attr}'>"
4179             f"<h4><span>{glyph}</span> {html_lib.escape(label)} "
4180             f"<span class='sp'></span>"
4181             f"<span class='badge' id='badge_{lane_attr}'>{badge}</span></h4>"
4182             f"<div class='col-tiles' id='cards_{lane_attr}'>{cards}</div>"
4183             f"{add}</div>"
4184         )
4185     board = "<div class='p2lanes'>" + "".join(cols) + "</div>"
4186     # v5 Wave 5: the full two-pane Grass workbench, rendered ONCE as a hidden
4187     # template the panel manager (openGrassWorkbench) clones into #panelStack.
4188     workbench = (
4189         "<div id='grassWorkbenchTpl' style='display:none'>"
4190         + _render_grass_workbench(folder_path, project_id)
4191         + "</div>"
4192     )
4193     return board + workbench

4196 # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
4197 # v12 Wave 2 — Layout-D static skeleton ("ship the look early").
4198 #
4199 # Render the approved Layout-D shell per _mockups/dashboard_D_headline_shelf.html
4200 # — a Latest-Research headline card + a collapsible older-research shelf, a
4201 # Latest-Plan/Build headline card + its own shelf, a persistent right column
4202 # (Grass mini-panel + Deliverables panel), a "+ New effort" control, and an
4203 # INERT bottom dock chrome (summary-on-top + draggable splitter + terminal host,
4204 # buttons disabled/labeled "wired in W10"). This wave is DRIVEN BY EXISTING DATA
4205 # (`_gather_project_sessions`, already on master) via a thin adapter — the live
4206 # effort-view (W9), the bottom-dock terminal/transport (W10), and the
4207 # advance/handoff interactions are deliberately DEFERRED. The headline cards +
4208 # little-tiles carry the legacy ``tile lane-tile`` + ``data-session`` hooks so
4209 # the W10 panel-open wiring (and the existing panel-open tests) still bind.
4210 # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
4211 
4212 def _layoutd_zones(folder_path, project_id, sessions_by_lane=None):
4213     """Map the EXISTING per-lane session views into the Layout-D headline/shelf
4214     shape (v12 Wave 2). Pure adapter over :func:`_gather_project_sessions` — no
4215     new data source, no model call.
4216 
4217     Returns ``{"research": [session_view, ...], "plan_build": [session_view, ...]}``
4218     newest-first, where the RESEARCH zone is the research column's sessions and
4219     the PLAN/BUILD zone is the plan + build columns' sessions merged newest-first.
4220     In each zone ``[0]`` is the headline (most-recent) and ``[1:]`` are the
4221     collapsible-shelf "little tiles". Each ``session_view`` is carried verbatim
4222     (``{"session_id", "members": [...], ...}``) so the existing tile helpers
4223     (:func:`_session_tile_title` / :func:`_session_light_class` /
4224     :func:`_session_state_text`) read it unchanged.
4225     """
4226     if sessions_by_lane is None:
4227         sessions_by_lane = _gather_project_sessions(folder_path, project_id)
4228     research = list(sessions_by_lane.get("research", []) or [])
4229     plan = list(sessions_by_lane.get("plan", []) or [])
4230     build = list(sessions_by_lane.get("build", []) or [])
4231     # Merge plan + build newest-first. Effort views don't carry an epoch on the
4232     # rep, so use the same best-effort created_at the merge sort uses, stable on
4233     # ties (build listed first → slightly newer-leaning, harmless for a skeleton).
4234     plan_build = sorted(
4235         plan + build, key=lambda sv: -_sv_created_at(sv))
4236     # General sessions (bare terminals) get their own zone: most-recent headline +
4237     # older-runs shelf, newest-first (registry created_at drives recency).
4238     general = sorted(
4239         list(sessions_by_lane.get("general", []) or []),
4240         key=lambda sv: -_sv_created_at(sv))
4241     return {"research": research, "plan_build": plan_build, "general": general}
4242 
4243 
4244 def _layoutd_tie_chip(sv):
4245     """The build→planning tie (v3, preserved into Layout-D): ``(data_attr, chip)``
4246     for a build session view whose ``linked_planning`` was set by
4247     :func:`_attach_build_planning_tie`. Returns ``("", "")`` when none. The chip
4248     links back to the planning session this build executed on (same markup the v4
4249     lane tile emitted, so the tie tests + ``openLinkedPlanning`` still bind)."""
4250     tie = sv.get("linked_planning") or {}
4251     if not tie.get("session_id"):
4252         return "", ""
4253     lp_sid = html_lib.escape(tie["session_id"], quote=True)
4254     lp_lbl = html_lib.escape(tie.get("label") or "planning")
4255     lp_lbl_attr = html_lib.escape(tie.get("label") or "planning", quote=True)
4256     data = (f" data-linked-planning=\"{lp_sid}\""
4257             f" data-linked-planning-label=\"{lp_lbl_attr}\"")
4258     chip = (
4259         f"<span class='tiechip' title='Open the planning session this build "
4260         f"executed on' onclick=\"openLinkedPlanning(event,'{lp_sid}')\">"
4261         f"&#9741; Planning: {lp_lbl} &#9656;</span>")
4262     return data, chip

4285 def _layoutd_resume_control(sv, rep, trio_lane):
4286     """The "Resume as session" control for a DISCOVERED/brownfield effort tile
4287     (crucible-improve #6 UI, W4). A discovered effort has no managed Anchor
4288     session — its tile otherwise only opens the on-disk artifact (read-only), so
4289     there is no way to *carry it on*. This control drives ``resumeDiscovered`` →
4290     ``continueSession`` → ``POST /api/rnd/continue_session``, whose
4291     :func:`_build_continue_seed` SYNTHESIZES a warm seed from the documents on disk
4292     for a discovered effort (W3 #6 backend — the detected phase, the trio skill,
4293     the enumerated doc list) before calling ``terminal_session.start_session``. So
4294     clicking it opens a WARM live session (skill loaded, docs read, oriented), not
4295     a cold terminal. Returns ``""`` for a non-discovered tile — those resume via
4296     the opened panel's "Continue in a live session" button instead.
4297 
4298     SAFE: emits only the ``session_id`` + the trio lane (never ``worktree_path`` /
4299     ``branch``). ``stopPropagation`` keeps the click off the tile's
4300     ``laneTileClick`` so it resumes rather than merely opening the read-only panel.
4301     """
4302     if not isinstance(rep, dict) or not rep.get("discovered"):
4303         return ""
4304     sid = (sv.get("session_id") or "") if isinstance(sv, dict) else ""
4305     if not sid:
4306         return ""
4307     sid_attr = html_lib.escape(sid, quote=True)
4308     lane_attr = html_lib.escape(trio_lane or "", quote=True)
4309     return (
4310         f"<button class='resume-disc' type='button' data-session=\"{sid_attr}\" "
4311         f"data-lane=\"{lane_attr}\" title='Resume this discovered effort as a warm "
4312         f"live session — the trio skill loads and the on-disk docs orient the turn' "
4313         f"onclick=\"resumeDiscovered(event,'{sid_attr}','{lane_attr}')\">"
4314         f"&#9654; Resume as session</button>")
4315 
4316 
4317 #: trio-lane → the trio STAGE it represents (for the EV-2 stage-track fallback
4318 #: when a tile has no live effort-view entry, e.g. a discovered/imported tile).
4319 _LANE_TO_STAGE = {"research": "research", "plan": "plan", "planning": "plan",
4320                   "build": "build"}
4321 
4322 
4323 def _effort_data_attrs(sid, effort_index, fallback_lane=""):
4324     """The v12 W10 effort-binding data-* attrs for a Layout-D tile.
4325 
4326     Resolves the session id to its EFFORT (via ``effort_index`` = session_id →
4327     effort dict, built from :func:`_gather_efforts`) and emits
4328     ``data-effort-id`` + ``data-current-stage`` so the bottom dock can open BOUND
4329     to the effort and light the 3-node stage track from ``current_stage`` (EV-2 —
4330     presence-based, NOT by iterating stage_history). When the index has no entry
4331     (a discovered/imported tile that never minted a managed session), it falls
4332     back to the session id as a singleton effort id and derives the stage from the
4333     tile's trio lane (``fallback_lane``) — honest, never blank for a real lane
4334     tile. Returns a leading-space attribute string ("" only if ``sid`` is empty).
4335     """
4336     if not sid:
4337         return ""
4338     eff = (effort_index or {}).get(sid)
4339     if eff:
4340         eid = (eff.get("effort_id") or sid)
4341         stage = (eff.get("current_stage") or "")
4342     else:
4343         eid = sid
4344         stage = ""
4345     if not stage:
4346         stage = _LANE_TO_STAGE.get((fallback_lane or "").strip(), "")
4347     eid_attr = html_lib.escape(str(eid), quote=True)
4348     stage_attr = html_lib.escape(str(stage), quote=True)
4349     return (f" data-effort-id=\"{eid_attr}\""
4350             f" data-current-stage=\"{stage_attr}\"")
4351 
4352 
4353 def _build_effort_index(project_id):
4354     """Build a ``session_id -> effort dict`` index from :func:`_gather_efforts`
4355     (the v12 Wave 9 effort view). Used by the Layout-D render to bind each tile to
4356     its effort (W10). Each effort's chain root AND every member session id map to
4357     the SAME effort dict. Best-effort: honest ``{}`` on any failure (the tiles
4358     then fall back to a singleton effort = the session id)."""
4359     idx = {}
4360     try:
4361         for eff in _gather_efforts(project_id):
4362             if not isinstance(eff, dict):
4363                 continue
4364             eid = eff.get("effort_id") or eff.get("chain_id") or ""
4365             if eid:
4366                 idx[eid] = eff
4367             for m in eff.get("members", []) or []:
4368                 msid = m.get("session_id") if isinstance(m, dict) else None
4369                 if msid:
4370                     idx[msid] = eff
4371     except Exception:
4372         return {}
4373     return idx
4374

4376 def _render_layoutd_minitile(sv, trio_lane, project_id, folder_path, store_lane,
4377                              effort_index=None):
4378     """Render ONE Layout-D shelf ``.minitile`` from a session view (v12 Wave 2).
4379 
4380     Mockup schema: a ``.minitile`` with a ``.mtop`` (status dot + a stage badge),
4381     a ``.mtitle`` (the session's short title), and a ``.mfoot`` (state + age). It
4382     ALSO carries the legacy ``tile lane-tile`` + ``data-session`` click hooks so
4383     the W10 dock-open wiring (and the panel-open tests) bind to it. v12 W10:
4384     clicking it opens the SINGLE bottom dock bound to the tile's effort.
4385     """
4386     members = sv.get("members", []) or []
4387     rep = members[0] if members else None
4388     if rep is None:
4389         return ""
4390     light = _session_light_class(rep)
4391     sid = sv.get("session_id", "") or ""
4392     sid_attr = html_lib.escape(sid, quote=True)
4393     lane_attr = html_lib.escape(trio_lane, quote=True)
4394     title = html_lib.escape(_session_tile_title(rep))
4395     state_cls, state_lbl = _session_state_text(rep)
4396     state_lbl = html_lib.escape(state_lbl)
4397     age = html_lib.escape(rep.get("age") or "")
4398     if trio_lane == "general":
4399         badge_lane, badge_lbl = "general", "General"
4400     else:
4401         badge_lane = "build" if trio_lane == "build" else (
4402             "plan" if trio_lane in ("plan", "planning") else "research")
4403         badge_lbl = badge_lane.capitalize()
4404     extra = ""
4405     if light == "green":
4406         extra = " running"
4407     elif light == "red":
4408         extra = " failed"
4409     foot = (f"<span class='state {html_lib.escape(state_cls)}'>{state_lbl}</span>"
4410             + (f"<span class='age'>{age}</span>" if age else "<span></span>"))
4411     grass_chip = _layoutd_grass_origin_chip(rep, trio_lane)
4412     tie_data, tie_chip = _layoutd_tie_chip(sv)
4413     em_data = " data-effort-managed=\"1\"" if rep.get("effort_managed") else ""
4414     eff_data = _effort_data_attrs(sid, effort_index, fallback_lane=trio_lane)
4415     # W4 #6 UI — a discovered/brownfield shelf tile also carries the "Resume as
4416     # session" control (same warm-resume path as the headline); "" otherwise.
4417     resume_ctl = _layoutd_resume_control(sv, rep, trio_lane)
4418     return (
4419         f"<div class='minitile tile lane-tile{extra}' data-session=\"{sid_attr}\" "
4420         f"data-lane=\"{lane_attr}\" data-light=\"{light}\"{tie_data}{em_data}"
4421         f"{eff_data} "
4422         f"onclick=\"laneTileClick(event,'{sid_attr}')\">"
4423         f"<div class='mtop'><span class='dot {light}'></span>"
4424         f"<span class='badge {badge_lane}'>{badge_lbl}</span></div>"
4425         f"<div class='mtitle'>{title}</div>"
4426         f"<div class='mfoot'>{foot}</div>"
4427         f"{tie_chip}"
4428         f"{grass_chip}"
4429         f"{resume_ctl}"
4430         f"</div>"
4431     )

4434 def _render_layoutd_headline(sv, trio_lane, project_id, folder_path, store_lane,
4435                              zone_label, effort_index=None):
4436     """Render the Layout-D ``.headline`` card for a zone's most-recent session
4437     (v12 Wave 2 / wired W10). Mirrors the mockup headline (status dot + stage
4438     badge + title + blurb + a 3-node stage track + report/summary links). Carries
4439     the legacy ``tile lane-tile`` + ``data-session`` hooks so the W10 dock-open
4440     wiring (and the panel-open tests) bind.
4441 
4442     v12 W10 / EV-2: the 3-node stage track lights by the tile's EFFORT
4443     ``current_stage`` (presence-based — research→node1, plan→1-2, build→1-3), NOT
4444     by the bare lane and NOT by iterating ``stage_history`` 1:1. Falls back to the
4445     lane when no effort resolves.
4446     """
4447     members = sv.get("members", []) or []
4448     rep = members[0] if members else None
4449     if rep is None:
4450         return ""
4451     light = _session_light_class(rep)
4452     sid = sv.get("session_id", "") or ""
4453     sid_attr = html_lib.escape(sid, quote=True)
4454     lane_attr = html_lib.escape(trio_lane, quote=True)
4455     title = html_lib.escape(_session_tile_title(rep))
4456     state_cls, state_lbl = _session_state_text(rep)
4457     blurb = ""
4458     if folder_path is not None:
4459         blurb = _session_tile_blurb(sv, folder_path, project_id, store_lane)
4460     blurb_html = (f"<p class='hblurb'>{html_lib.escape(blurb)}</p>"
4461                   if blurb else "")
4462     if trio_lane == "general":
4463         badge_lane, badge_lbl = "general", "General"
4464     else:
4465         badge_lane = "build" if trio_lane == "build" else (
4466             "plan" if trio_lane in ("plan", "planning") else "research")
4467         # Plan and Build share ONE combined zone → label it as both.
4468         badge_lbl = ("Plan / Build" if badge_lane in ("plan", "build")
4469                      else badge_lane.capitalize())
4470     running_cls = " running" if light == "green" else ""
4471     running_chip = ("<span style='font-size:11px;color:var(--success)'>"
4472                     "&#9679; running</span>" if light == "green" else "")
4473     # v12 W10 / EV-2: light the 3-node stage track by the EFFORT's current_stage
4474     # (presence-based), falling back to the bare lane when no effort resolves.
4475     # General sessions are stage-less (not a trio lane) — no Research→Plan→Build
4476     # track (it would be misleading); the dock likewise suppresses it for general.
4477     if trio_lane == "general":
4478         track = ""
4479     else:
4480         eff = (effort_index or {}).get(sid)
4481         track_stage = (eff.get("current_stage") if eff else "") or trio_lane
4482         # research → first node; plan → first two; build → all three.
4483         reached = {"research": 1, "plan": 2, "planning": 2, "build": 3}.get(
4484             track_stage, 1)
4485         track = _render_layoutd_track(track_stage, reached)
4486     grass_chip = _layoutd_grass_origin_chip(rep, trio_lane)
4487     tie_data, tie_chip = _layoutd_tie_chip(sv)
4488     em_data = " data-effort-managed=\"1\"" if rep.get("effort_managed") else ""
4489     eff_data = _effort_data_attrs(sid, effort_index, fallback_lane=trio_lane)
4490     # W4 #6 UI — a discovered/brownfield headline carries a "Resume as session"
4491     # control (warm resume via the W3 synthesized seed); "" for a managed tile.
4492     resume_ctl = _layoutd_resume_control(sv, rep, trio_lane)
4493     # Trio skill icon(s) on the big headline tile: Research→researchPrime; the
4494     # combined Plan/Build zone shows BOTH Crucible + Foreman. Served from /vendor/brand.
4495     def _skill_icon_img(fn, skill):
4496         return (
4497             f"<img class='lane-skill-icon' src='/vendor/brand/{fn}?v={BUILD_ID}' "
4498             f"alt='{skill}' title='{skill}' "
4499             f"style='width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:5px;object-fit:cover;"
4500             f"vertical-align:middle;margin-right:5px'>")
4501     if badge_lane == "research":
4502         lane_icon = _skill_icon_img("research-prime-icon.jpg", "researchPrime")
4503     elif badge_lane in ("plan", "build"):
4504         lane_icon = (_skill_icon_img("crucible-icon.svg", "Crucible")
4505                      + _skill_icon_img("foreman-icon.svg", "Foreman"))
4506     else:
4507         lane_icon = ""
4508     return (
4509         f"<div class='headline tile lane-tile{running_cls}' "
4510         f"data-session=\"{sid_attr}\" data-lane=\"{lane_attr}\" "
4511         f"data-light=\"{light}\"{tie_data}{em_data}{eff_data} "
4512         f"onclick=\"laneTileClick(event,'{sid_attr}')\">"
4513         f"<div class='htop'>"
4514         f"<span class='dot {light}'></span>"
4515         f"{lane_icon}"
4516         f"<span class='badge {badge_lane}'>{badge_lbl}</span>"
4517         f"{running_chip}{grass_chip}</div>"
4518         f"<div class='htitle'>{title}</div>"
4519         f"{blurb_html}"
4520         f"<div class='hrow'>{track}{tie_chip}{resume_ctl}</div>"
4521         f"</div>"
4522     )
4523 
4524 
4525 def _render_layoutd_track(trio_lane, reached):
4526     """Render the 3-node Research→Plan→Build stage track for a headline card."""
4527     lanes = ("research", "plan", "build")
4528     cur_idx = {"research": 0, "plan": 1, "planning": 1, "build": 2}.get(
4529         trio_lane, 0)
4530     parts = ["<span class='track'>"]
4531     for i, ln in enumerate(lanes):
4532         node_cls = ["node", ln]
4533         if i < reached:
4534             node_cls.append("reached")
4535         if i == cur_idx:
4536             node_cls.append("current")
4537         parts.append(f"<span class='{' '.join(node_cls)}'></span>")
4538         if i < len(lanes) - 1:
4539             line_cls = "line done" if i + 1 < reached else "line"
4540             parts.append(f"<span class='{line_cls}'></span>")
4541     cur_lbl = {"plan": "Plan", "planning": "Plan", "build": "Build"}.get(
4542         trio_lane, "Research")
4543     parts.append(f"<span class='track-lbl'>{cur_lbl}</span></span>")
4544     return "".join(parts)
4545 
4546 
4547 def _render_layoutd_zone(zone_key, zone_label, section_lbl, sessions,
4548                          folder_path, project_id, effort_index=None):
4549     """Render one Layout-D zone: a section label + the headline card + a
4550     collapsible shelf of older "little tiles" (v12 Wave 2 / wired W10). Honest
4551     empty state (and NO shelf) when the zone has no sessions. ``effort_index``
4552     (session_id → effort dict) binds each tile to its effort for the dock.
4553     """
4554     if not sessions:
4555         empty = (
4556             f"<div class='sectionlbl'>{section_lbl}</div>"
4557             f"<div class='headline' data-empty='1' data-zone='{zone_key}'>"
4558             f"<p class='hblurb'>No {html_lib.escape(zone_label.lower())} "
4559             f"sessions yet.</p></div>"
4560         )
4561         return empty
4562     head_sv = sessions[0]
4563     head_lane = _sv_zone_lane(head_sv, zone_key)
4564     store_lane = "planning" if head_lane == "plan" else head_lane
4565     headline = _render_layoutd_headline(
4566         head_sv, head_lane, project_id, folder_path, store_lane, zone_label,
4567         effort_index=effort_index)
4568     older = sessions[1:]
4569     shelf = ""
4570     if older:
4571         tiles = []
4572         for sv in older:
4573             ln = _sv_zone_lane(sv, zone_key)
4574             sl = "planning" if ln == "plan" else ln
4575             tiles.append(_render_layoutd_minitile(
4576                 sv, ln, project_id, folder_path, sl,
4577                 effort_index=effort_index))
4578         n = len(older)
4579         shelf_id = f"shelf_{html_lib.escape(zone_key, quote=True)}"
4580         tgl_id = f"tgl_{html_lib.escape(zone_key, quote=True)}"
4581         label_attr = html_lib.escape(zone_label.lower(), quote=True)
4582         # John tweak: the OLDER-runs shelf starts COLLAPSED on first load (the
4583         # headline card stays visible). Server-render the collapsed class + the
4584         # "Show all" caption so there is no flash of expanded content before JS.
4585         # W4 #3 render — the shelf IS the "previous efforts" expander: it renders
4586         # ONLY when a zone holds >1 effort (the latest is the headline, the rest
4587         # sit behind this expander). The ``prev-efforts`` class is the stable hook
4588         # for that contract (present iff >1).
4589         shelf = (
4590             f"<button class='showall prev-efforts' id='{tgl_id}' "
4591             f"onclick=\"toggleShelf('{shelf_id}','{tgl_id}',{n},"
4592             f"'{label_attr}')\">&#9656; Show all {n} older "
4593             f"{html_lib.escape(zone_label.lower())} sessions</button>"
4594             f"<div class='shelf-wrap prev-efforts collapsed' id='{shelf_id}'>"
4595             f"<div class='shelf'>{''.join(tiles)}</div></div>"
4596         )
4597     return (
4598         f"<div class='sectionlbl'>{section_lbl}</div>"
4599         f"{headline}"
4600         f"{shelf}"
4601     )
4602 
4603 
4604 def _sv_zone_lane(sv, zone_key):
4605     """Best-effort trio-lane for a session view inside a Layout-D zone, from the
4606     representative member's ``trio_lane`` (the merged plan/build zone holds both)."""
4607     if zone_key == "research":
4608         return "research"
4609     if zone_key == "general":
4610         return "general"
4611     rep = (sv.get("members") or [None])[0]
4612     if isinstance(rep, dict):
4613         ln = (rep.get("trio_lane") or "").strip()
4614         if ln in ("plan", "planning", "build"):
4615             return ln
4616     return "plan"

4619 def _gandalf_ts_label(ts) -> str:
4620     """Format a Gandalf run's unix ts as ``YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`` (honest empty)."""
4621     try:
4622         return datetime.fromtimestamp(float(ts)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
4623     except (TypeError, ValueError, OSError):
4624         return ""

4627 def _render_layoutd_gandalf_panel(folder_path, project_id) -> str:
4628     """Render the Layout-D right-column Gandalf mini-panel (Gandalf v1 Wave 3).
4629 
4630     The white-wizard "what's really going on here" read. Reads ``gandalf.list_runs``
4631     ONLY (the internal index — NEVER a model call on render). Header = the
4632     white-wizard icon + "Gandalf" + a Re-run button (``gandalfRun(PROJECT_ID)``).
4633     Run history newest-first; each row = the one-line verdict + ts + grade chips
4634     (a SPECULATIVE/PROMISING floor chip + a single-family/Error chip as applicable).
4635     Clicking a row inline-expands its exec-summary (fetched from ``exec_rel`` via
4636     the traversal-safe ``/artifact`` route) with [Full report] + [raw JSON] links.
4637     A degraded/error run renders an HONEST row (reason text, NO dead links).
4638     Honest empty state ("No Gandalf read yet" + a Run button) before the first run.
4639     Sits ABOVE Grass in the right column (decision #5). HTML f-string (double
4640     braces); the panel JS lives in the RAW ``_PROJECT_WINDOW_JS``.
4641     """
4642     try:
4643         runs = _gandalf.list_runs(folder_path, project_id)
4644     except Exception:
4645         runs = []
4646     n = len(runs)
4647     
4648     in_flight = False
4649     with _GANDALF_INFLIGHT_GUARD:
4650         in_flight = project_id in _GANDALF_INFLIGHT
4651         
4652     pid_q = html_lib.escape(str(project_id), quote=True)
4653     icon = (
4654         f"<img class='gicon' src='/vendor/brand/gandalf-icon-v5.jpg?v={BUILD_ID}' "
4655         "alt='Gandalf the White'>")
4656 
4657     dis = " disabled" if in_flight else ""
4658 
4659     if not runs:
4660         # Honest empty state — no fabricated rows; a single Run control.
4661         body = (
4662             "<div class='gandalf-empty' data-gandalf-empty='1'>"
4663             "No Gandalf read yet."
4664             f"<button class='btn sm primary gandalf-run'{dis} "
4665             f"onclick=\"gandalfRun('{pid_q}')\">&#8635; { 'Running...' if in_flight else 'Run' }</button>"
4666             f"<button class='btn sm gandalf-run gandalf-heavy'{dis} "
4667             "title='Gandalf-Heavy — top-tier Claude (Fable-5) reasoner' "
4668             f"onclick=\"gandalfRun('{pid_q}', 'heavy')\">&#9733; { 'Running Heavy...' if in_flight else 'Run Heavy' }</button>"
4669             "</div>")
4670         inflight_attr = " data-gandalf-inflight='1'" if in_flight else ""
4671         return (
4672             f"<div class='panel gandalf-panel' id='gandalfPanel'{inflight_attr}>"
4673             "<div class='ptitle gandalf-head'>"
4674             ""
4675             f"{icon}<span class='gt'>Gandalf</span>"
4676             f"<button class='btn sm gandalf-run gandalf-rerun'{dis} "
4677             f"onclick=\"gandalfRun('{pid_q}')\">&#8635; { 'Running...' if in_flight else 'Re-run' }</button>"
4678             f"<button class='btn sm gandalf-run gandalf-heavy'{dis} "
4679             "title='Gandalf-Heavy — top-tier Claude (Fable-5) reasoner' "
4680             f"onclick=\"gandalfRun('{pid_q}', 'heavy')\">&#9733; { 'Running Heavy...' if in_flight else 'Heavy' }</button></div>"
4681             f"<div class='gandalf-panel-body' id='gandalfPanelBody'>{body}</div>"
4682             "</div>")
4683 
4684     rows = []
4685     for r in runs:
4686         run_id = html_lib.escape(str(r.get("run_id") or ""), quote=True)
4687         ok = bool(r.get("ok"))
4688         verdict = r.get("verdict") or ""
4689         ts_lbl = html_lib.escape(_gandalf_ts_label(r.get("ts")))
4690         report_rel = r.get("report_rel") or ""
4691         exec_rel = r.get("exec_rel") or ""
4692         adv_rel = r.get("advisor_rel") or ""
4693 
4694         # A still-running record (the up-front in-progress row a background run
4695         # writes before it finishes) is neither a success nor an error — render it
4696         # as a RUNNING row, never a red "Run did not complete" error.
4697         running = bool(r.get("in_progress")) or (r.get("status") == "running")
4698 
4699         # Verdict / honest-error one-liner.
4700         if running:
4701             vtxt = "Running&hellip;"
4702             vcls = "verdict"
4703         elif ok:
4704             vtxt = html_lib.escape(verdict or "(no verdict)")
4705             vcls = "verdict"
4706         else:
4707             reason = html_lib.escape(str(r.get("reason") or "unknown"))
4708             vtxt = ("Run did not complete &mdash; " + reason)
4709             vcls = "verdict err"
4710 
4711         # Grade chips. The v1 honesty floor: Tier-1 elevations land SPECULATIVE,
4712         # single-family is cross_model:false. An error run gets a single Error chip.
4713         chips = []
4714         if running:
4715             chips.append("<span class='chip run'>Running</span>")
4716         elif not ok:
4717             chips.append("<span class='chip deg'>Error</span>")
4718         else:
4719             if r.get("cross_model"):
4720                 chips.append("<span class='chip prom'>Promising</span>")
4721             else:
4722                 chips.append("<span class='chip spec'>Speculative</span>")
4723                 chips.append("<span class='chip sf'>single-family</span>")
4724             if r.get("degraded"):
4725                 chips.append("<span class='chip deg'>degraded</span>")
4726         # Tier badge — mark a Gandalf-Heavy (Fable-5) read so it's distinguishable
4727         # from a regular (Opus) read at a glance.
4728         if r.get("tier") == "heavy":
4729             chips.append("<span class='chip heavy'>Heavy</span>")
4730         chips_html = "".join(chips)
4731 
4732         # SAFE links — only when the artifact rel paths exist (an error run has
4733         # none → NO dead links, per the mockup).
4734         exec_attr = html_lib.escape(exec_rel, quote=True)
4735         links = ""
4736         link_parts = []
4737         if ok and exec_rel:
4738             link_parts.append(
4739                 f"<span class='genlarge' onclick=\"enlargeGandalfRun(event, this)\" style='cursor:pointer;color:var(--accent);margin-right:12px;font-size:11px'>&#10530; Enlarge</span>"
4740             )
4741         if ok and (report_rel or adv_rel):
4742             if report_rel:
4743                 # v13 W1: &render=1 → the route serves the rendered Reader page;
4744                 # the named window keeps every report open in ONE tab.
4745                 href = (f"/artifact/{pid_q}?path="
4746                         + url_quote(report_rel, safe='') + "&render=1")
4747                 link_parts.append(
4748                     f"<a href='{href}' target='anchor_report_window' "
4749                     "rel='noopener'>&#128196; Full report</a>")
4750             if adv_rel:
4751                 ahref = (f"/artifact/{pid_q}?path="
4752                          + url_quote(adv_rel, safe=''))
4753                 link_parts.append(
4754                     f"<a href='{ahref}' target='anchor_report_window' "
4755                     "rel='noopener'>{ } raw JSON</a>")
4756         if link_parts:
4757             links = "<div class='glinks'>" + "".join(link_parts) + "</div>"
4758 
4759         # The expandable body: only OK runs with an exec-summary carry one (fetched
4760         # lazily on first expand via gandalfToggleRun → /artifact). John tweak: an
4761         # ERROR run is NOT expandable — drop its caret + onclick (the failure reason
4762         # already shows in the row line; clicking opened an empty body box). OK runs
4763         # keep the expand caret + onclick.
4764         body_attr = (f" data-exec-rel='{exec_attr}'" if (ok and exec_rel) else "")
4765         # The (x) retire/archive control on EACH tile — drops the run via
4766         # /api/rnd/gandalf_archive and removes the tile on success. stopPropagation
4767         # so it never toggles the row open.
4768         retire = (
4769             "<span class='gretire' title='Retire / archive this run' "
4770             f"onclick=\"gandalfArchiveRun(event, '{run_id}')\">&times;</span>")
4771         if running:
4772             # Non-expandable RUNNING row: no caret, no error class, no retire
4773             # control (a live run can't be archived) — just a live status line.
4774             rows.append(
4775                 f"<div class='grun run-row' data-run='{run_id}'>"
4776                 f"<div class='grtop'><span class='{vcls}'>{vtxt}</span></div>"
4777                 "<div class='gmeta'>"
4778                 f"<span class='gts'>{ts_lbl}</span>{chips_html}</div>"
4779                 "</div>")
4780         elif ok:
4781             rows.append(
4782                 f"<div class='grun' data-run='{run_id}'{body_attr} "
4783                 "onclick='gandalfToggleRun(this)'>"
4784                 "<div class='grtop'><span class='gcaret'>&#9656;</span>"
4785                 f"<span class='{vcls}'>{vtxt}</span>{retire}</div>"
4786                 "<div class='gmeta'>"
4787                 f"<span class='gts'>{ts_lbl}</span>{chips_html}</div>"
4788                 "<div class='gbody' onclick='event.stopPropagation()'>"
4789                 f"<div class='gexec'></div>{links}</div>"
4790                 "</div>")
4791         else:
4792             # Non-expandable error row: no caret, no onclick, no body box.
4793             rows.append(
4794                 f"<div class='grun err-row' data-run='{run_id}'>"
4795                 f"<div class='grtop'><span class='{vcls}'>{vtxt}</span>{retire}</div>"
4796                 "<div class='gmeta'>"
4797                 f"<span class='gts'>{ts_lbl}</span>{chips_html}</div>"
4798                 "</div>")
4799 
4800     # "Clear failed" — bulk-retire every failed/error run. Rendered ONLY when at
4801     # least one failed run exists (POST /api/rnd/gandalf_clear_failed).
4802     n_failed = sum(1 for r in runs if not bool(r.get("ok"))
4803                    and not (r.get("in_progress") or r.get("status") == "running"))
4804     clear_failed_btn = ""
4805     if n_failed:
4806         clear_failed_btn = (
4807             "<button class='btn sm gandalf-clear-failed' "
4808             "title='Retire all failed runs' "
4809             f"onclick=\"gandalfClearFailed('{pid_q}')\">&#10005; "
4810             f"Clear failed ({n_failed})</button>")
4811     # John tweak: the run list is collapsible IN THE HEADER (caret toggle, mirrors
4812     # the grass-mini pattern) and starts COLLAPSED on first load (server-rendered
4813     # .collapsed + the ▸ caret) so there is no flash of expanded content before JS.
4814     inflight_attr = " data-gandalf-inflight='1'" if in_flight else ""
4815     return (
4816         f"<div class='panel gandalf-panel' id='gandalfPanel'{inflight_attr}>"
4817         "<div class='ptitle gandalf-head'>"
4818         "<span class='gmini-tog' id='gandalfRunsTog' title='Collapse / expand the "
4819         "run list' onclick='toggleGandalfRuns(this)'>&#9656;</span>"
4820         f"{icon}<span class='gt'>Gandalf</span>"
4821         f"<span class='cnt'>{n} read{'s' if n != 1 else ''}</span>"
4822         f"{clear_failed_btn}"
4823         f"<button class='btn sm gandalf-run gandalf-rerun'{dis} "
4824         f"onclick=\"gandalfRun('{pid_q}')\">&#8635; { 'Running...' if in_flight else 'Re-run' }</button>"
4825         f"<button class='btn sm gandalf-run gandalf-heavy'{dis} "
4826         "title='Gandalf-Heavy — top-tier Claude (Fable-5) reasoner' "
4827         f"onclick=\"gandalfRun('{pid_q}', 'heavy')\">&#9733; { 'Running Heavy...' if in_flight else 'Heavy' }</button></div>"
4828         f"<div class='gandalf-panel-body' id='gandalfPanelBody'>"
4829         f"<div class='gruns collapsed' id='gandalfRuns'>{''.join(rows)}</div>"
