4882 def _render_layoutd_deliverables_panel(folder_path, project_id) -> str:
4883     """Project Deliverables tab: same hierarchy as the cockpit tile.
4884 
4885     Current work, approved versions, then expandable work streams (the course /
4886     product groups). Pinned Foreman tiles remain as a stream when they are not
4887     already in a steward register.
4888     """
4889     from steward_cockpit import steward_campaign as _scamp
4890     try:
4891         views = _scamp.project_deliverable_view(folder_path)
4892     except Exception:
4893         views = []
4894     try:
4895         pinned = _deliv.list_pinned_deliverables(folder_path, project_id)
4896     except Exception:
4897         pinned = []
4898     listed_paths = {str(it.get("path") or "").replace("\\", "/").lower()
4899                     for v in views for it in (v.get("items") or [])}
4900     leftover = []
4901     for r in pinned:
4902         rel = (r.get("artifact_path") or "").replace("\\", "/")
4903         if rel.lower() not in listed_paths:
4904             leftover.append(r)

4906     body = []

4908     approved = [it for v in views for it in (v.get("approved") or [])]
4909     body.append(_render_deliv_section("Current work and review", current, project_id,
4910                                       empty="No current items awaiting review."))
4911     body.append(_render_deliv_approved(approved, project_id))
4912     if len(views) > 1:
4913         for v in views:
4914             streams = "".join(_render_deliv_stream(s, project_id) for s in (v.get("streams") or []))
4915             if not streams:
4916                 streams = "".join(_render_deliv_item(it, project_id) for it in (v.get("items") or []))
4917             if not streams:
4918                 streams = "<div class='navempty'>No deliverables registered yet.</div>"
4919             body.append(
4920                 "<details class='deliv-stream'>"
4921                 f"<summary>{html_lib.escape(v.get('name') or 'effort')}</summary>"

4930         body.extend(streams)

4932         pins = "".join(_render_pinned_deliv_row(r) for r in leftover)

4935             "<summary><span class='plan-mark todo'>▷</span> Pinned builds</summary>"
4936             f"<div class='deliv-stream-body'>{pins}</div></details>")
4937     if count == 0:
4938         body.append(
4939             "<div class='idea-empty'>No deliverables registered yet — the steward "
4940             "lists them when a human-facing artifact lands.</div>")
4941     return (
4942         "<div class='panel deliverables-panel'>"
4943         "<details class='deliv-details'>"
4944         f"<summary class='ptitle' style='cursor:pointer; outline:none'>"
4945         f"<span class='disc-caret' style='font-size:11px; transition:transform 0.12s; display:inline-block; margin-right:4px'>&#9662;</span>"
4946         f"&#128230; Deliverables <span class='cnt'>{count}</span>"
4947         f"</summary>"
4948         f"<div class='deliv-body' style='margin-top:8px'>{''.join(body)}</div>"
4949         "</details>"
4950         "</div>"
4951     )

5032 def _load_gitignore(folder_path) -> list:
5033     """Read .gitignore patterns from the project root if present, plus .anchorignore."""
5034     ignore_path = Path(folder_path) / ".gitignore"
5035     patterns = []
5036     if ignore_path.is_file():
5037         try:
5038             with open(ignore_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
5039                 for line in fh:
5040                     line = line.strip()
5041                     if line and not line.startswith("#"):
5042                         patterns.append(line)
5043         except OSError:
5044             pass
5045     anchorignore_path = Path(folder_path) / ".anchorignore"
5046     if anchorignore_path.is_file():
5047         try:
5048             with open(anchorignore_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
5049                 for line in fh:
5050                     line = line.strip()
5051                     if line and not line.startswith("#"):
5052                         patterns.append(line)
5053         except OSError:
5054             pass
5055     return patterns
5056 
5057 
5058 def _should_ignore_file(rel_path: Path, patterns: list) -> bool:
5059     """Determine if a relative path matches any ignore pattern or standard skip dirs.
5060 
5061     Reuses the existing logic shape from gandalf.py.
5062     """
5063     import fnmatch
5064     parts_lower = [p.lower() for p in rel_path.parts]
5065     for skip in {".git", ".anchor", "node_modules", "__pycache__", ".venv", "venv", ".mypy_cache", ".pytest_cache"}:
5066         if skip in parts_lower:
5067             return True
5068 
5069     rel_str = rel_path.as_posix()
5070     rel_str_lower = rel_str.lower()
5071 
5072     for pattern in patterns:
5073         clean_pat = pattern.rstrip('/')
5074         if not clean_pat:
5075             continue
5076         clean_pat_lower = clean_pat.lower()
5077 
5078         # Check components of the path
5079         for part in rel_path.parts:
5080             part_lower = part.lower()
5081             if fnmatch.fnmatch(part, clean_pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(part_lower, clean_pat_lower):
5082                 return True
5083 
5084         # Check full relative path and patterns
5085         if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel_str, clean_pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(rel_str_lower, clean_pat_lower):
5086             return True
5087         if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel_str, pattern) or fnmatch.fnmatch(rel_str_lower, pattern.lower()):
5088             return True
5089 
5090         # Support directory-specific patterns like "dir/*" or "dir/"
5091         if pattern.endswith('/'):
5092             if rel_str_lower.startswith(clean_pat_lower + '/'):
5093                 return True
5094         if clean_pat.startswith('*') and fnmatch.fnmatch(rel_str_lower, '*' + clean_pat_lower):
5095             return True
5096 
5097     return False
5098

5100 def _render_layoutd_files_panel(folder_path, project_id) -> str:
5101     """Render the Layout-D right-column Project Files panel (v13 Wave 3)."""
5102     pid_attr = html_lib.escape(project_id, quote=True)
5103     try:
5104         project_root = Path(folder_path).resolve()
5105         patterns = _load_gitignore(project_root)
5106         count = 0
5107         for entry in project_root.iterdir():
5108             try:
5109                 resolved_entry = entry.resolve()
5110                 resolved_entry.relative_to(project_root)
5111                 rel_entry = entry.relative_to(project_root)
5112                 if not _should_ignore_file(rel_entry, patterns):
5113                     count += 1
5114             except (ValueError, OSError):
5115                 continue
5116     except Exception:
5117         count = 0
5118 
5119     return (
5120         "<div class='panel files-panel'>"
5121         "<details class='files-details' id='projectFilesDetails' ontoggle='onProjectFilesToggle(this)'>"
5122         "<summary class='ptitle' style='cursor:pointer; outline:none'>"

5142 def _render_layoutd_html(folder_path, project_id):
5143     """Render the v12 Layout-D board (Wave 2 skeleton, wired LIVE in W10).
5144 
5145     The headline cards + collapsible shelves render from
5146     :func:`_gather_project_sessions` (the visible tile shape) and are BOUND to the
5147     effort view (:func:`_gather_efforts`) via an effort index so each tile carries
5148     ``data-effort-id`` + ``data-current-stage`` — the dock opens bound to the
5149     effort and the 3-node stage track lights by ``current_stage`` (W10 / EV-2).
5150     The single bottom dock (chrome rendered separately) is the live surface.
5151     Returns the board fragment (+ the retained hidden grass-workbench template)."""
5152     sessions_by_lane = _gather_project_sessions(folder_path, project_id)
5153     zones = _layoutd_zones(folder_path, project_id, sessions_by_lane)
5154     # v12 W10: bind the tiles to the effort view (session_id → effort dict).
5155     effort_index = _build_effort_index(project_id)
5156     # (2026-08-07, John — the simple workbench, SERVER-side this time.) The
5157     # Research and Plan/Build zones are gone: John works in general terminals,
5158     # and steward-commissioned trio runs are watched from the run ledger, not
5159     # board columns. Sessions in those lanes stay reachable via the session
5160     # bar chips and the ledger's "Open the session".
5161     research_zone = ""
5162     plan_build_zone = ""
5163     # The GENERAL zone is the board now — always rendered, empty state included.
5164     general_sessions = zones.get("general", []) or []
5165     general_zone = _render_layoutd_zone(
5166         "general", "General", "&#128187; Latest General session",
5167         general_sessions, folder_path, project_id, effort_index=effort_index)
5168     # (2026-08-07, John) The Gandalf panel is OUTSIDE the steward — commissioned
5169     # Gandalf runs live in the Seal's ledger now, so the project page drops the
5170     # standalone tab. It stays in the dashboard's slim Workbench (John's four
5171     # right-hand tiles there include it).
5172     gandalf_panel = (_render_layoutd_gandalf_panel(folder_path, project_id)
5173                      if project_id == "__dashboard__" else "")
5174     grass_panel = _render_layoutd_grass_panel(folder_path, project_id)
5175     deliv_panel = _render_layoutd_deliverables_panel(folder_path, project_id)
5176     files_panel = _render_layoutd_files_panel(folder_path, project_id)
5177     # v12 W10 (John change #2): TWO explicit start controls — "+ New research"
5178     # starts an effort at the Research stage, "+ New plan/build" starts one at the
5179     # Plan stage (W6 supports starting at research OR plan). Both go through
5180     # newEffort(stage) → term_start (effort_managed=True), token-authed.
5181     # (2026-08-07, John) One start control: the general terminal. Research /
5182     # plan / build work is commissioned through the steward, not hand-started
5183     # from board buttons.
5184     new_effort = (
5185         "<div class='neweffort-wrap' style='margin:0 0 18px;display:flex;gap:8px'>"
5186         "<button class='btn primary neweffort' id='newGeneralBtn' "
5187         "onclick=\"newEffort('general')\" "
5188         "title='Start a new general terminal session'>"
5189         "+ New general terminal</button></div>"
5190     )
5191     board = (
5192         "<div class='pgrid layoutd'>"
5193         "<div class='leftcol'>"
5194         f"{new_effort}"
5195         f"{research_zone}"
5196         f"{plan_build_zone}"
5197         f"{general_zone}"
5198         "</div>"
5199         "<div class='rightcol'>"
5200         f"{gandalf_panel}"
5201         f"{grass_panel}"
5202         f"{deliv_panel}"
5203         f"{files_panel}"
5204         "</div>"
5205         "</div>"
5206     )
5207     # The full two-pane Grass workbench, kept as a hidden template the panel
5208     # manager (openGrassWorkbench) clones into #panelStack (reused unchanged).
5209     workbench = (
5210         "<div id='grassWorkbenchTpl' style='display:none'>"
5211         + _render_grass_workbench(folder_path, project_id)
5212         + "</div>"
5213     )
5214     return board + workbench

5217 def _render_layoutd_dock_html() -> str:
5218     """Render the Layout-D single bottom DOCK chrome (v12 Wave 2; wired LIVE W10).
5219 
5220     Mirrors the mockup dock: a title bar (status dot + title + a 3-node stage
5221     track + min/max/close + a distinct Kill -> Boneyard + the context-full WARN
5222     banner + Advance ->), then the body — summary ON TOP (full width), a draggable
5223     vertical splitter, and a full-width terminal whose height the user drags.
5224     Hidden + UNBOUND by default (``display:none``, no ``data-effort-id``); the W10
5225     JS (``openEffortDock``) shows + binds it to the clicked effort. The structural
5226     ids/classes here are the JS attach points; the live content is filled by JS
5227     (summary via ``_loadPanelSummary``/``_renderSplitSummary``; terminal via
5228     ``_mountTerminal``/``_mountReadOnlyBody`` over the WS->SSE transport).
5229     """
5230     return (
5231         "<div class='dock' id='effortDock' style='display:none'>"
5232         "<div class='dbar'>"
5233         "<span class='dot grey' id='dockDot'></span>"
5234         "<span class='dtitle' id='dockTitle'>Effort</span>"

5301 def _session_tile_title(rep) -> str:
5302     """The visible title for a Paradigm-2 lane tile, derived from a session's
5303     representative effort view. Discovered → its ``title``; a run → its prompt
5304     hint / skill ``sub``; falls back to a lane-agnostic placeholder."""
5305     if not rep:
5306         return "session"
5307     if rep.get("discovered"):
5308         return (rep.get("title") or rep.get("artifact_path") or "imported").strip()
5309     sub = (rep.get("sub") or "").strip()
5310     if sub:
5311         return sub
5312     return (rep.get("skill") or "session").strip() or "session"

5315 def _session_state_text(rep):
5316     """Return ``(state_class, state_label)`` for a tile's ``.st`` state span,
5317     mapped from the representative effort view (mirrors the mockup states:
5318     running / needs you / fail / done / imported / idle)."""
5319     if not rep:
5320         return ("done", "idle")
5321     if rep.get("discovered"):
5322         return ("done", "imported")
5323     if rep.get("needs_input"):
5324         return ("attn", "needs you")
5325     if rep.get("is_live"):
5326         return ("running", "running")
5327     if rep.get("is_done"):
5328         return ("done", "done")
5329     pill = (rep.get("pill_cls") or "").strip()
5330     if pill == "fail":
5331         return ("fail", rep.get("pill_lbl") or "failed")
5332     return ("done", rep.get("pill_lbl") or rep.get("status") or "idle")

5334 
5335 def _session_tile_blurb(sv, folder_path, project_id, store_lane):
5336     """The short, clean blurb line for a lane tile (v7 Wave 3).
5337 
5338     Cache/registry-only — NEVER a synchronous model call on the render path:
5339 
5340     - A FINISHED session prefers its CACHED session summary blurb
5341       (:func:`summarizer.session_blurb`, a cache read; ``""`` when uncached).
5342     - A RUNNING session (or a finished one with no cache yet) falls back to its
5343       own short intent — the rep's ``sub`` (skill · prompt hint) or its
5344       ``title``/``label`` — run through :func:`summarizer.tile_blurb` so it is
5345       clean + capped (the Wave-1 normalizer).
5346     - Honest empty (``""``) when there is neither; the caller renders nothing.
5347 
5348     Stdlib only; never raises (degrades to ``""``).
5349     """
5350     rep = (sv.get("members") or [None])[0]
5351     if not isinstance(rep, dict):
5352         return ""
5353     sid = (sv.get("session_id") or "").strip()
5354     blurb = ""
5355     # Prefer a cached SESSION summary blurb (cache read; no model call). Skip the
5356     # synthetic "loose::<jid>" ids (no real cached summary keyed on them).
5357     if sid and not sid.startswith("loose::"):
5358         try:
5359             blurb = _summarizer.session_blurb(
5360                 folder_path, project_id, store_lane, sid) or ""
5361         except Exception:
5362             blurb = ""
5363     if blurb:
5364         return blurb
5365     # Fall back to the session's own short intent (running or uncached).
5366     intent = (rep.get("sub") or rep.get("title") or "").strip()
5367     if not intent:
5368         return ""
5369     try:
5370         return _summarizer.tile_blurb(intent) or ""
5371     except Exception:
5372         return ""
5373 
5374 
5375 def _render_lane_tile(sv, trio_lane, project_id, folder_path=None,
5376                       store_lane=""):
5377     """Render ONE session as a GENUINE Paradigm-2 ``.tile`` (v4.1 cockpit-render).
5378 
5379     Schema (per the mockup): ``.tr1`` (lane + version + status light ``.lt``),
5380     ``.ttl`` (title), ``.st`` (state + age). The tile carries a status light
5381     (locked color bucket via :func:`_session_light_class`) and a click hook
5382     (``laneTileClick`` → ``openPanel``) that opens the full-width inline panel —
5383     where the summary + transcript/terminal live. The tile itself contains NO
5384     report-viewer links, NO summary accordion, NO files expander; that detail
5385     moved INTO the opened panel. The legacy ``lane-tile`` class + ``data-light``
5386     are preserved alongside ``.tile`` so the panel-open hooks/tests still bind.
5387     """
5388     members = sv.get("members", [])
5389     rep = members[0] if members else None
5390     if rep is None:
5391         return ""
5392     light = _session_light_class(rep)
5393     sid = sv.get("session_id", "") or ""
5394     sid_attr = html_lib.escape(sid, quote=True)
5395     lane_attr = html_lib.escape(trio_lane, quote=True)
5396     ver = html_lib.escape(rep.get("ver") or "")
5397     age = html_lib.escape(rep.get("age") or "")
5398     title = html_lib.escape(_session_tile_title(rep))
5399     state_cls, state_lbl = _session_state_text(rep)
5400     state_lbl = html_lib.escape(state_lbl)
5401     # Extra tile class for the attn/fail accent borders (mockup .tile.attn/.fail).
5402     extra = ""
5403     if light == "amber" and rep.get("needs_input"):
5404         extra = " attn"
5405     elif light == "red":
5406         extra = " fail"
5407     st_bits = [f"<span class='state {html_lib.escape(state_cls)}'>{state_lbl}</span>"]
5408     if age:
5409         st_bits.append(f"<span class='age'>· {age}</span>")
5410     n_members = len(members)
5411     counts = ""
5412     if n_members > 1:
5413         counts = (f"<div class='counts'>{n_members} files</div>")
5414     # v7 Wave 3 — a short, clean blurb line (cache/registry-only; no model call).
5415     # Cached session-summary blurb for a finished session, else the session's own
5416     # short intent for a running/uncached one; honest-empty renders nothing.
5417     blurb_html = ""
5418     if folder_path is not None:
5419         blurb = _session_tile_blurb(sv, folder_path, project_id, store_lane)
5420         if blurb:
5421             blurb_html = f"<div class='blurb'>{html_lib.escape(blurb)}</div>"
5422     # Live-job data hooks: a live/needs-input representative carries its job_id +
5423     # live flag as data-* attributes (used by tests + any future re-adoption of a
5424     # background job). The cockpit opens such a tile through laneTileClick →
5425     # openPanel like any other. (Discovered/done tiles carry no live hooks.)
5426     live_data = ""
5427     if rep.get("is_live"):
5428         jid = rep.get("job_id", "") or ""
5429         live_data = (
5430             f" data-job-id=\"{html_lib.escape(jid, quote=True)}\""
5431             f" data-trio-lane=\"{lane_attr}\""
5432             f" data-ver=\"{ver}\" data-live=\"1\"")
5433     # Build→Planning tie (Option A): a clickable chip on the build tile linking to
5434     # the planning session this build executed on (set by _attach_build_planning_tie
5435     # only when there is a clear single-planning match). The matched planning
5436     # session_id rides as data-* so the opened panel's chain breadcrumb can render
5437     # the same tie (see _loadChainBreadcrumb's static fallback). Clicking the chip
5438     # opens that planning session's panel without also opening this tile's panel.
5439     tie = sv.get("linked_planning") or {}
5440     tie_data = ""
5441     tie_chip = ""
5442     if tie.get("session_id"):
5443         lp_sid = html_lib.escape(tie["session_id"], quote=True)
5444         lp_lbl = html_lib.escape(tie.get("label") or "planning")
5445         lp_lbl_attr = html_lib.escape(tie.get("label") or "planning", quote=True)
5446         tie_data = (f" data-linked-planning=\"{lp_sid}\""
5447                     f" data-linked-planning-label=\"{lp_lbl_attr}\"")
5448         tie_chip = (
5449             f"<span class='tiechip' title='Open the planning session this build "
5450             f"executed on' onclick=\"openLinkedPlanning(event,'{lp_sid}')\">"
5451             f"&#9741; Planning: {lp_lbl} &#9656;</span>")
5452     # v10 Wave 4 FIX 2 (D8): the board-tile "from grass" lineage chip. When this
5453     # session's record carries a ``grass_origin`` (set on the dev session at
5454     # export, or INHERITED down the chain by start_session FIX 1), render a chip
5455     # on the plan/build board tile that links back to the originating grass idea
5456     # — satisfying D8 VISIBLY on the board (not only in the opened panel). The
5457     # chip reads ONLY the SAFE projection field ``grass_origin`` (an idea id —
5458     # never worktree_path/branch). Its label + dead-state ("idea removed") are
5459     # resolved client-side by ``_resolveGrassOriginChips`` against the loaded
5460     # grass data, so the server render stays cheap and the panel + tile chips
5461     # share one dead-chip code path. Only plan/build columns carry it (the lanes
5462     # the mockup depicts); research is the chain root, never "from" itself.
5463     grass_chip = ""
5464     origin = (rep.get("grass_origin") or "").strip()
5465     if origin and trio_lane in ("plan", "planning", "build"):
5466         origin_attr = html_lib.escape(origin, quote=True)
5467         grass_chip = (
5468             f"<span class='grassorigin' data-grass-origin=\"{origin_attr}\" "
5469             f"data-grass-pending=\"1\" "
5470             f"title='This work traces back to a grass idea — click to open it'>"
5471             f"&#127793; from grass</span>")
5472     return (
5473         f"<div class='tile lane-tile{extra}' data-session=\"{sid_attr}\" "
5474         f"data-lane=\"{lane_attr}\" data-light=\"{light}\"{live_data}{tie_data} "
5475         f"onclick=\"laneTileClick(event,'{sid_attr}')\">"
5476         f"<div class='tr1'><span class='lane'>{ver or lane_attr}</span>"
5477         f"<span class='ver'></span>"
5478         f"<span class='lt {light}' aria-hidden='true'></span></div>"
5479         f"<div class='ttl'>{title}</div>"
5480         f"{blurb_html}"
5481         f"<div class='st'>{''.join(st_bits)}</div>"
5482         f"{counts}"
5483         f"{tie_chip}"
5484         f"{grass_chip}"
5485         f"</div>"
5486     )
5487

5489 def _render_lane_sessions(session_views, store_lane, project_id, trio_lane="",
5490                           folder_path=None):
5491     """Render a lane's sessions as Paradigm-2 tiles: most-recent visible +
5492     a "previous sessions (N)" expander holding the rest, ALSO as tiles
5493     (v4.1 cockpit-render — replaces the old effort-card lane content).
5494 
5495     The MOST-RECENT session is the visible lane TILE — a status light
5496     (``.lt green/amber/red/grey`` from :func:`_session_light_class`) + a
5497     click-to-expand hook (``laneTileClick`` → ``openPanel``) opening the
5498     full-width inline panel (NOT a floating window, NOT page nav). The remaining
5499     sessions are tiles inside a ``<details class='prev-sessions'>`` expander. No
5500     tile carries report links / a summary accordion / a files expander — that
5501     detail lives in the opened panel.
5502     """
5503     if not session_views:
5504         return ""
5505     recent = _render_lane_tile(
5506         session_views[0], trio_lane, project_id, folder_path, store_lane)
5507     older = session_views[1:]
5508     if not older:
5509         return recent
5510     older_tiles = "".join(
5511         _render_lane_tile(sv, trio_lane, project_id, folder_path, store_lane)
5512         for sv in older)
5513     return (
5514         f"{recent}"
5515         f"<details class='prev-sessions'>"
5516         f"<summary>previous sessions ({len(older)})</summary>"
5517         f"<div class='prev-sessions-body'>{older_tiles}</div>"
5518         f"</details>"
5519     )

5523 def _render_deliverable_lane_tiles(folder_path, project_id) -> str:
5524     """Render the Deliverables lane as launch-by-type ``.tile`` cards (mockup
5525     Paradigm-2): one tile per pinned deliverable, showing its name + type, whose
5526     click launches it via the existing ``launchDeliverable`` JS (which POSTs the
5527     type-appropriate run endpoint). Falls back to a placeholder when none are
5528     pinned. Best-effort; never raises."""

5535                 "build pins one on GREEN.</div>")

5539         rel = r.get("artifact_path", "") or ""

5542             raw_type = _deliv.infer_type(rel)
5543         dtype = html_lib.escape(raw_type)
5544         did = r.get("job_id", "") or ""
5545         rel_attr = html_lib.escape(rel, quote=True)
5546         did_attr = html_lib.escape(did, quote=True)
5547         tiles.append(
5548             f"<div class='tile deliv-tile deliv-pinned' data-deliv=\"{rel_attr}\" "
5549             f"data-deliv-id=\"{did_attr}\" data-deliv-type=\"{dtype}\" "
5550             f"onclick=\"launchDeliverable(this)\">"
5551             f"<div class='tr1'><span class='lane'>{dtype}</span>"
5552             f"<span class='lt grey' aria-hidden='true'></span></div>"
5553             f"<div class='ttl'>{name}</div>"
5554             f"<div class='st'><span class='state done'>▸ launch</span>"
5555             f"<span class='deliv-msg' style='color:var(--text-dim);"
5556             f"margin-left:6px'></span></div>"
5557             f"<button class='deliv-stop' onclick=\"event.stopPropagation();"
5558             f"stopDeliverable(this)\" style='display:none'>Stop</button>"
5559             f"</div>"
5560         )
5561     return "".join(tiles)

5564 def _fmt_rollup_line(roll: dict) -> str:
5565     """Render a ``project_effort_rollup`` dict as ``Σ <tok> tok · $<c> · <t> · N sessions``.
5566 
5567     Used by the project-window header (v4 Wave 5). Run-session-only totals (the
5568     rollup already excludes imported/discovered). Stdlib only; never raises.
5569 
5570     Honesty rules (optimize-not-lying):
5571     - Zero activity (no sessions, no tokens, no wall clock) → named empty state,
5572       never ``0 tok · (subscription)``.
5573     - ``$`` is shown only for an engine-reported numeric cost.
5574     - ``(subscription)`` requires the explicit ``subscription_covered`` state;
5575       it is never inferred from tokens plus a numeric zero.
5576     - Sessions with no token measurement use ``0 tok measured`` / ``cost unknown``.
5577     """
5578     toks = int(roll.get("tokens", 0) or 0)
5579     raw_cost = roll.get("cost_usd")
5580     try:
5581         cost = float(raw_cost) if raw_cost is not None else None
5582     except (TypeError, ValueError):
5583         cost = None
5584     ms = int(roll.get("wall_clock_ms", 0) or 0)
5585     n = int(roll.get("sessions", 0) or 0)
5586     if n <= 0 and toks <= 0 and ms <= 0:
5587         return "Σ no run sessions yet"
5588     secs = ms / 1000.0
5589     if secs >= 3600:
5590         tstr = f"{secs / 3600.0:.1f}h"
5591     elif secs >= 60:
5592         tstr = f"{secs / 60.0:.0f}m"
5593     else:
5594         tstr = f"{secs:.0f}s"
5595     if toks >= 1000:
5596         tokstr = f"{toks / 1000.0:.0f}k tok"
5597     else:
5598         tokstr = f"{toks} tok"
5599     # No-own-pricing-table (LOCKED, telemetry-resume W5): ``$`` is shown ONLY when
5600     # the engine itself reported a nonzero ``costUSD``. On the Max-subscription
5601     # host the per-message sidecar carries no dollar figure, so a *measured*
5602     # session renders ``… (subscription)`` — Anchor never computes a dollar
5603     # figure of its own. (See NORTH-STAR-AMENDMENT.md "No-own-pricing-table".)
5604     states = set(roll.get("cost_states") or [])
5605     no_seat = "no_seat_started" in states
5606     unpriced_subscriptions = int(roll.get("unpriced_subscription_count", 0) or 0)
5607     priced_count = int(roll.get("priced_cost_count", 0) or 0)
5608     if unpriced_subscriptions and priced_count and cost is not None:
5609         money = f"${cost:.2f} measured + subscription"
5610     elif unpriced_subscriptions or "subscription_covered" in states:
5611         money = "(subscription)"
5612     elif cost is not None and (cost > 0 or "engine_reported" in states):
5613         money = f"${cost:.2f}"
5614     elif no_seat:
5615         money = "no seat started"
5616     else:
5617         money = "cost unknown"
5618     # When only wall-clock exists (Grok unmeasured / wall-only rows), be explicit.
5619     if toks == 0 and ms > 0:
5620         return (f"Σ time {tstr} · {money} · 0 tok measured"
5621                 f" · {n} session{'' if n == 1 else 's'}")
5622     if toks == 0:
5623         return (f"Σ 0 tok measured · {money} · {tstr}"
5624                 f" · {n} session{'' if n == 1 else 's'}")
5625     return (f"Σ {tokstr} · {money} · {tstr} "
5626             f"· {n} session{'' if n == 1 else 's'}")
5627

5630 def _live_session_count(project_id: str) -> int:
5631     """Count not-yet-finalized live managed sessions for a project (never raises)."""
5632     if not project_id:
5633         return 0
5634     try:
5635         import session_registry as _sreg
5636         live_statuses = {
5637             getattr(_sreg, "STATUS_RUNNING", "running"),
5638             getattr(_sreg, "STATUS_NEEDS_ATTENTION", "needs-attention"),
5639             getattr(_sreg, "STATUS_IDLE", "idle"),
5640         }
5641         n = 0
5642         for rec in _sreg.list_sessions(project_id) or []:
5643             if (rec or {}).get("status") in live_statuses:
5644                 n += 1
5645         return n
5646     except Exception:
5647         return 0

5650 def _live_steward_estate():
5651     """Read the runtime cockpit ledger without moving the engine STATE_FILE.
5652 
5653     The GUI relocates ``STATE_FILE`` to the data-dir ledger on steward API
5654     calls; dashboard rendering can run before that swap. Prefer the data-dir
5655     file when present so MBA-class totals are the live account, not the
5656     in-repo proto-state residue.
5657     """
5658     from steward_cockpit import steward_engine as _se
5659     tried = []
5660     try:
5661         live = _paths.data_dir() / "steward-cockpit-state.json"
5662         if live.exists():
5663             tried.append(live)
5664     except Exception:
5665         pass
5666     current = getattr(_se, "STATE_FILE", None)
5667     if current:
5668         try:
5669             path = Path(current)
5670             if path.exists() and path.resolve() not in {p.resolve() for p in tried}:
5671                 tried.append(path)
5672         except Exception:
5673             pass
5674     for path in tried:
5675         try:
5676             data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
5677             if isinstance(data, dict):
5678                 return data
5679         except Exception:
5680             continue
5681     try:
5682         return _se._read_all_state()
5683     except Exception:
5684         return {}

5687 def _project_steward_usage(project_id):
5688     """Persisted cockpit usage for the project's folder. Not a RUN rollup.
5689 
5690     Kept as a named source: overlap with effort_history is unknown, so this
5691     is never added into ``project_effort_rollup`` as one certified bill.
5692     """
5693     if not project_id:
5694         return None
5695     try:
5696         proj = _rnd.get_project(project_id)
5697         folder = (proj or {}).get("folder_path") or ""
5698         if not folder:
5699             return None
5700         from steward_cockpit.steward_routes import _usage_rollup
5701         total = ((_usage_rollup(folder, estate=_live_steward_estate()) or {}).get("total") or {})
5702         toks = int(total.get("tokens") or 0)
5703         turns = int(total.get("unpriced_turns") or 0)
5704         reported = float(total.get("reported_spend") or 0)
5705         secs = float(total.get("secs") or 0)
5706         if toks <= 0 and turns <= 0 and reported <= 0 and secs <= 0:
5707             return None
5708         return total
5709     except Exception:
5710         return None
5711 
5712 
5713 def _fmt_steward_usage_clause(steward) -> str:
5714     """Named steward clause. Never invents dollars or merges RUN totals."""
5715     if not steward:
5716         return ""
5717     try:
5718         from steward_cockpit.steward_engine import fmt_usage_cost_text
5719         cost = steward.get("cost_text") or fmt_usage_cost_text(
5720             steward, cli=steward.get("billing_family") or steward.get("cli"))
5721     except Exception:
5722         cost = ""
5723     toks = int(steward.get("tokens") or 0)
5724     bits = ["steward"]
5725     if toks >= 1_000_000:
5726         bits.append("%dM tok" % round(toks / 1_000_000))
5727     elif toks >= 1000:
5728         bits.append("%dk tok" % round(toks / 1000))
5729     elif toks > 0:
5730         bits.append("%d tok" % toks)
5731     if cost and cost != "cost unavailable":
5732         bits.append(cost)
5733     return " · ".join(bits) if len(bits) > 1 else ""
5734 
5735 
5736 def _fmt_project_usage_line(roll, rate=None, live_count=0, steward=None,
5737                             project_id=None) -> str:
5738     """Honest project usage line combining effort rollup + capture-rate + live.
5739 
5740     ``project_effort_rollup`` only counts RUN cost records (tokens/wall). Managed
5741     terminal sessions can exist with zero rollup contribution (still live, or
5742     finalized unmeasured with no wall row). Never show ``Σ no run sessions yet``
5743     when capture-rate or live registry sessions prove activity. Steward cockpit
5744     usage is appended as a named source when present; it is not summed into the
5745     RUN dollar figure.
5746     """
5747     if steward is None and project_id:
5748         steward = _project_steward_usage(project_id)
5749     roll = roll or {}
5750     toks = int(roll.get("tokens", 0) or 0)
5751     ms = int(roll.get("wall_clock_ms", 0) or 0)
5752     n = int(roll.get("sessions", 0) or 0)
5753     if toks > 0 or ms > 0 or n > 0:
5754         base = _fmt_rollup_line(roll)
5755     else:
5756         rate = rate or {}
5757         total = int(rate.get("total", 0) or 0)
5758         measured = int(rate.get("measured", 0) or 0)
5759         unm = int(rate.get("unmeasured", 0) or 0)
5760         failed = int(rate.get("capture_failed", 0)
5761                      or rate.get("capture-failed", 0) or 0)
5762         live = int(live_count or 0)
5763 
5764         if total <= 0 and live <= 0:
5765             base = "Σ no run sessions yet"
5766         else:
5767             parts = []
5768             if live > 0:
5769                 parts.append("%d live" % live)
5770             if measured > 0:
5771                 parts.append("%d measured" % measured)
5772             if unm > 0:
5773                 parts.append("%d unmeasured" % unm)
5774             if failed > 0:
5775                 parts.append("%d capture-failed" % failed)
5776             if not parts and total > 0:
5777                 parts.append("%d session%s" % (total, "" if total == 1 else "s"))
5778 
5779             reason_bit = ""
5780             reasons = rate.get("reasons") or {}
5781             if isinstance(reasons, dict) and reasons:
5782                 try:
5783                     top = max(reasons.items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[1] or 0))
5784                     if top and top[0]:
5785                         reason_bit = " (%s)" % top[0]
5786                 except Exception:
5787                     reason_bit = ""
5788 
5789             pending = " · usage pending finalize" if live > 0 and measured == 0 else ""
5790             base = ("Σ 0 tok measured · cost unknown · %s%s%s"
5791                     % (", ".join(parts), reason_bit, pending))
5792     clause = _fmt_steward_usage_clause(steward)
5793     if not clause:
5794         return base
5795     if base == "Σ no run sessions yet":
5796         return "Σ " + clause
5797     return base + " · " + clause
5798 
5799 
5800 def _fmt_capture_rate_short(rate: dict) -> str:
5801     """Compact capture-rate note for project-row rollup (never raises)."""
5802     try:
5803         total = int(rate.get("total", 0) or 0)
5804         measured = int(rate.get("measured", 0) or 0)
5805         unm = int(rate.get("unmeasured", 0) or 0)
5806         failed = int(rate.get("capture-failed", 0) or rate.get("capture_failed", 0) or 0)
5807         if total <= 0:
5808             return ""
5809         parts = [f"measured {measured}/{total}"]
5810         if unm:
5811             parts.append(f"{unm} unmeasured")
5812         if failed:
5813             parts.append(f"{failed} capture-failed")
5814         return " · ".join(parts)
5815     except Exception:
5816         return ""

5819 def render_header_rollup_html(project_id: str) -> str:
5820     """The per-project cost/tokens/time rollup for the project-window header.
5821 
5822     Server-side render of ``effort_history.project_effort_rollup(pid,'lifetime')``
5823     beside the project path (v4 Wave 5, MASTER-PLAN cockpit header). A small
5824     lifetime/30-day toggle re-fetches the read-only ``/api/rnd/project_rollup``
5825     endpoint and swaps the text in place (the actual swap is the JS
5826     ``rndRollupWindow``). Both windows' text are rendered so a no-JS view still
5827     shows lifetime totals. Stdlib only; never raises (omits on failure).
5828     """
5829     try:
5830         life = _eh.project_effort_rollup(project_id, window=_eh.WINDOW_LIFETIME)
5831     except Exception:
5832         return ""
5833     rate_life = {}
5834     try:
5835         rate_life = _rollhon.project_capture_rate(
5836             project_id, window="lifetime") or {}
5837     except Exception:
5838         rate_life = {}
5839     live_n = _live_session_count(project_id)
5840     pid_attr = html_lib.escape(project_id, quote=True)
5841     life_txt = html_lib.escape(
5842         _fmt_project_usage_line(life, rate=rate_life, live_count=live_n,
5843                                 project_id=project_id))
5844     # Honest Telemetry W5: the capture-rate stamp beside the numeric rollup —
5845     # 'measured N/T sessions (lifetime) · K capture-failed'. capture-failed is
5846     # ALWAYS counted separately (never folded into unmeasured) and tinted red when
5847     # present. Sibling projection (rollup_honesty) — the numeric rollup dict above
5848     # is unchanged (the W1 audit's preferred path). Best-effort; omit on failure.
5849     caprate_html = ""
5850     try:
5851         rate = _rollhon.project_capture_rate(project_id, window="lifetime")
5852         if int(rate.get("total", 0) or 0) > 0:
5853             caprate_html = " &nbsp;·&nbsp; " + _rollhon.capture_rate_html(rate)
5854     except Exception:
5855         caprate_html = ""
5856     # telemetry-resume W6: the bounded parked-worktree budget count (a system
5857     # indicator — parked warm worktrees held vs the eviction budget). Best-effort;
5858     # omitted when there are no parked worktrees.
5859     parked_html = _parked_worktree_stamp()
5860     return (
5861         f"<span class='roll' id='hdrRollup' data-window='lifetime' "
5862         f"data-pid=\"{pid_attr}\">{life_txt}</span>"
5863         f"{caprate_html}"
5864         f"{parked_html}"
5865         f"<span class='rolltog' role='group' aria-label='rollup window'>"
5866         f"<b class='on' data-window='lifetime' "
5867         f"onclick=\"rndRollupWindow('lifetime',this)\">lifetime</b>"
5868         f"<b data-window='30d' "
5869         f"onclick=\"rndRollupWindow('30d',this)\">30d</b>"
5870         f"</span>"
5871     )
5872

5874 def _parked_worktree_stamp() -> str:
5875     """The bounded parked-worktree count stamp (telemetry-resume W6, dashboard).
5876 
5877     'N parked worktrees / budget M' — the count of RETAINED-parked worktrees vs
5878     the eviction budget, so the user can see how close the system is to graceful
5879     oldest-first eviction. Returns '' when nothing is parked (or on any failure).
5880     """
5881     try:
5882         import worktrees as _wt
5883         import pty_manager as _pty_c
5884         n = _wt.parked_worktree_count(set(_pty_c._LIVE.keys()))
5885         if n <= 0:
5886             return ""
5887         budget = _wt.parked_worktree_budget()
5888         over = n > budget
5889         tint = " style='color:#dc2626'" if over else ""
5890         return (" &nbsp;·&nbsp; <span class='pwbudget'%s title='parked warm "
5891                 "worktrees held vs the eviction budget'>%d parked / budget %d"
5892                 "</span>" % (tint, n, budget))
5893     except Exception:
5894         return ""
5895

5897 def render_model_flex_badge(env=None, families=None) -> str:
5898     """Header badge surfacing the host's model-flex posture (Wave 8, #10).
5899 
5900     Reads the host-capability profile (``lanes.detect_host_profile``) and shows,
5901     honestly, how execution resolves on THIS host:
5902 
5903     - both subscriptions → Claude driver + Gemini 5:1 skill-layer swarm;
5904     - Claude only → Claude everywhere, no Gemini swarm spawned;
5905     - Gemini only → research on Gemini, Plan/Build require Claude;
5906     - neither → no engine.
5907 
5908     Pure render (no side effects, no subprocess). Returns a ``<span class='mflex …'>``.
5909     """
5910     prof = _lanes.detect_host_profile(env)
5911     has_c, has_g = bool(prof.get("claude")), bool(prof.get("gemini"))
5912     # (2026-09-04, John) the badge says what the DASHBOARD selected — the seats every
5913     # skill uses — never what happens to be installed.
5914     try:
5915         fams = families if isinstance(families, dict) else _lanes.selected_families(env)
5916     except Exception:
5917         fams = {"coding": "claude", "review": "claude", "default_cli": "claude", "selected": {"claude"}}
5918     gemini_selected = "gemini" in (fams.get("selected") or set())
5919     if has_c and has_g and gemini_selected:
5920         label = "&#9670; Claude driver &middot; &#10022; Gemini swarm %s" % (
5921             html_lib.escape(_lanes.SWARM_RATIO))
5922         title = ("Both subscriptions and gemini selected on the dashboard: Claude drives every "
5923                  "lane; Gemini runs the skill-layer %s swarm (agy-dispatch). Never cross-called." %
5924                  _lanes.SWARM_RATIO)
5925         cls = "mflex-both"
5926     elif has_c and (fams.get("coding") != "claude" or fams.get("review") != "claude"):
5927         label = "&#9670; Coder %s &middot; Reviewer %s" % (
5928             html_lib.escape(str(fams.get("coding", "claude")).capitalize()),
5929             html_lib.escape(str(fams.get("review", "claude")).capitalize()))
5930         title = ("Seats as selected on the dashboard: coding family %s, review family %s "
5931                  "(terminal %s). Every skill reads these; nothing else is spawned." % (
5932                      fams.get("coding"), fams.get("review"), fams.get("default_cli")))
5933         cls = "mflex-claude"
5934     elif has_c:
5935         label = "&#9670; Claude only"
5936         title = ("Claude-only host: Claude drives every lane; no agy/Gemini "
5937                  "process is ever spawned.")
5938         cls = "mflex-claude"
5939     elif has_g:
5940         label = "&#10022; Gemini only &middot; Plan/Build require Claude"
5941         title = ("Gemini-only host: research runs on Gemini; Plan/Build require "
5942                  "Claude (Crucible/Foreman are Claude Code engines) and are shown "
5943                  "as an honest 'requires Claude' state, not a crash.")
5944         cls = "mflex-gemini"
5945     else:
5946         label = "no engine"
5947         title = "No Claude or Gemini subscription detected on this host."
5948         cls = "mflex-none"
5949     # Dismissible chip (2026-07-02, John): an inline × persists the dismissal in
5950     # localStorage ('mflexDismissed'); the trailing self-contained script hides an
5951     # already-dismissed chip on load (document.currentScript anchors it to THIS
5952     # badge, so the pattern is safe wherever the badge is rendered — project
5953     # window and home dashboard). Clearing site data brings it back.
5954     _x = ("<button class='mflex-x' title='Dismiss' "
5955           "style=\"background:transparent;border:none;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;"
5956           "font-size:13px;line-height:1;padding:0 0 0 6px;vertical-align:baseline\" "
5957           "onclick=\"try{localStorage.setItem('mflexDismissed','1')}catch(e){}"
5958           "this.parentNode.style.display='none';return false\">&times;</button>")
5959     # NOTE: no consecutive `{{`/`}}` anywhere in this JS — the W8 test suite
5960     # treats doubled braces in rendered HTML as f-string leakage (a real bug
5961     # class in this file), so the closing braces are spaced.
5962     _hide = ("<script>try{if(localStorage.getItem('mflexDismissed')==='1')"
5963              "{var _m=document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;"
5964              "if(_m&&_m.classList&&_m.classList.contains('mflex'))"
5965              "_m.style.display='none';} }catch(e){}</script>")
5966     return (f"<span class='mflex {cls}' "
5967             f"title='{html_lib.escape(title, quote=True)}'>{label}{_x}</span>{_hide}")

6004 def render_steward_control() -> str:
6005     """Compact 'Steward' persona select for the home header (2026-07-29).
6006 
6007     One steward engine, selectable livery: Ecgberht (throne + wax seal),
6008     Aladdin (opened cave + genie lamp), Jarvis (tipped bowler + silver
6009     server). Each option's title carries the one-line description. POSTs
6010     ``steward_type`` to /api/settings on change, then reloads — the HIGH
6011     SEAT and SEAL icons are rendered server-side from the setting.
6012     """
6013     prof = _steward_ui()
6014     active = prof.get("key", "ecgberht")
6015     opts = []
6016     for key in ("ecgberht", "aladdin", "jarvis"):
6017         meta = _aset.STEWARDS[key]
6018         sel = " selected" if key == active else ""
6019         opts.append(
6020             "<option value='%s' title=\"%s\"%s>%s</option>"
6021             % (key, html_lib.escape(meta["desc"], quote=True), sel,
6022                html_lib.escape(meta["label"])))
6023     seal_icon = html_lib.escape(str(prof.get("seal", "")), quote=True)
6024     desc = html_lib.escape(str(prof.get("desc", "")), quote=True)
6025     html = (
6026         "<div id='stewardPick' style=\"display:inline-flex;align-items:center;"
6027         "gap:6px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-dim)\" title=\"%s\">"
6028         "<img src='/vendor/brand/%s?v=%s' alt='' "
6029         "style=\"width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:3px\" "
6030         "onerror=\"this.style.display='none'\" />"
6031         "<label style=\"display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;"
6032         "white-space:nowrap\">Steward "
6033         "<select id='stewardSelect' style=\"background:var(--surface);"
6034         "color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;"
6035         "padding:2px 6px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer\">%s</select>"
6036         "</label>"
6037         "<span id='stewardStatus' style=\"font-size:10px;opacity:.7\"></span>"
6038         "</div>"
6039     ) % (desc, seal_icon, BUILD_ID, "".join(opts))
6040     # Self-contained script (dashboard conventions: X-Anchor-Token on POST;
6041     # spaced braces — never consecutive `{{`/`}}` in raw JS).
6042     script = r"""
6043 <script>
6044 (function () {
6045   function tok() {
6046     try { return localStorage.getItem('anchor_token') || ''; }
6047     catch (e) { return ''; }
6048   }
6049   function setStatus(m) {
6050     var el = document.getElementById('stewardStatus');
6051     if (el) el.textContent = m || '';
6052   }
6053   document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
6054     var sel = document.getElementById('stewardSelect');
6055     if (!sel) return;
6056     sel.addEventListener('change', function () {
6057       setStatus('saving…');
6058       var headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
6059       var t = tok();
6060       if (t) headers['X-Anchor-Token'] = t;
6061       fetch('/api/settings', {
6062         method: 'POST', headers: headers,
6063         body: JSON.stringify({ steward_type: sel.value })
6064       }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
6065         .then(function (d) {
6066           if (d && d.ok) { setStatus('✓'); location.reload(); }
6067           else { setStatus((d && d.error) || 'failed'); }
6068         })
6069         .catch(function () { setStatus('failed'); });
6070     });
6071   });
6072 })();
6073 </script>
6074 """
6075     return html + script
6076

6094 def model_role_capabilities(profile=None) -> dict:
6095     """Return honest dashboard availability for each visible agentic role.
6096 
6097     This reports transport truth without creating another setting.  Codex can
6098     drive coding/orchestration when its subscription CLI is present; since
6099     2026-09-05 it also drives the interactive terminal (the Codex TUI in the
6100     cockpit PTY) and the reviewer/judge seats, whose verdicts carry a
6101     model-unattested stamp because the Codex receipts name no served model.
6102     """
6103     if profile is None:
6104         try:
6105             profile = _lanes.detect_host_profile()
6106         except Exception:
6107             profile = {}
6108     available = {
6109         family: bool((profile or {}).get(family))
6110         for family, _label in _MODEL_PREF_FAMILIES
6111     }
6112     roles = {}
6113     for role, setting in _MODEL_PREF_ROLES.items():
6114         families = {}
6115         for family, label in _MODEL_PREF_FAMILIES:
6116             present = available[family]
6117             selectable = present
6118             status = "ready" if present else "unavailable"
6119             reason = (
6120                 "%s subscription CLI is ready on this host." % label
6121                 if present else
6122                 "%s subscription CLI is not detected on this host." % label
6123             )
6124             if family == "chatgpt" and present and role == "terminal":
6125                 # (John, 2026-09-05) the Codex TUI runs in the cockpit terminal;
6126                 # the user's own Codex config governs approvals and sandbox there
6127                 # (the Doctor forces read-only); usage stays honestly unmeasured.
6128                 status = "ready"
6129                 reason = (
6130                     "ChatGPT terminal: the Codex TUI runs in the cockpit "
6131                     "terminal; your Codex config's approval and sandbox settings "
6132                     "apply (the Doctor forces read-only); usage is unmeasured. "
6133                     "The first ChatGPT terminal on a project asks Codex's "
6134                     "one-time trust question - press Enter for Yes."
6135                 )
6136             elif family == "chatgpt" and present and role == "coder":
6137                 status = "available_unattested"
6138                 reason = (
6139                     "ChatGPT is ready as the Codex coding/orchestration driver "
6140                     "with Ultra requested; served-model identity is not attested."
6141                 )
6142             elif family == "chatgpt" and present and role in ("reviewer", "judge"):
6143                 # (John, 2026-09-05) ChatGPT reviews and judges. The Codex transport
6144                 # attests the FAMILY (the binary) but not the served model, so every
6145                 # verdict carries a model-unattested stamp — accepted, never blind.
6146                 status = "available_unattested_review"
6147                 reason = (
6148                     "ChatGPT can review and judge: the Codex transport attests "
6149                     "the family but not the served model, so its verdicts carry a "
6150                     "model-unattested stamp (accepted on John's word, 2026-09-05)."
6151                 )
6152             families[family] = {
6153                 "label": label,
6154                 "available": present,
6155                 "selectable": selectable,
6156                 "status": status,
6157                 "reason": reason,
6158             }
6159         roles[role] = {"setting": setting, "families": families}
6160     return {
6161         "schema": "anchor.model-role-capabilities.v1",
6162         "profile": available,
6163         "judge_follows": "reviewer",
6164         "roles": roles,
6165     }

6182 def render_model_prefs_controls(extra_html: str = "") -> str:
6183     """Compact Terminal / Coder / Reviewer / Judge selects for the home header.
6184 
6185     Loads current prefs via GET ``/api/settings`` (token from localStorage, same
6186     pattern as other dashboard token-gated reads) and POSTs on change. Dark-theme
6187     compact styling; pure HTML + a small self-contained script (no consecutive
6188     ``{{``/``}}`` so f-string-leakage tests stay clean).
6189     """
6190     # Server-side initial values so the selects are correct before the fetch
6191     # returns (and when auth is off / settings unreachable).
6192     try:
6193         s = _aset.load_settings()
6194     except Exception:
6195         s = dict(_aset.DEFAULTS)
6196     dcli = html_lib.escape(str(s.get("default_cli") or "grok"), quote=True)
6197     ccode = html_lib.escape(str(s.get("coding_family") or "claude"), quote=True)
6198     rcode = html_lib.escape(str(s.get("review_family") or "gemini"), quote=True)

6279     # Self-contained script: load prefs on DOMContentLoaded; POST on change.
6280     # Uses X-Anchor-Token for POST and ?token= for GET (dashboard convention).
6281     # NEVER emit consecutive `{{` or `}}` — dashboard f-string-leakage tests
6282     # treat those as accidental Python f-string escapes. Always space braces.
6283     script = r"""
6284 <script>
6285 (function () {
6286   function tok() {
6287     try { return localStorage.getItem('anchor_token') || ''; }
6288     catch (e) { return ''; }
6289   }
6290   function tq() {
6291     var t = tok();
6292     return t ? ('?token=' + encodeURIComponent(t)) : '';
6293   }
6294   function setStatus(m) {
6295     var el = document.getElementById('mpStatus');
6296     if (el) el.textContent = m || '';
6297   }
6298   function optionLabel(cap, base) {
6299     if (!cap) return base;
6300     if (base === 'ChatGPT') {
6301       var suffix = {
6302         available_unattested: 'coder ready',
6303         available_unattested_review: 'reviewer ready (model unattested)',
6304         verification_unattested: 'verification unavailable',
6305         unavailable: 'unavailable'
6306       }[cap.status] || cap.status;
6307       return base + ' — ' + suffix;
6308     }
6309     return cap.selectable ? base : (base + ' — unavailable');
6310   }
6311   function applyCapabilities(caps) {
6312     if (!caps || !caps.roles) return;
6313     window.ANCHOR_MODEL_CAPABILITIES = caps;
6314     var roleIds = {
6315       terminal: 'mpDefaultCli', coder: 'mpCoding',
6316       reviewer: 'mpReview', judge: 'mpJudge'
6317     };
6318     Object.keys(roleIds).forEach(function (role) {
6319       var el = document.getElementById(roleIds[role]);
6320       var families = caps.roles[role] && caps.roles[role].families;
6321       if (!el || !families) return;
6322       Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.options, function (opt) {
6323         var cap = families[opt.value];
6324         if (!cap) return;
6325         var base = opt.getAttribute('data-label') || opt.textContent;
6326         opt.disabled = !cap.selectable;
6327         opt.setAttribute('data-status', cap.status || '');
6328         opt.setAttribute('data-reason', cap.reason || '');
6329         opt.textContent = optionLabel(cap, base);
6330       });
6331     });
6332     var note = document.getElementById('mpCapability');
6333     var chat = caps.roles.coder && caps.roles.coder.families.chatgpt;
6334     if (note && chat) {
6335       note.textContent = chat.available
6336         ? 'ChatGPT: terminal, coder, reviewer and judge ready (reviewer/judge model unattested, stamped)'
6337         : 'ChatGPT unavailable on this host';
6338     }
6339   }
6340   function showReason(el) {
6341     if (!el) return;
6342     var opt = el.options[el.selectedIndex];
6343     var note = document.getElementById('mpCapability');
6344     if (note && opt && opt.getAttribute('data-reason')) {
6345       note.textContent = opt.getAttribute('data-reason');
6346     }
6347   }
6348   function apply(d) {
6349     if (!d) return;
6350     window.ANCHOR_SETTINGS_REVISION = d.settings_revision;
6351     var map = {
6352       default_cli: ['mpDefaultCli'],
6353       coding_family: ['mpCoding'],
6354       review_family: ['mpReview', 'mpJudge']
6355     };
6356     Object.keys(map).forEach(function (k) {
6357       map[k].forEach(function (id) {
6358         var el = document.getElementById(id);
6359         if (el && d[k]) el.value = d[k];
6360       });
6361     });
6362     applyCapabilities(d.model_capabilities);
6363     if (d.default_cli) window.ANCHOR_DEFAULT_CLI = d.default_cli;
6364     if (d.coding_family) window.ANCHOR_CODING_FAMILY = d.coding_family;
6365     if (d.review_family) window.ANCHOR_REVIEW_FAMILY = d.review_family;
6366   }
6367   function load() {
6368     var opts = { cache: 'no-store', headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } };
6369     fetch('/api/settings' + tq(), opts)
6370       .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
6371       .then(function (d) { if (d && d.ok) { apply(d); if (d.settings_error) setStatus(d.settings_error); } })
6372       .catch(function () { });
6373   }
6374   function save(el) {
6375     var key = el.getAttribute('data-key');
6376     if (!key) return;
6377     var body = Object.create(null);
6378     ['mpDefaultCli', 'mpCoding', 'mpReview'].forEach(function (id) {
6379       var choice = document.getElementById(id);
6380       if (choice) body[choice.getAttribute('data-key')] = choice.value;
6381     });
6382     body[key] = el.value;
6383     if (!Number.isInteger(window.ANCHOR_SETTINGS_REVISION)) { setStatus('load settings before saving'); load(); return; }
6384     body.expected_revision = window.ANCHOR_SETTINGS_REVISION;
6385     setStatus('saving…');
6386     var h = {
6387       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
6388       Accept: 'application/json'
6389     };
6390     var t = tok();
6391     if (t) h['X-Anchor-Token'] = t;
6392     var opts = { method: 'POST', headers: h, body: JSON.stringify(body) };
6393     fetch('/api/settings', opts)
6394       .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
6395       .then(function (d) {
6396         if (d && d.ok) {
6397           apply(d);
6398           setStatus(d.mirror_out_of_sync ? 'saved; standalone mirror needs repair' : 'saved · latest model / highest effort · active turns finish before switching');
6399         } else {
6400           setStatus((d && d.error) || 'error');
6401           load();
6402         }
6403       })
6404       .catch(function () { setStatus('error'); });
6405   }
6406   function wire() {
6407     ['mpDefaultCli', 'mpCoding', 'mpReview', 'mpJudge'].forEach(function (id) {
6408       var el = document.getElementById(id);
6409       if (!el) return;
6410       el.addEventListener('change', function () { showReason(el); save(el); });
6411       el.addEventListener('focus', function () { showReason(el); });
6412     });
6413     load();
6414   }
6415   if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
6416     document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', wire);
6417   } else {
6418     wire();
6419   }
6420 })();
6421 </script>
6422 """.strip()
6423     # Defense-in-depth: if any consecutive brace pair snuck in, space it.
6424     while "{{" in script:
6425         script = script.replace("{{", "{ {")
6426     while "}}" in script:
6427         script = script.replace("}}", "} }")
6428     return html + script

6434 def render_project_window_html(project_id: str) -> str:
6435     """Render the per-project "Project Cockpit" (Paradigm 2) for ``/project/<id>``.
6436 
6437     A 5-column Paradigm-2 lane grid (``.p2lanes`` → Research|Planning|Build|
6438     Deliverables|Grass) of clean status-light TILES (most-recent session per lane
6439     + a "previous sessions" expander; Deliverables = launch-by-type tiles; Grass =
6440     idea board). Clicking ANY tile (live OR historical) opens an inline expanding
6441     panel in ``#panelStack`` with a split summary on top (materials + doc-role
6442     links) and, below, a live xterm terminal for running sessions or a read-only
6443     note for done/historical ones. Plus the lifecycle header with the cost/tokens/
6444     time rollup. Returns a standalone HTML page; all engine/user content is
6445     HTML-escaped (XSS-safe).
6446     """
6447     entry = _rnd.get_project(project_id)
6448     if entry is None:
6449         return ("<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'>"
6450                 "<title>Project not found</title></head><body>"
6451                 "<h1>Project not found</h1>"
6452                 f"<p>No R&amp;D project with id "
6453                 f"{html_lib.escape(project_id)}.</p>"
6454                 "<p><a href=\"/\" target=\"_top\">&larr; Back to dashboard</a></p>"
6455                 "</body></html>")
6456         # Surface path-missing on read.

6849 def _fmt_cost(rollup: dict) -> str:
6850     """Render a one-line cost/time/tokens summary from a rollup dict."""
6851     raw_cost = rollup.get("total_cost_usd")
6852     try:
6853         cost = float(raw_cost) if raw_cost is not None else None
6854     except (TypeError, ValueError):
6855         cost = None
6856     unpriced = int(rollup.get("unpriced_subscription_count", 0) or 0)
6857     priced = int(rollup.get("priced_cost_count", 0) or 0)
6858     states = set(rollup.get("cost_states") or [])
6859     no_seat = "no_seat_started" in states
6860     if unpriced and priced and cost is not None:
6861         money = f"${cost:.4f} measured + subscription"
6862     elif unpriced or "subscription_covered" in states:
6863         money = "(subscription)"
6864     elif cost is not None and (cost > 0 or "engine_reported" in states):
6865         money = f"${cost:.4f}"
6866     elif no_seat:
6867         money = "no seat started"
6868     else:
6869         money = "cost unknown"
6870     dur_ms = rollup.get("duration_ms", 0) or 0
6871     toks = rollup.get("total_tokens", 0) or 0
6872     secs = dur_ms / 1000.0
6873     return (f"{money} · {secs:.1f}s · {toks:,} tok "
6874             f"({rollup.get('effort_count', 0)} effort"
6875             f"{'s' if rollup.get('effort_count', 0) != 1 else ''})")
6876 
6877 
6878 def render_cost_rollup_html(project_id: str, folder_path: str) -> str:
6879     """Render the per-project cost/time/tokens rollup (tile + dashboard, Wave 7).
6880 
6881     Shows the project total plus a per-lane breakdown. Best-effort: a project
6882     with no efforts shows zeros and never crashes.
6883     """
6884     try:
6885         roll = _eh.project_rollup(project_id, folder_path)
6886     except Exception:
6887         return ""
6888     total = roll.get("total", {})
6889     lanes = roll.get("lanes", {})
6890     rows = []
6891     for lane in _eh.ROLLUP_LANES:
6892         lr = lanes.get(lane, {})
6893         if not lr.get("effort_count"):
6894             continue
6895         rows.append(
6896             f"<div class='rnd-lane'>{html_lib.escape(lane)}: "
6897             f"{html_lib.escape(_fmt_cost(lr))}</div>"
6898         )
6899     breakdown = ("<div class='rnd-status-line'>" + "".join(rows) + "</div>"
6900                  if rows else "")
6901     n_imp = int(total.get("discovered_count", 0) or 0)
6902     imported_bit = (f" · <span class='rnd-imported'>{n_imp} imported</span>"
6903                     if n_imp else "")
6904     return (
6905         "<h2>Cost rollup</h2>"
6906         f"<p style='font-size:15px'><strong>Total:</strong> "
6907         f"{html_lib.escape(_fmt_cost(total))}{imported_bit}</p>"
6908         f"{breakdown}"
6909     )

6914 def project_tasks(project_id: str) -> list:
6915     """Return every active task whose ``Project: <id>`` field matches.
6916 
6917     ``gather_all()`` already parses each task's ``project`` field (Wave 3) and
6918     deduplicates; Wave 9 simply FILTERS on it. This is the data behind the
6919     project-tasks view (AC2). Returns the matching task dicts (order preserved).
6920     """
6921     pid = (project_id or "").strip()
6922     if not pid:
6923         return []
6924     _projects, tasks, _inbox = gather_all()
6925     return [t for t in tasks if (t.get("project") or "").strip() == pid]

6956 def ensure_anchor_deliverable(folder_path: str, project_id: str):
6957     """Pin ``anchor_gui.py`` as the project's runnable Anchor deliverable (Wave 8).
6958 
6959     Idempotent: ``deliverables.pin_deliverable`` is content-addressed by path, so
6960     pinning the same file twice produces no duplicate. ``anchor_gui.py`` is a
6961     long-running SERVER (not a run-to-completion program), so its run is the
6962     ephemeral preview (``preview_server``), not the program contract — it is
6963     pinned with type ``program`` only so it surfaces in the Deliverables lane.
6964     Best-effort: a pin failure never breaks the window render.
6965 
6966     Pin-if-absent: this runs on EVERY ``GET /project/<id>`` render, and
6967     ``pin_deliverable`` → ``record_effort`` unconditionally rewrites the pointer
6968     JSON under ``WRITE_LOCK``. To avoid needless disk-write/lock churn on this
6969     hot path, skip the pin entirely when ``anchor_gui.py`` is already pinned for
6970     this project; the first render still pins. The pinned content/id is
6971     unchanged (content-addressed by path).
6972     """
6973     try:
6974         target = _preview.DEFAULT_TARGET
6975         for rec in _deliv.list_pinned_deliverables(folder_path, project_id):
6976             if (rec.get("artifact_path") or "") == target:
6977                 return rec  # already pinned — no write, no lock contention
6978         return _deliv.pin_deliverable(
6979             folder_path, project_id, target,
6980             name=target, dtype=_deliv.TYPE_PROGRAM,
6981             description="Anchor dashboard web app (run as an ephemeral preview)")
6982     except Exception:
6983         return None
6984

6986 def render_deliverables_html(project_id: str, folder_path: str) -> str:
6987     """Render the project's deliverables: pinned deliverables (with Run/Stop) +
6988     deliverable run-status records (Wave 9 AC1 + v3 Wave 8 ephemeral preview).
6989 
6990     The pinned ``anchor_gui.py`` deliverable gets a **Run** action that starts an
6991     ephemeral preview on a free port (≠8777) and opens it in a new tab, plus a
6992     **Stop** that reaps it — token-aware via the project-window JS.
6993     """
6994     pinned = []
6995     try:
6996         pinned = _deliv.list_pinned_deliverables(folder_path, project_id)
6997     except Exception:
6998         pinned = []
6999     try:
7000         records = _deliv.list_status(folder_path, project_id)
7001     except Exception:
7002         records = []
7003 
7004     out = []
7005 
7006     # Pinned deliverables with Run/Stop (the runnable Anchor deliverable).
7007     if pinned:
7008         # v4 Wave 7: the launch action ADAPTS to the deliverable type — the
7009         # per-type affordance label mirrors the "📦 Deliverable" mockup card.
7010         _launch_label = {
7011             _deliv.TYPE_SERVICE: "▶ launch in window / pull up",
7012             _deliv.TYPE_PROGRAM: "▶ run in a window",
7013             _deliv.TYPE_SCRIPT: "▶ run in a window",
7014             _deliv.TYPE_SKILL: "✓ verify status",
7015             _deliv.TYPE_TOOL: "✓ verify status",
7016             _deliv.TYPE_DOC: "📖 open rendered",
7017             _deliv.TYPE_NOTEBOOK: "📓 open notebook on Anchor host",
7018         }
7019         items = []
7020         for r in pinned:
7021             name = html_lib.escape(
7022                 r.get("title") or r.get("artifact_path") or "")
7023             rel = r.get("artifact_path", "") or ""
7024             raw_type = (r.get("deliverable_type", "") or "").strip().lower()
7025             if raw_type not in _deliv.VALID_TYPES:
7026                 raw_type = _deliv.infer_type(rel)
7027             dtype = html_lib.escape(raw_type)
7028             did = r.get("job_id", "") or ""
7029             rel_attr = html_lib.escape(rel, quote=True)
7030             did_attr = html_lib.escape(did, quote=True)
7031             label = html_lib.escape(_launch_label.get(raw_type, "▶ launch"))
7032             items.append(
7033                 f"<li class='deliv-pinned' data-deliv=\"{rel_attr}\" "
7034                 f"data-deliv-id=\"{did_attr}\" data-deliv-type=\"{dtype}\">"
7035                 f"<span class='deliv-name'>{name}</span> "
7036                 f"<span style='color:#8a90a2;font-size:12px'>[{dtype}]</span> "
7037                 f"<button class='deliv-run' "
7038                 f"onclick=\"launchDeliverable(this)\">{label}</button> "
7039                 f"<button class='deliv-stop' "
7040                 f"onclick=\"stopDeliverable(this)\" style='display:none'>"
7041                 f"Stop</button> "
7042                 f"<span class='deliv-msg' style='color:#8a90a2;"
7043                 f"font-size:12px'></span></li>"
7044             )
7045         out.append("<h3 style='margin:8px 0 4px;font-size:14px;color:#aeb4c2'>"
7046                    "Pinned</h3>")
7047         out.append("<ul style='list-style:none;padding:0'>"
7048                    + "".join(items) + "</ul>")
7049 
7050     # Run-status records (read-only history).
7051     if records:
7052         colors = {_deliv.STATUS_SUCCESS: "#4caf78",
7053                   _deliv.STATUS_FAILED: "#e06c75",
7054                   _deliv.STATUS_TIMED_OUT: "#d6a35c"}
7055         rows = []
7056         for r in records:
7057             status = r.get("status", "")
7058             color = colors.get(status, "#8a90a2")
7059             name = html_lib.escape(
7060                 r.get("name", "") or r.get("deliverable_id", ""))
7061             dtype = html_lib.escape(r.get("type", ""))
7062             rows.append(
7063                 f"<li>{name} <span style='color:#8a90a2;font-size:12px'>"
7064                 f"[{dtype}]</span> — <span style='color:{color}'>"
7065                 f"{html_lib.escape(status)}</span></li>"
7066             )
7067         out.append("<h3 style='margin:8px 0 4px;font-size:14px;color:#aeb4c2'>"
7068                    "Run history</h3>")
7069         out.append("<ul style='list-style:none;padding:0'>"
7070                    + "".join(rows) + "</ul>")
7071 
7072     if not pinned and not records:
7073         out.append("<p style='color:#8a90a2'>No deliverables yet.</p>")
7074     # crucible-improve #4 (W5): wrap the deliverables in a <details> so they
7075     # render COLLAPSED by default (no `open` attribute); the "Deliverables"
7076     # heading becomes the always-visible <summary> disclosure.
7077     return ("<details class='deliv-collapse'>"
7078             "<summary class='deliv-summary'><h2 style='display:inline'>"
7079             "Deliverables</h2></summary>"
7080             + "".join(out) + "</details>")

7083 # ── Change operations ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
7084 #
7085 # Every function that MUTATES a markdown or JSON file is wrapped with
7086 # @_with_write_lock. The lock is a process-wide RLock (re-entrant), so nested
7087 # mutators (e.g. mark_done -> log_change) acquire it safely. Under
7088 # ThreadingHTTPServer this serializes concurrent writers so no update is lost.
7089 
7090 import functools as _functools
7091 
7092 
7093 def _with_write_lock(fn):
7094     @_functools.wraps(fn)
7095     def _wrapped(*args, **kwargs):
7096         with WRITE_LOCK:
7097             return fn(*args, **kwargs)
7098     return _wrapped
7099

7101 @_with_write_lock
7102 def log_change(message):
7103     today = date.today().isoformat()
7104     now = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M")
7105     LOGS_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
7106     log_file = LOGS_DIR / f"{today}.md"
7107     if not log_file.exists():
7108         day_name = datetime.now().strftime("%A")
7109         _paths.atomic_write_text(log_file, f"# {today} — {day_name}\n\n## Changes\n")
7110     with open(log_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
7111         f.write(f"- {now} — {message}\n")
7112     print(f"  Logged: {now} — {message}")

7115 @_with_write_lock
7116 def mark_done(task_text):
7117     search = task_text.lower().strip()
7118     found = False
7119     for md_file in _all_md_files():
7120         if not md_file.exists():
7121             continue
7122         text = _read_md_text(md_file)
7123         new_lines = []
7124         changed = False
7125         for line in text.splitlines():
7126             if re.match(r'\s*-\s*\[ \]', line) and search in line.lower():
7127                 new_lines.append(line.replace("[ ]", "[x]", 1))
7128                 found = True
7129                 changed = True
7130             else:
7131                 new_lines.append(line)
7132         if changed:
7133             _paths.atomic_write_text(md_file, "\n".join(new_lines) + "\n")
7134     if found:
7135         log_change(f"Completed: {task_text}")
7136     return found

7163 @_with_write_lock
7164 def add_task(text, domain="academic", priority=2, energy="med", due="", notes=""):

7169     def _insert(filepath, section_names):

7171             return False

7173         for section in section_names:
7174             idx = content.find(section)
7175             if idx >= 0:
7176                 ns = content.find("\n##", idx + len(section))
7177                 if ns < 0:
7178                     ns = len(content)
7179                 content = content[:ns].rstrip() + "\n" + line + "\n\n" + content[ns:]
7180                 _paths.atomic_write_text(filepath, content)
7181                 return True
7182         return False
7183 
7184     _insert(DASHBOARD_MD, ["## Today's Priorities", "## Active Priorities"])

7206 @_with_write_lock
7207 def link_task(task_text, project_id):
7208     """Link a task to an R&D project — set/maintain its ``Project: <id>`` field.
7209 
7210     Wave 9 activation: edits ONLY the ``Project:`` field on the first matching
7211     active task line, preserving every other character verbatim (byte-stable for
7212     untouched tasks; clean round-trip for linked ones). An empty ``project_id``
7213     unlinks. Mirrors ``anchor.link_task``. Returns True if a task was updated.
7214     """
7215     search = task_text.lower().strip()
7216     new_id = (project_id or "").strip()
7217     found = False
7218     for md_file in _all_md_files():
7219         if not md_file or not md_file.exists():
7220             continue
7221         text = _read_md_text(md_file)
7222         new_lines = []
7223         changed = False
7224         for line in text.splitlines():
7225             if (not found and re.match(r'\s*-\s*\[([ xX])\]', line)
7226                     and search in line.lower()):
7227                 existing = re.search(r'(\s*—\s*Project:\s*)([^\s—]+)', line, re.I)
7228                 if existing:
7229                     if new_id:
7230                         new_line = (line[:existing.start(2)] + new_id
7231                                     + line[existing.end(2):])
7232                     else:
7233                         new_line = line[:existing.start(1)] + line[existing.end(2):]
7234                 else:
7235                     new_line = line.rstrip() + f" — Project: {new_id}" if new_id else line
7236                 if new_line != line:
7237                     changed = True
7238                 new_lines.append(new_line)
7239                 found = True
7240             else:
7241                 new_lines.append(line)
7242         if changed:
7243             _paths.atomic_write_text(md_file, "\n".join(new_lines) + "\n")
7244     if found:
7245         log_change(f"Linked task '{task_text}' to project {new_id}" if new_id
7246                    else f"Unlinked task '{task_text}'")
7247     return found
