7250 @_with_write_lock
7251 def edit_task(old_text, new_text=None, new_priority=None, new_domain=None, new_energy=None, new_due=None, new_notes=None):
7252     """Edit a task's properties across all markdown files. Only changes specified fields."""
7253     search = old_text.lower().strip()
7254     found = False
7255     for md_file in _all_md_files():
7256         if not md_file or not md_file.exists():
7257             continue
7258 
7259         # Infer domain from filename: domains/family.md → "family"
7260         file_domain = None
7261         if md_file.parent == DOMAINS_DIR:
7262             file_domain = md_file.stem  # e.g. "family", "academic", "writing", "commercial"
7263 
7264         text = _read_md_text(md_file)
7265         new_lines = []
7266         changed = False
7267         for line in text.splitlines():
7268             if re.match(r'\s*-\s*\[([ xX])\]', line) and search in line.lower():
7269                 check_m = re.match(r'(\s*-\s*\[)([ xX])(\]\s*)', line)
7270                 if check_m:
7271                     prefix = check_m.group(1)
7272                     check_state = check_m.group(2)
7273                     rest = line[check_m.end():]
7274 
7275                     # Parse existing text (everything before the first " — ")
7276                     raw_rest = line[check_m.end():]
7277                     text_end = raw_rest.find(" — ")
7278                     existing_text = raw_rest[:text_end].strip(' *') if text_end >= 0 else raw_rest.strip(' *')
7279                     existing_priority = 2
7280                     existing_energy = "med"
7281                     existing_due = ""
7282 
7283                     # Domain: prefer file-inferred domain, then tag in line, then "personal"
7284                     existing_domain = file_domain or "personal"
7285                     dm = re.search(r'\[(\w+)\]', rest)
7286                     if dm and not file_domain:
7287                         existing_domain = dm.group(1).lower()
7288 
7289                     pm = re.search(r'Priority:\s*(\d)', rest)
7290                     if pm: existing_priority = int(pm.group(1))
7291                     em = re.search(r'energy:\s*(\w+)', rest, re.I)
7292                     if em: existing_energy = em.group(1).lower()
7293                     due_m = re.search(r'Due:\s*([\d/\-\w]+)', rest, re.I)
7294                     if due_m: existing_due = due_m.group(1)
7295                     existing_notes = ""
7296                     notes_m = re.search(r'Notes:\s*(.+?)(?:\s*—\s*(?:Priority|energy|Due|Project|\[)|$)', rest, re.I)
7297                     if not notes_m:
7298                         notes_m = re.search(r'Notes:\s*(.+?)$', rest, re.I)
7299                     if notes_m: existing_notes = notes_m.group(1).strip().rstrip(' —')
7300                     # Preserve the optional Project: <id> link unchanged (Wave 3).
7301                     existing_project = ""
7302                     proj_m = re.search(r'Project:\s*([^\s—]+)', rest, re.I)
7303                     if proj_m: existing_project = proj_m.group(1).strip()
7304 
7305                     # Apply only specified changes
7306                     t_text = new_text if new_text is not None else existing_text
7307                     t_priority = new_priority if new_priority is not None else existing_priority
7308                     t_energy = new_energy if new_energy is not None else existing_energy
7309                     t_domain = new_domain if new_domain is not None else existing_domain
7310                     t_due = new_due if new_due is not None else existing_due
7311                     t_notes = new_notes if new_notes is not None else existing_notes
7312                     due_str = f" — Due: {t_due}" if t_due else ""
7313                     notes_str = f" — Notes: {t_notes}" if t_notes else ""
7314                     project_str = f" — Project: {existing_project}" if existing_project else ""
7315 
7316                     new_line = f"{prefix}{check_state}] {t_text} — Priority: {t_priority} — energy: {t_energy} — [{t_domain}]{due_str}{project_str}{notes_str}"
7317                     new_lines.append(new_line)
7318                     found = True
7319                     changed = True
7320                 else:
7321                     new_lines.append(line)
7322             else:
7323                 new_lines.append(line)
7324         if changed:
7325             _paths.atomic_write_text(md_file, "\n".join(new_lines) + "\n")
7326     if found:
7327         changes = []
7328         if new_text and new_text != old_text:
7329             changes.append(f"renamed to '{new_text}'")
7330         if new_priority is not None:
7331             changes.append(f"P{new_priority}")
7332         if new_domain:
7333             changes.append(f"[{new_domain}]")
7334         if new_due is not None:
7335             changes.append(f"due {new_due}" if new_due else "due removed")
7336         log_change(f"Edited task '{old_text}': {', '.join(changes)}")
7337     return found
7338

7340 @_with_write_lock
7341 def edit_project(old_name, new_name=None, new_priority=None, new_domain=None,
7342                  new_status=None, new_effort=None, new_due=None, new_next=None):
7343     """Edit a project's properties in PROJECTS.md files."""
7344     search = old_name.lower().strip()
7345     found = False
7346 
7347     for proj_file in [PROJECTS_MD]:
7348         if not proj_file or not proj_file.exists():
7349             continue
7350         text = _read_md_text(proj_file)
7351         lines = text.splitlines()
7352         new_lines = []
7353         in_project = False
7354         i = 0
7355         while i < len(lines):
7356             line = lines[i]
7357             h2 = re.match(r'^##\s+(.+)', line)
7358             if h2 and search in h2.group(1).lower():
7359                 in_project = True
7360                 found = True
7361                 # Replace name if needed
7362                 if new_name:
7363                     new_lines.append(f"## {new_name}")
7364                 else:
7365                     new_lines.append(line)
7366                 i += 1
7367                 # Process key-value lines within this project section
7368                 while i < len(lines):
7369                     line = lines[i]
7370                     # Stop at next project heading
7371                     if re.match(r'^##\s+', line):
7372                         in_project = False
7373                         break
7374                     kv = re.match(r'(\s*-\s*\*\*)(\w[\w\s]*?)(:\*\*\s*)(.*)', line)
7375                     if kv:
7376                         key = kv.group(2).strip().lower()
7377                         indent = kv.group(1)
7378                         colon = kv.group(3)
7379                         if key == "priority" and new_priority is not None:
7380                             new_lines.append(f"{indent}{kv.group(2)}{colon}{new_priority}")
7381                         elif key == "domain" and new_domain:
7382                             new_lines.append(f"{indent}{kv.group(2)}{colon}{new_domain}")
7383                         elif key == "status" and new_status:
7384                             new_lines.append(f"{indent}{kv.group(2)}{colon}{new_status}")
7385                         elif key in ("effort", "effort level") and new_effort:
7386                             new_lines.append(f"{indent}{kv.group(2)}{colon}{new_effort}")
7387                         elif key in ("deadline", "due") and new_due is not None:
7388                             new_lines.append(f"{indent}{kv.group(2)}{colon}{new_due}")
7389                         elif key.startswith("next") and new_next is not None:
7390                             new_lines.append(f"{indent}{kv.group(2)}{colon}{new_next}")
7391                         else:
7392                             new_lines.append(line)
7393                     else:
7394                         new_lines.append(line)
7395                     i += 1
7396                 continue
7397             else:
7398                 if h2:
7399                     in_project = False
7400                 new_lines.append(line)
7401             i += 1
7402         _paths.atomic_write_text(proj_file, "\n".join(new_lines) + "\n")
7403 
7404     if found:
7405         changes = []
7406         if new_name and new_name != old_name:
7407             changes.append(f"renamed to '{new_name}'")
7408         if new_priority is not None:
7409             changes.append(f"P{new_priority}")
7410         if new_domain:
7411             changes.append(f"[{new_domain}]")
7412         if new_status:
7413             changes.append(f"status: {new_status}")
7414         if new_next is not None:
7415             changes.append(f"next: {new_next}")
7416         log_change(f"Edited project '{old_name}': {', '.join(changes)}")
7417     return found

7420 def _remove_task_from_files(task_text):
7421     """Remove a task line from all markdown files. Returns the task dict if found."""
7422     search = task_text.lower().strip()
7423     found_task = None
7424     for md_file in _all_md_files():
7425         if not md_file or not md_file.exists():
7426             continue
7427         text = _read_md_text(md_file)
7428         new_lines = []
7429         changed = False
7430         for line in text.splitlines():
7431             if re.match(r'\s*-\s*\[([ xX])\]', line) and search in line.lower():
7432                 # Parse the task before removing
7433                 if not found_task:
7434                     tm = re.match(r'\s*-\s*\[([ xX])\]\s*\*?\*?(.*?)(?:\*?\*?\s*—\s*(.*))?$', line)
7435                     if tm:
7436                         meta = tm.group(3) or ""
7437                         dm = re.search(r'\[(\w+)\]', meta)
7438                         pm = re.search(r'Priority:\s*(\d)', meta)
7439                         notes_m = re.search(r'Notes:\s*(.+?)(?:\s*—\s*(?:Priority|energy|Due|\[)|$)', meta, re.I)
7440                         if not notes_m:
7441                             notes_m = re.search(r'Notes:\s*(.+?)$', meta, re.I)
7442                         found_task = {
7443                             "text": task_text,
7444                             "domain": dm.group(1).lower() if dm else "",
7445                             "priority": int(pm.group(1)) if pm else 2,
7446                             "notes": notes_m.group(1).strip().rstrip(' —') if notes_m else "",
7447                         }
7448                 changed = True
7449                 continue  # skip this line (remove it)
7450             new_lines.append(line)
7451         if changed:
7452             _paths.atomic_write_text(md_file, "\n".join(new_lines) + "\n")
7453     return found_task
7454

7456 def _append_to_archive(filepath, task_dict):
7457     """Append a task entry to an archive file (CANCELLED.md or SAVED_FOR_LATER.md)."""
7458     if not filepath:
7459         return
7460     today = date.today().isoformat()
7461     domain_str = f" — [{task_dict.get('domain', '')}]" if task_dict.get('domain') else ""
7462     priority_str = f" — P{task_dict.get('priority', 2)}"
7463     notes_str = f" — Notes: {task_dict['notes']}" if task_dict.get('notes') else ""
7464     line = f"- {today}: {task_dict['text']}{domain_str}{priority_str}{notes_str}"
7465 
7466     if not filepath.exists():
7467         _paths.atomic_write_text(filepath, f"# {filepath.stem.replace('_', ' ').title()}\n\n")
7468     content = _read_md_text(filepath)
7469     content = content.rstrip() + "\n" + line + "\n"
7470     _paths.atomic_write_text(filepath, content)

7495 @_with_write_lock
7496 def restore_task(task_text, from_archive="saved"):
7497     """Restore a task from an archive back to the active dashboard."""
7498     archive_file = SAVED_FOR_LATER_MD if from_archive == "saved" else CANCELLED_MD
7499     if not archive_file or not archive_file.exists():
7500         return False
7501     text = _read_md_text(archive_file)
7502     search = task_text.lower().strip()
7503     found = None
7504     new_lines = []
7505     for line in text.splitlines():
7506         if search in line.lower() and not found:
7507             # Parse the archived task
7508             m = re.match(r'\s*-\s*\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}:\s*(.*?)(?:\s*—\s*\[(\w+)\])?(?:\s*—\s*P(\d))?(?:\s*—\s*Notes:\s*(.*))?$', line)
7509             if m:
7510                 found = {
7511                     "text": m.group(1).strip(),
7512                     "domain": m.group(2) or "personal",
7513                     "priority": int(m.group(3)) if m.group(3) else 2,
7514                     "notes": m.group(4).strip() if m.group(4) else "",
7515                 }
7516             continue  # remove from archive
7517         new_lines.append(line)
7518     if found:
7519         _paths.atomic_write_text(archive_file, "\n".join(new_lines) + "\n")
7520         add_task(found["text"], found["domain"], found["priority"], "med", "", found["notes"])
7521         log_change(f"Restored from {from_archive}: {task_text}")
7522         return True
7523     return False

7526 # ── HTML Dashboard Generation ─────────────────────────────────────────
7527 
7528 # ── r3 home (2026-09-03) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
7529 # The home page follows the dashboard-v2 prototype (r3, 2026-08-27/28;
7530 # _mockups/dashboard-v2 + SCORECARD.md): "open Anchor in the morning, see what
7531 # needs you, act, and leave." The steward owns the left rail (the move today ·
7532 # due today · coming up · project counts · workbench); the steward tile opens
7533 # with ranked "needs attention" rows; Calendar and Email are tiles on the HOME
7534 # (not the project cockpit) in an honest not-connected state — no connector
7535 # exists yet (plans/2026-08-29-anchor-email-calendar-research), so nothing is
7536 # sample data and the only action says it is not yet available. Everything here
7537 # is read-only projection of state the page already has; the ranking is
7538 # home_attention (deterministic, every row names its rule).
7539 def _home_r3_parts(tasks, health, steward_label, steward_hs_name,
7540                    today=None, now=None, facts=None):
7541     """Return the r3 rail / attention / calendar / email HTML snippets.
7542 
7543     Best-effort at every seam: a registry hiccup degrades one section to an
7544     honest line, never the page."""
7545     import home_attention as _ha
7546     import home_rows as _hr
7547     esc = lambda s: html_lib.escape(str(s if s is not None else ""))
7548 
7549     try:
7550         sessions = _sessreg.list_sessions()
7551     except Exception:
7552         sessions = []
7553     names, folders, open_n, entries = {}, 0, 0, []
7554     try:
7555         for _e in _rnd.list_projects(include_archived=False, include_future=False,
7556                                      include_retired=False):
7557             if _e.get("id"):
7558                 names[_e["id"]] = _e.get("name") or _e["id"][:8]
7559                 entries.append(_e)
7560         open_n = len(names)
7561     except Exception:
7562         pass
7563     # W1a (High Seat, 2026-09-26): each project's steward record — its wait, its lead line, its
7564     # dated open steps — three small reads per project, no scan, no model, no bridge on GET /
7565     facts = list(facts.values()) if isinstance(facts, dict) else _hr.all_project_facts(entries, today)
7566     try:
7567         folders = len(_rnd.group_by_group())
7568     except Exception:
7569         pass
7570 
7571     rows = _ha.build_attention(tasks=tasks, sessions=sessions, health=health,
7572                                today=today, now=now, project_names=names, projects=facts)
7573     bullets = _ha.brief_bullets(rows, facts, today=today, seat_name=steward_hs_name)
7574     move_html = ('<div class="rlead">%s</div>' % esc(bullets[0])
7575                  + "".join('<div class="rsub">%s</div>' % esc(b) for b in bullets[1:]))
7576     counts = _ha.rail_counts(sessions, rows, folders=folders, open_projects=open_n)
7577     due, due_more = _ha.due_rows(tasks, today=today, projects=facts)
7578     live, live_more = _ha.live_rows(sessions, names)
7579 
7580     # ── rail ──
7581     due_html = "".join(
7582         '<div class="rrow"><span class="rdot %s"></span><span>%s</span></div>' % (

7666 def _working_pids(entries, sessions):
7667     """The projects with something running (the initiative light's "working"): a managed session in status running, or
7668     a live steward engine that is busy on the project's folder or an effort under it. Read-only; never raises."""
7669     out = set()
7670     try:
7671         for rec in sessions or ():
7672             if isinstance(rec, dict) and rec.get("status") == "running" and rec.get("project_id"):
7673                 out.add(str(rec["project_id"]))
7674     except Exception:
7675         pass
7676     try:
7677         from steward_cockpit.steward_routes import ENGINES as _engines
7678         folders = []
7679         for e in entries or ():
7680             try:
7681                 if e.get("folder_path") and e.get("id"):
7682                     folders.append((Path(e["folder_path"]).resolve(), str(e["id"])))
7683             except Exception:
7684                 continue
7685         for cdir, eng in list(_engines.items()):
7686             try:
7687                 if not (eng.alive() and getattr(eng, "busy", False)):
7688                     continue
7689                 c = Path(str(cdir)).resolve()
7690                 for f, pid in folders:
7691                     if c == f or f in c.parents:
7692                         out.add(pid)
7693             except Exception:
7694                 continue
7695     except Exception:
7696         pass
7697     return out

7700 def _engine_light(cdir):
7701     """The cockpit's OWN light for one effort directory - the same source the cockpit page shows (green working ·
7702     orange needs an answer · quiet idle · red broken or stuck) - read from its engine object as the cockpit's state
7703     route does (no wake; a parked cockpit answers from its record). {light, question}; empty when unreadable."""
7704     try:
7705         from steward_cockpit.steward_routes import get_engine as _get
7706         eng = _get(str(cdir), False, None)
7707         if eng is None:
7708             return {"light": "", "question": ""}
7709         return {"light": str(eng.light() or ""), "question": " ".join(str(getattr(eng, "open_question", "") or "").split())}
7710     except Exception:
7711         return {"light": "", "question": ""}

7714 def _attention_of(cdir):
7715     try:
7716         ap = Path(str(cdir)) / ".ecgberht" / "attention.json"
7717         att = json.loads(ap.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if cdir and ap.is_file() else {}
7718         return att if isinstance(att, dict) else {}
7719     except Exception:
7720         return {}

7722 
7723 def _light_words(cdir, f, working_here, with_engine):
7724     """One card's light in his words. The cockpit's light leads (W2e-7, his word: the cockpit's convention); the
7725     record's wait still makes orange so the dot never contradicts the card's own Needs-you line; red ahead of orange
7726     ahead of green; quiet and nothing else = gray idle."""
7727     att = _attention_of(cdir)
7728     state = str(att.get("state") or "").lower()
7729     el = _engine_light(cdir) if with_engine else {"light": "", "question": ""}
7730     if el["light"] in ("red", "orange", "green", "quiet"):
7731         # the cockpit answered: its light IS the dot (Grok's read of W2e-7: the engine already folds the attention flag in
7732         # the cockpit's order; a second boss painted orange over a green cockpit)
7733         light, word, why = {"red": ("red", "a problem", str(att.get("reason") or "the steward is stuck or broken")),
7734                             "orange": ("orange", "needs you", str(el["question"] or (f or {}).get("needs_you") or att.get("reason") or "")),
7735                             "green": ("green", "working", str(att.get("reason") or "")),
7736                             "quiet": ("gray", "idle", "")}[el["light"]]
7737     elif state == "blocked" and not (f or {}).get("needs_you"):
7738         light, word, why = "orange", "needs you", str(att.get("reason") or "")
7739     elif (f or {}).get("needs_you") or state in ("needs_you", "deliverable_ready"):
7740         light, word, why = "orange", "needs you", str((f or {}).get("needs_you") or att.get("reason") or "")
7741     elif working_here or state == "working":
7742         light, word, why = "green", "working", str(att.get("reason") or "")
7743     else:
7744         light, word, why = "gray", "idle", ""
7745     return {"light": light, "word": word, "why": " ".join(why.split())[:160]}

7748 def _project_lights(entries, facts, working, seats=()):
7749     """W2e (2026-09-30, his words): every card's light - green working · orange needs you · red a problem · gray idle.
7750     W2e-7 (his word, 19:1x): a SEATED card - a project's or an effort's - takes its own cockpit's light (``seats`` =
7751     (pid, dir) pairs; an effort's light is keyed ``pid|dir``), the record's wait and the working set still read; the
7752     other projects keep the record-only rule (no engine object built for a card nobody sees). Read-only; never raises."""
7753     out = {}
7754     by_id = {str((e or {}).get("id") or ""): e for e in entries or () if (e or {}).get("id")}
7755     seated = set()
7756     for pid, d in seats or ():
7757         pid = str(pid or ""); d = str(d or "")
7758         e = by_id.get(pid)
7759         if not e:
7760             continue
7761         folder = str(e.get("folder_path") or "")
7762         cdir = str(Path(folder) / d) if d else folder
7763         if not cdir:
7764             continue
7765         f = (facts or {}).get(pid) or {}
7766         key = pid + "|" + d if d else pid
7767         try:
7768             out[key] = _light_words(cdir, {} if d else f, (pid in (working or set())) and not d, True)
7769         except Exception:
7770             out[key] = {"light": "gray", "word": "idle", "why": ""}
7771         seated.add(key)
7772     for pid, e in by_id.items():
7773         if pid in seated:
7774             continue
7775         folder = str(e.get("folder_path") or "")
7776         try:
7777             out[pid] = _light_words(folder, (facts or {}).get(pid) or {}, pid in (working or set()), False)
7778         except Exception:
7779             out[pid] = {"light": "gray", "word": "idle", "why": ""}
7780     return out

7783 def _high_seat_context():
7784     """Everything the High Seat page (W1b, 2026-09-26) is made of, read once per request: the
7785     registry, each project's steward record (home_rows), the ranked rows and the brief

7787     exists. No model call, no bridge spawn. Best-effort at every seam."""
7788     import home_attention as _ha

7809     rows = _ha.build_attention(tasks=[], sessions=sessions, health=(hr[0], hr[1]) if hr else None,
7810                                today=today, now=now, project_names=names, projects=facts_list, limit=12)
7811     try:   # the Cave's Terminal (2026-10-02): the Terminal seat's engine as the default, the plain terminals open now
7812         default_cli = _aset.get_default_cli()
7813     except Exception:
7814         default_cli = "claude"

7818     counts = _ha.rail_counts(sessions, rows, folders=len(groups), open_projects=len(entries))

7820     parked = [e for e in everything if e.get("state") == "future"]
7821     try:
7822         _p, tasks, _i = gather_all()
7823         tasks_open = sum(1 for x in tasks if not x.get("done"))
7824     except Exception:
7825         tasks_open = 0
7826     # the Campaign: the project whose folder is <workspace>/Campaign (PLAN §3), read once
7827     campaign, initiatives, seeds, seed_rows = None, [], 0, []

7830         camp_dir = Path(_paths.data_dir()).resolve().parent / "Campaign"

7832                       if e.get("folder_path") and Path(e["folder_path"]).resolve() == camp_dir), None)
7833         if entry and (camp_dir / "roadmap.json").is_file():
7834             from steward_cockpit.steward_campaign import read_map as _read_map

7836             m = _read_map(str(camp_dir))

7839                       for f in facts_list if f.get("folder") and f.get("projection") is not None}

7841             initiatives = _hsp.campaign_initiatives(m.get("steps") or [], resolved)
7842             _loose = _hsp.loose_initiative(m.get("steps") or [], resolved)     # a cockpit seated from the Candidates, in no goal yet (2026-10-02)

7844                 _evs = json.loads((camp_dir / "roadmap.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("roadmap_events") or []
7845                 for _e in _evs:

7847                     if _sid and _at:
7848                         _a, _b = step_dates.get(_sid, ("", ""))

7962 def _nudge_or_log(where, fn):
7963     """W3 (Grok's read, RC-G): the nudges are derived from the records and must never break a page - but a guard that
7964     swallows the failure cannot see what it exists for (the first build's seed-count TypeError painted a quiet brief).
7965     One line in the server log names the boundary and the error; the page goes on without a nudge."""
7966     try:

8047 def _conversation_turns(folder):
8048     """The Campaign's one conversation log as the pages show it (W2 v2; W2c-2: the Campaign page and the High Seat read
8049     it through this one reader): every turn with who said it, its text, its time on HIS clock (the log's stamps are UTC),
8050     and the goal it was said from; and the same turns filtered by goal."""
8051     turns, goal_turns = [], {}
8052     try:
8053         from steward_cockpit.conversation_history import read_history_document
8054         for tn in (read_history_document(folder) or {}).get("turns") or []:
8055             if not isinstance(tn, dict) or not tn.get("text"):
8056                 continue
8057             at = str(tn.get("at") or "")
8058             try:
8059                 from datetime import datetime as _dt
8060                 _ts = _dt.fromisoformat(at.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
8061                 at_s = (_ts.astimezone() if _ts.tzinfo is not None else _ts).strftime("%H:%M")
8062             except (ValueError, TypeError, OSError):
8063                 at_s = at[11:16] if len(at) >= 16 else at
8064             t = {"you": str(tn.get("role") or "").lower() in ("you", "user", "john", "human"),
8065                  "text": " ".join(str(tn.get("text")).split()), "at": at_s, "goal": str(tn.get("goal") or "")}
8066             turns.append(t)
8067             if t["goal"]:
8068                 goal_turns.setdefault(t["goal"], []).append(t)      # a goal's thread is the one log, filtered
8069     except Exception:
8070         turns, goal_turns = [], {}
8071     return turns, goal_turns

8096                     if e.get("id") and e.get("id") != entry.get("id")]

8283 class _SlowWatch:
8284     """A page that takes long says WHERE it waited (2026-10-02, his word: find why the Cave is slow again): a watcher
8285     thread samples the request thread's stack at 2 s and 4 s while the page is still building, and the total is logged
8286     when it is over 1.5 s. One line per sample in the service log ("SLOW <label>"); nothing when the page is quick."""
8287     def __init__(self, label):
8288         self.label, self.tid, self.done, self.t0 = label, threading.get_ident(), threading.Event(), time.time()
8289 
8290     def __enter__(self):
8291         def watch():
8292             for at in (2.0, 4.0):
8293                 if self.done.wait(at - (time.time() - self.t0)):
8294                     return
8295                 try:
8296                     import traceback as _tb
8297                     fr = sys._current_frames().get(self.tid)
8298                     stack = " <- ".join("%s:%d %s" % (os.path.basename(f.filename), f.lineno, f.name) for f in reversed(_tb.extract_stack(fr)[-14:])) if fr else "?"
8299                     print("  [%s] SLOW %s at %.0fs: %s" % (datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S"), self.label, at, stack), flush=True)
8300                 except Exception:
8301                     pass
8302         threading.Thread(target=watch, name="slow-watch", daemon=True).start()
8303         return self
8304 
8305     def __exit__(self, *exc):
8306         self.done.set()
8307         took = time.time() - self.t0
8308         if took > 1.5:
8309             print("  [%s] SLOW %s took %.1fs" % (datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S"), self.label, took), flush=True)
8310         return False
8311 
8312 
8313 def handle_debug_threads(handler, path, body):
8314     """GET /api/debug/threads (token) - every thread's stack, for finding what a slow request waits on (2026-10-02)."""
8315     import traceback as _tb
8316     names = {t.ident: t.name for t in threading.enumerate()}
8317     out = []
8318     for tid, fr in sys._current_frames().items():
8319         out.append("--- %s (%s)" % (names.get(tid, "?"), tid))
8320         out.extend(l.rstrip() for l in _tb.format_stack(fr)[-18:])
8321     handler._send_bytes(("\n".join(out) + "\n").encode("utf-8", "replace"), "text/plain; charset=utf-8", cache="no-store")
8322

8353 def _np_place(res, group):
8354     """After a creation: put the new project in the folder he chose (``set_group``); the entry says so."""
8355     group = str(group or "").strip()
8356     if not group or not isinstance(res, dict):
8357         return res
8358     entry = res.get("entry") if isinstance(res.get("entry"), dict) else None
8359     if not entry or not entry.get("id"):
8360         return res
8361     name = str(entry.get("name") or "the project")
8362     try:
8363         placed = _rnd.set_group(str(entry["id"]), group)
8364         if isinstance(placed, dict):
8365             res["entry"] = placed
8366         else:
8367             entry["group"] = group
8368         res["group"] = group
8369         res["message"] = "Project \u201c%s\u201d created in the folder %s." % (name, group)
8370     except Exception as exc:
8371         # the creation stands; the failed placement is SAID in the sentence both surfaces show (Grok R11)
8372         res["group_error"] = "the project was made but could not be placed in %s" % group
8373         res["message"] = "Project \u201c%s\u201d created, but it could not be placed in the folder %s (%s) \u2014 it sits in Ungrouped." % (name, group, type(exc).__name__)
8374     return res

8381 def generate_html(projects, tasks, inbox):

8392     # the page can prompt for the token ONCE on first load — never the token value

8402     np_group_options = _np_group_options()

8472     # Domain sort order: commercial first, then academic, family, writing, personal
8473     domain_sort_order = {"commercial": 0, "academic": 1, "family": 2, "writing": 3, "personal": 4}
8474     # Energy sort order: high-energy tasks first, then med, then low
8475     energy_sort_order = {"high": 0, "med": 1, "medium": 1, "low": 2}
8476     today_iso = date.today().isoformat()
8477 
8478     # Top Tasks = P1 tasks + anything due today (any priority)
8479     # Other Tasks = everything P2+ (that isn't due today)
8480     # Within Top Tasks: due today first, then by domain order (commercial → academic → family → writing → personal)
8481     p1 = [t for t in active if t["priority"] == 1]
8482     due_today_non_p1 = [t for t in active if t["priority"] != 1 and t.get("due") and t["due"] <= today_iso]
8483     p1_sorted = sorted(p1, key=lambda t: (
8484         0 if t.get("due") and t["due"] <= today_iso else 1,  # due today first
8485         domain_sort_order.get(t["domain"], 9),
8486         t["text"]
8487     ))
8488 
8489     seen_top = set()
8490     top_tasks = []
8491     for t in due_today_non_p1 + p1_sorted:
8492         key = t["text"].lower()[:60]
8493         if key not in seen_top:
8494             seen_top.add(key)
8495             top_tasks.append(t)
8496     top_done = len([t for t in top_tasks if t["done"]])
8497     top_task_texts = set(t["text"].lower()[:60] for t in top_tasks)
8498 
8499     # P1 and P2+ projects
8500     p1_projects = sorted([p for p in projects if p["priority"] == 1 and p["status"] == "active"],
8501                          key=lambda p: (0 if p.get("due") else 1, p.get("due", ""), p["name"]))
8502     p2_projects = sorted([p for p in projects if p["priority"] >= 2 and p["status"] == "active"],
8503                          key=lambda p: (p["priority"], p["name"]))
8504 
8505     # P2+ tasks not already in Top Tasks (other tasks).
8506     # Sort: by domain (commercial → academic → family → writing → personal),
8507     # then by energy (high → med → low), then by priority number, then text.
8508     other_tasks = sorted(
8509         [t for t in active if t["priority"] >= 2 and t["text"].lower()[:60] not in top_task_texts],
8510         key=lambda t: (
8511             domain_sort_order.get(t["domain"], 9),
8512             energy_sort_order.get(t.get("energy", "med").lower(), 1),
8513             t["priority"],
8514             t["text"],
8515         ),
8516     )

8518     # Group by domain for sidebar

8520     for t in active:
8521         domain_counts[t["domain"]] = domain_counts.get(t["domain"], 0) + 1

8523     def esc(s):
8524         return html_lib.escape(str(s)).replace("'", "&#39;").replace('"', "&quot;")
8525 
8526     def linkify_notes(s):
8527         """Escape HTML, then convert URLs into clickable <a> tags."""
8528         escaped = html_lib.escape(str(s))
8529         return re.sub(
8530             r'(https?://[^\s<>&\'"]+)',
8531             r'<a href="\1" target="_blank" rel="noopener" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">\1</a>',
8532             escaped
8533         )
8534 
8535     def notes_popover(notes_text):
8536         """Build a hoverable popover element for task notes."""
8537         if not notes_text:
8538             return ""
8539         linked = linkify_notes(notes_text)
8540         return f'''<span class="notes-wrapper">
8541             <span class="notes-indicator">&#128203;</span>
8542             <div class="notes-popover">{linked}</div>
8543         </span>'''
8544 
8545     def js_safe(s):
8546         """Escape a string for safe use inside JS onclick='func(\"...\")' attributes."""
8547         import base64
8548         return base64.b64encode(s.encode('utf-8')).decode('ascii')
8549 
8550     def task_data_b64(t):
8551         """Base64-encode a task's full data dict for safe embedding in HTML attributes."""
8552         import base64
8553         d = {"text": t["text"], "priority": t["priority"], "domain": t["domain"],
8554              "energy": t.get("energy","med"), "due": t.get("due",""), "notes": t.get("notes","")}
8555         return base64.b64encode(json.dumps(d).encode('utf-8')).decode('ascii')
8556 
8557     def project_data_b64(p):
8558         """Base64-encode a project's full data dict for safe embedding in HTML attributes."""
8559         import base64
8560         d = {"name": p["name"], "priority": p["priority"], "domain": p["domain"],
8561              "status": p.get("status","active"), "effort": p.get("effort","high"),
8562              "due": p.get("due",""), "next": p.get("next","")}
8563         return base64.b64encode(json.dumps(d).encode('utf-8')).decode('ascii')

8594             {f'<span class="top-task-due">{esc(t["due"])}</span>' if t.get("due") else ""}
8595             <span class="top-task-effort {effort}">{effort}</span>

8597             {tier_btn}

8601         </div>'''

8722         d_other_tasks = sorted(

8802             {f'<div class="section-header" style="margin-top:24px"><h3>Completed ({len(d_done)})</h3></div><div class="task-list">{d_completed_items}</div>' if d_done else ""}
8803         </div>'''

8805     # Build completed view
8806     completed_items = ""

8808         b64c = js_safe(t["text"])

8810         completed_items += f'''<div class="task-item completed">

8828         cancelled_items += f'''<div class="task-item archived-task">

8832                 {notes_line}
8833             </div>

8845         saved_items += f'''<div class="task-item archived-task">

8986     # ── rearch W6b (C1 increment 3): the static home-dashboard path ─────────
8987     # Chosen by the SAME ``frontend`` pillar off-switch flag as W4/W5 (one flag,
8988     # one revert). EMBEDDED (the default, the f-string below) is the pre-wave
8989     # emission — byte-identical and the byte-parity reference. STATIC assembles
8990     # the same page from the checked-in ``static/home.{html,css,js}`` mirror
8991     # (minted by ``tools/extract_home_dashboard.py``): the head <style> and the
8992     # application <script> arrive as hashed static assets, server state rides
8993     # ONLY the ANCHOR_BOOT bootstrap, and the markup-emitting values stay
8994     # server-rendered as include-slot fills. A missing/undecodable shell mirror
8995     # (or a missing hashed asset) falls back to the embedded path — never a 500.
8996     if _static_frontend_enabled():
8997         _home_shell = _home_shell_template()
8998         _home_css_ver = static_asset_version(HOME_CSS_ASSET)
8999         _home_js_ver = static_asset_version(HOME_JS_ASSET)
9000         if (_home_shell is not None and _home_css_ver != "missing"
9001                 and _home_js_ver != "missing"):
9002             _home_css_block = (
9003                 "<link rel='stylesheet' href='" + STATIC_URL_PREFIX + "/"
9004                 + HOME_CSS_ASSET + "?v=" + _home_css_ver + "'>")
9005             _home_js_block = (
9006                 "<script>\n" + anchor_boot_script(home_boot_extra()) + "\n</script>"
9007                 "<script src='" + STATIC_URL_PREFIX + "/" + HOME_JS_ASSET
9008                 + "?v=" + _home_js_ver + "'></script>")
9009             _home_slots = {

9011                 "inbox_count": str(len(inbox)),
9012                 "nav_items": nav_items,
9013                 "balance_rows": balance_rows,

9018                 "saved_count": str(len(saved_tasks)),
9019                 "model_flex_badge": "",
9020                 "today_str": today_str,
9021                 "top_done": str(top_done),
9022                 "top_total": str(len(top_tasks)),
9023                 "top_task_rows": "".join(top_task_row(t) for t in top_tasks),
9024                 "rnd_projects_html": rnd_projects_html,
9025                 "p1_cards": "".join(project_card(p) for p in p1_projects),
9026                 "active_projects": str(
9027                     len([p for p in projects if p["status"] == "active"])),
9028                 "open_tasks": str(len(active)),
9029                 "other_task_items": "".join(
9030                     task_item(t) for t in other_tasks),
9031                 "p2_cards": "".join(project_card(p) for p in p2_projects),
9032                 "completed_items": completed_items,
9033                 "cancelled_items": cancelled_items,
9034                 "saved_items": saved_items,
9035                 "inbox_items": inbox_items,
9036                 "rnd_archive_html": rnd_archive_html,
9037                 "domain_views": domain_views,
9038                 "cache_bust": cache_bust_script(),
9039                 "orphan_alert": _ORPHAN_ALERT_JS,
9040                 "home_css": _home_css_block,
9041                 "home_js": _home_js_block,
9042             }
9043             return _render_home_slots(_home_shell, _home_slots)

9045     return f'''<!DOCTYPE html>

9076

9078 .gwl-lockup {{
9079     display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;

9170 .card {{

9172     padding: 10px 14px; transition: border-color 0.2s; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;

9174 .card:hover {{ border-color: #3e4455; }}

9176 .card.priority-2 {{ border-left: 3px solid var(--warning); }}
9177 .card.priority-3 {{ border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); }}
9178 .card.has-deadline {{ background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(248,113,113,0.06), transparent 40%); }}
9179 .card-main {{ flex: 1; min-width: 0; }}
9180 .card-top {{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }}
9181 .card h3 {{ font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }}
9182 .due-badge {{ font-size: 10px; background: rgba(248,113,113,0.2); color: var(--danger); padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }}
9183 .effort-badge {{ font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 3px; white-space: nowrap; }}

9185 .effort-badge.med {{ background: rgba(251,191,36,0.12); color: var(--warning); }}
9186 .effort-badge.high {{ background: rgba(192,132,252,0.12); color: var(--writing); }}
9187 .next-text {{ font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-dim); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; margin-top: 2px; }}
9188 .domain-tag {{ font-size: 9px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.8px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap; }}
9189 .domain-tag.academic {{ background: rgba(108,156,252,0.15); color: var(--academic); }}
9190 .domain-tag.writing {{ background: rgba(192,132,252,0.15); color: var(--writing); }}
9191 .domain-tag.family {{ background: rgba(74,222,128,0.15); color: var(--family); }}
9192 .domain-tag.commercial {{ background: rgba(251,146,60,0.15); color: var(--commercial); }}
9193 .domain-tag.personal {{ background: rgba(103,232,249,0.15); color: var(--personal); }}
9194 
9195 .card-grid.expanded .card {{ flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; padding: 14px; }}
9196 .card-grid.expanded .card-main {{ width: 100%; }}
9197 .card-grid.expanded .card h3 {{ white-space: normal; }}
9198 .card-grid.expanded .next-text {{ white-space: normal; }}

9200 /* Gandalf in-flight status badge on a dashboard project card. Hidden until the
9201    bulk poller finds an active run for this card's project, then shows a small
9202    spinner + short status text (e.g. "Gandalf: running…"). */
9203 .gandalf-card-status {{
9204     display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
9205     font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2px;
9206     padding: 1px 7px 1px 6px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap;
9207     background: rgba(192,132,252,0.14); color: var(--writing);
9208     border: 1px solid rgba(192,132,252,0.30);
9209 }}
9210 .gandalf-card-status[hidden] {{ display: none; }}
9211 .gandalf-card-status .gcs-spin {{
9212     width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
9213     border: 1.5px solid rgba(192,132,252,0.35); border-top-color: var(--writing);
9214     animation: gcs-spin 0.8s linear infinite; flex-shrink: 0;
9215 }}
9216 @keyframes gcs-spin {{ to {{ transform: rotate(360deg); }} }}

9218 /* Tasks */

9224     background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; transition: all 0.15s;
9225 }}

9230     width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 2px solid var(--border); border-radius: 5px;

9232     justify-content: center; transition: all 0.15s;
9233 }}

9241 .task-priority.p2 {{ background: rgba(251,191,36,0.15); color: var(--warning); }}

9246 .top-tasks-box {{
9247     background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid rgba(108,156,252,0.3);
9248     border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 18px; margin-bottom: 20px;
9249 }}

9251 .top-tasks-box h3 {{ font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--accent); }}

9259     cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; transition: all 0.15s;
9260     border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface2); color: var(--text-dim);
9261 }}

9263 .top-task-done-btn.checked {{ background: var(--success); color: #000; border-color: var(--success); }}
9264 .top-task-text {{ font-size: 13px; flex: 1; font-weight: 500; position: relative; }}

9268 .top-task-effort.med {{ background: rgba(251,191,36,0.12); color: var(--warning); }}
9269 .top-task-effort.high {{ background: rgba(192,132,252,0.12); color: var(--writing); }}

9271 /* ── Dashboard section tiles (2026-07-27) ──────────────────────────────────
9272    The dashboard body is four collapsible tiles, in this order:
9273    High Seat · Workbench · Tasks · Projects. Each is a plain <details>, so the
9274    open/closed state needs no JS; the hint is a caret that flips off the [open]
9275    attribute (r3, 2026-09-03: the click-to-expand copy was cut). */
9276 .dash-tile {{
9277     border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px;
9278     background: var(--surface); margin-bottom: 14px; overflow: hidden;
9279 }}
9280 .dash-tile > summary {{
9281     display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 16px;
9282     cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600;
9283     user-select: none;
9284 }}
9285 .dash-tile > summary::-webkit-details-marker {{ display: none; }}
9286 .dash-tile > summary::marker {{ content: ""; }}
9287 .dash-tile > summary:hover {{ background: var(--surface2); }}
9288 .dash-tile .tile-ico {{ width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 4px; flex: none; }}
9289 .dash-tile .tile-glyph {{ font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; flex: none; }}
9290 .dash-tile .tile-count {{ font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-dim); }}
9291 .dash-tile .tile-hint {{ margin-left: auto; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-dim); white-space: nowrap; }}
9292 .dash-tile .tile-hint::after {{ content: "\\25BE"; }}
9293 .dash-tile[open] .tile-hint::after {{ content: "\\25B4"; }}
9294 .dash-tile .tile-count .tc-link {{ color: var(--text-dim); text-decoration: underline dotted; }}
9295 .dash-tile .tile-count .tc-link:hover {{ color: var(--text); }}
9296 .tile-links {{ display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }}
9297 .tlink {{ display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim);
9298           border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 3px 8px; text-decoration: none; }}
9299 .tlink:hover {{ color: var(--text); background: var(--surface2); }}
9300 .tlink b {{ font-weight: 600; }}
9301 .tlink .dot {{ width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; }}
9302 
9303 /* ── r3 rail (2026-09-03): the steward owns the left column ─────────────── */
9304 .rail-home {{ padding: 0 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }}
9305 .rail-card {{ border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--bg); padding: 10px 12px; }}
9306 .rail-card .rlab {{ font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.2px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-bottom: 6px; }}
9307 .rail-move {{ border-color: rgba(251,191,36,0.45); }}
9308 .rail-move .rlab {{ color: var(--warning); }}
9309 .rail-move .rtitle {{ font-size: 11px; color: var(--warning); margin-bottom: 4px; }}
9310 .rail-move .rlead {{ font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 500; }}
9311 .rail-move .rsub {{ font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 6px; line-height: 1.35; }}
9312 .rail-card .rrow {{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12.5px; padding: 3px 0; line-height: 1.3; }}
9313 .rail-card .rrow a {{ color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; }}
9314 .rail-card .rrow a:hover {{ text-decoration: underline; }}
9315 .rail-card .rdot {{ width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; background: var(--warning); }}
9316 .rail-card .rdot.p1, .rail-card .rdot.late {{ background: var(--danger); }}
9317 .rail-card .rlive {{ color: var(--success); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }}

9319 .rail-card .rquiet a {{ color: var(--accent); }}
9320 .rail-card .rgrid {{ display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px; }}
9321 .rail-card .rstat {{ background: var(--surface2); border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 9px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--text); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }}
9322 .rail-card .rstat b {{ font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; }}

9324 .rail-card .rstat b.bad {{ color: var(--danger); }}

9326 .rail-back a {{ font-size: 12px; color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; }}

9328 /* ── r3 steward tile: needs-attention rows ──────────────────────────────── */

9330 .attn-quiet {{ font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-dim); }}

9495 .top-task-row:hover .promote-btn, .top-task-row:hover .demote-btn {{ opacity: 1; }}
9496 .promote-btn:hover {{ background: rgba(248,113,113,0.15); color: var(--danger); border-color: var(--danger); }}
9497 .demote-btn:hover {{ background: rgba(251,191,36,0.15); color: var(--warning); border-color: var(--warning); }}
9498 
9499 /* Modal */
9500 .modal-overlay {{
9501     display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
9502     z-index: 200; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
9503 }}
9504 .modal-overlay.open {{ display: flex; }}
9505 /* R11 (2026-09-28): opened from the High Seat as a small window — the dialog alone, nothing else of this page */
9506 body.only-new-project > *:not(#newProjectModal) {{ display: none !important; }}
9507 body.only-new-project #newProjectModal {{ background: var(--bg); align-items: flex-start; padding: 8px; }}
9508 body.only-new-project #newProjectModal .modal {{ width: 100%; max-width: 100%; max-height: none; }}
9509 .modal {{
9510     background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px;
9511     padding: 24px; width: 500px; max-width: 90vw; max-height: 85vh; overflow-y: auto;
9512 }}
9513 .modal h3 {{ font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; }}
9514 .modal label {{ font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; margin-top: 12px; }}
9515 .modal input, .modal select, .modal textarea {{
9516     width: 100%; background: var(--surface2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px;
9517     padding: 8px 12px; color: var(--text); font-size: 13px; outline: none; font-family: inherit;
9518 }}
9519 .modal textarea {{ resize: vertical; min-height: 60px; }}
9520 .modal input:focus, .modal select:focus {{ border-color: var(--accent); }}
9521 .modal-actions {{ display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: 20px; }}
9522 
9523 /* R&D existing-folder picker */
9524 .rnd-picker-loc {{
9525     font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-bottom: 6px;
9526     word-break: break-all; line-height: 1.4;
9527 }}
9528 .rnd-picker-loc b {{ color: var(--text); }}
9529 .rnd-picker-selected {{
9530     font-size: 12px; margin: 6px 0 0; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px;
9531     background: rgba(108,156,252,0.12); border: 1px solid var(--accent);
9532     color: var(--text); word-break: break-all; line-height: 1.4;
9533 }}
9534 .rnd-picker-selected.empty {{
9535     background: var(--surface2); border-color: var(--border); color: var(--text-dim);
9536 }}
9537 .rnd-picker-err {{
9538     font-size: 12px; margin: 6px 0; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px;
9539     background: rgba(248,113,113,0.12); border: 1px solid var(--danger); color: var(--text);
9540     word-break: break-all; line-height: 1.4;
9541 }}
9542 /* Explorer-style expandable TREE folder picker */
9543 .rnd-tree {{
9544     background: var(--surface2); max-height: 300px; overflow: auto;
9545     border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px;
9546     margin-top: 6px; font-size: 13px;
9547 }}
9548 .rnd-tree-children {{ margin-left: 16px; border-left: 1px solid var(--border); padding-left: 2px; }}
9549 .rnd-tree-row {{
9550     display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 6px;
9551     border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: background 0.12s;
9552 }}
9553 .rnd-tree-row:hover {{ background: rgba(108,156,252,0.14); }}
9554 .rnd-tree-row.selected {{ background: rgba(108,156,252,0.28); }}
9555 .rnd-tree-row .rt-caret {{
9556     flex: 0 0 auto; width: 14px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-dim);
9557     font-size: 11px;
9558 }}
9559 .rnd-tree-row .rt-icon {{ flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 15px; }}
9560 .rnd-tree-row .rt-name {{
9561     flex: 1 1 auto; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
9562 }}
9563 .rnd-tree-err {{ color: var(--danger); font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 6px 2px 22px; }}
9564 .rnd-use-btn {{ background: var(--accent); }}
9565 
9566 /* Toast */
9567 .toast {{
9568     position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; background: var(--success);
9569     color: #000; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600;
9570     display: none; z-index: 200; animation: fadeIn 0.2s;
9571 }}
9572 @keyframes fadeIn {{ from {{ opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }} to {{ opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }} }}
9573 
9574 /* Cancel / Save for Later buttons */
9575 .cancel-btn, .save-later-btn {{
9576     background: none; border: 1px solid var(--border); cursor: pointer;
9577     font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; opacity: 0; transition: all 0.15s; white-space: nowrap;
9578 }}
9579 .cancel-btn {{ color: var(--danger); }}
9580 .save-later-btn {{ color: var(--warning); }}
9581 .task-item:hover .cancel-btn, .task-item:hover .save-later-btn,
9582 .top-task-row:hover .cancel-btn, .top-task-row:hover .save-later-btn {{ opacity: 1; }}
9583 .cancel-btn:hover {{ background: rgba(248,113,113,0.15); border-color: var(--danger); }}
9584 .save-later-btn:hover {{ background: rgba(251,191,36,0.15); border-color: var(--warning); }}
9585 
9586 /* Notes popover */
9587 .notes-wrapper {{
9588     position: relative; display: inline-block; margin-left: 6px;
9589 }}
9590 .notes-indicator {{
9591     font-size: 11px; cursor: help; opacity: 0.6;
9592 }}
9593 .notes-wrapper:hover .notes-indicator {{ opacity: 1; }}
9594 .notes-popover {{
9595     display: none; position: absolute; bottom: calc(100% + 8px); left: 50%;
9596     transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 150;
9597     background: var(--surface2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px;
9598     padding: 10px 14px; min-width: 220px; max-width: 400px;
9599     font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text);
9600     box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
9601     word-break: break-word; white-space: normal;
9602 }}
9603 .notes-popover::after {{
9604     content: ''; position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
9605     border: 6px solid transparent; border-top-color: var(--border);
9606 }}
9607 .notes-popover a {{
9608     color: var(--accent); text-decoration: underline; word-break: break-all;
9609 }}
9610 .notes-popover a:hover {{ color: #93b8fd; }}
9611 .notes-wrapper:hover .notes-popover {{ display: block; }}
9612 
9613 /* Archived task notes */
9614 .archived-notes {{
9615     font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 4px;
9616     padding: 4px 8px; background: var(--surface2); border-radius: 4px;
9617     word-break: break-word;
9618 }}
9619 .archived-notes a {{ color: var(--accent); }}
9620 
9621 /* Archived task items */
9622 .archived-task {{
9623     align-items: center;
9624 }}
9625 
9626 @media (max-width: 768px) {{
9627     .sidebar {{ display: none; }}
9628     .main {{ margin-left: 0; padding: 16px; }}
9629     .stats-row {{ flex-wrap: wrap; }}
9630     .stat-card {{ min-width: calc(50% - 6px); }}
9631 }}
9632 
9633 /* ── R&D project tiles (rich) ── */
9634 .rnd-projects {{ display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }}
9635 /* v4 Wave 8: the per-folder directory header (.rnd-folder/.rnd-folder-head/
9636    .rnd-folder-tiles) was removed — projects render as a FLAT row list. */
9637 .rnd-name {{ font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; }}
9638 .rnd-badge {{ font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-dim); }}
9639 .rnd-badge.rnd-p1 {{ background: rgba(248,113,113,.18); color: var(--danger); border-color: rgba(248,113,113,.3); }}
9640 .rnd-badge.rnd-p2 {{ background: rgba(251,191,36,.15); color: var(--warning); border-color: rgba(251,191,36,.3); }}
9641 .rnd-badge[class*="rnd-state-archived"], .rnd-badge[class*="rnd-state-future"], .rnd-badge[class*="rnd-state-retired"] {{ background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); }}
9642 .rnd-imported {{ color: var(--text-dim); font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; }}
9643 .rnd-running {{ color: var(--success); font-size: 11px; }}
9644 .rnd-status-line {{ margin: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }}
9645 .rnd-lane {{ padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: #1b2030; font-size: 13px; }}
9646 .rnd-lane.rnd-lane-empty {{ color: var(--text-dim); }}
9647 .rnd-blurb {{ font-size: 12px; color: var(--text); opacity: .85; }}
9648 .rnd-notes {{ font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-dim); background: rgba(255,255,255,.03); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 8px; white-space: pre-wrap; }}
9649 .rnd-actions {{ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; margin-top: 2px; }}
9650 .rnd-mini {{ font-size: 11px; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; }}
9651 .rnd-mini:hover {{ border-color: var(--accent); }}
9652 .rnd-mini.rnd-pr-on {{ border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }}
9653 .rnd-mini.rnd-open-btn {{ background: var(--accent); color: #0b1020; border-color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }}
9654 .rnd-mini.rnd-accent {{ border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }}
9655 /* v9 Wave 3 — collapsible project FOLDERS (group field; drag-to-group). */
9656 .rnd-folder-toolbar {{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; }}
9657 .rnd-newfolder-btn {{ font-size: 12px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(108,156,252,.5); background: var(--surface2, #232733); color: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; }}
9658 .rnd-newfolder-btn:hover {{ border-color: var(--accent); }}
9659 .rnd-folder-hint {{ font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-dim); }}
9660 .rnd-folder-list {{ display: flex; flex-direction: column; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; }}
9661 .rnd-folder {{ border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }}
9662 .rnd-folder:last-child {{ border-bottom: none; }}
9663 .rnd-folder-head {{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 11px 14px; cursor: pointer; background: var(--surface2, #232733); }}
9664 .rnd-folder-head:hover {{ background: var(--surface3, #2a2f3d); }}
9665 .rnd-tw {{ font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); width: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; }}
9666 .rnd-fname {{ font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; }}
9667 .rnd-fcount {{ font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); }}
9668 .rnd-fpath {{ font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--text-dim); font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; margin-left: 6px; }}
9669 .rnd-fsp {{ flex: 1; }}
9670 .rnd-fdrop-hint {{ font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent); }}
9671 .rnd-folder-body {{ display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 8px 8px; }}
9672 .rnd-folder.rnd-collapsed .rnd-folder-body {{ display: none; }}
9673 .rnd-folder.rnd-droptarget .rnd-folder-head {{ outline: 2px dashed var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; }}
9674 .rnd-grip {{ flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 13px; cursor: grab; letter-spacing: -2px; }}
9675 .rnd-row[draggable="true"] {{ cursor: grab; }}
9676 .rnd-row.rnd-dragging {{ opacity: .5; }}
9677 /* v9 Wave 4 — the Option-C "move on disk + group" confirm dialog. */
9678 .rnd-move-overlay {{ position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9000; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }}
9679 .rnd-move-dlg {{ max-width: 560px; width: calc(100% - 40px); border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.4); border-radius: 12px; background: #160f12; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6); }}
9680 .rnd-move-h {{ padding: 10px 14px; background: rgba(239,68,68,.1); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.3); color: var(--text); }}
9681 .rnd-move-b {{ padding: 13px 14px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text); }}
9682 .rnd-move-mono {{ font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; color: #cdd2dc; background: #05070c; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 10px; margin: 9px 0; word-break: break-all; }}
9683 .rnd-move-mono .rnd-move-arr {{ color: var(--accent); }}
9684 .rnd-move-guard {{ font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 8px; }}
9685 .rnd-move-guard b {{ color: #e9dca8; }}
9686 .rnd-move-acts {{ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 9px; padding: 11px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }}
9687 .rnd-move-btn {{ font-size: 12.5px; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface2, #232733); color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; }}
9688 .rnd-move-btn:hover {{ border-color: var(--accent); }}
9689 .rnd-move-btn.rnd-move-go {{ border-color: rgba(239,68,68,.55); background: rgba(239,68,68,.14); color: #ffd2d2; }}
9690 /* v3 Wave 5 — thin full-width project ROWS (replace the square .rnd-tile). */
9691 .rnd-folder-rows {{ display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }}
9692 .rnd-row {{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface2, #232733); cursor: pointer; position: relative; }}
9693 .rnd-seal-ico {{ width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 4px; flex: 0 0 auto; object-fit: cover; }}
9694 .rnd-row:hover {{ border-color: var(--accent); }}
9695 .rnd-row:focus {{ outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }}
9696 .rnd-dot {{ flex: 0 0 auto; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-dim); }}
9697 .rnd-dot.rnd-dot-running {{ background: var(--success); box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--success); }}
9698 .rnd-dot.rnd-dot-idle {{ background: var(--text-dim); }}
9699 .rnd-row .rnd-name {{ flex: 0 0 auto; white-space: nowrap; }}
9700 .rnd-row-summary {{ flex: 2 1 0; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text); opacity: .85; }}
9701 .rnd-row-summary.rnd-dim {{ color: var(--text-dim); opacity: .6; font-style: italic; }}
9702 /* v6 Wave 7 — timely activity reflection: running indicator + "what's happening". */
9703 .rnd-row-activity {{ flex: 3 1 0; min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); overflow: hidden; }}
9704 .rnd-row-steward {{ flex: 2 1 0; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent); opacity: .9; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }}
9705 .rnd-act-running {{ flex: 0 0 auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: var(--success); font-weight: 600; }}
9706 .rnd-act-pulse {{ width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success); box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--success); animation: rndActPulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; }}
9707 @keyframes rndActPulse {{ 0%, 100% {{ opacity: 1; }} 50% {{ opacity: .35; }} }}
9708 .rnd-act-latest {{ flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }}
9709 .rnd-act-lane {{ text-transform: capitalize; color: var(--text); opacity: .85; }}
9710 .rnd-act-title {{ color: var(--text); opacity: .9; }}
9711 .rnd-act-status.rnd-act-green {{ color: var(--success); }}
9712 .rnd-act-status.rnd-act-amber {{ color: #e0a02a; }}
9713 .rnd-act-status.rnd-act-red {{ color: var(--danger, #e06c6c); }}
9714 .rnd-act-status.rnd-act-grey {{ color: var(--text-dim); }}
9715 .rnd-row-counts {{ flex: 0 0 auto; }}
9716 .rnd-row-counts .rnd-status-line {{ gap: 5px; }}
9717 .rnd-row-counts .rnd-lane {{ padding: 2px 7px; font-size: 11px; }}
9718 /* v4 Wave 8 — per-row cost/tokens/time rollup + the R&D view's global window toggle. */
9719 .rnd-row-roll {{ flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }}
9720 .rnd-rows-rolltog {{ display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); }}
9721 .rnd-rows-rolltog-label {{ margin-right: 2px; }}
9722 .rnd-rows-rolltog b {{ font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-dim); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }}
9723 .rnd-rows-rolltog b.on {{ background: rgba(108,156,252,.15); color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }}
9724 .rnd-kebab {{ flex: 0 0 auto; position: relative; }}
9725 .rnd-grave {{ flex: 0 0 auto; opacity: .55; padding: 1px 6px; }}
9726 .rnd-grave:hover {{ opacity: 1; }}
9727 .rnd-kebab-btn {{ background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; }}
9728 .rnd-kebab-btn:hover {{ border-color: var(--border); color: var(--text); }}
9729 .rnd-kebab-menu {{ display: none; position: absolute; right: 0; top: 100%; margin-top: 4px; z-index: 30; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 120px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.4); }}
9730 .rnd-kebab-menu.rnd-kebab-open {{ display: flex; }}
9731 .rnd-kebab-menu .rnd-mini {{ width: 100%; text-align: left; }}
9732 .rnd-mini.rnd-danger:hover {{ border-color: var(--danger); color: var(--danger); }}
9733 .rnd-empty {{ color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 13px; }}
9734 </style>
9735 </head>
9736 <body>
9737 <div class="app">
9738   <nav class="sidebar">
9739     <div class="gwl-lockup">
9740       <img src="/vendor/brand/gwl-m-icon.svg?v={BUILD_ID}" alt="Ghost World Labs">
9741       <div class="gwl-wordmark">Ghost World <span class="gwl-accent">Labs</span></div>
9742     </div>
9743     <div class="gwl-badge">Powered by NextGen Nuclear <svg class="gwl-rad" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="vertical-align:middle" role="img" aria-label="radiation"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2.6" fill="#22c55e"/><path fill="#22c55e" d="M13.6 14.77L17.5 21.53A11 11 0 0 1 6.5 21.53L10.4 14.77A3.2 3.2 0 0 0 13.6 14.77ZM8.8 12L1 12A11 11 0 0 1 6.5 2.47L10.4 9.23A3.2 3.2 0 0 0 8.8 12ZM13.6 9.23L17.5 2.47A11 11 0 0 1 23 12L15.2 12A3.2 3.2 0 0 0 13.6 9.23Z"/></svg></div>
9744     <h1>{_anchor_mark(28)} Anchor</h1>
9745     <div class="subtitle">J.C. Liechty — Life Dashboard</div>
9746     <!-- r3 (2026-09-03): the steward owns the rail — the move today, due
9747          today, coming up, project counts, workbench. The old Views/Domains/
9748          Domain-balance nav is gone (SCORECARD cuts); Inbox, domain filters and
9749          the R&D archive stay one click away inside the Tasks/Projects tiles. -->
9750     <div class="rail-home" data-rail>
9751       <div class="rail-back" style="display:none" data-railback>
9752         <a href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault();showView('dashboard')">&#8592; Dashboard</a>
9753       </div>
9754       {r3_rail_html}
9755     </div>
9756   </nav>
9757 
9758   <div class="main">
9759     <!-- v4 Wave 8 — Option B masthead lockup (Anchor · divider · GWL mark +
9760          wordmark · NextGen Nuclear pill). Single vendored brand mark. -->
9761     <div class="masthead">
9762       <div class="mh-title">{_anchor_mark(26)}Anchor</div>
9763       <div class="mh-vdiv"></div>
9764       <div class="mh-lock">
9765         <img src="/vendor/brand/gwl-m-icon.svg?v={BUILD_ID}" alt="Ghost World Labs">
9766         <div class="mh-words">
9767           <div class="mh-w1">Ghost World <span class="gwl-accent">Labs</span></div>
9768           <div class="mh-w2">R&amp;D Mission Control</div>
9769         </div>
9770       </div>
9771       <div class="mh-spacer"></div>
9772       <button id="tokenBtn" onclick="if(setAnchorToken())location.reload();" title="Set or clear the Anchor access token" style="display:{auth_token_btn_display};margin-right:10px;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px">&#128273;</button>
9773       <div class="mh-pill">Powered by NextGen Nuclear <svg class="gwl-rad" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="vertical-align:middle" role="img" aria-label="radiation"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2.6" fill="#22c55e"/><path fill="#22c55e" d="M13.6 14.77L17.5 21.53A11 11 0 0 1 6.5 21.53L10.4 14.77A3.2 3.2 0 0 0 13.6 14.77ZM8.8 12L1 12A11 11 0 0 1 6.5 2.47L10.4 9.23A3.2 3.2 0 0 0 8.8 12ZM13.6 9.23L17.5 2.47A11 11 0 0 1 23 12L15.2 12A3.2 3.2 0 0 0 13.6 9.23Z"/></svg></div>
9774     </div>
9775     <!-- Dashboard view -->
9776     <div class="view" id="view-dashboard">
9777       {health_banner_html}
9778       <div class="page-header">
9779         <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
9780           <h2>Dashboard</h2>
9781           <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="refresh()" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px 10px;background:var(--accent)">&#8635; Update</button>
9782           <button class="btn btn-sm" id="doctorChip" onclick="window.open('/doctor' + (_anchorToken() ?
