10204 <script>
10205 // Heartbeat disabled — the server runs until explicitly stopped so the
10206 // dashboard is instantly available when you return to the tab later.
10207 
10208 // ── Access token (D4) ──
10209 // Kept ONLY in this browser's localStorage; sent as X-Anchor-Token on mutating
10210 // POSTs; NEVER embedded in the served HTML (GET is unauthenticated). When the
10211 // server has no ANCHOR_TOKEN set, auth is off and the header is ignored.
10212 window.ANCHOR_AUTH_REQUIRED = {auth_required_js};
10213 // W2 contract shim: the versioned bootstrap — apiCall declares this build id on
10214 // every mutating POST (X-Anchor-Build); a mismatch renders the reload banner.
10215 window.ANCHOR_BOOT = {anchor_boot_js};
10216 function _anchorToken() {{ try {{ return localStorage.getItem('anchor_token') || ''; }} catch (e) {{ return ''; }} }}
10217 // ── One-time launcher token hand-off (v1.1.3 share-fix) ──
10218 // launch_anchor_dashboard.py opens this page ONCE as /?token=<minted>. Store
10219 // it (localStorage — same slot the manual paste uses), mint the HttpOnly auth
10220 // cookie so page NAVIGATION (/project/, /report/, term_ws…) authenticates,
10221 // then STRIP the token from the URL/history. Loopback-only by construction;
10222 // after this runs no page URL carries the token again.
10223 (function () {{
10224     try {{
10225         var _q = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
10226         var _t = (_q.get('token') || '').trim();
10227         if (!_t) return;
10228         try {{ localStorage.setItem('anchor_token', _t); }} catch (e) {{}}
10229         try {{
10230             fetch('/api/auth/login', {{
10231                 method: 'POST',
10232                 headers: {{ 'Content-Type': 'application/json',
10233                             'X-Anchor-Token': _t }},
10234                 body: JSON.stringify({{ token: _t }})
10235             }});
10236         }} catch (e) {{}}
10237         _q.delete('token');
10238         var _rest = _q.toString();
10239         history.replaceState(null, '',
10240             window.location.pathname + (_rest ? '?' + _rest : '') +
10241             window.location.hash);
10242     }} catch (e) {{}}
10243 }})();
10244 function setAnchorToken(opts) {{
10245     const cur = _anchorToken();
10246     // Do NOT re-offer a token the server just REJECTED (2026-07-28). The prompt
10247     // used to pre-fill the saved value even when that value had just produced a
10248     // 401, so pressing OK re-sent the known-bad token and the user looped. After
10249     // a token rotation this is exactly what happens on every device that still
10250     // holds the old one — "it was still saved" was the symptom.
10251     const rejected = !!(opts && opts.rejected) && !!cur;
10252     // R14 (2026-09-29): an in-page box, never window.prompt — a browser that suppresses dialogs showed nothing at
10253     // all ("I click that button and nothing happens"). The box saves and reloads; this call returns false because
10254     // nothing is known yet (its callers fall through; the reload carries the new token).
10255     const msg = document.getElementById('tokenMsg'), inp = document.getElementById('tokenInput'), modal = document.getElementById('tokenModal');
10256     if (!modal || !inp) return false;
10257     if (msg) msg.textContent = rejected
10258         ? 'Your saved Anchor token was REJECTED (it is probably out of date). Paste the current token:'
10259         : 'Paste your Anchor access token. It stays in this browser.';
10260     inp.value = rejected ? '' : cur;
10261     modal.classList.add('open');
10262     setTimeout(function () {{ try {{ inp.focus(); inp.select(); }} catch (e) {{}} }}, 50);
10263     return false;
10264 }}
10265 function saveAnchorToken() {{
10266     const inp = document.getElementById('tokenInput');
10267     const t = inp ? inp.value.trim() : '';
10268     try {{ if (t) {{ localStorage.setItem('anchor_token', t); }} else {{ localStorage.removeItem('anchor_token'); }} }} catch (e) {{}}
10269     closeModal('tokenModal');
10270     location.reload();
10271 }}
10272 // On first load, if the server requires auth and we have no token yet, ask once.
10273 // Once stored, this never fires again (token persists in localStorage).
10274 window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {{
10275     if (window.ANCHOR_AUTH_REQUIRED && !_anchorToken()) {{ setAnchorToken(); }}
10276 }});
10277 
10278 // ── Global 401 auto-reprompt (self-service token) ──
10279 // A fresh origin (e.g. a laptop on the tailnet IP) has no token in this origin's
10280 // localStorage → token-gated reads return 401 and dynamic content comes up empty.
10281 // Wrap window.fetch so a 401 (auth on, not already prompting) re-prompts for the
10282 // token and reloads — every read then retries with the new token. Non-401
10283 // responses pass through UNCHANGED (the body/stream is never touched).
10284 // /api/version is public (returns 200) so the cache-bust poll never trips this.
10285 (function () {{
10286     if (window.__anchorFetchWrapped) return;
10287     window.__anchorFetchWrapped = true;
10288     const _origFetch = window.fetch.bind(window);
10289     let prompting = false;
10290     // Rewrite a stale ?token= in a URL so a retry carries the NEW token.
10291     function _retok(u) {{
10292         try {{
10293             const t = _anchorToken();
10294             if (!t) return u;
10295             const s = String(u);
10296             if (/[?&]token=/.test(s))
10297                 return s.replace(/([?&]token=)[^&]*/, '$1' + encodeURIComponent(t));
10298             return s + (s.indexOf('?') >= 0 ? '&' : '?') + 'token=' + encodeURIComponent(t);
10299         }} catch (e) {{ return u; }}
10300     }}
10301     window.fetch = function () {{
10302         const _args = arguments;
10303         return _origFetch.apply(null, _args).then(function (resp) {{
10304             if (resp && resp.status === 401 && window.ANCHOR_AUTH_REQUIRED && !prompting) {{
10305                 prompting = true;
10306                 try {{
10307                     // RETRY, DO NOT RELOAD (2026-07-28). This used to be
10308                     // `location.reload()`, which threw away everything the user
10309                     // had typed — the High Seat saybox draft and the in-flight
10310                     // act itself. After a token rotation that is guaranteed data
10311                     // loss on the first click, and it made the steward unusable.
10312                     // We already hold the original arguments, so re-issue the
10313                     // SAME request with the new token instead.
10314                     if (setAnchorToken({{ rejected: true }})) {{
10315                         prompting = false;
10316                         const a0 = _args[0];
10317                         if (typeof a0 === 'string') {{
10318                             const a1 = _args[1] ? Object.assign({{}}, _args[1]) : {{}};
10319                             try {{
10320                                 const h = new Headers(a1.headers || {{}});
10321                                 const nt = _anchorToken();
10322                                 if (nt) h.set('X-Anchor-Token', nt);
10323                                 a1.headers = h;
10324                             }} catch (e) {{}}
10325                             return _origFetch(_retok(a0), a1).then(function (r2) {{
10326                                 // Still refused with a fresh token — the token is
10327                                 // wrong, not stale. Reload is the honest last resort.
10328                                 if (r2 && r2.status === 401) location.reload();
10329                                 return r2;
10330                             }});
10331                         }}
10332                         // Non-string input (a Request): its body may already be
10333                         // consumed, so a retry is not safe. Fall back to reload.
10334                         location.reload();
10335                     }}
10336                 }} finally {{
10337                     prompting = false;
10338                 }}
10339             }}
10340             // W2 contract shim: a structured 409 build-mismatch means this tab
10341             // predates the current deploy — show the 'reload required' banner.
10342             // The body is read off a CLONE so the caller's .json() still works.
10343             if (resp && resp.status === 409) {{
10344                 try {{
10345                     resp.clone().json().then(function (d) {{
10346                         if (d && d.error === 'build-mismatch') _showReloadBanner();
10347                     }}).catch(function () {{}});
10348                 }} catch (e) {{}}
10349             }}
10350             return resp;
10351         }});
10352     }};
10353 }})();
10354 
10355 // ── W2 contract shim: the 'reload required' banner ──
10356 // Idempotent; fixed to the top of the viewport; one click reloads onto the
10357 // new build. Matched by the structured 409 body ({{error:'build-mismatch'}}).
10358 function _showReloadBanner() {{
10359     if (document.getElementById('anchorReloadBanner')) return;
10360     const d = document.createElement('div');
10361     d.id = 'anchorReloadBanner';
10362     d.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
10363     d.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:2147483647;' +
10364         'background:#b45309;color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;text-align:center;' +
10365         'font:600 14px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4)';
10366     d.innerHTML = 'Anchor was updated — this page is out of date. ' +
10367         '<button onclick="location.reload()" style="margin-left:10px;padding:4px 12px;' +
10368         'border:1px solid #fff;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:#fff;' +
10369         'cursor:pointer;font:inherit">Reload</button>';
10370     (document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(d);
10371 }}
10372 
10373 async function apiCall(endpoint, body) {{
10374     // Retry once on network failure — the server may have briefly paused
10375     // (e.g. GC, slow I/O) and the browser throttled our heartbeat.
10376     async function _doFetch() {{
10377         const headers = {{'Content-Type': 'application/json'}};
10378         const tok = _anchorToken();
10379         if (tok) headers['X-Anchor-Token'] = tok;
10380         // W2 contract shim: declare this page's build id on every mutating
10381         // POST (a stale tab gets the structured 409 → the reload banner).
10382         const bid = (window.ANCHOR_BOOT && window.ANCHOR_BOOT.build_id) || '';
10383         if (bid) headers['X-Anchor-Build'] = bid;
10384         const r = await fetch(endpoint, {{
10385             method: 'POST',
10386             headers: headers,
10387             body: JSON.stringify(body)
10388         }});
10389         return await r.json();
10390     }}
10391     try {{
10392         let data;
10393         try {{ data = await _doFetch(); }}
10394         catch(e1) {{
10395             await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 400));
10396             data = await _doFetch();
10397         }}
10398         // Auth required but missing/stale → let the user supply it, then retry once.
10399         if (data && data.error === 'unauthorized' && setAnchorToken()) {{
10400             data = await _doFetch();
10401         }}
10402         if (data.ok) {{
10403             showToast(data.message || 'Done!');
10404             setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 600);
10405         }} else {{
10406             showToast('Error: ' + (data.error || 'unknown'));
10407         }}
10408     }} catch(e) {{
10409         showToast('Connection error: ' + e.message + ' — the server may have stopped. Relaunch the dashboard.');
10410     }}
10411 }}
10412 
10413 function showToast(msg) {{
10414     const t = document.getElementById('toast');
10415     t.textContent = msg;
10416     t.style.display = 'block';
10417     setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 2500);
10418 }}
10419 
10420 // ── Calendar Picker ──
10421 let _calOpen = null;   // currently open calendar popup element
10422 let _calInput = null;   // the date input it controls
10423 let _calMonth = null;   // displayed month (0-11)
10424 let _calYear = null;    // displayed year
10425 
10426 function toggleCalendar(inputId, btn) {{
10427     const popup = document.getElementById('cal_' + inputId);
10428     const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
10429     if (_calOpen && _calOpen === popup) {{ closeAllCalendars(); return; }}
10430     closeAllCalendars();
10431     _calOpen = popup;
10432     _calInput = input;
10433     // Start on the input's current value or today
10434     const cur = input.value ? new Date(input.value + 'T00:00:00') : new Date();
10435     _calMonth = cur.getMonth();
10436     _calYear = cur.getFullYear();
10437     renderCalendar();
10438     popup.classList.add('open');
10439 }}
10440 
10441 function closeAllCalendars() {{
10442     document.querySelectorAll('.cal-popup.open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('open'));
10443     _calOpen = null;
10444     _calInput = null;
10445 }}
10446 
10447 function renderCalendar() {{
10448     if (!_calOpen) return;
10449     const today = new Date();
10450     const todayStr = today.getFullYear() + '-' + String(today.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0') + '-' + String(today.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
10451     const selectedStr = _calInput.value || '';
10452     const monthNames = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];
10453     const dows = ['Su','Mo','Tu','We','Th','Fr','Sa'];
10454 
10455     const firstDay = new Date(_calYear, _calMonth, 1).getDay();
10456     const daysInMonth = new Date(_calYear, _calMonth + 1, 0).getDate();
10457     const daysInPrev = new Date(_calYear, _calMonth, 0).getDate();
10458 
10459     let html = `<div class="cal-header">
10460         <button onclick="calNav(-1)">&#9664;</button>
10461         <span class="cal-title">${{monthNames[_calMonth]}} ${{_calYear}}</span>
10462         <button onclick="calNav(1)">&#9654;</button>
10463     </div><div class="cal-grid">`;
10464     dows.forEach(d => html += `<span class="cal-dow">${{d}}</span>`);
10465 
10466     // Previous month trailing days
10467     for (let i = firstDay - 1; i >= 0; i--) {{
10468         const day = daysInPrev - i;
10469         const m = _calMonth === 0 ? 12 : _calMonth;
10470         const y = _calMonth === 0 ? _calYear - 1 : _calYear;
10471         const ds = y + '-' + String(m).padStart(2,'0') + '-' + String(day).padStart(2,'0');
10472         html += `<span class="cal-day other-month" onclick="calPick('${{ds}}')">${{day}}</span>`;
10473     }}
10474     // Current month days
10475     for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {{
10476         const ds = _calYear + '-' + String(_calMonth+1).padStart(2,'0') + '-' + String(d).padStart(2,'0');
10477         let cls = 'cal-day';
10478         if (ds === todayStr) cls += ' today';
10479         if (ds === selectedStr) cls += ' selected';
10480         html += `<span class="${{cls}}" onclick="calPick('${{ds}}')">${{d}}</span>`;
10481     }}
10482     // Next month leading days
10483     const totalCells = firstDay + daysInMonth;
10484     const remaining = (7 - (totalCells % 7)) % 7;
10485     for (let d = 1; d <= remaining; d++) {{
10486         const m = _calMonth === 11 ? 1 : _calMonth + 2;
10487         const y = _calMonth === 11 ? _calYear + 1 : _calYear;
10488         const ds = y + '-' + String(m).padStart(2,'0') + '-' + String(d).padStart(2,'0');
10489         html += `<span class="cal-day other-month" onclick="calPick('${{ds}}')">${{d}}</span>`;
10490     }}
10491     html += `</div>`;
10492     html += `<div class="cal-actions">
10493         <button onclick="calClear()">Clear</button>
10494         <button class="cal-today-btn" onclick="calPickToday()">Today</button>
10495     </div>`;
10496     _calOpen.innerHTML = html;
10497 }}
10498 
10499 function calNav(delta) {{
10500     _calMonth += delta;
10501     if (_calMonth > 11) {{ _calMonth = 0; _calYear++; }}
10502     if (_calMonth < 0) {{ _calMonth = 11; _calYear--; }}
10503     renderCalendar();
10504 }}
10505 
10506 function calPick(dateStr) {{
10507     if (_calInput) {{
10508         _calInput.value = dateStr;
10509         _calInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
10510     }}
10511     closeAllCalendars();
10512 }}
10513 
10514 function calPickToday() {{
10515     const t = new Date();
10516     calPick(t.getFullYear() + '-' + String(t.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0') + '-' + String(t.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'));
10517 }}
10518 
10519 function calClear() {{
10520     if (_calInput) {{ _calInput.value = ''; _calInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); }}
10521     closeAllCalendars();
10522 }}
10523 
10524 // Close calendar when clicking outside
10525 document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {{
10526     if (_calOpen && !e.target.closest('.date-picker-wrap')) closeAllCalendars();
10527 }});

10568 function refresh() {{ window.location.reload(); }}
10569 function r3RaiseRows(n) {{
10570     // The steward's raise queue (⚑ n) as attention rows + rail facts. Ranked
10571     // like home_attention: after a health row, before everything else.
10572     // Idempotent across badge polls; n == 0 removes the row; null never gets here.
10573     var host = document.querySelector('[data-attention]');
10574     var old = host ? host.querySelector('.att[data-rule="raise"]') : null;
10575     if (old) old.remove();
10576     var stat = document.querySelector('[data-needyou]');
10577     var base = stat ? parseInt(stat.getAttribute('data-needyou') || '0', 10) : 0;
10578     var total = base + (n > 0 ? n : 0);
10579     if (stat) {{ stat.textContent = String(total); stat.className = total > 0 ? 'bad' : ''; }}
10580     if (!host || !(n > 0)) return;
10581     var stw = window.ANCHOR_STEWARD || {{}};
10582     var name = stw.high_seat_name || 'High Seat';
10583     var text = n === 1 ? 'One decision is waiting on you' : n + ' decisions are waiting on you';
10584     var row = document.createElement('a');
10585     row.className = 'att red'; row.setAttribute('data-rule', 'raise'); row.href = '#';
10586     row.onclick = function (e) {{
10587         e.preventDefault();
10588         var t = document.getElementById('tile-highseat'); if (t) t.open = true;
10589         var d = document.querySelector('.ecg-hs-inline');
10590         if (d) {{ try {{ d.scrollIntoView({{ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }}); }} catch (x) {{ d.scrollIntoView(); }} }}
10591     }};
10592     row.innerHTML = '<span class="adot"></span><span class="atext"></span>'
10593         + '<span class="awhy">the steward raised ' + (n === 1 ? 'it' : 'them') + ' — answer below</span>'
10594         + '<span class="arule">raised by: steward</span>';
10595     row.querySelector('.atext').textContent = text;
10596     if (host.classList.contains('attn-quiet')) {{
10597         host.classList.remove('attn-quiet');
10598         host.innerHTML = '<div class="attn-head"><b>Needs attention</b>'
10599             + '<span>say which to act on — nothing opens until you ask</span></div>'
10600             + '<div class="attn-rows"></div><div class="attn-first"></div>';
10601     }}
10602     var rows = host.querySelector('.attn-rows');
10603     var health = rows.querySelector('.att[data-rule="health"]');
10604     if (health) rows.insertBefore(row, health.nextSibling);
10605     else rows.insertBefore(row, rows.firstChild);
10606     var cnt = document.querySelector('#tile-highseat .tile-count');
10607     if (cnt) {{
10608         var k = rows.querySelectorAll('.att').length;
10609         cnt.textContent = (stw.label || 'Ecgberht') + ' — ' + k + ' need attention · talk below';
10610     }}
10611     if (!health) {{
10612         var lead = document.querySelector('[data-rail] .rail-move .rlead');
10613         if (lead) lead.textContent = text + ' — ' + name + '.';
10614         var first = host.querySelector('.attn-first');
10615         if (first) {{
10616             first.innerHTML = 'I would take <b></b> first. Or say another.';
10617             first.querySelector('b').textContent = text.toLowerCase();
10618         }}
10619     }}
10620 }}
10621 // (2026-09-03, John: "when I mark a task as done, do not suddenly close the
10622 // task window") Every task action reloads the page and <details> tiles start
10623 // closed, so the tile he was working in vanished. A tile he opened now stays
10624 // open across reloads (per browser, like the project folders).
10625 const TILE_OPEN_LS = 'anchor_tiles_open';
10626 function _tilesOpen() {{
10627     try {{ return new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(TILE_OPEN_LS) || '[]')); }}
10628     catch (e) {{ return new Set(); }}
10629 }}
10630 function _wireTileMemory() {{
10631     const open = _tilesOpen();
10632     document.querySelectorAll('details.dash-tile[id]').forEach(d => {{
10633         if (open.has(d.id) && !d.open) d.open = true;
10634         d.addEventListener('toggle', () => {{
10635             const s = _tilesOpen();
10636             if (d.open) s.add(d.id); else s.delete(d.id);
10637             try {{ localStorage.setItem(TILE_OPEN_LS, JSON.stringify(Array.from(s))); }} catch (e) {{}}
10638         }});
10639     }});
10640 }}

10674 // ── v5 Wave 3: live-ish R&D rows refresh (no full page reload) ──
10675 // Poll the read-only rows fragment ONLY while the R&D view is active AND the
10676 // tab is visible; swap the container's innerHTML only when the fragment CHANGED
10677 // (diff-before-swap → no DOM churn / scroll jumps). Failure-tolerant: a failed
10678 // fetch is a silent no-op, never throws.
10679 function _rndViewActive() {{
10680     const v = document.getElementById('view-rnd');
10681     return !!(v && v.style.display !== 'none'
10682               && document.visibilityState === 'visible');
10683 }}
10684 function rndRowsRefresh() {{
10685     try {{
10686         if (!_rndViewActive()) return;
10687         // Don't clobber an OPEN kebab menu (the swap would re-render it closed) —
10688         // skip this tick; the user is mid-interaction. The next tick refreshes.
10689         if (document.querySelector('.rnd-kebab-menu.rnd-kebab-open')) return;
10690         const box = document.getElementById('rndProjectsRows');
10691         if (!box) return;
10692         fetch('/api/rnd/projects_html', {{cache: 'no-store'}})
10693           .then(function (r) {{ return r.ok ? r.json() : null; }})
10694           .then(function (d) {{
10695               if (!d || !d.ok || typeof d.html !== 'string') return;
10696               if (!_rndViewActive()) return;              // re-check after await
10697               if (document.querySelector('.rnd-kebab-menu.rnd-kebab-open')) return;
10698               if (d.html === box.innerHTML) return;       // diff-before-swap
10699               // Preserve the user's lifetime/30d rollup-window toggle across the
10700               // swap: the server fragment always renders 'lifetime' as active, so
10701               // capture the active window BEFORE the swap and re-apply it after
10702               // (otherwise the 15s poll would silently revert a 30d selection).
10703               var onBtn = box.querySelector('.rnd-rows-rolltog b.on[data-window]');
10704               var savedWin = onBtn ? onBtn.getAttribute('data-window') : 'lifetime';
10705               box.innerHTML = d.html;
10706               if (savedWin && savedWin !== 'lifetime') {{
10707                   var reBtn = box.querySelector(
10708                       '.rnd-rows-rolltog b[data-window="' + savedWin + '"]');
10709                   if (reBtn) rndRowsRollupWindow(savedWin, reBtn);
10710               }}
10711               // v9 Wave 3 — re-wire folder drag/drop + restore collapse state on
10712               // the freshly-swapped rows.
10713               if (typeof rndFolderInit === 'function') rndFolderInit();
10714           }})
10715           .catch(function () {{}});                       // silent no-op
10716     }} catch (e) {{}}
10717 }}
10718 setInterval(rndRowsRefresh, 15000);
10719 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {{
10720     if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') rndRowsRefresh();
10721 }});
10722 
10723 // ── Gandalf in-flight status on dashboard project cards ──
10724 // One bulk poll (/api/rnd/gandalf_status_all) drives the per-card badge instead
10725 // of N single-project requests. Each card carrying a data-project-id is matched
10726 // against the returned project_id-to-status map: a match shows a spinner + the
10727 // short status text; a card no longer in the map is cleared. The interval runs
10728 // only while the tab is visible AND at least one run is in-flight — it idles
10729 // (interval cleared) otherwise and is woken by a slow keep-alive probe / a
10730 // visibility change, so it never leaks intervals and never polls in the dark.
10731 var _gandalfCardTimer = null;
10732 var _gandalfCardProbe = null;
10733 function _gandalfCardTokenQ() {{
10734     try {{ var t = _anchorToken(); return t ? ('?token=' + encodeURIComponent(t)) : ''; }}
10735     catch (e) {{ return ''; }}
10736 }}
10737 function _gandalfCardApply(statuses) {{
10738     var any = false;
10739     // both tile kinds: the PROJECTS.md .card AND the R&D .rnd-row
10740     var cards = document.querySelectorAll('[data-project-id]');
10741     for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {{
10742         var card = cards[i];
10743         var pid = card.getAttribute('data-project-id');
10744         var badge = card.querySelector('.gandalf-card-status');
10745         if (!badge) continue;
10746         var st = statuses && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(statuses, pid)
10747                  ? statuses[pid] : null;
10748         if (st) {{
10749             any = true;
10750             // a setup message is already a sentence; only a raw Gandalf
10751             // status needs the prefix
10752             var label = (st.indexOf('Setting up') === 0
10753                          || st.indexOf('Read deferred') === 0)
10754                         ? st : 'Gandalf: ' + st;
10755             var txt = badge.querySelector('.gcs-text');
10756             if (txt) txt.textContent = label;
10757             badge.title = label;
10758             badge.hidden = false;
10759         }} else {{
10760             badge.hidden = true;
10761             var txt2 = badge.querySelector('.gcs-text');
10762             if (txt2) txt2.textContent = '';
10763         }}
10764     }}
10765     return any;
10766 }}
10767 function _gandalfCardTick() {{
10768     if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible'
10769         || !document.querySelector('[data-project-id]')) {{
10770         _gandalfCardStop();
10771         return;
10772     }}
10773     fetch('/api/rnd/gandalf_status_all' + _gandalfCardTokenQ(), {{cache: 'no-store'}})
10774       .then(function (r) {{ return r.ok ? r.json() : null; }})
10775       .then(function (d) {{
10776           if (!d || !d.ok) return;
10777           var any = _gandalfCardApply(d.statuses || {{}});
10778           if (!any) _gandalfCardStop();   // nothing in-flight → idle the poller
10779       }})
10780       .catch(function () {{}});            // silent no-op
10781 }}
10782 function _gandalfCardStart() {{
10783     if (_gandalfCardTimer) return;        // already polling — don't stack intervals
10784     if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible'
10785         || !document.querySelector('[data-project-id]')) return;
10786     _gandalfCardTick();                   // immediate first paint
10787     _gandalfCardTimer = setInterval(_gandalfCardTick, 1000);
10788 }}
10789 function _gandalfCardStop() {{
10790     if (_gandalfCardTimer) {{ clearInterval(_gandalfCardTimer); _gandalfCardTimer = null; }}
10791 }}
10792 // Slow keep-alive: while idle, probe occasionally so a run STARTED after the
10793 // poller went quiet re-arms the 1s loop (single probe; re-uses the same fetch).
10794 function _gandalfCardProbeTick() {{
10795     if (_gandalfCardTimer) return;        // already active
10796     if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible'
10797         || !document.querySelector('[data-project-id]')) return;
10798     fetch('/api/rnd/gandalf_status_all' + _gandalfCardTokenQ(), {{cache: 'no-store'}})
10799       .then(function (r) {{ return r.ok ? r.json() : null; }})
10800       .then(function (d) {{
10801           if (d && d.ok && d.statuses && Object.keys(d.statuses).length) {{
10802               _gandalfCardApply(d.statuses);
10803               _gandalfCardStart();
10804           }}
10805       }})
10806       .catch(function () {{}});
10807 }}
10808 window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {{
10809     _gandalfCardStart();
10810     _gandalfCardProbe = setInterval(_gandalfCardProbeTick, 8000);
10811 }});
10812 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {{
10813     if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') _gandalfCardStart();
10814     else _gandalfCardStop();
10815 }});

10916 // auto-suggest flag so later folder selections never clobber the user's text.

10919 function npUpdatePreview() {{
10920     const parentInput = document.getElementById('npParentPath');
10921     const nameInput = document.getElementById('npName');
10922     const previewEl = document.getElementById('npPreviewPath');
10923     if (!previewEl) return;
10924     
10925     const parentVal = (parentInput.value || '').trim();
10926     const nameVal = (nameInput.value || '').trim();
10927     if (!parentVal || !nameVal) {{
10928         previewEl.textContent = '';
10929         return;
10930     }}
10931     
10932     let normalizedParent = parentVal.replace(/[\\\\/]+$/, '');
10933     let lastSegment = normalizedParent.split(/[\\\\/]/).pop() || '';
10934     
10935     let resolved;
10936     if (lastSegment.toLowerCase() === nameVal.toLowerCase()) {{
10937         resolved = normalizedParent;
10938     }} else {{
10939         const sep = parentVal.includes('/') ? '/' : '\\\\';
10940         resolved = normalizedParent + sep + nameVal;
10941     }}
10942     previewEl.innerHTML = 'Preview: <b>' + escHtml(resolved) + '</b>';
10943 }}

10945 // Auto-suggest the project name from a selected folder's basename, but ONLY if
10946 // the field is empty or still holds a prior auto-suggestion (never overwrite a
10947 // value the user typed). Keeps the field fully editable.
10948 function npSuggestName(path) {{
10949     if (!path) return;
10950     const nameEl = document.getElementById('npName');
10951     const cur = (nameEl.value || '').trim();
10952     if (cur !== '' && !_npAutoName) return;   // user typed their own — leave it
10953     const base = npBasename(path);
10954     if (!base) return;
10955     nameEl.value = base;
10956     _npAutoName = true;
10957     npUpdatePreview();
10958 }}
10959 
10960 // Last path segment (drive-letter and trailing-separator aware), e.g.
10961 // 'C:\\dev\\Anchor' -> 'Anchor', 'C:\\' -> 'C:'.
10962 function npBasename(path) {{
10963     // NOTE: this is inside a Python f-string, so a literal backslash in the
10964     // emitted JS regex needs FOUR here ('\\\\' -> '\\' in JS -> one '\\' match).
10965     // Two backslashes would collapse to one in the f-string and the JS regex
10966     // would only match forward slashes, breaking Windows path basenames.
10967     let p = String(path).replace(/[\\\\/]+$/, '');     // strip trailing slashes
10968     const parts = p.split(/[\\\\/]+/);
10969     let base = parts[parts.length - 1] || '';
10970     if (/^[A-Za-z]:$/.test(base)) base = base.charAt(0);  // 'C:' -> 'C'
10971     return base;
10972 }}

10978     document.getElementById('npExistingFields').style.display = isNew ? 'none' : 'block';
10979     document.getElementById('npModeNewBtn').className = 'btn btn-sm' + (isNew ? '' : ' btn-outline');
10980     document.getElementById('npModeExistingBtn').className = 'btn btn-sm' + (isNew ? ' btn-outline' : '');

10984 // ── Explorer-style expandable TREE picker ────────────────────────────────────
10985 // Each tree node is a <div class="rnd-tree-node"> containing one clickable row
10986 // (caret + folder icon + label) and a hidden children container. Clicking a row
10987 // BOTH selects the node (highlight + Selected line + name auto-suggest) AND
10988 // toggles lazy expansion (fetch child dirs from /api/rnd/dir_browse). Clicking
10989 // an open node again collapses it. Drill arbitrarily deep.
10990 
10991 let _npCurrentPath = null;   // the currently highlighted/selected folder path
10992 
10993 // Populate the top level with the drive roots.
10994 async function npTreeInit() {{
10995     const tree = document.getElementById('npTree');
10996     if (!tree) return;
10997     tree.innerHTML = '';
10998     _npCurrentPath = null;
10999     let data;
11000     try {{ data = await npDirBrowse(null); }}
11001     catch(e) {{ npTreeErr(tree, 'Browse failed: ' + e.message); return; }}
11002     const res = (data && data.result) || {{}};
11003     (res.roots || []).forEach(r => tree.appendChild(npMakeNode(r, r)));
11004 }}
11005 
11006 // Fetch helper — returns the parsed JSON for a dir_browse call.
11007 async function npDirBrowse(path) {{
11008     const url = '/api/rnd/dir_browse' + (path ? ('?path=' + encodeURIComponent(path)) : '');
11009     const r = await fetch(url);
11010     return await r.json();
11011 }}
11012 
11013 // Build one tree node (row + empty children container). `path` is the absolute
11014 // folder path; `label` is what to display (drive root or folder basename).
11015 function npMakeNode(path, label) {{
11016     const node = document.createElement('div');
11017     node.className = 'rnd-tree-node';
11018     node.dataset.path = path;
11019 
11020     const row = document.createElement('div');
11021     row.className = 'rnd-tree-row';
11022     row.dataset.path = path;
11023 
11024     const caret = document.createElement('span');
11025     caret.className = 'rt-caret';
11026     caret.textContent = '\\u25B8';                // ▸ collapsed
11027 
11028     const icon = document.createElement('span');
11029     icon.className = 'rt-icon';
11030     icon.textContent = '\\uD83D\\uDCC1';          // 📁
11031 
11032     const name = document.createElement('span');
11033     name.className = 'rt-name';
11034     name.textContent = label;
11035 
11036     row.appendChild(caret);
11037     row.appendChild(icon);
11038     row.appendChild(name);
11039 
11040     const kids = document.createElement('div');
11041     kids.className = 'rnd-tree-children';
11042     kids.style.display = 'none';
11043 
11044     node.appendChild(row);
11045     node.appendChild(kids);
11046 
11047     node._loaded = false;
11048     node._open = false;
11049 
11050     // One click = select + toggle expand/collapse.
11051     row.addEventListener('click', function(ev) {{
11052         ev.stopPropagation();
11053         npTreeSelect(row, path);
11054         npTreeToggle(node);
11055     }});
11056 
11057     return node;
11058 }}
11059 
11060 // Highlight a row as the current selection, update the Selected line, and
11061 // auto-suggest the project name.
11062 function npTreeSelect(row, path) {{
11063     document.querySelectorAll('#npTree .rnd-tree-row.selected')
11064         .forEach(r => r.classList.remove('selected'));
11065     row.classList.add('selected');
11066     _npCurrentPath = path;
11067     document.getElementById('npFolderPath').value = path;
11068     npSuggestName(path);
11069     npUpdateSelectedUI();
11070 }}
11071 
11072 // Expand (lazy-load children on first open) or collapse a node.
11073 async function npTreeToggle(node) {{
11074     const caret = node.querySelector(':scope > .rnd-tree-row > .rt-caret');
11075     const kids = node.querySelector(':scope > .rnd-tree-children');
11076     if (node._open) {{
11077         node._open = false;
11078         caret.textContent = '\\u25B8';            // ▸
11079         kids.style.display = 'none';
11080         return;
11081     }}
11082     node._open = true;
11083     caret.textContent = '\\u25BE';                // ▾
11084     kids.style.display = 'block';
11085     if (node._loaded) return;
11086     node._loaded = true;
11087     let data;
11088     try {{ data = await npDirBrowse(node.dataset.path); }}
11089     catch(e) {{ npTreeErr(kids, 'Browse failed: ' + e.message); return; }}
11090     const res = (data && data.result) || {{}};
11091     if (res.error) {{
11092         // Inline message; parent stays usable. Allow a later retry.
11093         node._loaded = false;
11094         npTreeErr(kids, "Can't open this folder — " + res.error);
11095         return;
11096     }}
11097     kids.innerHTML = '';
11098     const dirs = res.dirs || [];
11099     if (!dirs.length) {{
11100         const empty = document.createElement('div');
11101         empty.className = 'rnd-tree-err';
11102         empty.style.color = 'var(--text-dim)';
11103         empty.textContent = '(no subfolders)';
11104         kids.appendChild(empty);
11105         return;
11106     }}
11107     dirs.forEach(d => kids.appendChild(npMakeNode(d.path, d.name)));
11108 }}
11109

11116     container.appendChild(e);

11118 }}

11143 function escHtml(s) {{ const d = document.createElement('div'); d.textContent = s == null ? '' : s; return d.innerHTML; }}

11189 async function _npCreateInPopup(body) {{
11190     const headers = {{'Content-Type': 'application/json'}};

11196     catch (e) {{ npSay('That did not go through \u2014 nothing was created (' + e.message + ').', true); return; }}
11197     // the result is SAID inside this dialog (the page's toast is hidden with the rest of the page — Grok R11)
11198     if (!data || !data.ok) {{ npSay('Not created: ' + ((data && (data.error || data.message)) || 'unknown'), true); return; }}

11200     const sentence = data.message || ('Project \u201c' + nm + '\u201d created.');
11201     try {{ if (window.opener) window.opener.postMessage({{ anchor: 'project-created', entry: data.entry || null, message: sentence, group_error: data.group_error || '' }}, location.origin); }} catch (e) {{}}
11202     npSay(sentence, !!data.group_error);
11203     if (data.group_error) return;     // made, not placed: the window stays open on that sentence
11204     setTimeout(function () {{ window.close(); }}, 900);

11228 // ── R&D project lifecycle (rich tiles) ──
11229 // Open the AI cockpit as a DIFFERENT web page. Open one same-origin blank tab,
11230 // sever its opener, then navigate it. Passing `noopener` in the feature string
11231 // can make a successful window.open return null; treating that as "blocked"
11232 // and clicking a fallback link opened TWO cockpits in affected browsers.
11233 function openProjectWindow(pid) {{
11234     if (!pid) return false;
11235     var url = '/project/' + encodeURIComponent(pid) + '?v={BUILD_ID}';
11236     var w = null;
11237     try {{ w = window.open('about:blank', '_blank'); }} catch (e) {{ w = null; }}
11238     if (!w || w === window) {{
11239         showToast('The browser blocked the cockpit page — allow popups and try again');
11240         return false;
11241     }}
11242     try {{
11243         w.opener = null;
11244         w.location.replace(url);
11245         w.focus();
11246         return true;
11247     }} catch (e) {{
11248         try {{ w.close(); }} catch (_ignored) {{}}
11249         showToast('The cockpit page could not be opened');
11250         return false;
11251     }}
11252 }}

11321 // ── v9 Wave 3 — project FOLDERS (group field; collapsible; drag-to-group) ──
11322 // Organization only — NOTHING moves on disk this wave (that's Wave 4). Dragging
11323 // a row into a folder header just sets the project's `group` via set_group.
11324 // (2026-09-01, John) Folders are CLOSED by default; localStorage remembers the
11325 // folders he OPENED (new key — the old "collapsed" set is simply orphaned).
11326 var RND_FOLDER_LS = 'anchor_rnd_folder_open';
11327 function _rndCollapsedSet() {{  // name kept for the callers; it is now the OPEN set
11328     try {{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RND_FOLDER_LS) || '[]') || []; }}
11329     catch (e) {{ return []; }}
11330 }}
11331 function _rndSaveCollapsed(arr) {{
11332     try {{ localStorage.setItem(RND_FOLDER_LS, JSON.stringify(arr || [])); }} catch (e) {{}}
11333 }}
11334 // (2026-09-05, John: "nothing happens") a drop that regroups reloads the page with
11335 // every folder closed by default - remember the DESTINATION folder open first, so
11336 // the moved row is the first thing on screen after the reload.
11337 function _rndOpenFolderNext(group) {{
11338     var g = (group || '').trim();
11339     if (!g) return;
11340     var set = _rndCollapsedSet();
11341     if (set.indexOf(g) < 0) {{ set.push(g); _rndSaveCollapsed(set); }}
11342 }}
11343 // Collapse / expand one folder, persisting the OPEN state by group name.
11344 function rndToggleFolder(headEl) {{
11345     var folder = headEl && headEl.closest ? headEl.closest('.rnd-folder') : null;
11346     if (!folder) return;
11347     var collapsed = folder.classList.toggle('rnd-collapsed');
11348     var tw = folder.querySelector('.rnd-tw');
11349     if (tw) tw.textContent = collapsed ? '\\u25B8' : '\\u25BE';  // ▸ / ▾
11350     var g = folder.getAttribute('data-group') || '';
11351     var set = _rndCollapsedSet();
11352     var i = set.indexOf(g);
11353     if (!collapsed && i < 0) set.push(g);
11354     else if (collapsed && i >= 0) set.splice(i, 1);
11355     _rndSaveCollapsed(set);
11356 }}
11357 // "+ New folder" — name a group and assign the FIRST ungrouped project to it,
11358 // OR (if there is none) create an empty folder by re-rendering a placeholder.
11359 // Simplest persistence model: a folder "exists" once >=1 project carries that
11360 // group. We create it by re-grouping the first ungrouped project; if none are
11361 // ungrouped, we still surface an empty folder via localStorage so the user can
11362 // drag into it (it persists once a project lands there).
11363 var RND_PENDING_FOLDERS = 'anchor_rnd_pending_folders';
11364 function _rndPendingFolders() {{
11365     try {{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RND_PENDING_FOLDERS) || '[]') || []; }}
11366     catch (e) {{ return []; }}
11367 }}
11368 function _rndSavePending(arr) {{
11369     try {{ localStorage.setItem(RND_PENDING_FOLDERS, JSON.stringify(arr || [])); }} catch (e) {{}}
11370 }}
11371 function rndNewFolder() {{
11372     var name = window.prompt('New folder name:', '');
11373     if (name === null) return;
11374     name = (name || '').trim();
11375     if (!name) return;
11376     // Render an empty folder immediately so the user can drag into it. It only
11377     // truly persists once a project is dropped in (set_group), but we keep the
11378     // pending name in localStorage so a reload still shows the empty folder.
11379     var pend = _rndPendingFolders();
11380     if (pend.indexOf(name) < 0) {{ pend.push(name); _rndSavePending(pend); }}
11381     // The home page renders the folder list in two places — create in each.
11382     var lists = document.querySelectorAll('.rnd-folder-list');
11383     for (var i = 0; i < lists.length; i++) _rndEnsureFolderIn(lists[i], name);
11384 }}
11385 // Ensure a folder header with the given group name exists in ONE list (create
11386 // an empty one before that list's Ungrouped folder if absent). Returns the el.
11387 function _rndEnsureFolderIn(list, name) {{
11388     if (!list) return null;
11389     var sel = (window.CSS && CSS.escape) ? CSS.escape(name) : name;
11390     var existing = list.querySelector('.rnd-folder[data-group="' + sel + '"]');
11391     if (existing) return existing;
11392     var folder = document.createElement('div');
11393     folder.className = 'rnd-folder';
11394     folder.setAttribute('data-group', name);
11395     folder.setAttribute('data-ungrouped', '0');
11396     folder.innerHTML =
11397         '<div class="rnd-folder-head" role="button" tabindex="0" '
11398         + 'title="Collapse / expand folder">'
11399         + '<span class="rnd-tw" aria-hidden="true">\u25BE</span>'
11400         + '<span class="rnd-fname"></span>'
11401         + '<span class="rnd-fcount">(0)</span>'
11402         + '<span class="rnd-fsp"></span>'
11403         + '</div><div class="rnd-folder-body"></div>';
11404     folder.querySelector('.rnd-fname').textContent = name;
11405     var head = folder.querySelector('.rnd-folder-head');
11406     head.addEventListener('click', function () {{ rndToggleFolder(head); }});
11407     // Insert before this list's Ungrouped folder so Ungrouped stays last.
11408     var ung = list.querySelector('.rnd-folder[data-ungrouped="1"]');
11409     if (ung) list.insertBefore(folder, ung); else list.appendChild(folder);
11410     _rndWireFolderDrop(folder);
11411     return folder;
11412 }}
11413 // Wire one folder header as a drop target. Dropping a dragged project row here
11414 // calls set_group with this folder's group ("" for the Ungrouped folder).
11415 function _rndWireFolderDrop(folder) {{
11416     var head = folder.querySelector('.rnd-folder-head');
11417     if (!head) return;
11418     head.addEventListener('dragover', function (ev) {{
11419         ev.preventDefault();
11420         if (ev.dataTransfer) ev.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
11421         folder.classList.add('rnd-droptarget');
11422     }});
11423     head.addEventListener('dragleave', function () {{
11424         folder.classList.remove('rnd-droptarget');
11425     }});
11426     head.addEventListener('drop', function (ev) {{
11427         ev.preventDefault();
11428         folder.classList.remove('rnd-droptarget');
11429         var pid = ev.dataTransfer ? ev.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') : '';
11430         if (!pid) return;
11431         var isUng = folder.getAttribute('data-ungrouped') === '1';
11432         var grp = isUng ? '' : (folder.getAttribute('data-group') || '');
11433         // v9 Wave 4 — the Option-C choice. Dropping into the Ungrouped folder
11434         // (remove from a folder) is dashboard-only — just set_group, no dialog.
11435         // Dropping into a NAMED folder asks: "Move on disk + group" (the guarded
11436         // move_project) vs "Just group" (set_group only) vs Cancel.
11437         if (isUng) {{
11438             apiCall('/api/rnd/set_group', {{project_id: pid, group: grp}});
11439         }} else {{
11440             rndMoveDialog(pid, grp, folder);
11441         }}
11442     }});
11443 }}
11444 // ── v9 Wave 4 — the Option-C "move on disk + group" dialog ─────────────────
11445 // On a drop into a NAMED folder, offer: (1) "Move on disk + group" → the guarded
11446 // POST /api/rnd/move_project {{confirm:true}} (refuses the Anchor app + any
11447 // live-session project; atomic + rolls back); (2) "Just group" → the Wave-3
11448 // set_group (dashboard-only, NO disk move); (3) Cancel.
11449 function rndMoveDialog(pid, group, folder) {{
11450     var ov = document.getElementById('rndMoveOverlay');
11451     if (!ov) {{  // dialog markup absent → fall back to the plain group path.
11452         _rndOpenFolderNext(group);
11453         apiCall('/api/rnd/set_group', {{project_id: pid, group: group}});
11454         return;
11455     }}
11456     var pname = '';
11457     var row = document.querySelector('.rnd-row[data-project-id="'
11458         + (window.CSS && CSS.escape ? CSS.escape(pid) : pid) + '"]');
11459     if (row) {{
11460         var n = row.querySelector('.rnd-name');
11461         if (n) pname = n.textContent || '';
11462     }}
11463     var title = document.getElementById('rndMoveTitle');
11464     if (title) title.textContent =
11465         'Move "' + (pname || 'project') + '" into folder "' + group + '"?';
11466     // The exact source→dest paths are resolved server-side (the row deliberately
11467     // carries no on-disk path); show the destination group so the user knows
11468     // what "move on disk" does.
11469     var mono = document.getElementById('rndMovePaths');
11470     if (mono) mono.textContent = 'Destination group: ' + group
11471         + '  →  <projects-root>/' + group + '/<project-dir>';
11472     var go = document.getElementById('rndMoveGo');
11473     var just = document.getElementById('rndMoveJust');
11474     if (go) go.onclick = function () {{ rndMoveConfirm(pid, group, true); }};
11475     if (just) just.onclick = function () {{ rndMoveConfirm(pid, group, false); }};
11476     ov.style.display = 'flex';
11477 }}
11478 function rndMoveCancel() {{
11479     var ov = document.getElementById('rndMoveOverlay');
11480     if (ov) ov.style.display = 'none';
11481 }}
11482 // onDisk=true → the guarded move_project; false → set_group (Wave-3 path). On a
11483 // refusal (Anchor repo / live session) we surface a clear toast (no reload).
11484 function rndMoveConfirm(pid, group, onDisk) {{
11485     rndMoveCancel();
11486     _rndOpenFolderNext(group);
11487     if (!onDisk) {{
11488         apiCall('/api/rnd/set_group', {{project_id: pid, group: group}});
11489         return;
11490     }}
11491     var headers = {{'Content-Type': 'application/json'}};
11492     var tok = (typeof _anchorToken === 'function') ? _anchorToken() : '';
11493     if (tok) headers['X-Anchor-Token'] = tok;
11494     fetch('/api/rnd/move_project', {{
11495         method: 'POST', headers: headers,
11496         body: JSON.stringify({{project_id: pid, group: group, confirm: true}})
11497     }}).then(function (r) {{ return r.json(); }}).then(function (data) {{
11498         if (data && data.ok) {{
11499             showToast('Moved on disk + grouped under "' + group + '"');
11500             setTimeout(function () {{ window.location.reload(); }}, 700);
11501         }} else {{
11502             var reason = (data && data.reason) || (data && data.error) || 'unknown';
11503             var msg;
11504             if (reason === 'refused-anchor-repo')
11505                 msg = "Can't move the running Anchor app (it'd kill the server). Grouped only.";
11506             else if (reason === 'refused-live-sessions')
11507                 msg = 'Refused: this project has a live session — stop it first. Grouped only.';
11508             else
11509                 msg = 'Move refused (' + reason + '). Grouped only.';
11510             showToast(msg);
11511             // The dashboard grouping still applies even when the disk move is
11512             // refused, so the row at least lands under the folder.
11513             apiCall('/api/rnd/set_group', {{project_id: pid, group: group}});
11514         }}
11515     }}).catch(function (e) {{
11516         showToast('Move error: ' + e.message);
11517     }});
11518 }}
11519 // Make project rows draggable and wire every folder as a drop target. Also
11520 // restore the persisted collapse state. The home page renders the folder list
11521 // in TWO places (the dashboard section + the #rndProjectsRows view), so we wire
11522 // EVERY .rnd-folder-list. Runs on DOMContentLoaded + after an in-place refresh.
11523 function rndFolderInit() {{
11524     var lists = document.querySelectorAll('.rnd-folder-list');
11525     for (var L = 0; L < lists.length; L++) {{
11526         var list = lists[L];
11527         if (list.getAttribute('data-rnd-wired') === '1') continue;
11528         list.setAttribute('data-rnd-wired', '1');
11529         // Draggable rows.
11530         var rows = list.querySelectorAll('.rnd-row[draggable="true"]');
11531         for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {{
11532             (function (row) {{
11533                 row.addEventListener('dragstart', function (ev) {{
11534                     var pid = row.getAttribute('data-project-id') || '';
11535                     if (ev.dataTransfer) {{
11536                         ev.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', pid);
11537                         ev.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
11538                     }}
11539                     row.classList.add('rnd-dragging');
11540                 }});
11541                 row.addEventListener('dragend', function () {{
11542                     row.classList.remove('rnd-dragging');
11543                 }});
11544             }})(rows[i]);
11545         }}
11546         // Drop targets + restore OPEN state (default: every folder closed).
11547         var folders = list.querySelectorAll('.rnd-folder');
11548         var opened = _rndCollapsedSet();
11549         for (var j = 0; j < folders.length; j++) {{
11550             _rndWireFolderDrop(folders[j]);
11551             var g = folders[j].getAttribute('data-group') || '';
11552             var isOpen = opened.indexOf(g) >= 0;
11553             folders[j].classList.toggle('rnd-collapsed', !isOpen);
11554             var tw = folders[j].querySelector('.rnd-tw');
11555             if (tw) tw.textContent = isOpen ? '\\u25BE' : '\\u25B8';  // ▾ / ▸
11556         }}
11557         // Re-surface any pending (empty, not-yet-populated) folders from a prior
11558         // "+ New folder" that has no project yet.
11559         var pend = _rndPendingFolders();
11560         for (var k = 0; k < pend.length; k++) {{
11561             if (!list.querySelector('.rnd-folder[data-group="'
11562                 + (window.CSS && CSS.escape ? CSS.escape(pend[k]) : pend[k]) + '"]')) {{
11563                 _rndEnsureFolderIn(list, pend[k]);
11564             }}
11565         }}
11566     }}
11567 }}
11568 window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', rndFolderInit);

11570 // --- Wave 2: File Upload (Dashboard) — multi-file + folder + drag-drop ---
11571 function _anchorReadB64(file) {{

11657 // Recurse a dropped FileSystemEntry, collecting every File with its full
11658 // relative path. readEntries() returns results in batches, so it must be
11659 // called repeatedly until it yields an empty array.
11660 function _anchorWalkEntry(entry, prefix, out) {{
11661   return new Promise(function(resolve) {{
11662     if (entry.isFile) {{
11663       entry.file(function(file) {{
11664         out.push({{ file: file, path: prefix ? (prefix + "/" + entry.name) : entry.name }});
11665         resolve();
11666       }}, function() {{ resolve(); }});
11667     }} else if (entry.isDirectory) {{
11668       var reader = entry.createReader();
11669       var dirPrefix = prefix ? (prefix + "/" + entry.name) : entry.name;
11670       var all = [];
11671       var readBatch = function() {{
11672         reader.readEntries(function(results) {{
11673           if (!results || !results.length) {{
11674             var chain = Promise.resolve();
11675             all.forEach(function(child) {{
11676               chain = chain.then(function() {{ return _anchorWalkEntry(child, dirPrefix, out); }});
11677             }});
11678             chain.then(resolve);
11679           }} else {{
11680             for (var m = 0; m < results.length; m++) all.push(results[m]);
11681             readBatch();
11682           }}
11683         }}, function() {{ resolve(); }});
11684       }};
11685       readBatch();
11686     }} else {{
11687       resolve();
11688     }}
11689   }});
11690 }}

11722       await _anchorWalkEntry(entries[j], "", items);

11876 # ── HTTP Server ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
11877 
11878 # WinError codes for the benign "the client went away" socket conditions.
11879 # 10053 = WSAECONNABORTED (an established connection aborted by the host/software),
11880 # 10054 = WSAECONNRESET (connection reset by peer). These ride in on a generic
11881 # OSError on Windows (BufferedWriter.write → sock.sendall) rather than as the
11882 # typed ConnectionAbortedError / ConnectionResetError, so we sniff .winerror too.
11883 _BENIGN_DISCONNECT_WINERRORS = (10053, 10054)
11884 
11885 
11886 def _is_benign_disconnect(exc):
11887     """True for a socket-teardown error that means the CLIENT closed the
11888     connection mid-response — not a server bug. A browser closing a terminal
11889     tab (or Playwright tearing down a page) makes the in-flight SSE/WS/HTTP
11890     write raise one of these; treating them as a normal client-gone condition
11891     is correct production behavior, never an error to surface or log loudly.
11892 
11893     Catches the typed connection-teardown exceptions AND a Windows OSError whose
11894     ``winerror`` is 10053/10054 (which is how the abort actually arrives on the
11895     BufferedWriter.write → sock.sendall path). Deliberately TIGHT — it never
11896     swallows a generic OSError/Exception that could hide a real defect.
11897     """
11898     if isinstance(exc, (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError,
11899                         ConnectionAbortedError)):
11900         return True
11901     if isinstance(exc, OSError) and getattr(exc, "winerror", None) \
11902             in _BENIGN_DISCONNECT_WINERRORS:
11903         return True
11904     return False
11905

11907 # ── Migrated route handlers (rearch W7 / C2 strangler, first batch) ──────────
11908 # Module-level handler functions the declarative route table dispatches to. Each
11909 # takes ``(handler, path, body)`` — ``handler`` is the live AnchorHandler
11910 # instance (for _send_json/wfile/etc.), ``path`` is the request path, ``body`` is
11911 # the parsed POST body (None for GET). Auth is applied by the strangler BEFORE
11912 # these run, per the route row's declared policy. Moving these out of the
11913 # do_GET/do_POST if/elif chains to module-level functions is the mechanism that
11914 # structurally kills the in-method import-shadowing class (W8 completes it).
11915

11970 # ── Browser auth-cookie login/logout (rearch W9 / C2) ───────────────────────
11971 def _request_presented_token(handler, body):
11972     """The shared-secret token this request carried, or ``None``.
11973 
11974     Mirrors the do_POST middleware's extraction order (X-Anchor-Token header →
11975     standard Authorization header → JSON body ``token``) and additionally
11976     accepts the W9 auth cookie, so the login handler can echo the caller's
11977     already-validated token into the Set-Cookie value.
11978     """
11979     # 2026-10-01 (Grok's independent review, the probe after the restart): a VALID credential wins when the request
11980     # carries one, else the first it carried - the one rule the GET gate and the POST middleware use. Before, the
11981     # first credential seen was answered, so a stale saved token in the header beside the valid pasted token in the
11982     # body (or a valid cookie) made the login handler refuse what the middleware had just accepted.
11983     cands = [handler.headers.get("X-Anchor-Token"),
11984              _paths.token_from_authorization(handler.headers.get("Authorization")),
11985              body.get("token") if isinstance(body, dict) else None,
11986              _paths.token_from_cookie(handler.headers.get("Cookie"))]
11987     cands = [t for t in cands if t]
11988     return next((t for t in cands if _paths.auth_ok(t)), cands[0] if cands else None)
11989

11991 def _local_browser(handler):
11992     """True iff this request came from a browser ON THIS MACHINE: the TCP peer is loopback, no proxy forwarded it
11993     (Tailscale Serve proxies the tailnet in over loopback too, but declares itself with X-Forwarded-* headers), and
11994     the browser asked for the machine's own address. Such a browser is this machine's own user, who holds the token
11995     in the service's registry already (John, 2026-10-01: "this computer has the token set up") - it is not asked to
11996     paste what the machine has."""
11997     try:
11998         addr = getattr(handler, "client_address", None)
11999         peer = str((addr or ("",))[0] or "").lower()
12000         if peer.startswith("::ffff:"):
12001             peer = peer[7:]
12002         if peer not in _own_addresses():
12003             return False      # the request came from another machine (the laptop over the tailnet, a LAN host)
12004         for h in ("X-Forwarded-For", "X-Forwarded-Proto", "X-Forwarded-Host", "Forwarded", "Via"):
12005             if handler.headers.get(h):
12006                 return False      # proxied in (Tailscale Serve connects over loopback and declares itself)
12007         if handler.headers.get("Sec-Fetch-Mode"):
12008             return True       # fetch metadata: only a browser sends it (Chrome sends it only to localhost over plain HTTP)
12009         ua = str(handler.headers.get("User-Agent") or "")
12010         accept = str(handler.headers.get("Accept") or "")
12011         return ("text/html" in accept) and ("Mozilla/" in ua) and ("PowerShell" not in ua) and ("python" not in ua.lower())
12012     except Exception:
12013         return False
12014 
12015 
12016 _OWN_ADDRESSES = None
12017 
12018 
12019 def _own_addresses():
12020     """Every address this machine answers on - loopback and the host's own interfaces - read once; a request whose peer
12021     is one of them came from this machine itself."""
12022     global _OWN_ADDRESSES
12023     if _OWN_ADDRESSES is None:
12024         own = {"127.0.0.1", "::1", "localhost"}
12025         try:
12026             host = socket.gethostname()
12027             for fam in (socket.AF_INET, socket.AF_INET6):
12028                 try:
12029                     for info in socket.getaddrinfo(host, None, fam):
12030                         own.add(str(info[4][0]).split("%")[0].lower())
12031                 except Exception:
12032                     continue
12033         except Exception:
12034             pass
12035         _OWN_ADDRESSES = own
12036     return _OWN_ADDRESSES
12037 
12038 
12039 def _request_is_secure(handler):
12040     """True iff the request reached us over HTTPS (so the cookie gets ``Secure``).
12041 
12042     Tailscale Serve terminates TLS and proxies to the loopback HTTP server,
12043     declaring the original scheme via ``X-Forwarded-Proto``. On the plain-HTTP
12044     ``http://localhost:8777`` loopback the header is absent → ``Secure`` is
12045     omitted so the cookie is still accepted locally.
12046     """
12047     xf = (handler.headers.get("X-Forwarded-Proto") or "").strip().lower()
12048     if xf:
12049         return xf == "https"
12050     return bool(getattr(handler, "_is_tls", False))
12051 
12052 
12053 def _send_json_with_cookie(handler, data, cookie, code=200):
12054     """Send a JSON response carrying ONE ``Set-Cookie`` header (W9 login/logout)."""
12055     payload = json.dumps(data).encode()
12056     try:
12057         handler.send_response(code)
12058         handler.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
12059         handler.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
12060         if cookie is not None:
12061             handler.send_header("Set-Cookie", cookie)
12062         handler.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
12063         handler.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
12064         handler.end_headers()
12065         handler.wfile.write(payload)
12066     except Exception as exc:
12067         if _is_benign_disconnect(exc):
12068             return
12069         raise
12070

12072 def handle_auth_login(handler, path, body):
12073     """POST /api/auth/login — mint the HttpOnly browser auth cookie (rearch W9).
12074 
12075     The do_POST token middleware has ALREADY validated the caller (the row is
12076     ``token``, default-deny), so this only ever runs for an authenticated
12077     request. It Set-Cookies the presented token so subsequent same-origin page
12078     navigation (``/project/``, ``/report/``, ``/summary/``, ``/artifact/``,
12079     ``/api/rnd/projects`` …) and the ``term_ws`` upgrade authenticate off the
12080     cookie — no shared-secret token ever rides in a page URL under
12081     ``ANCHOR_AUTH_MODE=enforce``.
12082     """
12083     want = _paths.expected_token()
12084     if want is None:
12085         # Auth disabled (no ANCHOR_TOKEN) — nothing to gate, no cookie to set.
12086         _send_json_with_cookie(handler, {"ok": True, "auth": "disabled"}, None)
12087         return
12088     token = _request_presented_token(handler, body)
12089     if not _paths.auth_ok(token):
12090         # Belt-and-suspenders: the middleware already enforced this.
12091         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "unauthorized"}, 401)
12092         return
12093     cookie = _paths.build_auth_cookie(token, secure=_request_is_secure(handler))
12094     _send_json_with_cookie(handler, {"ok": True, "auth": "cookie-set"}, cookie)
12095 
12096 
12097 def handle_auth_logout(handler, path, body):
12098     """POST /api/auth/logout — clear the browser auth cookie (rearch W9)."""
12099     cookie = _paths.build_auth_cookie(
12100         None, secure=_request_is_secure(handler), clear=True)
12101     _send_json_with_cookie(
12102         handler, {"ok": True, "auth": "cookie-cleared"}, cookie)
12103

12222 def handle_chain(handler, path, body):

12239                        if chain_id else [])
12240         except Exception:

12242             members = []

12247             safe.append({
12248                 "session_id": r.get("session_id"),

12250                 "label": r.get("label", ""),
12251                 "status": r.get("status", ""),
12252                 "parent_session_id": r.get("parent_session_id", ""),
12253                 "chain_id": r.get("chain_id", ""),
12254                 # v10 Wave 4: grass→project lineage (SAFE — idea id only).
12255                 "grass_origin": r.get("grass_origin", ""),
12256             })
12257         handler._send_json({"ok": True, "chain_id": chain_id or "",
12258                             "members": safe})

12376 def handle_new_project(handler, path, body):
12377     """POST /api/rnd/new_project — register a new/existing R&D project. Token-gated by the middleware."""
12378     mode = body.get("mode", "existing")
12379     name = body.get("name", "")
12380     priority = body.get("priority", 2)
12381     group = str(body.get("group") or "").strip()     # R11 (2026-09-28): the dashboard folder to place it in (read first: the duplicate check places too)
12382     # Same name + same folder, already registered → hand back the EXISTING
12383     # project instead of minting a twin (2026-08-26: a slow first registration
12384     # left the page unreloaded, so a second click produced a duplicate that
12385     # looked exactly like the first). Only an exact match short-circuits;
12386     # deliberate 1-folder:N-projects still works via a different name.
12387     _dup_folder = str(body.get("folder_path", "") or "").strip()
12388     if mode in ("existing", "auto") and _dup_folder and name:
12389         try:
12390             # ACTIVE projects only: group_by_folder includes archived/future/
12391             # RETIRED by default, so matching them would hand back a retired
12392             # entry forever and make re-registering that name impossible.
12393             for _e in _rnd.group_by_folder().get(
12394                     str(Path(_dup_folder).expanduser()), []):
12395                 if _rnd._effective_state(_e) != _rnd.STATE_ACTIVE:
12396                     continue
12397                 if (_e.get("name") or "").strip().lower() == name.strip().lower():
12398                     # R11: a retry with a folder chosen still places the existing project there (Grok R11)
12399                     handler._send_json(_np_place({
12400                         "ok": True, "entry": _e, "already_registered": True,
12401                         "message": f"'{name}' is already registered for that "
12402                                    f"folder — it is on your dashboard "
12403                                    f"already, not created twice.",
12404                     }, group))
12405                     return
12406         except Exception:
12407             pass   # never block a registration on the duplicate check
12408     # (2026-08-07, John — High Seat "+ New project") mode 'auto': one folder
12409     # path decides. Existing folder → brownfield register (discover/adopt +
12410     # first-scan Gandalf fire inside); missing → create it under its parent.
12411     if mode == "auto":
12412         folder = Path(str(body.get("folder_path", ""))).expanduser()
12413         if folder.exists():
12414             res = select_existing_project(name or folder.name, str(folder),
12415                                           priority=priority)
12416             handler._send_json({"ok": True, "path_existed": True, **_np_place(res, group)})
12417         else:
12418             res = create_new_folder_project(
12419                 name or folder.name, str(folder.parent), priority=priority)
12420             handler._send_json({"ok": True, "path_existed": False, **_np_place(res, group)})
12421         return
12422     if mode == "new_folder":
12423         res = create_new_folder_project(
12424             name, body.get("parent_path", ""),
12425             priority=priority,
12426             git_init=bool(body.get("git_init", False)),
12427         )
12428     else:
12429         res = select_existing_project(
12430             name, body.get("folder_path", ""), priority=priority,
12431         )
12432     handler._send_json({"ok": True, **_np_place(res, group)})
12433

12504 def _supervisor_parent_name():
12505     """Name of this process's parent executable (Windows), '' if unknown.
12506 
12507     Used to prove we run UNDER nssm (AppExit=Restart) before /api/restart is
12508     honored — exiting an unsupervised server would just leave it down."""
12509     if os.name != "nt":
12510         return ""
12511     try:
12512         import ctypes
12513         from ctypes import wintypes
12514         k32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
12515         h = k32.OpenProcess(0x1000, False, os.getppid())  # PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION
12516         if not h:
12517             return ""
12518         try:
12519             buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(1024)
12520             n = wintypes.DWORD(1024)
12521             if k32.QueryFullProcessImageNameW(h, 0, buf, ctypes.byref(n)):
12522                 return os.path.basename(buf.value).lower()
12523         finally:
12524             k32.CloseHandle(h)
12525     except Exception:
12526         return ""
12527     return ""
12528 
12529 
12530 def handle_restart(handler, path, body):
12531     """POST /api/restart — restart the SUPERVISED server onto the code on disk.
12532 
12533     Token-authed by the route row. This is NOT the removed /api/shutdown: it
12534     only works when the process runs under nssm (whose AppExit=Restart brings
12535     a fresh server up within seconds), so it can never leave Anchor down. It
12536     exists so a redeploy needs no elevated hands (2026-09-03: an unelevated
12537     session cannot stop the service's process — access denied). Sequence:
12538     answer → run the warm pre-restart drain (best-effort, fail-open, the same
12539     one restart_anchor.ps1 runs) → exit 0 → nssm restarts. Refuses (409) when
12540     unsupervised; ``force`` overrides that for a caller who has its own
12541     supervisor. Answers with the build it is leaving so the caller can poll
12542     /api/version for a different one.
12543     """
12544     parent = _supervisor_parent_name()
12545     supervised = parent.startswith("nssm")
12546     if body.get("drain") or body.get("op"):
12547         # codex-discipline-2026-09-15 Wave 1.6: the drained restart. Same
12548         # endpoint, same auth, same exit path; the barrier only decides WHEN.
12549         from steward_cockpit import maintenance as _mt
12550         from steward_cockpit import steward_routes as _sr
12551         obj, code = _mt.handle_op(
12552             body, busy_engines=_sr._busy_engine_keys, running_jobs=_sr._running_job_ids,
12553             restart=lambda reason: restart_now("maintenance barrier: " + reason),
12554             supervised=supervised)
12555         obj.setdefault("build", BUILD_ID)
12556         handler._send_json(obj, code)
12557         return
12558     if not supervised and not body.get("force"):
12559         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "not_supervised",
12560                             "parent": parent or "unknown", "build": BUILD_ID,
12561                             "message": "Not running under nssm — an exit would leave "
12562                                        "the server down. Restart it by hand."}, 409)
12563         return
12564     handler._send_json({"ok": True, "restarting": True, "leaving_build": BUILD_ID,
12565                         "parent": parent or "unknown"})
12566     threading.Thread(target=restart_now, args=("POST /api/restart",),
12567                      name="anchor-restart", daemon=True).start()
12568

12570 def restart_now(reason="restart"):
12571     """Drain warm and exit so the supervisor brings up the code on disk.
12572     Shared by POST /api/restart and the maintenance barrier
12573     (codex-discipline-2026-09-15 Wave 1.6). Caller has verified supervision."""
12574     time.sleep(0.5)  # let any HTTP response flush
12575     try:
12576         logging.getLogger(__name__).info("restart_now: %s (leaving build %s)", reason, BUILD_ID)
12577     except Exception:
12578         pass
12579     try:
12580         from tools import pre_restart_drain as _drain
12581         _drain.drain(summary_timeout=20)
12582     except Exception:
12583         pass  # fail-open, exactly like restart_anchor.ps1
12584     try:
12585         sys.stdout.flush()
12586     except Exception:
12587         pass
12588     os._exit(0)

12593 
12594     Token-authed by the route row. Returns load_settings() fields plus
12595     ``env`` (export_env_overrides), ``cross_model`` (coding ≠ review family),
12596     plus the host profile and per-role capability matrix.
12597     """

12599     payload = {
12600         "ok": True,
12601         **settings,
12602         "env": _aset.export_env_overrides(),
12603         "cross_model": _aset.families_are_cross_model(),
12604         # Steward persona catalog + the resolved active profile, so the UI can
12605         # render the selector (label + one-line desc + icon pair) without
12606         # hardcoding the persona set client-side.
12607         "stewards": _aset.STEWARDS,

12609         **_model_capability_fields(),

12614 def handle_settings_post(handler, path, body):
12615     """POST /api/settings — merge partial model prefs; return full settings.
12616 
12617     Accepts any of ``default_cli``, ``coding_family``, ``review_family``.
12618     Judge intentionally persists through ``review_family`` and the response's
12619     capability matrix tells the UI which role/provider choices are selectable.
12620     Invalid values → 400. Token-authed by the route row (mutating).
12621     """
12622     body = body or {}
12623     kwargs = {}
12624     for key in ("default_cli", "coding_family", "review_family",
12625                 "steward_type", "expected_revision", "model_policy"):
12626         if key in body and body[key] is not None:
12627             kwargs[key] = body[key]
12628     if not kwargs:
12629         # No-op write: still return the current full settings snapshot.
12630         settings = _aset.load_settings()
12631         handler._send_json({
12632             "ok": True,
12633             **settings,
12634             "env": _aset.export_env_overrides(),
12635             "cross_model": _aset.families_are_cross_model(),
12636             **_model_capability_fields(),
12637         })
12638         return
12639     try:
12640         settings = _aset.save_settings(**kwargs)
12641     except _aset.SettingsInvalid as exc:
12642         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, 409)
12643         return
12644     except ValueError as exc:
12645         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, 400)
12646         return
12647     if "steward_type" in kwargs:      # 2026-10-05: the live stewards take the new persona's name too
12648         try:
12649             from steward_cockpit import steward_routes as _sr
12650             _sr.rename_stewards(_steward_ui().get("label"))
12651         except Exception as _e:
12652             print("  [%s] persona rename of live stewards failed: %r" % (datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S"), _e))
12653     handler._send_json({
12654         "ok": True,
12655         **settings,
12656         "env": _aset.export_env_overrides(),
12657         "cross_model": _aset.families_are_cross_model(),
12658         **_model_capability_fields(),
12659     })

12854 def _ecgberht_bridge(args, timeout=20):
12855     """Spawn the Ecgberht seal-chamber bridge (Node, read-only) and parse its
12856     one-line JSON. Same closed verb bodies as the ecgberht CLI (parity)."""
12857     import subprocess
12858     root = _ecgberht_root()
12859     bridge = root / "scripts" / "seal-chamber-bridge.mjs"
12860     if not bridge.exists():
12861         return {"ok": False, "error": "ecgberht_engine_missing",
12862                 "message": "seal-chamber bridge not found (set ECGBERHT_ROOT "
12863                            "or keep Ecgberht checkout beside Anchor)"}
12864     try:
12865         res = subprocess.run(
12866             ["node", str(bridge)] + list(args),
12867             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout,
12868             # Node emits UTF-8; without this Windows decodes cp1252 and
12869             # the steward's dialogue (em-dashes, curly quotes, flags)
12870             # turns to mojibake in the chamber/overlay.
12871             encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
12872             cwd=str(root), creationflags=_paths.NO_WINDOW)
12873     except Exception as exc:
12874         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_spawn_failed",
12875                 "message": str(exc)}
12876     out = (res.stdout or "").strip()
12877     if not out:
12878         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_no_output",
12879                 "message": (res.stderr or "").strip()[:500]}
12880     try:
12881         return json.loads(out.splitlines()[-1])
12882     except Exception:
12883         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_bad_json",
12884                 "message": out[:500]}
