12887 def render_chamber_lock_document(project_id: str) -> str:
12888     """The tokenless face of a chamber. No transcript, no goal, no steps, no
12889     folder path — a lock, a one-line explanation, and the self-bounce: if the
12890     browser holds the Anchor token, it reloads with it immediately, so an
12891     authorized person never reads this page."""
12892     pid_js = json.dumps(project_id)
12893     return (
12894         "<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'>"
12895         "<meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0'>"
12896         "<title>token-locked</title>"
12897         "<style>body{background:#0f1117;color:#e2e4e9;font-family:system-ui,"
12898         "'Segoe UI',sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;"
12899         "justify-content:center;height:100vh;margin:0}"
12900         ".lock{max-width:44ch;text-align:center}"
12901         ".lock h1{font-size:17px;margin:0 0 8px}"
12902         ".lock p{font-size:13px;color:#8b8f9a;margin:0 0 16px}"
12903         ".lock button{font-size:12px;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:7px;"
12904         "border:1px solid #c9a227;background:#232733;color:#c9a227;"
12905         "cursor:pointer}</style></head><body>"
12906         "<div class='lock'><h1>&#128274; This chamber is token-locked</h1>"
12907         "<p>The steward conversation is private. Set the Anchor access token "
12908         "and the page opens.</p>"
12909         "<button onclick='setTok()'>Set the token</button></div>"
12910         "<script>var PID=" + pid_js + ";"
12911         # preserve the existing query (e.g. ?cockpit=1) across the bounce -
12912         # rebuilding a bare /project/<id>?token= dropped it and always landed
12913         # on the chamber, never the cockpit
12914         "function go(t){var q=location.search.replace(/[?&]token=[^&]*/,'');"
12915         "if(q&&q[0]!=='?')q='?'+q;"
12916         "location.replace(location.pathname+q+(q?'&':'?')"
12917         "+'token='+encodeURIComponent(t));}"
12918         "function setTok(){var t=prompt('Anchor access token:');"
12919         "if(t===null)return;try{localStorage.setItem('anchor_token',"
12920         "t.trim());}catch(e){}go(t.trim());}"
12921         "try{var t0=localStorage.getItem('anchor_token');"
12922         "if(t0){go(t0);}}catch(e){}</script>"
12923         "</body></html>")
12924

12926 def render_chamber_page_document(project_id: str) -> str:
12927     """GET /project/<id> — THE STEWARD CHAMBER AS THE PAGE (2026-08-15, John).
12928 
12929     A whole document, not a tile in the cockpit. Measured on his screen, the
12930     cockpit gave him 446px of conversation out of 1000; this gives ~848 by
12931     spending 68px on chrome instead of 762.
12932 
12933     Deterministic-first, exactly like ``seal_open``: the entire page is
12934     rendered from the sidecar projections + the raw ledger tail + the
12935     conversation log. ZERO model calls, ZERO child processes, ZERO writes on
12936     the open path. It loads ONE stylesheet and ONE script — never the
12937     cockpit's 8,000-line bundle, because dead code sharing a document with
12938     live code is precisely what deleted the M1 chamber for twelve waves.
12939     """
12940     import chamber_page
12941     import chamber_rail
12942     proj = _rnd.get_project(project_id) or {}
12943     folder = (proj.get("folder_path") or "").strip()
12944     stw = _steward_ui()
12945     _eff = {"active": "campaign"}
12946     steward = {"label": stw.get("label") or "Ecgberht",
12947                "glyph": stw.get("glyph") or "\U0001f9ff",
12948                "seal_src": _steward_seal_icon_src(),
12949                "seat": "claude"}
12950     try:
12951         import chamber_open as _copen
12952         view = chamber_rail.seal_rail_view(folder, project_id=project_id)
12953         # Elapsed time is a RENDER-time fact, never part of the deterministic
12954         # open view — four stat() calls, no spawn, no write.
12955         _proj = dict(proj)
12956         # The stamp is the running server's build — the answer to "did my
12957         # restart take?" without anyone having to guess.
12958         _proj["build"] = "build %s" % BUILD_ID
12959         # Multi-seal: the strip's tiles + the ACTIVE seal's thread. A
12960         # non-campaign seal paints its own dialogue; the campaign paints the
12961         # engine's log exactly as before.
12962         import chamber_efforts as _ceff
12963         _eff = _ceff.load_efforts(folder)
12964         if _eff.get("active") and _eff["active"] != _ceff.CAMPAIGN_ID:
12965             view["dialogue"] = _ceff.read_dialogue(folder, _eff["active"])
12966         body = chamber_page.render_chamber_page_html(
12967             view, steward=steward, project=_proj,
12968             freshness=_copen.campaign_freshness(folder),
12969             efforts=_eff)
12970     except Exception as exc:
12971         # Honest failure, never a blank page — and the cockpit (the default
12972         # page since the 2026-08-25 cutover) is one click away so a broken
12973         # chamber can never strand him. (?classic=1 would loop back HERE.)
12974         body = (
12975             "<div class='cpage'><div class='cfail'>"
12976             "<h4>The chamber could not open.</h4>"
12977             "<p>%s</p>"
12978             "<a class='cbtn' href='/project/%s'>Open the cockpit</a> "
12979             "<a class='cbtn' href='/'>Back to the High Seat</a>"
12980             "</div></div>"
12981             % (html_lib.escape(str(exc)), html_lib.escape(project_id, quote=True)))
12982     return (
12983         "<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'>"
12984         "<meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0'>"
12985         "<title>%s — %s</title>"
12986         "<link rel='stylesheet' href='/static/chamber-page.css?v=%s'>"
12987         # The workbench terminal needs xterm; it is vendored, not remote.
12988         "<link rel='stylesheet' href='%s/xterm.css'>"
12989         "</head><body>%s"
12990         "<script>window.ANCHOR_PROJECT_ID=%s;window.ANCHOR_STEWARD_NAME=%s;"
12991         "window.ANCHOR_BUILD=%s;window.ANCHOR_EFFORT=%s;</script>"
12992         "<script src='%s/xterm.js'></script>"
12993         "<script src='/static/chamber-page.js?v=%s'></script>"
12994         # (2026-08-25 cutover) The chamber is now the ESCAPE HATCH behind
12995         # ?classic=1; the beta link that used to live here is gone — the
12996         # cockpit answers the plain /project/<id> URL.
12997         "</body></html>"
12998     ) % (html_lib.escape(proj.get("name") or "project"),
12999          html_lib.escape(steward["label"]),
13000          static_asset_version("chamber-page.css"),
13001          XTERM_URL_PREFIX,
13002          body,
13003          json.dumps(project_id), json.dumps(steward["label"]),
13004          json.dumps(BUILD_ID),
13005          json.dumps(_eff.get("active") or "campaign"),
13006          XTERM_URL_PREFIX,
13007          static_asset_version("chamber-page.js"))

13010 def _ecgberht_project_folder(pid):
13011     """project_id -> (folder, error_json, status). Same validation as boneyard."""
13012     if not pid:
13013         return None, {"ok": False, "error": "project_id required"}, 400
13014     if _unsafe_path_seg(pid):
13015         return None, {"ok": False, "error": "bad pid"}, 400
13016     proj = _rnd.get_project(pid)
13017     if proj is None:
13018         return None, {"ok": False, "error": "Unknown project"}, 404
13019     folder = (proj.get("folder_path") or "").strip()
13020     if not folder:
13021         # A registry row with a blank folder_path would otherwise reach the
13022         # bridge as `--project ""`, which spawns Node to work on nothing.
13023         return None, {"ok": False, "error": "project_has_no_folder",
13024                       "message": "the project record carries no folder_path"}, 409
13025     return folder, None, 200

13028 def handle_ecgberht_chamber(handler, path, body):

13245 def handle_ecgberht_deliverable_action(handler, path, body):
13246     """POST /api/ecgberht/deliverable_action — invoke THE registry action
13247     for the project's declared deliverable (steward-chamber W9, C10 — F3).
13248 
13249     The ONE chamber execution path, F3-bounded end to end: the action is
13250     re-resolved server-side from the validated manifest at invoke time
13251     (never trusted from the client — the request carries only the project
13252     id), so the spawn — when one is armed at all — is ``shell:false`` with a
13253     LIST argv built from the CODE-OWNED verb allow-list's fixed prefix plus
13254     the symlink/junction-resolved CONTAINED output path, cwd pinned to the
13255     project folder. Anything else — unknown type, disallowed verb, hostile
13256     path content, an uncontained resolution, not-landed — answers the
13257     LABELED inert state with its NAMED reason and executes NOTHING (409).
13258     An armed ``open-report`` action answers its internal href and spawns
13259     nothing. Token-authed + F6 (POST-only mutator; row in
13260     chamber/routes-inventory.json; red-to-green in
13261     tests/test_chamber_close_ci_w9.py).
13262     """
13263     pid = str(body.get("project_id", "") or "").strip()
13264     folder, err, status = _ecgberht_project_folder(pid)
13265     if err is not None:
13266         handler._send_json(err, status)
13267         return
13268     import chamber_deliverable
13269     try:
13270         action = chamber_deliverable.action_for_project(folder, project_id=pid)
13271         result = chamber_deliverable.invoke_action(action)
13272     except Exception as exc:  # honest failure — never a guess, never a spawn
13273         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "deliverable_action_failed",
13274                             "message": str(exc)}, 500)
13275         return
13276     if not result.get("ok"):
13277         # The labeled inert state: named reason + user-visible label,
13278         # nothing executed. 409 — the affordance is honestly not armed.
13279         result.setdefault("error", "deliverable_action_inert")
13280         handler._send_json(result, 409)
13281         return
13282     handler._send_json(result, 200)

13353 def handle_ecgberht_sweep_bind(handler, path, body):
13354     """POST /api/ecgberht/sweep_bind — run the two-tier containment-checked
13355     worktree sweep for a died/quiet/timeout run and BIND its card into the
13356     decision-gate queue (steward-chamber W10, C5/E2/F4).
13357 
13358     The state-machine transition that releases the E2 enqueue gate: tier 1
13359     lands declared-deliverable-glob matches onto the step, tier 2 lists the
13360     worktree's unclaimed changes BY PATH ONLY (symlink- and
13361     junction-resolved containment both directions; nothing is executed),
13362     and the card takes the queue HEAD — a held gate is re-queued behind it,
13363     never dropped. Campaign state auto-commits after the bind (V3 landing
13364     class: sweep landing). Token-authed + F6; row in
13365     chamber/routes-inventory.json; red-to-green in
13366     tests/test_chamber_gate_routes_w10.py."""
13367     b = body or {}
13368     pid = str(b.get("project_id", "") or "").strip()
13369     folder, err, status = _ecgberht_project_folder(pid)
13370     if err is not None:
13371         handler._send_json(err, status)
13372         return
13373     sid = str(b.get("session_id", "") or "").strip()
13374     if not sid:
13375         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "session_id required"}, 400)
13376         return
13377     import chamber_gates
13378     import commission_session as _cs
13379     record = _cs.load_run_record(folder, sid)
13380     if record is None:
13381         # An honest sweep still binds for a record that vanished: the death
13382         # row is what blocks E2, and only a bound card may release it.
13383         record = {"session_id": sid}
13384     try:
13385         swept = chamber_gates.run_sweep(folder, record)
13386         out = chamber_gates.bind_sweep_card(folder, swept, session_id=sid)
13387     except Exception as exc:  # honest failure — never a half-bound queue
13388         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "sweep_bind_failed",
13389                             "message": str(exc)}, 500)
13390         return
13391     out["sweep"] = (swept.get("sweep") if isinstance(swept, dict) else None)
13392     handler._send_json(out, 200 if out.get("ok") else 409)

13468 def handle_ecgberht_rebrief(handler, path, body):
13469     """POST /api/ecgberht/rebrief — mid-flight RE-BRIEF of the running
13470     commission in the audited LIVE mode (steward-chamber W11, C7 — E7).
13471 
13472     ``{project_id, session_id, text, step_id?}`` delivers ONE paced write
13473     onto the LIVE session's stdin (the wired paced-PTY channel — never a
13474     relaunch) and mints the acknowledgment receipt on the step. During an
13475     active sweep the re-brief is REFUSED-AND-QUEUED behind the sweep's
13476     card binding with the named finding (409) — never interleaved. A
13477     dead/unknown session answers the honest named refusal (409).
13478     Token-authed + F6 (POST-only mutator; row in
13479     chamber/routes-inventory.json; red-to-green in
13480     tests/test_chamber_refine_routes_w11.py)."""
13481     b = body or {}
13482     pid = str(b.get("project_id", "") or "").strip()
13483     folder, err, status = _ecgberht_project_folder(pid)
13484     if err is not None:
13485         handler._send_json(err, status)
13486         return
13487     sid = str(b.get("session_id", "") or "").strip()
13488     if not sid:
13489         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "session_id required"}, 400)
13490         return
13491     import chamber_rebrief
13492     out = chamber_rebrief.rebrief(folder, sid, b.get("text"),
13493                                   step_id=b.get("step_id"))
13494     if out.get("ok"):
13495         handler._send_json(out, 200)

13547 # ── Ecgberht High Seat (TW6 — wireframes v2.1 Screens 0+2+3) ──────────────
13548 # Portfolio altitude on the live-Anchor MAIN dashboard. Same engine-bridge
13549 # pattern as the TW5 Seal chamber, spawning scripts/high-seat-bridge.mjs.
13550 # Read-compose only; the only writes the bridge can produce are structured
13551 # receipts (override / seen) and single-writer Roadmap appends (decide).
13552 
13553 def _ecgberht_hs_bridge(args, timeout=30):
13554     """Spawn the Ecgberht high-seat bridge (Node) and parse its one-line JSON.
13555     Same closed surfaces as `ecgberht status --roots …` (CLI parity)."""
13556     import subprocess
13557     root = _ecgberht_root()
13558     bridge = root / "scripts" / "high-seat-bridge.mjs"
13559     if not bridge.exists():
13560         return {"ok": False, "error": "ecgberht_engine_missing",
13561                 "message": "high-seat bridge not found (set ECGBERHT_ROOT "
13562                            "or keep Ecgberht checkout beside Anchor)"}
13563     try:
13564         res = subprocess.run(
13565             ["node", str(bridge)] + list(args),
13566             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout,
13567             # Node emits UTF-8; without this Windows decodes cp1252 and
13568             # the steward's dialogue (em-dashes, curly quotes, flags)
13569             # turns to mojibake in the chamber/overlay.
13570             encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
13571             cwd=str(root), creationflags=_paths.NO_WINDOW)
13572     except Exception as exc:
13573         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_spawn_failed",
13574                 "message": str(exc)}
13575     out = (res.stdout or "").strip()
13576     if not out:
13577         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_no_output",
13578                 "message": (res.stderr or "").strip()[:500]}
13579     try:
13580         return json.loads(out.splitlines()[-1])
13581     except Exception:
13582         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_bad_json",
13583                 "message": out[:500]}
13584 
13585 
13586 def _ecgberht_steward_cli(args, timeout=30):
13587     """Spawn the Ecgberht STEWARD PORTFOLIO CLI (`bin/steward.mjs`) and parse JSON.
13588 
13589     A SECOND closed surface, separate from the fifteen per-project talk verbs the
13590     seal-chamber bridge speaks. Anchor needs exactly one verb from it — ``register``
13591     — because that is the only path that mints a project marker, a minted
13592     (dashed-UUID) project_id is the only thing the engine will index, and the index
13593     is what the High Seat reads. Anchor's own project ids are 32-hex WITHOUT dashes
13594     and deliberately never cross this boundary as an identity.
13595     """
13596     import subprocess
13597     root = _ecgberht_root()
13598     cli = root / "bin" / "steward.mjs"
13599     if not cli.exists():
13600         return {"ok": False, "error": "ecgberht_engine_missing",
13601                 "message": "steward CLI not found (set ECGBERHT_ROOT or keep the "
13602                            "Ecgberht checkout beside Anchor)"}
13603     try:
13604         res = subprocess.run(
13605             ["node", str(cli)] + list(args),
13606             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout,
13607             encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
13608             cwd=str(root), creationflags=_paths.NO_WINDOW)
13609     except Exception as exc:
13610         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_spawn_failed", "message": str(exc)}
13611     out = (res.stdout or "").strip()
13612     if not out:
13613         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_no_output",
13614                 "message": (res.stderr or "").strip()[:500]}
13615     try:
13616         return json.loads(out) if out.startswith("{") else json.loads(out.splitlines()[-1])
13617     except Exception:
13618         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_bad_json", "message": out[:500]}

13652 def handle_ecgberht_scaffold_confirm(handler, path, body):
13653     """POST /api/ecgberht/scaffold_confirm — write the confirmed stages.
13654 
13655     The ONE write on this path: opens the session envelope, proposes through the
13656     spine, then batch-confirms, so the steps land in roadmap_events via the single
13657     writer. Carries ``who`` because a confirmation is a human decision.
13658     """
13659     b = body or {}
13660     pid = (b.get("project_id") or "").strip()
13661     folder, err, status = _ecgberht_project_folder(pid)
13662     if err is not None:
13663         handler._send_json(err, status)
13664         return
13665     text = (b.get("text") or b.get("description") or "").strip()
13666     stages = b.get("stages")
13667     # THE CONVERSATIONAL PATH confirms by PROPOSAL HASH: the proposal is already a
13668     # typed scaffold_proposal on the ledger, and binding to its hash is what makes
13669     # "what gets written is exactly what you reviewed" true. Without this the browser
13670     # sent a hash, the host dropped it, and the confirm 400'd as "Nothing to confirm".
13671     proposal_hash = (b.get("proposal_hash") or "").strip()
13672     if not text and not stages and not proposal_hash:
13673         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "empty_scaffold",
13674                             "message": "Nothing to confirm."}, 400)
13675         return
13676     if text and _ecgberht_reject_oversized(handler, text):
13677         return
13678     fields = {
13679         "project_path": folder,
13680         "goal": b.get("goal"),
13681         "description": text or None,
13682         "stages": stages or None,
13683         "who": b.get("who") or "john",
13684     }
13685     if proposal_hash:
13686         fields["proposal_hash"] = proposal_hash
13687         if (b.get("proposal_id") or "").strip():
13688             fields["proposal_id"] = b["proposal_id"].strip()
13689     if b.get("client_event_id"):
13690         fields["client_event_id"] = b["client_event_id"]
13691     out = _ecgberht_bridge(["--project", folder,
13692                             "--scaffold-confirm", json.dumps(fields)])
13693     # (2026-08-06) Plan approval banks the campaign: John's standing rule is
13694     # commit-as-we-go, and both his first real campaigns sat untracked for a
13695     # day. Best-effort — a git hiccup never breaks the confirm he just made.
13696     if out.get("ok"):
13697         try:
13698             import commission_session as _cs
13699             out["campaign_commit"] = _cs.commit_campaign_state(
13700                 folder, "roadmap confirmed")
13701         except Exception:
13702             pass
13703     handler._send_json(out, 200 if out.get("ok") else 502)

13706 def handle_ecgberht_converse(handler, path, body):
13707     """POST /api/ecgberht/converse — TALK to the steward (2026-08-04).
13708 
13709     The chamber used to compile free-form speech through a closed ELEVEN-act table,
13710     so describing or refining a project dead-ended on "could not compile that to a
13711     closed act". This is the conversational door: routing happens in the ENGINE
13712     (control verbs still compile deterministically; only genuine talk reaches the
13713     seat), and the reply is a conversational answer plus, when there is enough to be
13714     useful, a typed proposal for review.
13715 
13716     ``turns`` carries the EPHEMERAL conversation so far — the browser page holds it,
13717     it is replayed for continuity, and it is never persisted anywhere. The durable
13718     continuity comes from the open scaffold_proposal on the ledger.
13719 
13720     Nothing is written here; confirming stays a separate explicit act.
13721 
13722     TIMEOUT: a real seat call is slow — measured 60-162s end-to-end on this host —
13723     so this path gets its own generous bound. The default 20s would kill every turn.
13724     """
13725     b = body or {}
13726     pid = (b.get("project_id") or "").strip()
13727     text = (b.get("text") or "").strip()
13728     folder, err, status = _ecgberht_project_folder(pid)
13729     if err is not None:
13730         handler._send_json(err, status)
13731         return
13732     if not text:
13733         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "empty_text",
13734                             "message": "Say something and the steward will answer."}, 400)
13735         return
13736     if _ecgberht_reject_oversized(handler, text):
13737         return
13738     args = ["--project", folder, "--converse", text]
13739     # steward-e1 W2 (E1): the turn-completion hook's bound payload rides the
13740     # W2-proven converse seam — the deterministic question ids + the F7
13741     # ratification state, computed by the committed Anchor owner
13742     # (chamber_e1_hook / chamber_e1_bound), never re-derived by the engine.
13743     args.extend(["--e1", json.dumps(_e1_bound_payload(text))])
13744     packed = _ecgberht_pack_turns(b.get("turns"))
13745     if packed:
13746         args.extend(["--turns", json.dumps(packed)])
13747     if (b.get("who") or "").strip():
13748         args.extend(["--who", (b.get("who") or "").strip()])
13749     out = _ecgberht_bridge(args, timeout=ECGBERHT_CONVERSE_TIMEOUT_S)
13750     out = _e1_enforce_turn_close(text, out)
13751     # (2026-08-15) Multi-seal: a non-campaign effort keeps its OWN painted
13752     # thread. The engine's global log still records everything (the audit
13753     # trail); this only decides what that seal shows. Best-effort — a thread
13754     # write must never break a turn John paid for.
13755     eid = (b.get("effort_id") or "").strip()
13756     if out.get("ok") and eid:
13757         try:
13758             import chamber_efforts as _ce
13759             reply_text = ((out.get("blocked") or {}).get("held_say")
13760                           if out.get("turn_blocked") else out.get("say"))
13761             turns = [{"role": "john", "text": text}]
13762             if reply_text:
13763                 turns.append({"role": "steward", "text": reply_text})
13764             _ce.append_dialogue(folder, eid, turns)
13765         except Exception:
13766             pass
13767     handler._send_json(out, 200 if out.get("ok") else 502)

13770 def _e1_bound_payload(utterance):
13771     """The ``--e1`` payload for one steward turn (steward-e1 W2). A hook
13772     failure NEVER silently disarms enforcement: the fallback payload fails
13773     CLOSED by name (E1-F7-ARTIFACT-MISSING), never permissive."""
13774     try:
13775         import chamber_e1_hook as _e1h
13776         return _e1h.bound_payload_for_turn(utterance)
13777     except Exception as exc:
13778         return {"schema_version": 1, "enforceable": False,
13779                 "finding": "E1-F7-ARTIFACT-MISSING",
13780                 "reason": "the bound payload could not be computed (%s) — "
13781                           "fail closed by name, never silently open" % exc}
13782 
13783 
13784 def _e1_enforce_turn_close(utterance, out):
13785     """The BRIDGE-BOUNDARY leg of the E1 seam (steward-e1 W2): re-evaluate
13786     the returned turn and block a close the engine leg let through. A hook
13787     error attaches a NAMED unenforceable verdict — loud, never silent."""
13788     try:
13789         import chamber_e1_hook as _e1h
13790         return _e1h.enforce_bridge_result(utterance, out)
13791     except Exception as exc:
13792         if isinstance(out, dict) and out.get("lane") == "converse":
13793             out.setdefault("turn_close", {
13794                 "decision": "unenforceable", "enforced": False,
13795                 "finding": "E1-F7-ARTIFACT-MISSING",
13796                 "reason": "the turn-completion hook errored at the bridge "
13797                           "boundary (%s) — named, never silently open"
13798                           % exc,
13799                 "unanswered": [], "answered": []})
13800         return out

13806 def handle_ecgberht_high_seat_say(handler, path, body):
13807     """POST /api/ecgberht/high_seat_say — TALK to the steward at portfolio
13808     level (2026-08-07, John: "I don't want to click a new project button —
13809     I want to just talk to it").
13810 
13811     Routes the utterance through the __dashboard__ project's steward (its
13812     campaign IS running Anchor, and it carries the auto-opened envelope) with
13813     the PORTFOLIO: prefix the talk instruction knows. A spoken "start a
13814     project" comes back as the typed project_create act — the High Seat
13815     renders the confirm card; nothing is created until John clicks it.
13816     """
13817     b = body or {}
13818     text = (b.get("text") or "").strip()
13819     if not text:
13820         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "empty_text",
13821                             "message": "Say something and the steward will answer."}, 400)
13822         return
13823     if _ecgberht_reject_oversized(handler, text):
13824         return
13825     # W2c-2 (2026-09-30): a page with a dialogue says it engages the steward itself — anything but the new-project ask
13826     # is answered 'talk' at once (no grammar compile, no model call here; Grok's read of W2c-2): the page says it to
13827     # the Campaign's steward, whose say route applies a Campaign verb first and shows the exchange for the rest. The
13828     # new-project ask keeps the dashboard steward's confirm card (R11).
13829     if b.get("verbs_only") and not _NEW_PROJECT_ASK.search(text):
13830         handler._send_json({"ok": True, "talk": True}, 200)
13831         return
13832     # W5 (High Seat, 2026-09-26): a Campaign verb typed on the home is applied on the Campaign record by its own
13833     # writer (the engine names the act; nothing is sent to a model); anything else talks to the dashboard steward
13834     from steward_cockpit.campaign_say import say_campaign
13835     _cd = _campaign_dir()
13836     if (_cd / "roadmap.json").is_file():
13837         spoken = say_campaign(str(_cd), text)      # a refusal on a failed compile or a writer error; None = not a verb
13838         if spoken is not None:
13839             handler._send_json(spoken, 200 if spoken.get("ok") else 400)
13840             return
13841     folder, err, status = _ecgberht_project_folder("__dashboard__")
13842     if err is not None:
13843         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "no_dashboard_steward",
13844                             "message": "The dashboard steward is not set up — "
13845                                        "open a project's Seal instead."}, 502)
13846         return
13847     args = ["--project", folder, "--converse", "PORTFOLIO: " + text]
13848     # steward-e1 W2 (E1): the High Seat talks through the SAME converse seam,
13849     # so the same turn-completion hook rides it — computed over the exact
13850     # utterance the engine sees (the PORTFOLIO-prefixed text).
13851     args.extend(["--e1", json.dumps(_e1_bound_payload("PORTFOLIO: " + text))])
13852     packed = _ecgberht_pack_turns(b.get("turns"))
13853     if packed:
13854         args.extend(["--turns", json.dumps(packed)])
13855     out = _ecgberht_bridge(args, timeout=ECGBERHT_CONVERSE_TIMEOUT_S)
13856     out = _e1_enforce_turn_close("PORTFOLIO: " + text, out)
13857     handler._send_json(out, 200 if out.get("ok") else 502)

13953 def handle_ecgberht_commission_go(handler, path, body):
13954     """POST /api/ecgberht/commission_go — John said go.
13955 
13956     Hash-confirm through the engine, launch the managed session (lean
13957     worktree, skill loaded, brief seeded), start the watcher. Returns at once
13958     with the session id; the raise arrives when the skill needs John.
13959     """
13960     import commission_session as _cs

13962     pid = (b.get("project_id") or "").strip()

14153 def handle_ecgberht_register_projects(handler, path, body):
14154     """POST /api/ecgberht/register_projects — join active projects to the portfolio.
14155 
14156     An EXPLICIT human act, never automatic. Registering writes a steward marker
14157     into each project root, and the portfolio altitude's contract is that it folds
14158     projections READ-ONLY and never writes to a project store — so this cannot ride
14159     a read path (that is precisely why it is a POST with a confirm, not a lazy
14160     side effect of rendering the High Seat).
14161 
14162     Idempotent for the caller: a root already marked answers ``already_registered``
14163     with the SAME project id and is counted as registered, not as an error.
14164     """
14165     roots, skipped, failed = _ecgberht_portfolio_roots()
14166     if failed:
14167         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "registry_unreadable",
14168                             "message": "could not read the project registry; "
14169                                        "the portfolio is unknown, not empty"}, 502)
14170         return
14171 
14172     only = (body or {}).get("root")
14173     if only:
14174         roots = [r for r in roots if str(r) == str(only)]
14175         if not roots:
14176             handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "unknown_root",
14177                                 "message": "that project is not an active R&D root"}, 404)
14178             return
14179 
14180     if not roots:
14181         handler._send_json({"ok": True, "registered": 0, "already": 0, "failed": 0,
14182                             "results": [], "skipped_roots": skipped,
14183                             "message": "No active projects to register."}, 200)
14184         return
14185 
14186     results, n_new, n_old, n_bad = [], 0, 0, 0
14187     for r in roots:
14188         out = _ecgberht_steward_cli(["register", "--root", str(r)])
14189         ok = bool(out.get("ok"))
14190         already = bool(out.get("already_registered"))
14191         if ok and already:
14192             n_old += 1
14193         elif ok:
14194             n_new += 1
14195         else:
14196             n_bad += 1
14197         results.append({"root": str(r), "ok": ok, "already_registered": already,
14198                         "project_id": out.get("project_id"),
14199                         "code": out.get("code") or out.get("error"),
14200                         "message": (out.get("message") or out.get("text") or "")[:300]})
14201 
14202     handler._send_json({"ok": n_bad == 0, "registered": n_new, "already": n_old,
14203                         "failed": n_bad, "results": results,
14204                         "skipped_roots": skipped,
14205                         "message": "%d newly registered, %d already in the portfolio%s."
14206                                    % (n_new, n_old,
14207                                       ", %d refused" % n_bad if n_bad else "")},
14208                        200 if n_bad == 0 else 207)
14209 
14210 
14211 #: Cap on user text handed to a bridge AS A COMMAND-LINE ARGUMENT. This is not
14212 #: the PTY path: ``rnd_terminal.MAX_TURN_CHARS`` (100_000) writes to a child's
14213 #: STDIN, which has no such limit. Here the text becomes argv, and Windows caps
14214 #: the entire command line near 32_767 characters — so an oversized paste does
14215 #: not fail as "too long", it fails as an opaque spawn error that surfaces as
14216 #: `bridge_spawn_failed`. Refuse it honestly, before spawning anything.
14217 _ECGBERHT_MAX_SPOKEN_CHARS = 8_000
14218 
14219 
14220 def _ecgberht_reject_oversized(handler, text):
14221     """True (and a 413 already sent) iff ``text`` is too long to pass as argv."""
14222     if len(text) <= _ECGBERHT_MAX_SPOKEN_CHARS:
14223         return False
14224     handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "text_too_long",
14225                         "message": "%d characters exceeds the %d-character "
14226                                    "limit for a spoken act"
14227                                    % (len(text), _ECGBERHT_MAX_SPOKEN_CHARS),
14228                         "length": len(text),
14229                         "limit": _ECGBERHT_MAX_SPOKEN_CHARS}, 413)
14230     return True
14231 
14232 
14233 #: A real seat call is SLOW — measured 60s (refinement) to 162s (first turn, with
14234 #: read-only grounding) on this host. The shared bridge default of 20s would kill
14235 #: every conversational turn, so the converse path carries its own bound. It stays
14236 #: under the engine's own SEAT_TIMEOUT_MS so the child dies before the parent gives up.
14237 ECGBERHT_CONVERSE_TIMEOUT_S = 240
14238 
14239 #: Ephemeral conversation replayed to the steward for continuity. Bounded by CHARS,
14240 #: not just count: the turns ride as ONE argv value alongside the utterance, and the
14241 #: steward's own replies run to a thousand characters each, so a naive "last N turns"
14242 #: would silently walk into the same Windows command-line ceiling that
14243 #: `_ecgberht_reject_oversized` exists to prevent. Oldest turns are dropped first —
14244 #: the durable continuity is the open scaffold_proposal on the ledger, not this.
14245 ECGBERHT_MAX_EPHEMERAL_TURNS = 12
14246 _ECGBERHT_MAX_TURNS_CHARS = 12_000
14247 
14248 
14249 def _ecgberht_pack_turns(turns):
14250     """Newest-first char-budgeted slice of the ephemeral turns, restored to order."""
14251     if not isinstance(turns, list):
14252         return []
14253     kept, used = [], 0
14254     for turn in reversed(turns[-ECGBERHT_MAX_EPHEMERAL_TURNS:]):
14255         if not isinstance(turn, dict):
14256             continue
14257         text = str(turn.get("text") or "")
14258         if not text.strip():
14259             continue
14260         if used + len(text) > _ECGBERHT_MAX_TURNS_CHARS:
14261             break
14262         kept.append({"role": str(turn.get("role") or "john"), "text": text})
14263         used += len(text)
14264     kept.reverse()
14265     return kept
14266 
14267 
14268 #: The high-seat bridge takes its roots as ONE ``--roots a;b;c`` argument, so a
14269 #: folder path containing a semicolon would be split into two bogus roots. A
14270 #: semicolon is legal in a Windows directory name, so this is filtered, not
14271 #: assumed away.
14272 _ECGBERHT_ROOT_DELIM = ";"
14273 
14274 
14275 def _ecgberht_portfolio_roots():
14276     """Active R&D project folders = the High Seat's discovery roots.
14277 
14278     Returns ``(roots, skipped, failed)``. Registry-derived, never a hardcoded
14279     host path.
14280 
14281     ``failed`` exists because this used to swallow every exception and return
14282     ``[]`` — so a registry read that BLEW UP was reported to the user as the
14283     cheerful "no active R&D project folders to steward". An empty portfolio and
14284     a broken registry are not the same state and must not render the same.
14285 
14286     ``skipped`` carries any root containing the delimiter (see
14287     ``_ECGBERHT_ROOT_DELIM``); including one would silently corrupt the root
14288     list the engine sees, so it is dropped and reported rather than mis-split.
14289     """
14290     roots = []
14291     skipped = []
14292     try:
14293         for entry in _rnd.list_projects(include_archived=False,
14294                                         include_future=False,
14295                                         include_retired=False):
14296             folder = (entry.get("folder_path") or "").strip()
14297             if not folder or folder in roots:
14298                 continue
14299             if _ECGBERHT_ROOT_DELIM in folder:
14300                 skipped.append(folder)
14301                 continue
14302             roots.append(folder)
14303     except Exception:
14304         return [], skipped, True
14305     return roots, skipped, False
14306 
14307 
14308 def handle_ecgberht_high_seat(handler, path, body):
14309     """GET /api/ecgberht/high_seat — Screen 2 view model (raise queue +
14310     tiles + spoken capacity balancing) over the portfolio index.
14311 
14312     Wave 17: semicolon-skipped roots are passed via ``--skipped`` JSON so they
14313     render as named unknown rows (row count never shrinks). The fold answers
14314     from the index; bridge_bad_json maps to GLANCE_INDEX_UNPARSEABLE text.
14315     """
14316     roots, skipped, failed = _ecgberht_portfolio_roots()
14317     if failed:
14318         # A registry read that BLEW UP is not an empty portfolio. Say so.
14319         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "registry_unreadable",
14320                             "message": "could not read the project registry; "
14321                                        "the portfolio is unknown, not empty"}, 502)
14322         return
14323     args = []
14324     if roots:
14325         args.extend(["--roots", _ECGBERHT_ROOT_DELIM.join(roots)])
14326     # Wave 17 delimiter guard: skipped roots cross the boundary as JSON, not
14327     # in the ';'-joined argv (which would mis-split them).
14328     if skipped:
14329         args.extend(["--skipped", json.dumps(skipped)])
14330     if not roots and not skipped:
14331         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "no_projects",
14332                             "code": "GLANCE_PORTFOLIO_EMPTY",
14333                             "message": "No active projects registered.",
14334                             "skipped_roots": skipped}, 200)
14335         return
14336     out = _ecgberht_hs_bridge(args)
14337     if isinstance(out, dict):
14338         if skipped:
14339             out["skipped_roots"] = skipped
14340         # EMPTY IS NOT BROKEN (hardening 2026-08-04). A portfolio index that has
14341         # never been written is a portfolio nobody has JOINED yet — not a damaged
14342         # one. It used to surface as a 502 banner quoting a remedy ("run the index
14343         # audit fix") that was not on any reachable verb surface, which is the
14344         # unknown-vs-empty honesty defect pointed the wrong way round. Report the
14345         # honest empty state, at 200, WITH the action that resolves it.
14346         if out.get("code") == "GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING" or                 out.get("error") == "GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING":
14347             handler._send_json({
14348                 "ok": True,
14349                 "empty": True,
14350                 "code": "GLANCE_NO_PROJECTS_REGISTERED",
14351                 "message": "No projects have joined the portfolio yet — this is "
14352                            "empty, not broken. Register your active projects to "
14353                            "see them here.",
14354                 "can_register": True,
14355                 "register_endpoint": "/api/ecgberht/register_projects",
14356                 "candidate_roots": len(roots),
14357                 "skipped_roots": skipped,
14358             }, 200)
14359             return
14360         # Map bridge garbage into the glance failure surface (never a blank panel).
14361         if out.get("error") == "bridge_bad_json":
14362             out["code"] = "GLANCE_INDEX_UNPARSEABLE"
14363             out["message"] = (
14364                 "Index snapshot or bridge output unreadable — nothing is guessed."
14365             )
14366             out["bridge_bad_json"] = True
14367         _hs_enrich_tiles(out)
14368     handler._send_json(out, 200 if out.get("ok") else 502)
14369

14371 def _hs_pick_entry(entries):
14372     """One folder can host N registered projects (live: BA815 has two). Pick
14373     the one that OWNS the work — the entry whose effort store holds the most
14374     files — so the High Seat click lands on the project id John actually
14375     uses, never an empty sibling registration."""
14376     best, best_score = None, -1
14377     for e in entries:
14378         score = 0
14379         try:
14380             store = Path(e["folder_path"]) / ".anchor" / "projects" / e["id"]
14381             if store.exists():
14382                 for _root, _dirs, files in os.walk(store):
14383                     score += len(files)
14384                     if score > 500:
14385                         break
14386         except Exception:
14387             score = 0
14388         if score > best_score:
14389             best, best_score = e, score
14390     return best
14391 
14392 
14393 def _hs_enrich_tiles(out):
14394     """(2026-08-07, John) The High Seat rows become a real portfolio glance:
14395     each tile gains the ANCHOR project id (path-passport: matched by resolved
14396     folder, never the steward registry id), a happening-NOW line from the
14397     project's commission runs, and its lifetime spend — so "what's going on /
14398     how are we using tokens" is answered on sight. Best-effort, read-only."""
14399     try:
14400         tiles = ((out.get("high_seat") or {}).get("tiles") or {}).get("tiles")
14401         if not tiles:
14402             return
14403         import commission_session as _cs
14404         by_folder = {}
14405         for entry in _rnd.list_projects():
14406             try:
14407                 by_folder.setdefault(
14408                     str(Path(entry["folder_path"]).resolve()), []).append(entry)
14409             except Exception:
14410                 continue
14411         for t in tiles:
14412             p = t.get("project_path")
14413             if not p:
14414                 continue
14415             try:
14416                 entry = _hs_pick_entry(by_folder.get(str(Path(p).resolve())) or [])
14417             except Exception:
14418                 entry = None
14419             if not entry:
14420                 continue
14421             t["anchor_project_id"] = entry["id"]
14422             if entry.get("name"):
14423                 t["display_name"] = entry["name"]
14424             try:
14425                 runs = _cs.list_runs(entry["folder_path"])
14426                 if runs:
14427                     # (2026-08-15, John: "flags — hey, it's time to look at
14428                     # something — pop up to the main dashboard".) This took
14429                     # runs[0], the NEWEST run. A project whose second run is
14430                     # waiting on him while a third runs on read "running now",
14431                     # so the one state he needs to see was the one state the
14432                     # tile could not show. Rank by urgency, not by recency.
14433                     _URGENCY = {"asked": 0, "died": 1, "quiet": 1, "timeout": 1,
14434                                 "running": 2}
14435                     r = min(runs, key=lambda x: _URGENCY.get(
14436                         str(x.get("outcome") or "").lower(), 3))
14437                     outcome = str(r.get("outcome") or "").lower()
14438                     state = {"running": "running now",
14439                              "asked": "waiting on you",
14440                              "died": "stopped — wants a decision",
14441                              "quiet": "went quiet — wants a decision",
14442                              "timeout": "timed out — wants a decision"}.get(
14443                         outcome, f"last run {r.get('outcome')}")
14444                     t["now_line"] = f"{r.get('skill', 'skill')} · {state}"
14445                     t["now_running"] = any(
14446                         str(x.get("outcome") or "").lower() == "running"
14447                         for x in runs)
14448                     # The flag the High Seat can render without re-deriving it,
14449                     # plus where to go when he clicks.
14450                     t["needs_you"] = outcome in ("asked", "died", "quiet", "timeout")
14451                     if t["needs_you"]:
14452                         t["needs_you_reason"] = state
14453                         t["needs_you_session"] = r.get("session_id") or ""
14454                     if len(runs) > 1:
14455                         t["run_count"] = len(runs)
14456                     # A campaign John has actually RUN is active — it renders
14457                     # up front; registered-but-untouched projects collapse
14458                     # (2026-08-07: "just two projects are running right now —
14459                     # it should just have those two tiles").
14460                     t["active_campaign"] = True
14461             except Exception:
14462                 pass
14463             try:
14464                 roll = _eh.project_effort_rollup(entry["id"], window="lifetime")
14465                 cost = (roll or {}).get("cost_usd") or (roll or {}).get("cost")
14466                 if cost:
14467                     t["spend_line"] = "$%.2f lifetime" % float(cost)
14468                 clause = _fmt_steward_usage_clause(
14469                     _project_steward_usage(entry["id"]))
14470                 if clause:
14471                     t["spend_line"] = (
14472                         (t.get("spend_line") + " · " + clause)
14473                         if t.get("spend_line") else clause)
14474             except Exception:
14475                 pass
14476     except Exception:
14477         pass

14480 def handle_ecgberht_high_seat_badge(handler, path, body):
14481     """GET /api/ecgberht/high_seat_badge — ⚑ raise-queue length ONLY.
14482     The single ambient Ecgberht signal anywhere in Anchor (S0-E2).
14483 
14484     Wave 17: BADGE PATH BOUNDED — the bridge ``--badge`` mode answers from the
14485     portfolio-index badge cache / attention cells (no discoverStrips root walk).
14486     At most one short-lived bridge process per client poll interval.
14487     """
14488     roots, _skipped, failed = _ecgberht_portfolio_roots()
14489     if failed:
14490         # The badge is ambient chrome, so it stays quiet rather than throwing a
14491         # banner — but it must not claim a queue of 0, which reads as "nothing
14492         # needs you". Report the unknown honestly and let the UI hide it.
14493         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "registry_unreadable",
14494                             "mode": "badge", "queue_length": None}, 502)
14495         return
14496     # Wave 17: --badge is index-only; roots are optional (cache / attention).
14497     # Still pass roots when present for transport parity; walk path is retired
14498     # inside the bridge (buildBadgeFromIndex — never verbStatus/discoverStrips).
14499     args = ["--badge"]
14500     if roots:
14501         args.extend(["--roots", _ECGBERHT_ROOT_DELIM.join(roots)])
14502     out = _ecgberht_hs_bridge(args)
14503     if isinstance(out, dict) and out.get("error") == "bridge_bad_json":
14504         out["code"] = "GLANCE_INDEX_UNPARSEABLE"
14505         out["message"] = (
14506             "Index snapshot or bridge output unreadable — nothing is guessed."
14507         )
14508         out["bridge_bad_json"] = True
14509         out["mode"] = "badge"
14510         out["queue_length"] = None
14511     # EMPTY IS NOT BROKEN (hardening 2026-08-04) — mirrors the high_seat handler.
14512     # No project has joined the portfolio yet, so the queue length is genuinely
14513     # UNKNOWN rather than zero: `queue_length: None` keeps the badge hidden instead
14514     # of asserting the reassuring "nothing needs you" the index cannot support.
14515     if isinstance(out, dict) and (out.get("code") == "GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING"
14516                                   or out.get("error") == "GLANCE_INDEX_MISSING"):
14517         handler._send_json({"ok": True, "mode": "badge", "empty": True,
14518                             "code": "GLANCE_NO_PROJECTS_REGISTERED",
14519                             "queue_length": None,
14520                             "message": "No projects have joined the portfolio yet."},
14521                            200)
14522         return
14523     handler._send_json(out, 200 if out.get("ok") else 502)

14539 def handle_ecgberht_high_seat_act(handler, path, body):
14540     """POST /api/ecgberht/high_seat_act — closed High Seat acts only:
14541     speak (compile), override (balancing → receipt), decide (packet answer →
14542     receipt moving the Roadmap through the single writer)."""
14543     kind = str(body.get("kind", "") or "").strip()
14544     if kind == "speak":
14545         text = str(body.get("text", "") or "").strip()

14547             handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "text required"}, 400)
14548             return
14549         if _ecgberht_reject_oversized(handler, text):
14550             return
14551         out = _ecgberht_hs_bridge(["--speak", text])
14552     elif kind == "override":
14553         fields = {k: body.get(k) for k in ("who", "why", "from", "to")}
14554         out = _ecgberht_hs_bridge(["--override", json.dumps(fields)])
14555     elif kind == "decide":
14556         pid = str(body.get("project_id", "") or "").strip()
14557         folder, err, status = _ecgberht_project_folder(pid)
14558         if err is not None:
14559             handler._send_json(err, status)
14560             return
14561         fields = {
14562             "project_path": folder,
14563             "step_id": body.get("step_id"),
14564             "decision": body.get("decision"),
14565             "who": body.get("who") or "john",
14566             "why": body.get("why"),
14567         }
14568         out = _ecgberht_hs_bridge(["--decide", json.dumps(fields)])
14569     elif kind == "capacity_choice":
14570         # TW7 S4-E2 — one of the three honest options under unknown capacity:
14571         # lite_now / queue_full / override (which lands as a receipt). There
14572         # is no silent-FULL path; anything else refuses with the options.
14573         fields = {"capacity": "unknown",
14574                   "choice": body.get("choice"),
14575                   "who": body.get("who") or "john",
14576                   "why": body.get("why"),
14577                   "from": body.get("from") or "blocked — capacity unknown",
14578                   "to": body.get("to") or "FULL admit (human override)"}
14579         out = _ecgberht_hs_bridge(["--request-full", json.dumps(fields)])
14580     else:
14581         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "unknown_act",
14582                             "allowed": ["speak", "override", "decide",
14583                                         "capacity_choice"]}, 400)
14584         return
14585     handler._send_json(out, 200 if out.get("ok") else 502)

14588 # Artifact display MVP (S3-E4): serve a packet artifact from inside the
14589 # project folder — traversal-safe — so HTML mockups render best-effort inline
14590 # (iframe) and everything else opens in the browser viewer. Never a bare
14591 # path with no open action.
14592 #: Cap on a single steward artifact served inline. The handler reads the whole
14593 #: file into memory on a shared server thread, so this is a memory bound, not a
14594 #: policy preference. 25 MB comfortably covers decision packets and images.
14595 _ECGBERHT_ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024
14596 
14597 _ECGBERHT_ARTIFACT_TYPES = {
14598     ".html": "text/html", ".htm": "text/html",
14599     ".md": "text/plain", ".markdown": "text/plain", ".txt": "text/plain",
14600     ".json": "application/json",
14601     ".png": "image/png", ".jpg": "image/jpeg", ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
14602     ".gif": "image/gif", ".svg": "image/svg+xml", ".webp": "image/webp",
14603     ".pdf": "application/pdf",
14604 }
14605

14607 def handle_ecgberht_artifact(handler, path, body):
14608     """GET /api/ecgberht/artifact?project_id=&rel= — open path for packet
14609     artifacts (resolve()+relative_to containment, same idiom as static_asset)."""
14610     q = parse_qs(urlparse(handler.path).query)
14611     pid = (q.get("project_id", [""])[0] or "").strip()
14612     rel = (q.get("rel", [""])[0] or "").strip()
14613     folder, err, status = _ecgberht_project_folder(pid)
14614     if err is not None:
14615         handler._send_json(err, status)
14616         return
14617     if not rel:
14618         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "rel required"}, 400)
14619         return
14620     root = Path(folder).resolve()
14621     target = (root / rel).resolve()
14622     if _provider_private_path(target):
14623         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "private_host_credentials"}, 403)
14624         return
14625     try:
14626         target.relative_to(root)
14627     except ValueError:
14628         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "artifact_outside_project"}, 400)
14629         return
14630     if not target.is_file():
14631         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "artifact_missing"}, 404)
14632         return
14633     # Bounded read: this runs on a shared server thread and reads the whole file
14634     # into memory before sending, so an oversized artifact in a project folder
14635     # is an unbounded allocation. Refuse honestly instead of trying.
14636     try:
14637         size = target.stat().st_size
14638     except OSError:
14639         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "artifact_unreadable"}, 404)
14640         return
14641     if size > _ECGBERHT_ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES:
14642         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "artifact_too_large",
14643                             "message": "%d bytes exceeds the %d-byte cap"
14644                                        % (size, _ECGBERHT_ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES),
14645                             "size": size,
14646                             "limit": _ECGBERHT_ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES}, 413)
14647         return
14648     ctype = _ECGBERHT_ARTIFACT_TYPES.get(target.suffix.lower(),
14649                                          "application/octet-stream")
14650     handler._send_bytes(target.read_bytes(), ctype, cache="no-cache")
14651

14653 # ── Ecgberht Chamber UI (Wave 18 — steps / proposals / artifacts / corrections)
14654 # Spawns scripts/chamber-ui-bridge.mjs. Token-auth only (OPEN_ROUTES review:
14655 # none of these routes are open). I52 scaffold chrome refusal + T-CON-18 path
14656 # containment live in the engine; handlers only bridge.
14657 
14658 
14659 def _ecgberht_chamber_ui_bridge(args, timeout=30):
14660     """Spawn the Ecgberht chamber-ui bridge (Node) and parse its one-line JSON."""
14661     import subprocess
14662     root = _ecgberht_root()
14663     bridge = root / "scripts" / "chamber-ui-bridge.mjs"
14664     if not bridge.exists():
14665         return {"ok": False, "error": "ecgberht_engine_missing",
14666                 "code": "CHAMBER_DEP_MISSING",
14667                 "message": "chamber-ui bridge not found (set ECGBERHT_ROOT "
14668                            "or keep Ecgberht checkout beside Anchor)"}
14669     try:
14670         proc = subprocess.run(
14671             ["node", str(bridge), *args],
14672             capture_output=True, timeout=timeout, cwd=str(root),
14673             # windowsHide / CREATE_NO_WINDOW not available on subprocess.run
14674             # flags portably; Anchor's service host already hides children.
14675         )
14676     except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
14677         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_timeout",
14678                 "code": "CHAMBER_DEP_DEAD",
14679                 "message": "chamber-ui bridge timed out — last good state "
14680                            "shown with its age when available"}
14681     except OSError as e:
14682         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_spawn_failed",
14683                 "code": "CHAMBER_DEP_MISSING",
14684                 "message": "chamber-ui bridge could not start: %s" % e}
14685     raw = (proc.stdout or b"").decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
14686     if not raw:
14687         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_no_output",
14688                 "code": "CHAMBER_DEP_GARBAGE",
14689                 "message": "chamber-ui bridge produced no output — unreadable"}
14690     # Last non-empty line is the JSON payload (stdout purity).
14691     line = raw.splitlines()[-1]
14692     try:
14693         return json.loads(line)
14694     except Exception:
14695         return {"ok": False, "error": "bridge_bad_json",
14696                 "code": "CHAMBER_DEP_GARBAGE",
14697                 "message": "chamber-ui bridge returned unreadable JSON — "
14698                            "shown as an error, nothing invented.",
14699                 "bridge_bad_json": True}

14847     this handler runs). Reads the query off ``handler.path``.

14859     elif _unsafe_path_seg(lane):
14860         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "bad lane"}, 400)
14861     else:
14862         proj = _rnd.get_project(pid)
14863         folder = (proj or {}).get("folder_path", "")
14864         result = {"resolved": False, "deliverable": None,
14865                   "reason": "no deliverable pinned yet"}

14867             session = None
14868             for s in _sessions.list_sessions(folder, pid, lane):
14869                 if s.get("session_id") == session_id:

14884 def handle_orphan_check(handler, path, body):
14885     """GET /api/rnd/orphan_check — lightweight read-only poll for the dashboard's
14886     orphan-swarm alert banner: the session_ids of RUNNING sessions currently
14887     classified ORPHANED (verdict "kill"). Token-gated (the strangler applies the
14888     row's auth FIRST); a no-op when ANCHOR_TOKEN is unset. Global (not
14889     project-scoped).
14890     """
14891     if not handler._term_token_ok():
14892         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "unauthorized"}, 401)
14893         return
14894     import reaper
14895     import pty_manager
14896     try:
14897         attached = set(pty_manager.live_sessions())
14898     except Exception:
14899         attached = set()
14900     orphans = []
14901     try:
14902         running_recs = _sessreg.list_sessions(status="running")
14903         # (#3, single source) An orphan is a RUNNING session with NO LIVE OWNER —
14904         # not merely one absent from the PTY-attached set. Build the ONE immutable
14905         # liveness snapshot for this sweep and classify every record against it so
14906         # a legit, work-doing session with no open browser stream is never falsely
14907         # flagged as a runaway.
14908         try:
14909             _snap = reaper.build_snapshot(attached_pty_ids=attached, records=running_recs,
14910                                           enumerate_pids=reaper.enumerate_live_pids)
14911             live_ids = reaper.live_owner_ids(_snap)
14912         except Exception:
14913             _snap = None
14914             live_ids = attached
14915         for rec in running_recs:
14916             sid = rec.get("session_id", "")
14917             try:
14918                 verdict = reaper.classify_record(rec, _snap)
14919             except Exception:
14920                 # Defensive: a fault NEVER produces a "kill" — abstain-safe so the
14921                 # startup banner can't false-alarm on a hiccup.
14922                 verdict = reaper.VERDICT_ABSTAIN
14923             # Only alert on orphans born DURING THIS server's life (a restart's
14924             # prior-instance 'running' records must not fire the startup banner).
14925             if (verdict == "kill" and sid
14926                     and float(rec.get("created_at") or 0) >= _SERVER_BOOT_TS):
14927                 orphans.append(sid)
14928     except Exception:
14929         pass
14930     handler._send_json({"ok": True, "orphans": orphans})
14931 
14932 
14933 def handle_zombie_spenders(handler, path, body):
14934     """GET /api/rnd/zombie_spenders — lightweight read-only poll for the home
14935     dashboard's token-spend zombie banner. Server-side reads the node Sentinel's
14936     /api/state and reports how many VALID zombies exist right now (processes
14937     spending paid AI tokens with no live session) plus the current burn rate.
14938     Best-effort: if the node server is down/absent, returns count 0 (no banner)
14939     rather than erroring. Token-gated like the other read-API GET routes.
14940 
14941     Dual-write dark (G0): under classifierMode=shadow (or missing armed receipt),
14942     actionable scare count is forced to 0 even if observe dual-run would-be
14943     candidates exist — no token-spending zombie banner chrome until armed.
14944     """
14945     if not handler._term_token_ok():
14946         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "unauthorized"}, 401)
14947         return
14948     import urllib.request
14949     count = 0
14950     usd_per_min = 0.0
14951     classifier_mode = "shadow"
14952     actionable_red_allowed = False
14953     observe_would_be = 0
14954     try:
14955         with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:48484/api/state', timeout=3) as r:
14956             st = json.loads(r.read().decode('utf-8'))
14957         classifier_mode = str(st.get("classifierMode") or "shadow").lower()
14958         actionable_red_allowed = bool(st.get("actionableRedAllowed"))
14959         # Prefer explicit dual-write dashboard surface when present
14960         dash = st.get("dashboardZombieBanner") or {}
14961         if isinstance(dash, dict) and "actionableRed" in dash:
14962             if dash.get("actionableRed"):
14963                 count = int(dash.get("count", 0) or 0)
14964             else:
14965                 count = 0
14966         elif actionable_red_allowed and classifier_mode in (
14967                 "armed", "armed_partial", "armed_global"):
14968             zg = st.get("zombies", []) or []
14969             count = sum(int(g.get("count", 0) or 0) for g in zg)
14970         else:
14971             # Shadow / dual-write dark: never paint scare banner
14972             count = 0
14973         obs = st.get("observe") or {}
14974         if isinstance(obs, dict):
14975             observe_would_be = int(obs.get("wouldBeCount", 0) or 0)
14976         usd_per_min = float((st.get("ledger", {}) or {}).get("totals", {}).get("usdPerMin", 0) or 0)
14977     except Exception:
14978         pass
14979     handler._send_json({
14980         "ok": True,
14981         "count": count,
14982         "usdPerMin": round(usd_per_min, 2),
14983         "classifierMode": classifier_mode,
14984         "actionableRedAllowed": actionable_red_allowed,
14985         "observeWouldBeCount": observe_would_be,
14986     })

15338 def handle_tidy_idy_run(handler, path, body):
15339     """POST /api/rnd/tidy_idy_run — thin caller for the tidy-idy CLI.
15340 
15341     Dispatches ``bin/tidy-idy.mjs`` via job_runner (build lane) and returns
15342     quickly with a ``status_url`` / ``job_id`` so the browser tab can show live
15343     progress. The panel bootstrap URL is fetched via ``tidy_idy_status`` poll
15344     (or is already present on a second click when a run is live).
15345     """
15346     import tidy_idy_runner as _tidy
15347     pid = (body.get("project_id", "") or body.get("id", "")).strip()
15348     if not pid:
15349         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "project_id required"}, 400)
15350         return
15351     if _unsafe_path_seg(pid):
15352         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "bad pid"}, 400)
15353         return
15354     proj = _rnd.get_project(pid)
15355     if proj is None:
15356         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Unknown project"}, 404)
15357         return
15358     folder = proj.get("folder_path", "")
15359     if not folder:
15360         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "project has no folder_path"}, 400)
15361         return
15362     # Default async: return as soon as status page is known (not after full scan).
15363     async_mode = body.get("async", True)
15364     if isinstance(async_mode, str):
15365         async_mode = async_mode.strip().lower() not in ("0", "false", "no")
15366     out = _tidy.launch_tidy_idy(pid, folder, async_mode=bool(async_mode))
15367     status = 200 if out.get("ok") else 400
15368     if not out.get("ok") and out.get("code") in (
15369             "spawn-cap-reached",
15370             getattr(_jr, "REFUSED_SAME_LANE", "same-lane"),
15371             getattr(_jr, "REFUSED_FOLDER_BUILD", "folder-build-lock"),
15372             "same-lane", "folder-build-lock", "busy"):
15373         status = 409
15374     handler._send_json(out, status)
15375

15377 def handle_tidy_idy_status(handler, path, body):
15378     """GET /api/rnd/tidy_idy_status?project_id=&job_id= — live run status for the status tab.
15379 
15380     Query must be read from ``handler.path`` (full request URI). The strangler
15381     passes a query-stripped ``path`` for route matching — using that alone made
15382     every remote Tailscale poll return ``project_id required`` and freeze the
15383     status shell at the last launch snapshot (often 42% / save).
15384     """
15385     import tidy_idy_runner as _tidy
15386     # Prefer the live request URI (includes ?project_id=…&token=…); fall back to
15387     # the strangler path only if somehow empty. Also accept X-Project-Id header
15388     # (remote status shell sends it so a query-strip bug cannot black-hole polls).
15389     raw = getattr(handler, "path", None) or path or ""
15390     qs = parse_qs(urlparse(raw).query)
15391     if not qs.get("project_id"):
15392         # body is usually None on GET; keep for tests that pass a dict.
15393         qs = parse_qs(urlparse(path or "").query) or qs
15394     hdr_pid = ""
15395     try:
15396         hdr_pid = (
15397             handler.headers.get("X-Project-Id")
15398             or handler.headers.get("x-project-id")
15399             or ""
15400         ).strip()
15401     except Exception:
15402         hdr_pid = ""
15403     pid = (
15404         (qs.get("project_id") or [""])[0].strip()
15405         or hdr_pid
15406         or (body or {}).get("project_id", "")
15407         or ""
15408     )
15409     if isinstance(pid, str):
15410         pid = pid.strip()
15411     job_id = (qs.get("job_id") or [""])[0].strip() or (body or {}).get("job_id") or None
15412     if not pid:
15413         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "project_id required"}, 400)
15414         return
15415     if _unsafe_path_seg(pid):
15416         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "bad pid"}, 400)
15417         return
15418     proj = _rnd.get_project(pid)
15419     if proj is None:
15420         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Unknown project"}, 404)
15421         return
15422     folder = proj.get("folder_path", "")
15423     if not folder:
15424         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "project has no folder_path"}, 400)
15425         return
15426     handler._send_json(
15427         _tidy.status_for_folder(folder, job_id=job_id or None, project_id=pid)
15428     )
15429 
15430 
15431 def handle_tidy_idy_proxy(handler, path, body):
15432     """GET|POST /api/rnd/tidy_idy_proxy/<project_id>/<...> — reverse-proxy to tool loopback.
15433 
15434     The tidy-idy status page and Triage Panel bind 127.0.0.1 only (by design).
15435     That works when the browser is on the same machine as Anchor; it fails for
15436     Tailscale / remote dashboard clients. This route is same-origin with Anchor,
15437     so remote browsers can reach the panel while the upstream stays loopback.
15438     """
15439     import json as _json
15440     import tidy_idy_runner as _tidy
15441 
15442     parsed = urlparse(path)
15443     prefix = "/api/rnd/tidy_idy_proxy/"
15444     if not parsed.path.startswith(prefix):
15445         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "bad proxy path"}, 400)
15446         return
15447     rest = parsed.path[len(prefix):]
15448     if not rest:
15449         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "project_id required in path"}, 400)
15450         return
15451     parts = rest.split("/", 1)
15452     pid = parts[0].strip()
15453     sub = "/" + parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else "/"
15454     if not pid or _unsafe_path_seg(pid):
15455         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "bad project_id"}, 400)
15456         return
15457     proj = _rnd.get_project(pid)
15458     if proj is None:
15459         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Unknown project"}, 404)
15460         return
15461     folder = proj.get("folder_path", "")
15462     if not folder:
15463         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "project has no folder_path"}, 400)
15464         return
15465 
15466     method = (getattr(handler, "command", None) or "GET").upper()
15467     # Panel POSTs JSON; the strangler already parsed the body into a dict.
15468     raw_body = None
15469     if method in ("POST", "PUT", "PATCH") and body is not None:
15470         if isinstance(body, (bytes, bytearray)):
15471             raw_body = bytes(body)
15472         else:
15473             raw_body = _json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
15474 
15475     fwd_headers = {}
15476     # Capability token for the panel control plane (never logged).
15477     tok = handler.headers.get("x-tidy-idy-token") or handler.headers.get("X-Tidy-Idy-Token")
15478     if tok:
15479         fwd_headers["x-tidy-idy-token"] = tok
15480     ctype = handler.headers.get("Content-Type")
15481     if ctype:
15482         fwd_headers["Content-Type"] = ctype
15483     elif raw_body is not None:
15484         fwd_headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
15485 
15486     result = _tidy.proxy_to_loopback(
15487         folder,
15488         method=method,
15489         rel_path=sub,
15490         query=parsed.query or "",
15491         headers=fwd_headers,
15492         body=raw_body,
15493     )

15495     def _tidy_html_page(title, heading, body_html, code=410):
15496         from html import escape as _html_esc
15497         html = (
15498             "<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=utf-8>"
15499             f"<title>{_html_esc(title)}</title>"
15500             '<link rel="icon" href="/vendor/brand/tidy-idy-icon.jpg" type="image/jpeg"/>'
15501             "<style>body{font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;background:#0f1115;color:#e8eaed;"
15502             "padding:2rem;line-height:1.5} .card{max-width:36rem;border:1px solid #2a2f3a;"
15503             "border-radius:12px;padding:1.25rem 1.4rem;background:#161a22}"
15504             "h1{font-size:1.25rem;margin:0 0 .5rem} p{color:#9aa0a6;margin:0 0 .75rem}"
15505             "code{color:#8ab4f8}</style></head><body><div class=card>"
15506             f"<h1>{_html_esc(heading)}</h1>{body_html}</div></body></html>"
15507         )
15508         payload = html.encode("utf-8")
15509         try:
15510             handler.send_response(code)
15511             handler.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
15512             handler.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
15513             handler.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
15514             handler.end_headers()
15515             handler.wfile.write(payload)
15516         except Exception:
15517             pass
15518 
15519     # Spent single-use bootstrap: reissue when panel is still live, else clear HTML.
15520     # Never forward raw JSON "{" to a browser tab (Tailscale operators hit this often).
15521     status_hop = int(result.get("status") or 0)
15522     if (
15523         method == "GET"
15524         and "/bootstrap/" in str(sub)
15525         and status_hop == 410
15526     ):
15527         fresh = _tidy.reissue_panel_bootstrap(folder)
15528         if fresh:
15529             loc = _tidy.browser_open_url(pid, fresh)
15530             if loc:
15531                 # Preserve Anchor auth token on the redirect.
15532                 tok = None
15533                 try:
15534                     tok = (parse_qs(parsed.query or "").get("token") or [""])[0]
15535                 except Exception:
15536                     tok = ""
15537                 if not tok:
15538                     tok = (handler.headers.get("X-Anchor-Token")
15539                            or handler.headers.get("x-anchor-token") or "")
15540                 if tok:
15541                     loc = loc + ("&" if "?" in loc else "?") + "token=" + url_quote(str(tok))
15542                 try:
15543                     handler.send_response(302)
15544                     handler.send_header("Location", loc)
15545                     handler.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
15546                     handler.end_headers()
15547                 except Exception:
15548                     pass
15549                 return
15550         # Panel gone or too old to reissue — clear corpse status and explain.
15551         try:
15552             _tidy.mark_status_stale(
15553                 folder, reason="bootstrap nonce spent; panel cannot reissue")
15554         except Exception:
15555             pass
15556         _tidy_html_page(
15557             "Tidy-Idy — link already used",
15558             "This panel link was already used",
15559             "<p>The open link is single-use (so a refresh cannot re-enable Apply).</p>"
15560             "<p>Close this tab and click <b>Tidy-Idy</b> on the project again to "
15561             "start a <b>fresh</b> hygiene pass and mint a new open link.</p>"
15562             "<p><code>bootstrap nonce already redeemed</code></p>",
15563             code=410,
15564         )
15565         return
15566 
15567     if not result.get("ok") and result.get("code"):
15568         code = 502 if result.get("code") in ("proxy-failed", "upstream-gone", "no-upstream") else 404
15569         if result.get("code") == "proxy-timeout":
15570             code = 504
15571         if result.get("code") == "ssrf-guard":
15572             code = 403
15573         # Browser navigations (GET bootstrap / status) should not show raw JSON.
15574         wants_html = method == "GET" and not str(sub).startswith("/api/")
15575         if wants_html:
15576             from html import escape as _html_esc
15577             err = result.get("error") or "Tidy-Idy panel is not available."
15578             _tidy_html_page(
15579                 "Tidy-Idy — session ended",
15580                 "Tidy-Idy session ended",
15581                 f"<p>{_html_esc(err)}</p>"
15582                 "<p>Close this tab and click <b>Tidy-Idy</b> on the project again "
15583                 "to start a fresh pass (the previous panel process is no longer running).</p>"
15584                 f"<p><code>{_html_esc(str(result.get('code') or ''))}</code></p>",
15585                 code=code,
15586             )
15587             return
15588         if result.get("code") == "proxy-timeout":
15589             code = 504
15590         handler._send_json(
15591             {"ok": False, "error": result.get("error"), "code": result.get("code")},
15592             code,
15593         )
15594         return
15595 
15596     upstream = result.get("upstream") or ""
15597     public_base = _tidy.proxy_mount_for(pid)
15598     payload = result.get("body") or b""
15599     ctype_out = result.get("content_type") or "application/octet-stream"
15600     if upstream and isinstance(payload, (bytes, bytearray)):
15601         payload = _tidy.rewrite_proxied_body(
15602             bytes(payload),
15603             content_type=ctype_out,
15604             upstream_base=upstream,
15605             public_base=public_base,
15606         )
15607 
15608     status = int(result.get("status") or 200)
15609 
15610     # If upstream still returned JSON 410 for bootstrap (old panel), convert to HTML.
15611     if (
15612         method == "GET"
15613         and "/bootstrap/" in str(sub)
15614         and status == 410
15615         and "json" in (ctype_out or "").lower()
15616     ):
15617         _tidy_html_page(
15618             "Tidy-Idy — link already used",
15619             "This panel link was already used",
15620             "<p>Close this tab and click <b>Tidy-Idy</b> on the project again "
15621             "for a fresh open link.</p>"
15622             "<p><code>bootstrap nonce already redeemed</code></p>",
15623             code=410,
15624         )
15625         return
15626 
15627     try:
15628         handler.send_response(status)
15629         handler.send_header("Content-Type", ctype_out)
15630         handler.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
15631         handler.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
15632         # Do not forward upstream Set-Cookie / hop-by-hop headers.
15633         handler.end_headers()
15634         handler.wfile.write(payload)
15635     except Exception:
15636         pass
