15725 def handle_term_kill(handler, path, body):
15726     session = (body.get("session", "") or "").strip()
15727     if not session:
15728         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "session required"}, 400)
15729     elif _termsess.get_session(session) is None:
15730         handler._send_json({"ok": False,
15731                          "error": f"unknown session: {session}",
15732                          "reason": "unknown-session"}, 404)
15733     else:
15734         rec = _termsess.get_session(session)
15735         if rec and rec.get("lane") == "gandalf":
15736             cancelled = _gandalf.cancel_run(session)
15737             handler._send_json({"ok": True, "result": {"ok": True, "cancelled": cancelled}})
15738             return
15739         # v6 Wave 6: a DELIBERATE hard-kill of a PLANNING session is a
15740         # DONE transition that may auto-advance to build.
15741         #
15742         # v8 Wave 4 (ordering fix): kill() PERSISTS the session's
15743         # freshly-produced docs into the MAIN folder (Wave 2,
15744         # capture-before-reap) BEFORE the worktree is reaped. The plan-set
15745         # capture (discover_recent_plan_set) reads the MAIN folder, so it
15746         # must run AFTER kill() — otherwise it sees the project as it was
15747         # before this session and the auto-opened build gets a stale (or no)
15748         # plan. So: kill (persists docs + sets STATUS_DONE + reaps), THEN
15749         # capture the now-persisted plan set, THEN auto-advance (idempotent
15750         # on parent_session_id; no plan ⇒ no advance). Best-effort.
15751         pid_for_advance = rec.get("project_id") if rec else None
15752         # v12 Wave 7 — RETIREMENT MAP (Shark C1/C3): a v12 EFFORT
15753         # advances IN-SESSION (advance_stage / detect_stage_progress) and
15754         # must NEVER trigger the legacy plan→build auto-advance mint. Gate
15755         # on ``effort_managed`` ONLY (never lane/kind/current_stage —
15756         # legacy records carry those too). A legacy record (False) keeps
15757         # the v6 planning-kill auto-advance fully live.
15758         planning_kill = (
15759             rec is not None
15760             and not rec.get("effort_managed")
15761             and rec.get("lane") in _termsess._PLANNING_LANES
15762             and pid_for_advance)
15763         out = _termsess.kill(session)
15764         # v7 Wave 2: a killed session is DONE — schedule a background
15765         # session-summary so the finished tile opens to a real summary
15766         # (and so it's restartable). Best-effort + non-blocking +
15767         # idempotent (skips a cached one); never delays the kill response.
15768         try:
15769             _trigger_session_summary_on_finish(
15770                 pid_for_advance or (rec.get("project_id") if rec else None),
15771                 rec.get("lane") if rec else None, session)
15772         except Exception:
15773             pass
15774         # v8 Wave 3: auto-push the project AFTER kill() persisted the
15775         # produced docs (Wave 2, capture-before-reap) — but ONLY when the
15776         # project is linked to a remote AND has opted in. A non-linked or
15777         # non-opted project never pushes. Best-effort + never blocks the
15778         # kill response; in tests origin is a LOCAL BARE repo (no network).
15779         try:
15780             _auto_push_on_finish(
15781                 pid_for_advance or (rec.get("project_id") if rec else None))
15782         except Exception:
15783             pass
15784         auto_build = None
15785         if planning_kill:
15786             # Capture the plan set AFTER kill() persisted this session's
15787             # produced docs into the main folder (the ordering fix above).
15788             try:
15789                 post_plan_set = _termsess.capture_plan_set(
15790                     pid_for_advance, session)
15791             except Exception:
15792                 post_plan_set = None
15793             try:
15794                 auto_build = _termsess.auto_advance_planning_to_build(
15795                     pid_for_advance, session,
15796                     plan_set=post_plan_set)
15797             except Exception:
15798                 auto_build = None
15799         handler._send_json({"ok": True, "result": out,
15800                          "auto_build": auto_build})
15801

15803 def handle_term_close(handler, path, body):
15804     # crucible-improve W6 — the panel "×" GRACEFUL CLOSE. Stop the PTY but
15805     # PRESERVE the worktree + KEEP the registry record (parked STATUS_IDLE,
15806     # resumable WARM via W3/W4). close_session persists the produced docs to
15807     # MAIN (so the boot reaper can't lose them and the W3 resume seed reads
15808     # them); here we ALSO schedule the SAME best-effort, non-blocking,
15809     # idempotent background session-summary hook kill/finish use, so a later
15810     # resume opens WARM, not cold. Token-gated by the do_POST middleware. A
15811     # park is NOT a finish — never auto-advances. Best-effort throughout.
15812     session = (body.get("session", "") or "").strip()
15813     if not session:
15814         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "session required"}, 400)
15815     elif _termsess.get_session(session) is None:
15816         handler._send_json({"ok": False,
15817                          "error": f"unknown session: {session}",
15818                          "reason": "unknown-session"}, 404)
15819     else:
15820         rec = _termsess.get_session(session)
15821         out = _termsess.close_session(session)
15822         try:
15823             _trigger_session_summary_on_finish(
15824                 rec.get("project_id") if rec else None,
15825                 rec.get("lane") if rec else None, session)
15826         except Exception:
15827             pass
15828         handler._send_json({"ok": True, "result": out})
15829

15831 def handle_term_delete(handler, path, body):
15832     # v9 Wave 1 — TRUE session delete (DISTINCT from term_kill). Removes
15833     # the session from Anchor entirely: hard-deletes the registry record
15834     # (so the tile stays gone across a reload), drops its lane effort
15835     # pointer-records / index entries / cached summary, and (if still
15836     # live) kills it first. The produced DOCUMENTS are KEPT (Option A).
15837     # Token-gated by the do_POST middleware above AND requires an explicit
15838     # confirm:true in the body (a deliberate, irreversible removal).
15839     session = (body.get("session", "") or "").strip()
15840     confirm = bool(body.get("confirm"))
15841     if not session:
15842         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "session required"}, 400)
15843     elif not confirm:
15844         handler._send_json({"ok": False,
15845                          "error": "delete requires confirm:true",
15846                          "reason": "confirm-required"}, 400)
15847     else:
15848         try:
15849             out = _termsess.delete_session(session)
15850         except Exception as exc:
15851             handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, 500)
15852         else:
15853             handler._send_json({"ok": True,
15854                              "deleted": bool(out.get("deleted")),
15855                              "result": out})

15936 def handle_term_resize(handler, path, body):
15937     session = (body.get("session", "") or "").strip()
15938     cols = body.get("cols")
15939     rows = body.get("rows")
15940     if not session or cols is None or rows is None:
15941         handler._send_json({"ok": False,
15942                          "error": "session, cols, rows required"}, 400)
15943     else:
15944         out = _termsess.resize(session, cols, rows)
15945         if out.get("ok"):
15946             handler._send_json({"ok": True})
15947         elif out.get("reason") == "unknown-session":
15948             # A resize is ADVISORY: a session with no live PTY
15949             # (parked / closed-to-tile / reconnecting, or a stale panel
15950             # caught mid-teardown or window-reuse) simply has nothing to
15951             # resize — a benign no-op, NOT a client error. Returning 404
15952             # here surfaced a spurious "Failed to load resource: 404"
15953             # browser console error on every reopen/continue, because
15954             # the terminal fit path fires term_resize as the panel lays
15955             # out. Report the no-op at HTTP 200 so it never reads as a
15956             # failed request. (Genuinely bad cols/rows still 400 below.)
15957             handler._send_json({"ok": False, "noop": True,
15958                              "reason": "unknown-session"})
15959         else:
15960             handler._send_json({"ok": False,
15961                              "error": out.get("detail", "bad request"),
15962                              "reason": out.get("reason")}, 400)

15965 def handle_start_terminal(handler, path, body):
15966     # Start a persistent interactive terminal session for a lane. The
15967     # returned job_id is the terminal session id the SSE stream + input
15968     # endpoints key off of. Clean JSON errors (not 500s) for unknown
15969     # project / invalid lane / engine or concurrency refusals.

15971     lane = body.get("lane", "")
15972     backend = body.get("backend") or _aset.get_default_cli()
15973     if lane not in _lanes.LANES:

15975                          "reason": "invalid-lane"}, 400)
15976     elif backend not in _termsess.VALID_BACKENDS:
15977         handler._send_json({"ok": False,
15978                          "error": f"invalid engine: {backend}",
15979                          "reason": "invalid-engine"}, 400)
15980     else:
15981         try:
15982             rec = _term.start_terminal(pid, lane, backend=backend)
15983             handler._send_json({
15984                 "ok": True,
15985                 "session": rec.get("job_id"),
15986                 "job_id": rec.get("job_id"),
15987                 "lane": lane,
15988                 "backend": rec.get("backend"),
15989                 "status": rec.get("status"),
15990                 "skill": rec.get("skill"),
15991                 "gates": rec.get("gates"),
15992             })
15993         except _lanes.EngineNotAllowedError as eng:
15994             handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(eng),
15995                              "reason": "engine-not-allowed",
15996                              "lane": eng.lane, "backend": eng.backend},
15997                             400)
15998         except KeyError:
15999             handler._send_json({"ok": False,
16000                              "error": f"unknown project: {pid}",
16001                              "reason": "unknown-project"}, 404)
16002         except _jr.LaneBusyError as busy:
16003             handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(busy),
16004                              "reason": busy.reason,
16005                              "holder": busy.holder}, 409)

16008 def handle_term_input(handler, path, body):
16009     # Write ONE user turn onto a live terminal session's stdin (reuses the
16010     # gate-adapter stdin sink — never forks it). Auth is enforced by the
16011     # middleware above. Clean JSON for an unknown/terminal session.
16012     session = (body.get("session", "") or body.get("job_id", "")).strip()
16013     text = body.get("text", "")
16014     if not session:
16015         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "missing session"}, 400)
16016     elif text is None or not str(text).strip():
16017         # Reject an empty/whitespace-only turn cleanly (nothing written).
16018         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "written": False,
16019                          "session": session, "error": "empty turn",
16020                          "reason": "empty"}, 400)
16021     elif len(str(text)) > _term.MAX_TURN_CHARS:
16022         # Reject an oversized turn cleanly (nothing written).
16023         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "written": False,
16024                          "session": session, "error": "turn too large",
16025                          "reason": "too-large"}, 413)
16026     else:
16027         ok = _term.send_turn(session, text)
16028         handler._send_json({"ok": bool(ok), "written": bool(ok),
16029                          "session": session,
16030                          "reason": None if ok else "not-writable"})

16063 def handle_term_start(handler, path, body):
16064     pid = (body.get("project_id", "") or body.get("id", "")).strip()
16065     lane = (body.get("lane", "") or "").strip()
16066     # Interactive default from durable settings (default_cli), not a hard-coded engine.
16067     backend = ((body.get("backend", "") or "").strip()
16068                or _aset.get_default_cli())
16069     label = body.get("label", "") or ""
16070     # Wave 6 seam → Wave 7: a launch-from-panel carries the source
16071     # session id as a seed hint. On a BUILD launch we now consume it:
16072     # after start_session creates the session+worktree, we discover the
16073     # most-recent plan set (preferring this seed_session's plan docs),
16074     # prime the worktree with a HANDOFF reference file, and record the
16075     # handoff in the per-project Anchor reference. The bare-PTY launch
16076     # still works when there is no plan set (no crash; priming skipped).
16077     _seed_session = (body.get("seed_session", "") or "").strip() or None
16078     # v12 Wave 10: the "+ New effort" control starts an effort_managed trio
16079     # session (the v12 discriminator — set ONLY by the v12 entrypoints). A
16080     # legacy launch omits it (default False), so the legacy paths are
16081     # unaffected. Coerced to a real bool.
16082     _effort_managed = bool(body.get("effort_managed", False))
16083     if not pid or not lane:
16084         handler._send_json({"ok": False,
16085                          "error": "project_id and lane required"}, 400)
16086     else:
16087         proj = _rnd.get_project(pid)
16088         if proj is None:
16089             handler._send_json({"ok": False,
16090                              "error": "Unknown project"}, 404)
16091         else:
16092             try:
16093                 rec = _termsess.start_session(pid, lane, backend=backend,
16094                                               label=label,
16095                                               effort_managed=_effort_managed)
16096             except _termsess.TerminalSessionError as exc:
16097                 handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, 400)
16098             else:
16099                 handoff_info = None
16100                 if lane in _handoff.BUILD_LANES:
16101                     folder = proj.get("folder_path", "")
16102                     try:
16103                         plan_set = _handoff.discover_recent_plan_set(
16104                             folder, pid, source_session_id=_seed_session)
16105                     except Exception:
16106                         plan_set = None
16107                     if plan_set:
16108                         primed = _handoff.prime_worktree(
16109                             rec.get("worktree_path", ""), plan_set,
16110                             project_id=pid)
16111                         recorded = _handoff.record_handoff(
16112                             folder, pid, rec.get("session_id", ""),
16113                             plan_set)
16114                         handoff_info = {
16115                             "plan_set": plan_set,
16116                             "primed": primed,
16117                             "recorded": bool(recorded.get("ok")),
16118                         }
16119                 resp = {"ok": True, "session": rec}
16120                 if handoff_info is not None:
16121                     resp["handoff"] = handoff_info
16122                 handler._send_json(resp)

16125 def handle_run_deliverable_terminal(handler, path, body):
16126     # reports-links W3 — the Run ▶ link behind a register row's `run:` marker.
16127     # Token-gated by the route row + the do_POST middleware (401 BEFORE any
16128     # substance). This is an ALLOWLIST, not an exec API: the ONLY command it
16129     # will stage is one that byte-for-byte equals a parsed row's run string in
16130     # THAT dir's register, re-read NOW from disk (steward_campaign.
16131     # discover_efforts + read_deliverables — exactly what register-all serves).
16132     # A near-miss is refused 400 WITHOUT echoing the rejected string (no
16133     # reflection surface). cwd derives from the MATCHED row — its effort dir
16134     # when the row is effort-level, else the project folder — never from the
16135     # caller. The command is STAGED UNSENT on a 'shell'-backend session (the
16136     # user's own shell; Enter runs it), and the response is the SAFE projection
16137     # (never worktree_path/branch).
16138     pid = (body.get("project_id", "") or body.get("pid", "") or "").strip()
16139     dir_rel = body.get("dir", "")
16140     dir_rel = dir_rel.strip() if isinstance(dir_rel, str) else None
16141     command = body.get("command", "")
16142     if not pid or dir_rel is None or not isinstance(command, str) or not command:
16143         handler._send_json({"ok": False,
16144                             "error": "project_id, dir and command required"}, 400)
16145         return
16146     # Containment: a '..'-bearing (or absolute / drive-qualified) dir can never
16147     # address a register outside the project tree.
16148     _norm = dir_rel.replace("\\", "/")
16149     if ".." in _norm.split("/") or _norm.startswith("/") or ":" in _norm:
16150         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "invalid dir"}, 400)
16151         return
16152     proj = _rnd.get_project(pid)
16153     if proj is None:
16154         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Unknown project"}, 404)
16155         return
16156     folder = proj.get("folder_path", "")
16157     from steward_cockpit import steward_campaign as _campaign
16158     matched = None
16159     match_dir = None
16160     for e in _campaign.discover_efforts(folder):
16161         if (e.get("rel") or "") != dir_rel:
16162             continue
16163         edir = str(Path(folder) / e["rel"]) if e["rel"] else str(folder)
16164         for it in _campaign.read_deliverables(edir).get("items", []):
16165             run = it.get("run")
16166             if isinstance(run, str) and run == command:
16167                 matched, match_dir = it, edir
16168                 break
16169         break  # effort rels are unique; the named dir's register was checked
16170     if matched is None:
16171         # No echo of the rejected string — the refusal carries nothing of it.
16172         handler._send_json({
16173             "ok": False,
16174             "error": "command is not a registered run for that dir"}, 400)
16175         return
16176     try:
16177         rec = _termsess.start_session(
16178             pid, "general",
16179             backend=getattr(_sessreg, "BACKEND_SHELL", "shell"),
16180             label=(matched.get("what") or "run"),
16181             paste_prompt=command, cwd=match_dir)
16182     except _termsess.TerminalSessionError as exc:
16183         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, 400)
16184         return
16185     handler._send_json({"ok": True, "session": _safe_session_projection(rec)})
16186

16188 def _zombie_scan_and_skill_briefing():
16189     """Whole-computer scan (the System-Wide Sentinel classifier on :48484) plus a
16190     distilled zombie-hunter awareness block, so the investigator agent reasons
16191     over the SAME data the GUI shows and knows the safety rules."""
16192     import urllib.request
16193     out = "\n\n## Whole-Computer Token-Spend Scan (System-Wide Sentinel)\n"
16194     try:
16195         with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:48484/api/state', timeout=3) as r:
16196             st = json.loads(r.read().decode('utf-8'))
16197         tot = (st.get("ledger", {}) or {}).get("totals", {}) or {}
16198         zombies = st.get("zombies", []) or []
16199         active = st.get("active", []) or []
16200         out += (f"- Burn rate NOW: ${tot.get('usdPerMin', 0):.2f}/min "
16201                 f"(${tot.get('usdRecent', 0):.2f} in last {(st.get('ledger', {}) or {}).get('windowMin', 10)}m, "
16202                 f"{tot.get('activeSessions', 0)} active Claude sessions)\n"
16203                 f"- Token-spending ZOMBIES (spending + no live session): {sum(g.get('count', 0) for g in zombies)}\n"
16204                 f"- Active + supervised (your live sessions): {sum(g.get('count', 0) for g in active)}\n"
16205                 f"- Idle engines + non-engine matches (hidden): {st.get('idleCount', 0)} + {st.get('hiddenNonEngine', 0)}\n\n")
16206         if zombies:
16207             out += "### ZOMBIES — reap candidates (spending paid tokens, unsupervised)\n"
16208             for g in zombies[:12]:
16209                 out += (f"- {g.get('count')}x {g.get('name')} | providers={','.join(g.get('providers') or [])} "
16210                         f"| supervised={g.get('supervised')} root={g.get('root')} "
16211                         f"| pids={','.join((g.get('pids') or [])[:8])}\n")
16212             out += "\n"
16213         sessions = (st.get("ledger", {}) or {}).get("sessions", []) or []
16214         if sessions:
16215             out += "### Burn ledger (Claude sessions accruing tokens)\n"
16216             for s in sessions[:8]:
16217                 out += (f"- ${s.get('usdPerMin', 0):.2f}/min | {s.get('model')} | {s.get('cwd')} "
16218                         f"| last {s.get('lastActivityAgoMin')}m ago\n")
16219             out += "\n"
16220     except Exception as exc:
16221         out += f"(live scan unavailable: {exc})\n\n"
16222     out += (
16223         "## Zombie-Hunter awareness (how to reason)\n"
16224         "The threat that MATTERS is a process SPENDING PAID AI TOKENS with nobody steering it. "
16225         "A ZOMBIE = an AI engine (claude->Anthropic, agy/gemini->Google) that is (a) actively "
16226         "calling a paid provider (live :443 connection to the provider's IP, and/or a Claude "
16227         "session log accruing tokens) AND (b) NOT rooted in a live interactive session "
16228         "(parent dead, or service-rooted with no session). An AI run that IS supervised (rooted "
16229         "in a live powershell/terminal you're using) is NOT a zombie — it's your work. Processes "
16230         "that merely matched a keyword but spend nothing (tail -f on an AI log, shells) are NOT a "
16231         "threat and are hidden. Safety: observe-only; prefer FREEZE (reversible) before KILL "
16232         "(tree-kill); never mass-kill; confirm before killing your own live session.\n\n"
16233         "Tools: spend detector (zombie-hunter spend.js — network by provider IP-prefix + Claude "
16234         "token-log $/min ledger from ~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl); "
16235         "classifier classify.js; live scan JSON http://127.0.0.1:48484/api/state; a PID's live API "
16236         "connections via `Get-NetTCPConnection -OwningProcess <pid> -State Established` (RemotePort 443); "
16237         "a PID's tree via `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process` (ParentProcessId).\n"
16238     )
16239     return out

16247

16271 def _w8_normalize_engine(raw):
16272     e = (raw or "").strip().lower()
16273     if e == "agy":
16274         return "gemini"
16275     if e in ("grok-cli", "grok.exe"):
16276         return "grok"
16277     if e in ("codex", "chatgpt-cli", "codex.exe"):
16278         return "chatgpt"
16279     if e in _W8_ENGINE_IDS:
16280         return e
16281     return None

16284 def _w8_engine_toggle(profile=None, prefs=None, last_used=None):
16285     """Three-engine toggle with health; never offers a silent dead toggle."""
16286     if profile is None:
16287         try:
16288             profile = _lanes.detect_host_profile()
16289         except Exception:
16290             profile = {"claude": False, "gemini": False, "grok": False, "chatgpt": False}
16291     prefs = dict(prefs or {})
16292     # (2026-09-04, John) an engine is offered only when it is installed AND the
16293     # dashboard selects its family (Terminal / Coder / Reviewer) — an installed
16294     # CLI whose subscription was dropped must not appear as a live choice.
16295     if not prefs.get("_selected"):
16296         try:
16297             fams = _lanes.selected_families()
16298             prefs.setdefault("default_cli", fams["default_cli"])
16299             prefs.setdefault("coding_family", fams["coding"])
16300             prefs.setdefault("review_family", fams["review"])
16301             prefs["_selected"] = set(fams["selected"])
16302         except Exception:
16303             prefs["_selected"] = {"claude"}
16304     selected = {_w8_normalize_engine(x) for x in prefs["_selected"] if x}
16305     selected.discard(None)
16306     engines = []
16307     for eid in _W8_ENGINE_IDS:
16308         available = bool(profile.get(eid))
16309         chosen = eid in selected
16310         transport = {
16311             "claude": ("claude", "claude"),
16312             "gemini": ("agy", "agy"),
16313             "grok": ("grok-cli", "grok.exe -p"),
16314             "chatgpt": ("chatgpt-cli", "codex exec"),
16315         }[eid]
16316         if not available:
16317             health = "unavailable (subscription CLI not detected)"
16318         elif not chosen:
16319             health = "installed, but not selected on the dashboard (Terminal / Coder / Reviewer)"
16320         else:
16321             health = "healthy"
16322         enabled = available and chosen
16323         engines.append({
16324             "id": eid,
16325             "label": eid.capitalize() if eid != "gemini" else "Gemini",
16326             "transport": transport[0],
16327             "spawn": transport[1],
16328             "subscriptionCli": True,
16329             "available": available,
16330             "selected": chosen,
16331             "enabled": enabled,
16332             "disabled": not enabled,
16333             "health": health,
16334             "firstPromptBudgetMs": _W8_FIRST_PROMPT_BUDGET_MS,
16335         })
16336     healthy = [e["id"] for e in engines if e["enabled"]]
16337     default = None
16338     last = _w8_normalize_engine(last_used)
16339     if last and last in healthy:
16340         default = last
16341     else:
16342         # (2026-09-04) a picker starts a TERMINAL, so the dashboard's Terminal role
16343         # (default_cli) wins; the Coder family is the fallback.
16344         family = _w8_normalize_engine(
16345             prefs.get("default_cli") or prefs.get("coding_family"))
16346         alt = _w8_normalize_engine(prefs.get("coding_family"))
16347         if family and family in healthy:
16348             default = family
16349         elif alt and alt in healthy:
16350             default = alt
16351         elif healthy:
16352             default = healthy[0]
16353     return {
16354         "engines": engines,
16355         "available": healthy,
16356         "defaultEngine": default,
16357         "anyHealthy": bool(healthy),
16358         "shellPaintBudgetMs": _W8_SHELL_PAINT_BUDGET_MS,
16359         "firstPromptBudgetMs": _W8_FIRST_PROMPT_BUDGET_MS,
16360         "profile": {
16361             "claude": bool(profile.get("claude")),
16362             "gemini": bool(profile.get("gemini")),
16363             "grok": bool(profile.get("grok")),
16364         },
16365     }
16366

16368 def _w8_resolve_interactive_engine(requested, toggle=None):
16369     """Pick a healthy engine; refuse dead toggles with health (never silent)."""
16370     toggle = toggle or _w8_engine_toggle()
16371     req = _w8_normalize_engine(requested)
16372     if req:
16373         row = next((e for e in toggle["engines"] if e["id"] == req), None)
16374         if row and row["enabled"]:
16375             return req, None
16376         reason = (row or {}).get("health") or "unknown engine (dead toggle forbidden)"
16377         return None, {"engine": req, "reason": reason, "disabled": True}
16378     if toggle.get("defaultEngine"):
16379         return toggle["defaultEngine"], None
16380     return None, {"engine": None, "reason": "no healthy engine", "disabled": True}

16383 def _w8_clip(s, n=240):
16384     t = "" if s is None else str(s)
16385     if len(t) <= n:

16387     return t[: n - 1] + "…"

16390 def _w8_build_investigate_slim_seed(candidate=None, opts=None):
16391     """Investigate slim seed: pid + class + top reason codes + freeze/kill status."""
16392     candidate = candidate or {}
16393     opts = opts or {}
16394     reasons = candidate.get("reasonCodes") or candidate.get("topReasonCodes") or []
16395     if not isinstance(reasons, list):
16396         reasons = []
16397     reasons = [str(r) for r in reasons[:8]]
16398     pid = candidate.get("pid")
16399     if pid is None and candidate.get("pids"):
16400         try:
16401             pid = int(candidate["pids"][0])
16402         except Exception:
16403             pid = None
16404     else:
16405         try:
16406             pid = int(pid) if pid is not None else None
16407         except Exception:
16408             pid = None
16409     freeze_status = opts.get("freezeStatus") or candidate.get("freezeStatus") or (
16410         "disabled" if opts.get("freezeKillEnabled") is False else (
16411             "available" if opts.get("freezeCapability") else "unavailable"))
16412     kill_status = opts.get("killStatus") or candidate.get("killStatus") or (
16413         "disabled" if opts.get("freezeKillEnabled") is False else "confirm_required")
16414     return {
16415         "kind": "investigate_slim",
16416         "version": "w8-investigate-slim-v1",
16417         "pid": pid,
16418         "class": _w8_clip(
16419             candidate.get("engineClass")
16420             or candidate.get("class")
16421             or candidate.get("name")
16422             or "unknown",
16423             80,
16424         ),
16425         "topReasonCodes": reasons,
16426         "freezeStatus": str(freeze_status),
16427         "killStatus": str(kill_status),
16428         "classifierMode": opts.get("classifierMode") or "shadow",
16429         "freezeCapability": bool(opts.get("freezeCapability")),
16430         "image": _w8_clip(candidate.get("imagePath") or candidate.get("image") or "", 160),
16431         "name": _w8_clip(candidate.get("name") or "", 80),
16432         "slim": True,
16433         "deepBrief": False,
16434     }

16437 def _w8_format_investigate_slim_seed_text(slim):
16438     s = slim or {}
16439     lines = [
16440         "ZOMBIE-HUNTER INVESTIGATE — SLIM SEED (W8/SC5)",
16441         "You help the operator treat ONE candidate. Prefer FREEZE before KILL. Uncertain ≠ red.",
16442         "pid: %s" % (s.get("pid") if s.get("pid") is not None else "unknown"),
16443         "class: %s" % (s.get("class") or "unknown"),
16444         "top reason codes: %s" % (", ".join(s.get("topReasonCodes") or []) or "(none)"),
16445         "freeze status: %s" % (s.get("freezeStatus") or "unknown"),
16446         "kill status: %s" % (s.get("killStatus") or "unknown"),
16447         "classifierMode: %s" % (s.get("classifierMode") or "shadow"),
16448         "freezeCapability: %s" % bool(s.get("freezeCapability")),
16449     ]
16450     if s.get("image"):
16451         lines.append("image: %s" % s["image"])
16452     lines.append(
16453         "Safety: observe-only unless DESTRUCTIVE_ELIGIBLE; never mass-kill; confirm before kill.")
16454     return "\n".join(lines)

16457 def _w8_build_doctor_short_seed(issue=None):

16485 def _w8_format_doctor_short_seed_text(short):

16505 def _w8_shared_session_start_plan(surface="investigate", engine=None, candidate=None,
16506                                   issue=None, deep_brief=False, slim=True,
16507                                   prefs=None, last_used=None):
16508     """Shared session-start helper: shell + picker + seed before session (P5)."""
16509     try:
16510         prefs = prefs or {
16511             "default_cli": _aset.get_default_cli(),
16512             "coding_family": getattr(_aset, "get_coding_family", lambda: None)()
16513             if hasattr(_aset, "get_coding_family") else None,
16514         }
16515     except Exception:
16516         prefs = prefs or {}
16517     toggle = _w8_engine_toggle(prefs=prefs, last_used=last_used)
16518     eng, denied = _w8_resolve_interactive_engine(engine, toggle)
16519     if surface == "doctor":
16520         seed = _w8_build_doctor_short_seed(issue)

16522     else:

16529                 "slim": seed,
16530                 "recommendedNext": "INVESTIGATE",
16531                 "deepBrief": True,
16532             }
16533             seed_text += "\nrecommendedNext: INVESTIGATE\n(deep-brief path; shell already painted)"
16534     can_start = bool(eng) and toggle["anyHealthy"] and not denied
16535     return {
16536         "surface": surface,
16537         "shell": {
16538             "paintFirst": True,
16539             "paintBudgetMs": _W8_SHELL_PAINT_BUDGET_MS,
16540             "enginePicker": True,
16541             "engines": toggle["engines"],
16542             "autoStartSession": False,
16543         },
16544         "seed": seed,
16545         "seedText": seed_text,
16546         "seedBeforeSession": True,
16547         "engine": eng,
16548         "engineDenied": denied,
16549         "engineToggle": toggle,
16550         "session": {
16551             "async": True,
16552             "cancelable": True,
16553             "failureNonBlocking": True,
16554             "autoStart": False,
16555             "firstPromptBudgetMs": _W8_FIRST_PROMPT_BUDGET_MS,
16556             "startWhen": ("operator_or_diagnose_click" if can_start
16557                           else "blocked_no_healthy_engine"),
16558         },
16559         "canStart": can_start,
16560         "ok": can_start,
16561         "error": (None if can_start else (
16562             (denied or {}).get("reason") if denied else "no healthy engine")),
16563         "p5Plumbing": _W8_P5_PLUMBING,
16564         "slim": bool(slim),
16565         "deepBrief": bool(deep_brief),
16566     }

16648 def _w9_normalize_banner_issue(raw, banner_surface=None):
16649     """Normalize banner/issue payload to 1:1 Doctor seed fields (SC7)."""
16650     if not raw or not isinstance(raw, dict):
16651         return None
16652     issue_id = raw.get("issueId") or raw.get("id")
16653     issue_id = str(issue_id) if issue_id else None
16654     catalog = _W9_DOCTOR_ISSUE_DEFAULTS.get(issue_id or "", {})
16655     message = _w8_clip(
16656         raw.get("message") or raw.get("exactMessage") or catalog.get("message") or "",
16657         400,
16658     )
16659     component = _w8_clip(
16660         raw.get("component") or catalog.get("component") or "",
16661         120,
16662     )
16663     last_error = _w8_clip(raw.get("lastError") or raw.get("error") or "", 400)
16664     checks = raw.get("suggestedChecks")
16665     if not isinstance(checks, list):
16666         checks = list(catalog.get("suggestedChecks") or [])
16667     checks = [_w8_clip(c, 160) for c in checks[:8] if c]
16668     surface = raw.get("bannerSurface") or banner_surface
16669     return {
16670         "issueId": issue_id,
16671         "message": message,
16672         "exactMessage": message,
16673         "component": component,
16674         "lastError": last_error,
16675         "suggestedChecks": checks,
16676         "bannerSurface": surface,
16677         "markdownPath": None,
16678         "isMarkdownPath": False,
16679         "version": _W9_BANNER_DOCTOR_SEED_VERSION,
16680         "catalogAligned": bool(issue_id and issue_id in _W9_DOCTOR_ISSUE_DEFAULTS),
16681     }
16682

16688     status = str(status or "ISSUES FOUND")
16689     msg = message or (
16690         f"Health check found issues"
16691         f"{(' on ' + report_date) if report_date else ''} ({status})"
16692     )

16694         "issueId": "ZH_HEALTH_CHECK_ISSUES",

16702 def _w9_build_reaper_health_banner_issue(banner=None):
16703     """Reaper-health banner issue from reaper_arming.health_banner() dict."""
16704     banner = banner or {}
16705     kind = str(banner.get("kind") or "abstain-streak")
16706     issue_id = (
16707         "ZH_REAPER_CHAIN_TAMPERED" if kind == "chain-tampered"
16708         else "ZH_REAPER_ABSTAIN_STREAK"
16709     )
16710     msg = banner.get("message") or (
16711         "Reaper receipt chain failed verification."
16712         if kind == "chain-tampered"
16713         else (
16714             f"Reaper has ABSTAINED for {banner.get('streak', '?')} consecutive "
16715             f"sweeps — flying blind."
16716         )
16717     )
16718     last_error = banner.get("lastError") or (
16719         "chain_verification_failed" if kind == "chain-tampered"
16720         else (
16721             f"abstain_streak={banner.get('streak', '?')};"
16722             f"threshold={banner.get('threshold', '?')}"
16723         )
16724     )
16725     return _w9_normalize_banner_issue({
16726         "issueId": issue_id,
16727         "message": msg,
16728         "component": "reaper-health",
16729         "lastError": last_error,
16730         "bannerSurface": "reaper_health",
16731     }, banner_surface="reaper_health")

16734 def _w9_extract_banner_seed_fields(issue):
16735     n = _w9_normalize_banner_issue(issue) or {}
16736     return {
16737         "issueId": n.get("issueId"),
16738         "message": n.get("message") or "",
16739         "component": n.get("component") or "",
16740         "lastError": n.get("lastError") or "",
16741         "suggestedChecks": list(n.get("suggestedChecks") or []),
16742     }
16743

16745 def _w9_assert_banner_seed_one_to_one(banner_issue, doctor_seed):
16746     """True iff Doctor short seed matches banner 1:1 on SC7 fields."""
16747     b = _w9_extract_banner_seed_fields(banner_issue)
16748     seed = doctor_seed or {}
16749     mismatches = []
16750     if str(seed.get("issueId") or "") != str(b.get("issueId") or ""):
16751         mismatches.append("issueId")
16752     if str(seed.get("message") or "") != str(b.get("message") or ""):
16753         mismatches.append("message")
16754     if str(seed.get("component") or "") != str(b.get("component") or ""):
16755         mismatches.append("component")
16756     if str(seed.get("lastError") or "") != str(b.get("lastError") or ""):
16757         mismatches.append("lastError")
16758     seed_checks = [str(c) for c in (seed.get("suggestedChecks") or [])]
16759     b_checks = [str(c) for c in (b.get("suggestedChecks") or [])]
16760     if seed_checks != b_checks:
16761         mismatches.append("suggestedChecks")
16762     if seed.get("markdownPath") or seed.get("isMarkdownPath") is True:
16763         mismatches.append("markdownPath_present")
16764     return {"ok": len(mismatches) == 0, "mismatches": mismatches,
16765             "fields": list(_W9_BANNER_SEED_FIELDS)}
16766 
16767 
16768 def _w9_build_doctor_navigation_from_banner(issue, token=None, auto_diagnose=True):
16769     """Doctor href with 1:1 query seed; model start always needs a click.
16770 
16771     ``auto_diagnose`` is retained as a compatibility name for callers that want
16772     the ``diagnose=1`` context marker. The marker now means "Diagnose requested"
16773     only; opening the URL never starts a model.
16774     """
16775     n = _w9_normalize_banner_issue(issue)
16776     if not n:
16777         return {
16778             "ok": False, "href": "/doctor", "path": "/doctor",
16779             "isMarkdownPath": False, "markdownPath": None,
16780             "autoDiagnose": False, "diagnoseRequested": False,
16781             "issue": None, "error": "no_issue",
16782         }
16783     from urllib.parse import urlencode
16784     q = {
16785         "issueId": n.get("issueId") or "",
16786         "message": n.get("message") or "",
16787         "component": n.get("component") or "",
16788         "lastError": n.get("lastError") or "",
16789         "suggestedChecks": "|".join(n.get("suggestedChecks") or []),
16790     }
16791     if auto_diagnose:
16792         q["diagnose"] = "1"
16793     if token:
16794         q["token"] = str(token)
16795     # Drop empties for cleaner URLs
16796     q = {k: v for k, v in q.items() if v not in (None, "")}
16797     href = "/doctor?" + urlencode(q)
16798     return {
16799         "ok": True,
16800         "href": href,
16801         "path": "/doctor",
16802         "isMarkdownPath": False,
16803         "markdownPath": None,
16804         "autoDiagnose": False,
16805         "diagnoseRequested": bool(auto_diagnose),
16806         "query": q,
16807         "issue": _w9_extract_banner_seed_fields(n),
16808         "bannerSurface": n.get("bannerSurface"),
16809         "version": _W9_BANNER_DOCTOR_SEED_VERSION,
16810     }
16811 
16812 
16813 def _w9_build_banner_diagnose_plan(issue, engine=None, profile=None):
16814     """Banner-to-Doctor seed plan; session start requires operator action."""
16815     n = _w9_normalize_banner_issue(issue)
16816     plan = _w8_shared_session_start_plan(
16817         surface="doctor", engine=engine, issue=n)
16818     seed = plan.get("seed") or _w8_build_doctor_short_seed(n)
16819     if n:
16820         seed = dict(seed)
16821         seed["exactMessage"] = n.get("exactMessage") or seed.get("message")
16822         seed["markdownPath"] = None
16823         seed["isMarkdownPath"] = False
16824         seed["bannerSurface"] = n.get("bannerSurface")
16825         seed["bannerDoctorVersion"] = _W9_BANNER_DOCTOR_SEED_VERSION
16826         plan["seed"] = seed
16827         plan["seedText"] = _w8_format_doctor_short_seed_text(seed)
16828     plan["bannerIssue"] = _w9_extract_banner_seed_fields(n)
16829     plan["bannerOneToOne"] = _w9_assert_banner_seed_one_to_one(n, plan.get("seed"))
16830     plan["navigation"] = _w9_build_doctor_navigation_from_banner(n, auto_diagnose=True)
16831     plan["p6BannerDoctor"] = {
16832         "id": "p6-health-banner-doctor-seed",
16833         "version": _W9_BANNER_DOCTOR_SEED_VERSION,
16834         "notMarkdownPath": True,
16835         "fields": list(_W9_BANNER_SEED_FIELDS),
16836     }
16837     if plan.get("canStart"):
16838         plan["session"] = dict(plan.get("session") or {})
16839         plan["session"]["attemptAsyncDiagnose"] = False
16840         plan["session"]["requiresOperatorClick"] = True
16841         plan["session"]["startWhen"] = "operator_diagnose_click"
16842         plan["session"]["failureNonBlocking"] = True
16843         plan["session"]["async"] = True
16844     return plan
16845

16847 def _w9_attempt_async_banner_diagnose_start(issue, engine=None, force_fail=False,
16848                                            fail_reason=None, profile=None):
16849     """Compatibility projection for the retired page-open start attempt.
16850 
16851     This function is intentionally read-only: it never starts a process and now
16852     reports ``attempted=False``. The authenticated session-start POST is the only
16853     paid launch path, after an operator click.
16854     """
16855     plan = _w9_build_banner_diagnose_plan(issue, engine=engine, profile=profile)
16856     if force_fail or not plan.get("canStart"):
16857         reason = (
16858             fail_reason if force_fail
16859             else (plan.get("error") or "no healthy engine")
16860         )
16861         return {
16862             "ok": False,
16863             "attempted": False,
16864             "async": False,
16865             "requiresOperatorClick": True,
16866             "failureNonBlocking": True,
16867             "uiUsable": True,
16868             "health": {
16869                 "status": "start_failed" if force_fail else "engine_disabled",
16870                 "message": str(reason),
16871                 "engine": plan.get("engine") or engine,
16872             },
16873             "plan": plan,
16874             "session": None,
16875             "seed": plan.get("seed"),
16876             "seedOneToOne": plan.get("bannerOneToOne"),
16877             "error": reason,
16878         }
16879     return {
16880         "ok": True,
16881         "attempted": False,
16882         "async": False,
16883         "requiresOperatorClick": True,
16884         "failureNonBlocking": True,
16885         "uiUsable": True,
16886         "health": {
16887             "status": "healthy",
16888             "message": "diagnose context ready; operator click required",
16889             "engine": plan.get("engine"),
16890         },
16891         "plan": plan,
16892         "session": None,
16893         "seed": plan.get("seed"),
16894         "seedOneToOne": plan.get("bannerOneToOne"),
16895         "error": None,
16896     }
16897

16899 def _w9_render_clickable_banner_html(issue, title, body, style_kind="health"):
16900     """Render a clickable health/reaper banner that opens Doctor with 1:1 seed."""
16901     n = _w9_normalize_banner_issue(issue) or {}
16902     nav = _w9_build_doctor_navigation_from_banner(n, auto_diagnose=True)
16903     href = nav.get("href") or "/doctor?diagnose=1"
16904     # JS open with token: base href + optional token from _anchorToken()
16905     if style_kind == "reaper":
16906         bg, border, color, strong = "#3b2a1f", "#9b6a3a", "#ffd9b3", "#ffb37a"
16907     else:
16908         bg, border, color, strong = "#3b1f1f", "#9b3a3a", "#ffb3b3", "#ff7a7a"
16909     # Escape attribute values
16910     def _attr(s):
16911         return html_lib.escape(str(s or ""), quote=True)
16912 
16913     issue_id = _attr(n.get("issueId") or "")
16914     message = _attr(n.get("message") or "")
16915     component = _attr(n.get("component") or "")
16916     last_error = _attr(n.get("lastError") or "")
16917     checks = _attr("|".join(n.get("suggestedChecks") or []))
16918     surface = _attr(n.get("bannerSurface") or "")
16919     href_js = href.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'")
16920     return (
16921         f'<div role="button" tabindex="0" class="zh-health-banner-doctor" '
16922         f'data-issue-id="{issue_id}" data-message="{message}" '
16923         f'data-component="{component}" data-last-error="{last_error}" '
16924         f'data-suggested-checks="{checks}" data-banner-surface="{surface}" '
16925         f'data-diagnose="1" data-not-markdown-path="1" '
16926         f'onclick="(function(){{var h=\'{href_js}\';'
16927         f'try{{var t=(typeof _anchorToken===\'function\')?(_anchorToken()||\'\'):\'\';'
16928         f'if(t)h+=(h.indexOf(\'?\')>=0?\'&amp;\':\'?\')+\'token=\'+encodeURIComponent(t);'
16929         f'}}catch(e){{}}window.open(h,\'_blank\');}})()" '
16930         f'style="background:{bg};border:1px solid {border};color:{color};'
16931         f'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:6px;margin:0 0 10px 0;font-size:13px;'
16932         f'cursor:pointer;" title="Open Doctor with seeded diagnose context (W9/SC7)">'
16933         f'<strong style="color:{strong}">&#9888; {_attr(title)}</strong> {body}'
16934         f'</div>'
16935     )

16938 def handle_doctor_banner_seed(handler, path, body):
16939     """GET/POST helper surface for W9 banner→Doctor seed (tests + clients)."""
16940     # Parse query from handler path when GET
16941     qs = {}
16942     try:
16943         qs = {k: (v[0] if v else "") for k, v in parse_qs(
16944             urlparse(path).query).items()}
16945     except Exception:
16946         qs = {}
16947     body = body or {}
16948     surface = (body.get("surface") or qs.get("surface") or "dashboard_health").lower()
16949     if surface in ("reaper_health", "reaper"):
16950         issue = _w9_build_reaper_health_banner_issue({
16951             "kind": body.get("kind") or qs.get("kind") or "abstain-streak",
16952             "message": body.get("message") or qs.get("message"),
16953             "streak": body.get("streak") or qs.get("streak"),
16954             "threshold": body.get("threshold") or qs.get("threshold"),
16955             "lastError": body.get("lastError") or qs.get("lastError"),
16956         })

17182 #: Cap on how much of the latest health report rides in the doctor seed —
17183 #: enough for the whole summary + failures section of a normal report without
17184 #: flooding the opening turn.
17185 _DOCTOR_SEED_REPORT_CAP = 6000
17186 
17187 
17188 def _build_doctor_seed():
17189     """Compose the ONE-TIME doctor-session briefing (doctor V3 Wave 2).
17190 
17191     Content (plan §W2): the latest ``health_reports/*.md`` (graceful "no
17192     reports yet" when absent), fresh ``doctor.run_doctor()`` output, the
17193     CORRECTNESS-vs-PERFORMANCE severity rule, and a capability list. ASCII-safe
17194     (encoded with replacement so no non-ASCII byte ever reaches the PTY seed).
17195     Every section is individually guarded — a failure degrades to an honest
17196     note, never a fabricated value and never a crash.
17197     """
17198     import contextlib
17199     import io as _io
17200     lines = [
17201         "ANCHOR DOCTOR - LIVE DIAGNOSTIC BRIEFING",
17202         "You are the Anchor Doctor: an HONEST, READ-ONLY diagnostic assistant "
17203         "for this Anchor installation. This terminal runs in plan permission "
17204         "mode - you may inspect anything, you can mutate nothing. Never invent "
17205         "a number: every figure you state must come from a file you actually "
17206         "read or a command you actually ran; say 'unknown' otherwise.",
17207     ]
17208 
17209     # 1) The latest health report (graceful when absent/corrupt).
17210     try:
17211         reports = sorted(_paths.health_reports_dir().glob("*.md"),
17212                          reverse=True)
17213     except Exception:
17214         reports = []
17215     if reports:
17216         latest = reports[0]
17217         try:
17218             body = latest.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
17219         except Exception as exc:
17220             body = "(report unreadable: %s)" % exc
17221         lines.append("## Latest health report (%s of %d on disk)"
17222                      % (latest.name, len(reports)))
17223         lines.append(body[:_DOCTOR_SEED_REPORT_CAP])
17224     else:
17225         lines.append("## Latest health report")
17226         lines.append("No health reports yet - the daily 5 AM health check has "
17227                      "not produced one on this install.")
17228 
17229     # 2) Fresh doctor.py system-check output (stdout captured; honest on fail).
17230     try:
17231         import doctor as _doctor
17232         buf = _io.StringIO()
17233         with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
17234             rc = _doctor.run_doctor()
17235         lines.append("## Fresh doctor.py system check (exit %s)" % rc)
17236         lines.append(buf.getvalue().strip() or "(no output)")
17237     except Exception as exc:
17238         lines.append("## Fresh doctor.py system check")
17239         lines.append("doctor.run_doctor() failed: %s" % exc)
17240 
17241     # 3) The severity rule (locked 2026-07-07) — so the agent explains a red
17242     #    banner vs a yellow warning correctly.
17243     lines.append("## Severity rule (locked 2026-07-07)")
17244     lines.append(
17245         "Every health check is either CORRECTNESS or PERFORMANCE - never "
17246         "conflate them. A CORRECTNESS failure (broken endpoint, journal "
17247         "corruption/loss, auth violation, bad page content) sets ISSUES FOUND "
17248         "and turns the dashboard banner RED. A PERFORMANCE/timing measurement "
17249         "(render latency, journal overhead %) is load-sensitive and flaps, so "
17250         "it is a NON-BLOCKING YELLOW warning that never reddens the banner. "
17251         "Never present a timing warning as a correctness failure.")
17252 
17253     # 4) Capability list.
17254     lines.append("## What you can do in this session")
17255     lines.append(
17256         "- Read health_reports/*.md and explain any failure or warning "
17257         "honestly (red = correctness, yellow = performance).\n"
17258         "- Inspect the Anchor folder (code, logs/, .anchor/ state) to "
17259         "diagnose issues; cross-reference the doctor.py output above.\n"
17260         "- Suggest fixes as commands FOR THE USER to run - this session is "
17261         "read-only and must not (and cannot) apply them itself.\n"
17262         "- Say plainly when something is healthy; never invent a problem.")
17263 
17264     text = "\n\n".join(lines)
17265     return text.encode("ascii", "replace").decode("ascii")
17266

17268 def handle_doctor_session_start(handler, path, body):
17269     # Doctor V3 Wave 2 + W8/SC6 multi-engine — start (or attach to) THE doctor
17270     # agentic session. Token-authed by middleware BEFORE this handler runs.
17271     # Resolve an omitted backend from the same authoritative dashboard
17272     # snapshot used by the status card. Never fall back to a legacy Claude seat.
17273     # Page itself must NOT auto-call this on load (shell-first / one-click
17274     # diagnose).
17275     body = body or {}
17276     short_only = bool(body.get("short") or body.get("shortSeed"))
17277     issue = body.get("issue") if isinstance(body.get("issue"), dict) else None
17278     explicit_backend = body.get("backend") or body.get("engine")
17279     try:
17280         launch_settings = _aset.get_launch_settings()
17281     except _aset.SettingsInvalid as exc:
17282         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc), "status": "settings_invalid",
17283                             "failureNonBlocking": True}, 400)
17284         return
17285     requested = _w8_normalize_engine(explicit_backend or launch_settings["default_cli"])
17286     if not requested:
17287         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Unknown model provider", "status": "invalid_engine"}, 400)
17288         return
17289     if body.get("settings_revision") is not None and body["settings_revision"] != launch_settings["settings_revision"]:
17290         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Model preferences changed; reload before starting",
17291                             "status": "settings_changed"}, 409)
17292         return
17293     start_plan = _w8_shared_session_start_plan(
17294         surface="doctor",
17295         engine=requested,
17296         issue=issue,
17297         prefs={**launch_settings, "_selected": {
17298             launch_settings[key] for key in ("default_cli", "coding_family", "review_family")}},
17299     )
17300     engine_meta = {
17301         "driver": None,
17302         "swarm": None,
17303         "swarm_ratio": None,
17304         "reason": "",
17305     }
17306     if requested:
17307         backend = start_plan.get("engine")
17308         engine_meta["driver"] = backend
17309         engine_meta["reason"] = "interactive doctor picker (W8/SC6)"
17310         if not backend:
17311             handler._send_json({
17312                 "ok": False,
17313                 "status": _lanes.ENGINE_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE,
17314                 "reason": start_plan.get("error") or "no healthy engine",
17315                 "session": None,
17316                 "engineDenied": start_plan.get("engineDenied"),
17317                 "engineToggle": start_plan.get("engineToggle"),
17318                 "shell": start_plan.get("shell"),
17319                 "failureNonBlocking": True,
17320                 "p5Plumbing": _W8_P5_PLUMBING,
17321             })
17322             return
17323     # Only the JSON boolean true requests write-enabled Resolve posture. A
17324     # truthy string such as "false" must not silently turn Diagnose into write.
17325     resolve = body.get("resolve") is True
17326     try:
17327         if resolve and issue and issue.get("all") is True:
17328             # (2026-09-03, John) RESOLVE ALL: the seed built by
17329             # /api/doctor/resolve_all already lists every open issue and the
17330             # live re-probe receipt — it goes in whole (bounded).
17331             seed = str(issue.get("message") or "")[:2400] or \
17332                 "ANCHOR DOCTOR - RESOLVE ALL OPEN ISSUES NOW"
17333         elif resolve and issue:
17334             # (2026-08-07, John) RESOLVE mode: no plan, no wandering diagnose
17335             # — a SHORT execution brief (short also mangles less on the PTY
17336             # paste path, bug 0080). The session launches with the normal
17337             # write posture, never --permission-mode plan.
17338             seed = (
17339                 "ANCHOR DOCTOR - RESOLVE THIS ISSUE NOW\n"
17340                 "issue: %s\n"
17341                 "component: %s\n"
17342                 "Do: reproduce it minimally, FIX it in this folder (edit code/"
17343                 "config/tests as needed), verify the fix (run the relevant "
17344                 "check), then report what changed in 5 lines. If a product "
17345                 "decision is required, ask John one short question in this "
17346                 "session and wait — do not sit on a tool-permission dialog."
17347                 % ((issue.get("message") or "")[:400],
17348                    (issue.get("component") or "")[:120]))
17349         elif short_only or issue:
17350             seed = start_plan.get("seedText") or _w8_format_doctor_short_seed_text(
17351                 start_plan.get("seed"))
17352         else:
17353             seed = _build_doctor_seed()
17354     except Exception as exc:
17355         # The briefing must never block the session — degrade honestly.
17356         seed = ("ANCHOR DOCTOR - LIVE DIAGNOSTIC BRIEFING\n\n"
17357                 "(briefing assembly failed: %s)" % exc)
17358     try:
17359         rec, attached = _termsess.start_doctor_session(
17360             seed_context=seed, backend=backend, resolve=resolve)
17361     except _termsess.TerminalSessionError as exc:

17363             "ok": False,
17364             "error": str(exc),
17365             "failureNonBlocking": True,
17366             "engine": backend,
17367             "shell": start_plan.get("shell"),
17368         }, 400)
17369         return
17370     # SAFE projection (consistent with term_sessions): NEVER worktree_path /
17371     # branch / seed text — the UI needs only the id + engine + status.
17372     handler._send_json({
17373         "ok": True,
17374         "status": _lanes.ENGINE_STATUS_OK,
17375         "attached": bool(attached),
17376         "session": {
17377             "session_id": rec.get("session_id"),
17378             "project_id": rec.get("project_id", ""),
17379             "lane": rec.get("lane", ""),
17380             "backend": rec.get("backend", ""),
17381             "status": rec.get("status", ""),
17382             "label": rec.get("label", ""),
17383             "created_at": rec.get("created_at"),
17384             "mode": rec.get("doctor_mode", ""),
17385             "posture": rec.get("doctor_posture", ""),
17386         },
17387         "engine": engine_meta,
17388         "engineToggle": start_plan.get("engineToggle"),
17389         "sessionStart": {
17390             "async": True,
17391             "cancelable": True,
17392             "failureNonBlocking": True,
17393             "autoStart": False,
17394             "firstPromptBudgetMs": _W8_FIRST_PROMPT_BUDGET_MS,
17395         },
17396         "p5Plumbing": _W8_P5_PLUMBING,
17397     })

17400 # ── Doctor V3 Wave 3 — the /doctor page + background diagnostics ────────────
17401 # Every number the page shows is REAL or ABSENT (plan North Star): status /
17402 # last-run / count come from health_reports/*.md on disk; the reports list rows
17403 # are the actual files; the terminal attaches to the Wave-2 agentic session.
17404 # Nothing fabricated — no disk-usage card, no fake chart, no placeholder nav.
17405 
17406 _DOCTOR_STATUS_TEXT = {
17407     "red": "Issues found",
17408     "yellow": "Warnings",
17409     "green": "Healthy",
17410     "unknown": "Unreadable report",
17411     "none": "No reports yet",
17412 }
17413 
17414 _DOCTOR_STATUS_DETAIL = {
17415     "red": "The latest report flags correctness issues (red banner).",
17416     "yellow": ("All correctness checks passed; non-blocking warnings "
17417                "or skipped checks remain."),
17418     "green": "All checks passed in the latest report.",
17419     "unknown": "The latest report file could not be parsed.",
17420     "none": "Run diagnostics now, or wait for the daily 5 AM health check.",
17421 }
17422 
17423 
17424 def _doctor_report_status(body):
17425     """Classify ONE health-report body per the locked severity rule.
17426 
17427     red    = a CORRECTNESS failure ("Status: ISSUES FOUND");
17428     yellow = correctness clean but the non-blocking Warnings section has
17429              content (PERFORMANCE/timing notes never redden the banner);
17430     green  = "Status: OK" with an empty Warnings section;
17431     unknown= no recognizable status line (corrupt/foreign file) — honest,
17432              never guessed.
17433     """
17434     if "Status: ISSUES FOUND" in body:
17435         return "red"
17436     warn_match = re.search(r"^## Warnings[^\n]*\n+(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)",
17437                            body, re.S | re.M)
17438     if warn_match:
17439         content = warn_match.group(1).strip()
17440         if content and content != "(none)":
17441             return "yellow"
17442     if re.search(r"^Status: OK\s*$", body, re.M):
17443         return "green"
17444     return "unknown"
17445 
17446 
17447 def _doctor_stats():
17448     """REAL /doctor stats — every value from ``health_reports/`` or absent.
17449 
17450     Total over an empty/corrupt reports dir: an unreadable file classifies
17451     ``unknown``, an empty dir yields the honest ``none`` state; never raises.
17452     """
17453     try:
17454         rd = _paths.health_reports_dir()
17455         files = sorted((p for p in rd.glob("*.md") if p.is_file()),
17456                        key=lambda p: p.name, reverse=True)
17457     except OSError:
17458         files = []
17459     reports = []
17460     newest_body = None
17461     for p in files[:10]:
17462         try:
17463             body = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
17464             st = _doctor_report_status(body)
17465             if newest_body is None:
17466                 newest_body = body
17467         except OSError:
17468             st = "unknown"
17469         reports.append({"name": p.name, "date": p.stem, "status": st})
17470     status = reports[0]["status"] if reports else "none"
17471     last_run = reports[0]["date"] if reports else None
17472     days_ago = None
17473     if last_run:
17474         try:
17475             days_ago = (date.today()
17476                         - datetime.strptime(last_run, "%Y-%m-%d").date()).days
17477         except ValueError:
17478             days_ago = None  # non-date filename — honest absence, no guess
17479     return {
17480         "status": status,
17481         "status_text": _DOCTOR_STATUS_TEXT.get(status, status),
17482         "status_detail": _DOCTOR_STATUS_DETAIL.get(status, ""),
17483         "last_run": last_run,
17484         "days_ago": days_ago,
17485         "report_count": len(files),
17486         "reports": reports,
17487         # (2026-08-07, John) The doctor LEADS with the diagnosis it already
17488         # has — the newest report's Issues, parsed deterministically — so
17489         # opening the page answers "what's wrong?" instantly, no model run.
17490         "issues": _doctor_latest_issues(newest_body or ""),
17491         "warnings": _doctor_latest_section(newest_body or "", "Warnings"),
17492         "autofixes": _doctor_latest_section(newest_body or "", "Auto-fixes applied"),
17493     }
17494 
17495 
17496 def _doctor_latest_section(body, heading):
17497     """The newest report's '- ' lines under '## <heading>' — never raises."""
17498     try:
17499         m = re.search(r"^## %s[^\n]*\n+(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)" % re.escape(heading),
17500                       body, re.S | re.M)
17501         if not m:
17502             return []
17503         return [ln.strip()[2:].strip() for ln in m.group(1).splitlines()
17504                 if ln.strip().startswith("- ")]
17505     except Exception:
17506         return []
17507 
17508 
17509 def _doctor_latest_issues(body):
17510     """The newest report's '## Issues' lines as {component, detail} rows —
17511     the instant diagnosis the /doctor page leads with. Never raises."""
17512     try:
17513         m = re.search(r"^## Issues[^\n]*\n+(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", body, re.S | re.M)
17514         if not m:
17515             return []
17516         out = []
17517         for ln in m.group(1).splitlines():
17518             ln = ln.strip()
17519             if not ln.startswith("- "):
17520                 continue
17521             mm = re.match(r"- \[([^\]]+)\]\s*(.*)", ln)
17522             comp = mm.group(1) if mm else ""
17523             detail = (mm.group(2) if mm else ln[2:]).strip()
17524             out.append({"component": comp[:120], "detail": detail[:400]})
17525             if len(out) >= 8:
17526                 break
17527         return out
17528     except Exception:
17529         return []
17530 
17531 
17532 def _doctor_restore_session(session_id=""):
17533     """Inspect an exact Doctor PTY, or the sole live Doctor. Never start one.
17534 
17535     A browser's saved pointer wins over discovery, even when unavailable. Do
17536     not silently substitute another session/model/posture for that pointer.
17537     """
17538     try:
17539         records = ([_termsess.get_session(session_id)] if session_id else
17540                    _termsess.list_sessions(project_id=_termsess.DOCTOR_PROJECT_ID,
17541                                            status="running"))
17542         found = []
17543         for rec in records:
17544             if not rec or rec.get("project_id") != _termsess.DOCTOR_PROJECT_ID:
17545                 continue
17546             mode = rec.get("doctor_mode")
17547             posture = rec.get("doctor_posture")
17548             if (mode not in ("diagnose", "resolve") or
17549                     {"diagnose": "read-only", "resolve": "write-enabled"}[mode] != posture):
17550                 continue
17551             output = _termsess.read_since(rec["session_id"], 0)
17552             if not output.get("ok", True):
17553                 continue
17554             if not session_id and output.get("status") != "running":
17555                 continue
17556             found.append({"session_id": rec["session_id"],
17557                           "backend": rec.get("backend", ""),
17558                           "mode": mode, "posture": posture,
17559                           "status": output.get("status", "unknown")})
17560         if len(found) == 1:
17561             return {"session": found[0], "error": None}
17562         return {"session": None, "error": ("unavailable" if session_id else
17563                                             "multiple" if found else None)}
17564     except Exception:
17565         # A failed inspection is not evidence that the saved session ended.
17566         return {"session": None, "error": "inspection_failed"}
17567

17569 def handle_doctor_status(handler, path, body):
17570     # Read-only JSON stats for the /doctor card + reports-list refresh after a
17571     # diagnostics run. Token-authed by the route row (?token= / header /
17572     # cookie). Never spawns / never blocks. W8: includes engine toggle so the
17573     # shell can paint pickers without starting a session.
17574     state = _aset.read_settings_state()
17575     prefs = state["settings"]
17576     toggle = _w8_engine_toggle(prefs={**prefs, "_selected": {
17577         prefs[key] for key in ("default_cli", "coding_family", "review_family")}})
17578     # An unavailable configured default stays visible and disabled. Choosing
17579     # another configured provider is an explicit user action, not a silent swap.
17580     toggle["defaultEngine"] = prefs["default_cli"]
17581     if not state["valid"]:
17582         toggle["defaultEngine"] = None
17583         for row in toggle["engines"]:
17584             row["enabled"] = False
17585     stats = _doctor_stats()
17586     query = parse_qs(urlparse(getattr(handler, "path", path)).query)
17587     recovery = (_doctor_restore_session((query.get("session", [""])[0] or "")[:128])
17588                 if query.get("restore") == ["1"] else None)
17589     handler._send_json({
17590         "ok": state["valid"],
17591         "error": state["error"],
17592         "settings_revision": prefs.get("settings_revision", 0),
17593         "model_policy": prefs.get("model_policy"),
17594         **stats,
17595         "issues_html": _doctor_issues_block_html(stats),
17596         "engines": toggle["engines"],
17597         "defaultEngine": toggle["defaultEngine"],
17598         "shellFirst": True,
17599         "autoStartSession": False,
17600         "recovery": recovery,
17601         "oneClickDiagnose": True,
17602         "p5Plumbing": _W8_P5_PLUMBING,
17603     })

17606 _DOCTOR_REPORT_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.md$")

17609 def handle_doctor_report(handler, path, body):
17610     # Read-only render of ONE health report. Traversal-safe: the name must be
17611     # a bare *.md filename (no separators — ".." can't survive the regex) AND
17612     # the resolved path must stay inside health_reports/.
17613     q = parse_qs(urlparse(handler.path).query)
17614     name = (q.get("name", [""])[0] or "").strip()
17615     if not name or not _DOCTOR_REPORT_NAME_RE.match(name) or ".." in name:
17616         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "bad report name"}, 400)
17617         return
17618     rd = _paths.health_reports_dir()
17619     try:
17620         target = (rd / name).resolve()
17621         if target.parent != rd.resolve():
17622             handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "bad report name"}, 400)
17623             return
17624         text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
17625     except FileNotFoundError:
17626         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "unknown report"}, 404)
17627         return
17628     except OSError as exc:
17629         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, 500)
17630         return
17631     handler._send_html(_rv.reader_html(text, title=name))
