17633 
17634 # One background anchor_healthcheck.py run at a time (idempotent: a second
17635 # POST while one is live attaches to it). The output tails from a log file by
17636 # BYTE offset — the cursor-stable /api/rnd/tail pattern — so the page streams
17637 # it live and a re-fetch from an old offset is stable, never interleaved.
17638 _DOCTOR_HC_LOCK = threading.Lock()
17639 _DOCTOR_HC = {"proc": None, "log": None, "started_at": None}
17640 
17641 
17642 def _doctor_hc_log_path():
17643     return _paths.logs_dir() / "doctor-healthcheck-run.log"
17644 
17645 
17646 def _doctor_hc_cmd():
17647     """The background diagnostics argv. ``ANCHOR_HEALTHCHECK_CMD`` is the
17648     test/deploy seam (same idiom as ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD — the gate never runs
17649     the real 75s healthcheck); default = this install's anchor_healthcheck.py
17650     under the current interpreter."""
17651     raw = (os.environ.get("ANCHOR_HEALTHCHECK_CMD", "") or "").strip()
17652     if raw:
17653         import shlex
17654         return shlex.split(raw, posix=(os.name != "nt"))
17655     return [sys.executable, str(ANCHOR_DIR / "anchor_healthcheck.py")]
17656 
17657 
17658 def _doctor_live_probe(path, timeout=4.0):
17659     """GET one path on the LIVE server. ``ok`` means the server ANSWERED (any
17660     HTTP status — 401 on a token route is still an answer); a connection
17661     error or timeout is the only failure. Read-only."""
17662     import urllib.request
17663     import urllib.error
17664     t0 = time.time()
17665     url = "http://127.0.0.1:%d%s" % (_doctor_live_port(), path)
17666     try:
17667         with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, method="GET"),
17668                                     timeout=timeout) as r:
17669             code = r.getcode()
17670     except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
17671         code = exc.code
17672     except Exception as exc:
17673         return {"path": path, "ok": False, "code": None,
17674                 "error": type(exc).__name__, "ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)}
17675     return {"path": path, "ok": True, "code": code,
17676             "ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)}
17677 
17678 
17679 def _doctor_live_port():
17680     """The port THIS server listens on (the live one the probe should hit)."""
17681     try:
17682         return int(os.environ.get("ANCHOR_PORT") or 0) or 8777
17683     except Exception:
17684         return 8777
17685 
17686 
17687 def _doctor_probe_state():
17688     """Read the newest report, explain its issues in plain words
17689     (doctor_plain), re-probe the LIVE server for the GET paths they name,
17690     and decide (``rerun`` / ``session`` / ``nothing``). READ-ONLY — the
17691     shared first half of ``handle_doctor_probe`` (what Doctor does on open)
17692     and ``handle_doctor_resolve_all`` (what the button does)."""
17693     import doctor_plain as _dp
17694     s = _doctor_stats()
17695     explained = _dp.explain_all(s.get("issues") or [], s.get("autofixes") or [])
17696     probe = [_doctor_live_probe(p) for p in _dp.probe_targets(explained)] if explained else []
17697     playbook = [{k: c.get(k) for k in
17698                  ("id", "title", "meaning", "suggested", "verify", "session_advice", "do_not")
17699                  if c.get(k) is not None}
17700                 for c in _dp.match_playbook(explained)]
17701     decision = _dp.decide(explained, probe, playbook)
17702     return s, explained, probe, decision, playbook
17703 
17704 
17705 def handle_doctor_probe(handler, path, body):
17706     """GET /api/doctor/probe — what Doctor does the moment it opens on a red
17707     banner (the r3 Doctor rule, 2026-09-03): a health issue is already a
17708     diagnosis on disk, so READ it, say it in plain words, PROBE the live
17709     server now for the paths it names, and DECIDE — changing nothing here.
17710     The page then re-runs the check by itself when the decision is ``rerun``
17711     (no model, no cost; the banner clears when the report is clean) and
17712     otherwise says what is still wrong and waits for your click — opening a
17713     page never starts a model session. Token-authed by the route row.
17714     Read-only: no re-run, no session, no seed.
17715     """
17716     s, explained, probe, decision, playbook = _doctor_probe_state()
17717     handler._send_json({"ok": True, "decision": decision, "issues": explained,
17718                         "probe": probe, "playbook": playbook,
17719                         "last_run": s.get("last_run"),
17720                         "status": s.get("status")})
17721 
17722 
17723 def handle_doctor_resolve_all(handler, path, body):
17724     """POST /api/doctor/resolve_all — one click for every open issue (John,
17725     2026-09-03). Token-authed by the middleware.
17726 
17727     1. explain the newest report's issues in plain words (doctor_plain);
17728     2. re-probe the LIVE server for the GET paths the issues name;
17729     3. decide: ``rerun`` (every issue was the self-test failing to reach its
17730        target and the live server answers) → start the background health
17731        re-run so the report and the banner say what is true now; ``session``
17732        → hand back ONE all-issues RESOLVE seed the page starts a doctor
17733        session with; ``nothing`` → no open issues.
17734     No model runs here; the receipt is real numbers or absent.
17735     """
17736     import doctor_plain as _dp
17737     s, explained, probe, decision, playbook = _doctor_probe_state()
17738     out = {"ok": True, "decision": decision, "issues": explained, "probe": probe,
17739            "playbook": playbook}
17740     if decision == "rerun":
17741         out["rerun"] = _doctor_start_healthcheck_run()
17742     elif decision == "session":
17743         out["seed_issue"] = {
17744             "issueId": "resolve-all", "component": "all", "all": True,
17745             "message": _dp.resolve_all_seed(explained, probe, decision, playbook),
17746             "suggestedChecks": [],
17747         }
17748     handler._send_json(out)
17749 
17750 
17751 def _doctor_start_healthcheck_run():
17752     """Start the background health re-run (the same launch the Diagnostics
17753     button uses); returns a small receipt dict. Idempotent while live."""
17754     import subprocess
17755     with _DOCTOR_HC_LOCK:
17756         proc = _DOCTOR_HC.get("proc")
17757         if proc is not None and proc.poll() is None:
17758             return {"ok": True, "already_running": True}
17759         log_path = _doctor_hc_log_path()
17760         try:
17761             log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
17762             fh = open(log_path, "wb")
17763         except OSError as exc:
17764             return {"ok": False, "error": "cannot open run log: %s" % exc}
17765         try:
17766             proc = subprocess.Popen(
17767                 _doctor_hc_cmd(), stdout=fh, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
17768                 stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, cwd=str(_paths.data_dir()),
17769                 creationflags=_paths.NO_WINDOW)
17770         except OSError as exc:
17771             fh.close()
17772             return {"ok": False, "error": "failed to launch: %s" % exc}
17773         _DOCTOR_HC["proc"] = proc
17774         _DOCTOR_HC["fh"] = fh
17775         _DOCTOR_HC["started_at"] = time.time()
17776         return {"ok": True, "pid": proc.pid, "log": str(log_path)}
17777 
17778 
17779 def handle_doctor_healthcheck_run(handler, path, body):
17780     # Doctor V3 W3 — launch anchor_healthcheck.py as a BACKGROUND process
17781     # (never the V2 75s synchronous request-thread block). Token-authed by the
17782     # do_POST default-deny middleware BEFORE this runs. Idempotent while live.
17783     import subprocess
17784     with _DOCTOR_HC_LOCK:
17785         proc = _DOCTOR_HC.get("proc")
17786         if proc is not None and proc.poll() is None:
17787             handler._send_json({"ok": True, "already_running": True})
17788             return
17789         log_path = _doctor_hc_log_path()
17790         try:
17791             log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
17792             fh = open(log_path, "wb")
17793         except OSError as exc:
17794             handler._send_json(
17795                 {"ok": False, "error": f"cannot open run log: {exc}"}, 500)
17796             return
17797         try:
17798             proc = subprocess.Popen(
17799                 _doctor_hc_cmd(),
17800                 stdout=fh,
17801                 stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
17802                 stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
17803                 cwd=str(_paths.data_dir()),
17804                 creationflags=_paths.NO_WINDOW,
17805             )
17806         except OSError as exc:
17807             fh.close()
17808             handler._send_json(
17809                 {"ok": False, "error": f"failed to launch: {exc}"}, 500)
17810             return
17811         # The child holds its own inherited handle; the parent's is done.
17812         fh.close()
17813         _DOCTOR_HC["proc"] = proc
17814         _DOCTOR_HC["log"] = str(log_path)
17815         _DOCTOR_HC["started_at"] = time.time()
17816     handler._send_json({"ok": True, "already_running": False})
17817 
17818 
17819 def handle_doctor_healthcheck_tail(handler, path, body):
17820     # Cursor-stable incremental read of the background run's log (?since=
17821     # BYTE offset → {text, next, running, exit_code}). Plain non-blocking
17822     # fetch the page polls ~1s; never holds the request thread. A missing log
17823     # (no run yet) is an honest empty, never a 500.
17824     q = parse_qs(urlparse(handler.path).query)
17825     try:
17826         since = int(q.get("since", ["0"])[0] or 0)
17827     except (TypeError, ValueError):
17828         since = 0
17829     with _DOCTOR_HC_LOCK:
17830         proc = _DOCTOR_HC.get("proc")
17831         log = _DOCTOR_HC.get("log") or str(_doctor_hc_log_path())
17832         started = _DOCTOR_HC.get("started_at")
17833     running = proc is not None and proc.poll() is None
17834     exit_code = None if (proc is None or running) else proc.returncode
17835     text = ""
17836     next_off = since
17837     try:
17838         with open(log, "rb") as f:
17839             f.seek(0, 2)
17840             total = f.tell()
17841             if since < 0 or since > total:
17842                 since = 0  # truncated/new log — clamp, stay stable
17843             f.seek(since)
17844             data = f.read()
17845         text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
17846         next_off = since + len(data)
17847     except OSError:
17848         pass  # no run yet — honest empty tail
17849     handler._send_json({
17850         "ok": True,
17851         "text": text,
17852         "next": next_off,
17853         "running": running,
17854         "exit_code": exit_code,
17855         "started": started is not None,
17856     })
17857

18206   function writePlaybook(p) {

18212   window.resolveAll = function () {

18216     fetch('/api/doctor/resolve_all', { method: 'POST', headers: hdrs(), body: JSON.stringify(token ? { token: token } : {}) })
18217       .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
18218       .then(function (p) {

18257   var REQUESTED_DIAGNOSE = false;

18269         BANNER_ISSUE = {
18270           issueId: issueId || null,
18271           message: message,
18272           exactMessage: message,
18273           component: component,
18274           lastError: lastError,
18275           suggestedChecks: suggestedChecks,
18276           markdownPath: null,
18277           isMarkdownPath: false

18281         if (BANNER_ISSUE.message) term.write('[doctor] message: ' + BANNER_ISSUE.message + '\r\n');
18282         if (BANNER_ISSUE.component) term.write('[doctor] component: ' + BANNER_ISSUE.component + '\r\n');

18291     }
18292   })();
18293 
18294   // (2026-09-03) The r3 Doctor rule: a red banner is already a diagnosis on
18295   // disk. Opening Doctor READS it, PROBES the live server now, and when every
18296   // issue was the 5 AM self-test failing to reach its own copy while the live
18297   // server answers, re-runs the check ITSELF so the banner clears - no click,
18298   // no model. Only a real, still-failing issue waits for you (Resolve all).
18299   var PROBED_ON_OPEN = false;
18300   function probeOnOpen() {
18301     if (PROBED_ON_OPEN) return;
18302     PROBED_ON_OPEN = true;

18309           term.write('[doctor] issue ' + (i + 1) + ': ' + (it.title || 'issue') + '\r\n');
18310         });
18311         (p.probe || []).forEach(function (q) {
18312           term.write('[doctor] live ' + q.path + ': ' + (q.ok ? ('answers (' + q.code + ', ' + q.ms + ' ms)') : ('NO ANSWER - ' + (q.error || ''))) + '\r\n');
18313         });

18322         } else {

18324         }
18325       })

18327   }

18329   // Shell-first: load deterministic status/engine health only. Opening this

18474       ((s.warnings || []).length ? ' ' + s.warnings.join('; ') : '');

18480       else if (s.days_ago === 1) el.textContent = '1 day ago';
18481       else if (s.days_ago == null) el.textContent = (s.last_run ? '' : 'never run');
18482       else el.textContent = s.days_ago + ' days ago';
18483     }

18485     if (el) el.textContent = String(s.report_count == null ? 0 : s.report_count);
18486     var list = document.getElementById('reportsList');
18487     if (list && s.reports) {
18488       if (!s.reports.length) {
18489         list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">No health reports on disk yet.</div>';
18490       } else {
18491         list.innerHTML = s.reports.map(function (r) {
18492           var chip = chipNames[r.status] || 'unreadable';
18493           var href = tq('/doctor/report?name=' + encodeURIComponent(r.name));
18494           return '<a class="report-row" target="_blank" href="' + href + '">'
18495             + '<span class="dot ' + r.status + '"></span>'
18496             + '<span class="rr-date">' + r.date + '</span>'
18497             + '<span class="rr-chip ' + r.status + '">' + chip + '</span></a>';

18502   function refreshStats() {
18503     fetch(tq('/api/doctor/status'), { headers: getHdrs() })
18504       .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
18505       .then(function (s) { if (s && s.ok) setCards(s); })
18506       .catch(function () {});
18507   }
18508   // Read-only refresh catches reports produced by a Doctor session or the
18509   // scheduled checker too, not just this tab's diagnostics button.
18510   setInterval(function () { if (!document.hidden) refreshStats(); }, 15000);
18511   window.addEventListener('focus', refreshStats);
18512   var polling = false;
18513   function pollDone() {
18514     polling = false;
18515     var btn = document.getElementById('runBtn');
18516     btn.disabled = false;
18517     btn.textContent = 'Run diagnostics';
18518     refreshStats();
18519   }
18520   function pollTail(since, initial) {
18521     if (polling) return;
18522     polling = true;
18523     (function step(cursor) {
18524       var request = initial ? Promise.resolve(initial) :
18525         fetch(tq('/api/doctor/healthcheck_tail?since=' + cursor), { headers: getHdrs() }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); });
18526       initial = null;
18527       request
18528         .then(function (p) {
18529           var out = document.getElementById('hcout');
18530           if (p && p.ok) {
18531             if (p.text) { out.textContent += p.text; out.scrollTop = out.scrollHeight; }
18532             if (p.running) { setTimeout(function () { step(p.next); }, 1000); return; }
18533             out.textContent += '\n[diagnostics finished' + (p.exit_code == null ? '' : ', exit ' + p.exit_code) + ']\n';
18534           }
18535           pollDone();
18536         })
18537         .catch(function () { pollDone(); });
18538     })(since);
18539   }
18540   window.runDiagnostics = function () {
18541     var out = document.getElementById('hcout');
18542     out.style.display = 'block';
18543     var body = {};
18544     if (token) body.token = token;
18545     fetch('/api/doctor/healthcheck_run', { method: 'POST', headers: hdrs(), body: JSON.stringify(body) })
18546       .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
18547       .then(function (p) {
18548         if (!p || !p.ok) {
18549           out.textContent += '\n[doctor] run failed: ' + ((p && p.error) || 'unknown') + '\n';
18550           return;
18551         }
18552         if (!p.already_running) out.textContent = '';
18553         var btn = document.getElementById('runBtn');
18554         btn.disabled = true;
18555         btn.textContent = 'Running…';
18556         pollTail(0);
18557       })
18558       .catch(function (e) { out.textContent += '\n[doctor] run failed: ' + e + '\n'; });
18559   };
18560 })();
18561 </script>
18562 </body>
18563 </html>"""

18566 def render_doctor_page_html():
18567     """The /doctor page — Anchor's own visual idiom, REAL values only.
18568 
18569     Server-renders the stat cards + reports list from :func:`_doctor_stats`;
18570     the terminal panel and diagnostics tail are wired by the page JS against
18571     the Wave-2 session endpoint and the background-run endpoints. Built by
18572     ``str.replace`` over a raw template — never an f-string (the V2 bug class).
18573     """
18574     s = _doctor_stats()
18575     esc = html_lib.escape
18576     if s["reports"]:
18577         chip_names = {"red": "issues", "yellow": "warnings", "green": "healthy"}
18578         rows = []
18579         for r in s["reports"]:
18580             chip = chip_names.get(r["status"], "unreadable")
18581             rows.append(
18582                 '<a class="report-row" target="_blank"'
18583                 ' href="/doctor/report?name=%s">'
18584                 '<span class="dot %s"></span>'
18585                 '<span class="rr-date">%s</span>'
18586                 '<span class="rr-chip %s">%s</span></a>'
18587                 % (url_quote(r["name"]), esc(r["status"]), esc(r["date"]),
18588                    esc(r["status"]), esc(chip)))
18589         reports_html = "".join(rows)
18590     else:
18591         reports_html = (
18592             '<div class="empty">No health reports on disk yet &mdash; run '
18593             'diagnostics now, or wait for the daily 5 AM check.</div>')
18594     if s["days_ago"] is None:
18595         ago = "" if s["last_run"] else "never run"
18596     elif s["days_ago"] == 0:
18597         ago = "today"
18598     elif s["days_ago"] == 1:
18599         ago = "1 day ago"
18600     else:
18601         ago = "%d days ago" % s["days_ago"]
18602     page = _DOCTOR_PAGE_TEMPLATE
18603     for key, value in (
18604         ("__STATUS_CLASS__", esc(s["status"])),
18605         ("__STATUS_TEXT__", esc(s["status_text"])),
18606         ("__STATUS_DETAIL__", esc(s["status_detail"])),
18607         ("__LAST_RUN__", esc(s["last_run"] or "—")),
18608         ("__LAST_AGO__", esc(ago)),
18609         ("__REPORT_COUNT__", str(s["report_count"])),
18610         ("__REPORTS_LIST__", reports_html),
18611         ("__ISSUES_BLOCK__", _doctor_issues_block_html(s)),
18612         ("__ISSUES_JSON__", json.dumps(s.get("issues") or [])),
18613         ("__ANCHOR_MARK__", _anchor_mark(26)),
18614     ):
18615         page = page.replace(key, value)
18616     return page

18619 def _doctor_issues_block_html(s):
18620     """The lead panel: what the last health run FOUND, with one-click
18621     resolve. Empty string when the latest report is clean."""
18622     issues = s.get("issues") or []
18623     if not issues:
18624         return ""
18625     # (2026-09-03, John) plain words first — a title and one sentence of
18626     # meaning — with the raw report line behind a disclosure, never lost.
18627     import doctor_plain as _dp
18628     explained = _dp.explain_all(issues, s.get("autofixes") or [])
18629     rows = []
18630     for i, ex in enumerate(explained):
18631         title = html_lib.escape(ex.get("title") or "issue")
18632         meaning = html_lib.escape(ex.get("meaning") or "")
18633         raw = html_lib.escape(ex.get("raw") or "")
18634         rows.append(
18635             '<div class="issue-row" style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:'
18636             'flex-start;margin:8px 0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45">'
18637             f'<div style="flex:1"><b>{title}</b>'
18638             f'<div style="color:#b7bcc7;margin-top:2px">{meaning}</div>'
18639             '<details style="margin-top:3px"><summary style="cursor:pointer;'
18640             'font-size:11.5px;color:#8b8f9a">what the check said</summary>'
18641             f'<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:#8b8f9a;white-space:pre-wrap;'
18642             f'word-break:break-word;margin-top:3px">{raw}</div></details></div>'
18643             f'<button class="btn" onclick="resolveIssue({i})" '
18644             'style="flex:none">Resolve this</button></div>')
18645     n = len(explained)
18646     return (
18647         '<div class="card panel" style="border-color:#b45309">'
18648         '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px">'
18649         '<h3 style="color:#e0a437;margin:0;flex:1">Found by the last health run'
18650         f' <span style="color:#8b8f9a;font-weight:400">({n})</span></h3>'
18651         '<button class="btn" id="resolveAllBtn" onclick="resolveAll()" '
18652         'style="flex:none;background:#b45309;border-color:#b45309" '
18653         'title="Re-probe the live server now; if all is well, re-run the check '
18654         'so the banner clears; otherwise one doctor session takes every issue">'
18655         'Resolve all</button></div>'
18656         + "".join(rows)
18657         + '<div class="hint">Parsed from the newest report — no model was '
18658           'run to show this. "Resolve all" re-probes the live server, then '
18659           'either re-runs the check (nothing was wrong) or opens ONE doctor '
18660           'session for every issue and runs it. "Resolve this" takes one '
18661           'issue and runs it.</div></div>')

18664 def handle_term_input2(handler, path, body):
18665     # POST-in half of the SSE-out + POST-in fallback transport. Authed by
18666     # the middleware above.
18667     session = (body.get("session", "") or "").strip()
18668     data = body.get("data", "")
18669     if not session:
18670         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "session required"}, 400)
18671     elif len(str(data)) > _term.MAX_TURN_CHARS:
18672         # INPUT CAP (2026-07-26 hardening, P0.3). The legacy REPL endpoint has
18673         # capped turns since v2; this ConPTY path had NO length guard, so the
18674         # iPad dictation blow-up (each utterance re-sending everything said so
18675         # far) could pin the PTY with an unbounded write. The client-side
18676         # composition guard is the fix; this is the backstop that keeps a
18677         # runaway input from reaching the terminal at all.
18678         handler._send_json(
18679             {"ok": False,
18680              "error": f"turn too large ({len(str(data))} chars > "
18681                       f"{_term.MAX_TURN_CHARS}); refusing to write it to the PTY",
18682              "reason": "turn-too-large"}, 413)
18683     else:
18684         out = _termsess.input(session, data)
18685         if out.get("ok"):
18686             handler._send_json({"ok": True})
18687         else:
18688             handler._send_json({"ok": False,
18689                              "error": f"unknown session: {session}",
18690                              "reason": "unknown-session"}, 404)
18691

18693 def handle_journal_friction(handler, path, body):
18694     """Capture ONE friction/problem/concern the user just hit (2026-07-26).
18695 
18696     The user's words are stored verbatim; context (project/session/lane/route/
18697     engine/version + recent error lines) is attached automatically so nobody has
18698     to type it. ZERO model calls — the moment of friction is exactly when the
18699     engines are down, wedged, or burning money.
18700     """
18701     import friction_journal as _fj
18702     title = (body.get("title", "") or "").strip()
18703     if not title:
18704         handler._send_json(
18705             {"ok": False, "error": "title required (one line: what hurt?)"}, 400)
18706         return
18707     try:
18708         rec = _fj.capture(
18709             title,
18710             body=body.get("body", "") or "",
18711             severity=body.get("severity", _fj.DEFAULT_SEVERITY),
18712             project_id=body.get("project_id"),
18713             session_id=body.get("session_id"),
18714             lane=body.get("lane"),
18715             route=body.get("route"),
18716             engine=body.get("engine"),
18717         )
18718     except _fj.FrictionJournalError as e:
18719         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(e)}, 400)
18720         return
18721     except Exception as e:  # capture must never 500 on the user
18722         _logger.error("journal_friction failed: %s", e)
18723         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "could not write the record"}, 500)
18724         return
18725     handler._send_json({"ok": True, "record": _fj.safe_projection(rec)})
18726

18730     import friction_journal as _fj

18742 def handle_answer_gate(handler, path, body):
18743     # Answer a pending in-session gate through the supervisor seam
18744     # (rearch W15): the answer is durably QUEUED + ACKed to the job dir
18745     # BEFORE this POST returns, then delivered to the session's stdin
18746     # supervisor-side — exactly once, retryable across a killed hop.
18747     # ``written`` is kept for the legacy endpoint contract (== delivered).
18748     job_id = body.get("job_id", "")
18749     choice = body.get("choice", "")
18750     res = _sup.get_supervisor().answer_gate(job_id, choice)
18751     handler._send_json({
18752         "ok": bool(res.get("ok")) and bool(res.get("delivered")),
18753         "written": bool(res.get("delivered")),
18754         "delivered": bool(res.get("delivered")),
18755         "deferred": bool(res.get("deferred")),
18756         "queued": bool(res.get("queued")),
18757         "reason": res.get("reason"),
18758         "job_id": res.get("job_id"),
18759     })
18760

18762 def handle_cancel_job(handler, path, body):
18763     # Stop a running job (tree-kill via job_runner.cancel). Acts on the
18764     # job_id supplied by the ATTACHED console session only — the caller
18765     # passes the exact job_id, so two concurrent sessions never cross-
18766     # wire. A clean 404 for an unknown id; auth is already enforced by the
18767     # middleware above (this is a mutating POST).
18768     job_id = (body.get("job_id", "") or "").strip()
18769     rec = _jr.load_record(job_id) if job_id else None
18770     if rec is None:
18771         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": f"unknown job: {job_id}",
18772                          "reason": "unknown-job"}, 404)
18773     else:
18774         # rearch W15: cancel through the supervisor seam (it owns the
18775         # process tree). Tree-kill is idempotent; a re-cancel no-ops.
18776         out = _sup.get_supervisor().cancel(job_id)
18777         handler._send_json({
18778             "ok": True,
18779             "job_id": job_id,
18780             "status": (out or {}).get("status"),
18781         })
18782

18819 def handle_continue_session(handler, path, body):
18820     # v5 Wave 2: open a NEW live session in the SAME lane as a DONE/
18821     # historical session, SEEDED with that prior session's context (its
18822     # cached summary, else a deterministic digest of its members). The
18823     # ORIGINAL session/registry record is NEVER mutated (Risk R2) — we
18824     # only READ it. Reuses terminal_session.start_session(seed_context=…)
18825     # (the Wave-1 seed path), so the new session's single opening turn
18826     # loads the lane skill AND carries the prior context. Auth enforced by
18827     # the do_POST middleware above (mutating/terminal).
18828     pid = (body.get("project_id", "") or body.get("id", "")).strip()
18829     lane = (body.get("lane", "") or "").strip()
18830     source = (body.get("source_session", "")
18831               or body.get("session", "") or "").strip()
18832     # Settings-backed default: continuing a past session opens a NEW session;
18833     # default it to default_cli rather than the project's sticky last_engine
18834     # (which could be another engine from an unrelated toggle). Explicit
18835     # backend in the body still wins; other engines stay reachable via the toggle.
18836     backend = ((body.get("backend", "") or "").strip()
18837                or _aset.get_default_cli())
18838     if not pid or not lane or not source:
18839         handler._send_json(
18840             {"ok": False,
18841              "error": "project_id, lane and source_session required"},
18842             400)
18843     else:
18844         proj = _rnd.get_project(pid)
18845         if proj is None:
18846             handler._send_json({"ok": False,
18847                              "error": "Unknown project"}, 404)
18848         else:
18849             folder = proj.get("folder_path", "")
18850             seed_context = _build_continue_seed(
18851                 folder, pid, lane, source)
18852             # telemetry-resume W6 — the eviction sub-contract (NORTH-STAR-
18853             # AMENDMENT): an EVICTED-parked source (worktree reaped, docs persisted
18854             # to main) resumes as a NEW seeded session whose orientation opens with
18855             # an explicit 'resumed from persisted docs (worktree evicted)' line —
18856             # the UI NEVER claims a reattach it cannot perform. The replacement
18857             # joins the SAME chain via parent_session_id below.
18858             evicted = False
18859             try:
18860                 src_rec = _termsess.get_session(source) or {}
18861                 evicted = bool(src_rec.get("evicted")) or (
18862                     _sessreg.is_parked_warm(src_rec)
18863                     and not (src_rec.get("worktree_path") or "").strip())
18864             except Exception:
18865                 evicted = False
18866             if evicted:
18867                 note = ("(resumed from persisted docs (worktree evicted))\n")
18868                 seed_context = note + (seed_context or "")
18869             try:
18870                 # Join the SAME chain as the source (lineage continuity across
18871                 # resume/eviction) via parent_session_id; an unknown source id
18872                 # harmlessly resets to its own chain (start_session guard).
18873                 if backend:
18874                     rec = _termsess.start_session(
18875                         pid, lane, backend=backend,
18876                         seed_context=seed_context, parent_session_id=source)
18877                 else:
18878                     rec = _termsess.start_session(
18879                         pid, lane, seed_context=seed_context,
18880                         parent_session_id=source)
18881             except _termsess.TerminalSessionError as exc:
18882                 handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, 400)
18883             else:
18884                 handler._send_json({"ok": True, "session": rec,
18885                                  "seeded_from": source, "evicted": evicted})

18888 def handle_resume_live(handler, path, body):
18889     # telemetry-resume W6 — the Layer-2 '▶ Resume live' escalation, routed by tile
18890     # class on the SERVER (so the per-class contract is one testable decision, not
18891     # scattered client logic). Cites the NORTH-STAR-AMENDMENT click contract +
18892     # eviction sub-contract:
18893     #   * RUNNING            → focus the already-live session (mode 'already-live').
18894     #   * parked-idle        → WARM REATTACH: relaunch a PTY in the RETAINED
18895     #                          worktree under the same id (mode 'reattach').
18896     #   * evicted-parked     → NEW seeded session on the SAME chain, seed opens with
18897     #                          'resumed from persisted docs (worktree evicted)'
18898     #                          (mode 'continue', evicted:true) — NEVER a reattach.
18899     #   * done/failed/discovered/one-shot job → the W3/W4 continue-seed path
18900     #                          (mode 'continue') on the SAME chain.
18901     # Auth: the do_POST token middleware gates this (mutating).
18902     pid = (body.get("project_id", "") or body.get("id", "")).strip()
18903     lane = (body.get("lane", "") or "").strip()
18904     source = (body.get("source_session", "")
18905               or body.get("session", "") or "").strip()
18906     backend = ((body.get("backend", "") or "").strip()
18907                or _aset.get_default_cli())
18908     if not pid or not source:
18909         handler._send_json({"ok": False,
18910                          "error": "project_id and source_session required"}, 400)
18911         return
18912     proj = _rnd.get_project(pid)
18913     if proj is None:
18914         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Unknown project"}, 404)
18915         return
18916     folder = proj.get("folder_path", "")
18917     try:
18918         src_rec = _termsess.get_session(source) or {}
18919     except Exception:
18920         src_rec = {}
18921     if not lane:
18922         lane = (src_rec.get("lane") or "").strip()
18923     # RUNNING → focus the existing live session (no new spawn).
18924     import pty_manager as _pty
18925     is_truly_live = False
18926     if src_rec.get("status") == _sessreg.STATUS_RUNNING:
18927         with _pty._TABLE_LOCK:
18928             is_truly_live = source in _pty._LIVE
18929 
18930     if src_rec.get("status") == _sessreg.STATUS_RUNNING and is_truly_live:
18931         handler._send_json({"ok": True, "mode": "already-live",
18932                          "session": _safe_session_projection(src_rec)})
18933         return
18934     # parked-idle (retained worktree) → warm reattach in place.
18935     is_parked = _sessreg.is_parked_warm(src_rec)
18936     has_worktree = bool((src_rec.get("worktree_path") or "").strip())
18937     if is_parked and has_worktree and not src_rec.get("evicted"):
18938         res = _termsess.resume_parked_session(source)
18939         if res.get("ok"):
18940             handler._send_json({"ok": True, "mode": res.get("mode", "reattach"),
18941                              "session": _safe_session_projection(
18942                                  res.get("session") or {})})
18943             return
18944         # A reattach that couldn't happen (evicted mid-flight) falls through to
18945         # the continue path below — honest, never a false reattach claim.
18946     # Everything else (evicted / done / failed / discovered) → continue-seed a NEW
18947     # session on the SAME chain (reuse the continue handler's exact policy).
18948     handle_continue_session(handler, path, {
18949         "project_id": pid, "lane": lane or (src_rec.get("lane") or ""),
18950         "source_session": source, "backend": backend})
18951 
18952 
18953 def _safe_session_projection(rec):
18954     """SAFE session projection for a Layer-2 escalation response — NEVER leaks
18955     ``worktree_path``/``branch`` (the board-projection discipline)."""
18956     rec = rec if isinstance(rec, dict) else {}
18957     return {
18958         "session_id": rec.get("session_id", ""),
18959         "lane": rec.get("lane", ""),
18960         "backend": rec.get("backend", ""),
18961         "status": rec.get("status", ""),
18962         "label": rec.get("label", ""),
18963         "chain_id": rec.get("chain_id", ""),
18964         "parent_session_id": rec.get("parent_session_id", ""),
18965         "evicted": bool(rec.get("evicted", False)),
18966     }

18969 def handle_orient_session(handler, path, body):
18970     # telemetry-resume W6 — the read-only plan-mode ORIENTATION trigger (the
18971     # Phase-0 orientation fork, NORTH-STAR-AMENDMENT). On a Layer-2 escalation the
18972     # orientation narration AUTO-EXECUTES as a read-only ``permission_mode='plan'``
18973     # one-shot job through job_runner (the Gandalf-shard substrate) — it prints
18974     # what was done / produced / next, and can NEVER edit the tree. It is NEVER a
18975     # seeded turn on the live PTY, and any ACTION prompt stays v10 paste-NOT-submit
18976     # (nothing is auto-submitted). Returns the launched job id so the client can
18977     # tail its output into the terminal chrome.
18978     #   POST /api/rnd/orient_session  {project_id, lane, session}
18979     # Auth: the do_POST token middleware gates this (mutating — it launches a job).
18980     pid = (body.get("project_id", "") or body.get("id", "")).strip()
18981     lane = (body.get("lane", "") or "").strip()
18982     session_id = (body.get("session", "")
18983                   or body.get("source_session", "") or "").strip()
18984     if not pid or not session_id:
18985         handler._send_json({"ok": False,
18986                          "error": "project_id and session required"}, 400)
18987         return
18988     proj = _rnd.get_project(pid)
18989     if proj is None:
18990         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Unknown project"}, 404)
18991         return
18992     folder = proj.get("folder_path", "")
18993     if not lane:
18994         try:
18995             lane = (_termsess.get_session(session_id) or {}).get("lane", "")
18996         except Exception:
18997             lane = ""
18998     try:
18999         import orientation as _orient
19000         out = _orient.orient_session(pid, lane, session_id, folder_path=folder)
19001     except Exception as exc:
19002         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, 500)
19003         return
19004     if out.get("ok"):
19005         handler._send_json({"ok": True, "job_id": out.get("job_id"),
19006                          "permission_mode": out.get("permission_mode"),
19007                          "owned_until": out.get("owned_until")})
19008     else:
19009         handler._send_json({"ok": False,
19010                          "reason": out.get("reason", "orient-failed")}, 400)

19013 def handle_advance_session(handler, path, body):
19014     # v6 Wave 5: MANUAL advance research → planning. Starts a NEW live
19015     # session in ``to_lane`` (defaults 'planning' for a research source),
19016     # LINKED to the source via ``parent_session_id`` (so it inherits the
19017     # source's ``chain_id`` — see session_registry.start_session / Wave 2),
19018     # and SEEDED with the source session's grounded summary/report context.
19019     # The seed is built by the SAME read-only _build_continue_seed helper
19020     # (its cached summary, else a member digest), so the SOURCE session /
19021     # registry record is NEVER mutated — we only READ it. Returns the new
19022     # session record in the same JSON shape as continue_session. Auth is
19023     # enforced by the do_POST token middleware above (mutating/terminal).
19024     pid = (body.get("project_id", "") or body.get("id", "")).strip()
19025     source = (body.get("source_session", "")
19026               or body.get("session", "") or "").strip()
19027     to_lane = (body.get("to_lane", "") or "").strip() or "planning"
19028     backend = (body.get("backend", "") or "").strip() or None
19029     if not pid or not source:
19030         handler._send_json(
19031             {"ok": False,
19032              "error": "project_id and source_session required"},
19033             400)
19034     else:
19035         proj = _rnd.get_project(pid)
19036         if proj is None:
19037             handler._send_json({"ok": False,
19038                              "error": "Unknown project"}, 404)
19039         elif (_termsess.get_session(source) or {}).get("effort_managed"):
19040             # v12 Wave 7 — RETIREMENT MAP (Shark C2/C3): a v12 EFFORT
19041             # advances IN-SESSION via /api/rnd/advance_stage; the legacy
19042             # research→plan advance must mint NOTHING for it. Early-return
19043             # so the effort's session-id set is unchanged. Gate on the
19044             # SOURCE session's ``effort_managed`` ONLY (never lane/kind).
19045             # Legacy records (False) fall through to the full v6/v11
19046             # advance path below, unchanged.
19047             handler._send_json(
19048                 {"ok": False, "session": None,
19049                  "reason": "effort-managed-use-advance-stage"}, 409)
19050         else:
19051             folder = proj.get("folder_path", "")
19052             # Resolve the SOURCE session's lane for the seed lookup. The
19053             # seed reads the source's CACHED summary in ITS lane; default
19054             # to 'research' (the only source this wave advances).
19055             src_lane = "research"
19056             try:
19057                 for r in _termsess.list_sessions(project_id=pid):
19058                     if r.get("session_id") == source:
19059                         src_lane = r.get("lane") or src_lane
19060                         break
19061             except Exception:
19062                 pass
19063             # v11 Wave 2 — THE user-facing fix: route research→plan through
19064             # the SHARED handoff KEYSTONE (terminal_session.prepare_stage_
19065             # handoff), mirroring finish_to_build's capture-before-advance.
19066             # The keystone (a) PERSISTS the live source session's produced
19067             # docs into the MAIN project (copy + commit to main HEAD,
19068             # session-tagged efforts — best-effort, idempotent, never raises)
19069             # so they ride into the planning worktree (checked out off main
19070             # HEAD); (b) BUILDS the REAL doc-referencing prompt (names the
19071             # actual persisted paths + "read these first, then plan" + load
19072             # Crucible — honest minimal only when there are genuinely no
19073             # docs, never fabricated); (c) resolves doc_rels + skill + the
19074             # source's cached summary for HANDOFF.md. This is the fix for the
19075             # reported failure: the pre-v11 path NEVER persisted the live
19076             # research docs, so the prompt was a bare "load Crucible" with no
19077             # paths and no HANDOFF.md.
19078             hk = _termsess.prepare_stage_handoff(pid, source, to_lane)
19079             # v11 honesty guard: if the keystone could NOT resolve the
19080             # source session (ok=False → no record / unknown id → empty
19081             # prompt + empty doc_rels), do NOT mint an orphan planning
19082             # session with an empty paste. Return an honest error instead
19083             # (matching the honest-degradation discipline). The
19084             # no-DOCS-but-valid-source path keeps ok=True and proceeds with
19085             # the honest minimal prompt — only the source-unresolvable case
19086             # is guarded here.
19087             if not hk.get("ok"):
19088                 handler._send_json(
19089                     {"ok": False,
19090                      "error": "could not resolve source session"}, 400)
19091                 return
19092             # The reviewable TASK PROMPT is delivered as a PENDING PASTE
19093             # (held in the new PTY input UNSENT until the user presses
19094             # Enter — paste-NOT-submit, unchanged). The grounded summary
19095             # context still seeds phase-1 (load+greet) so the model greets
19096             # with prior context. Best-effort: an empty prompt → falls back
19097             # to today's seed-context-only path (honest, no fabrication).
19098             seed_context = _build_continue_seed(
19099                 folder, pid, src_lane, source)
19100             paste = (hk.get("prompt", "") or "").strip() or None
19101             try:
19102                 if backend:
19103                     rec = _termsess.start_session(
19104                         pid, to_lane, backend=backend,
19105                         seed_context=seed_context,
19106                         paste_prompt=paste,
19107                         parent_session_id=source)
19108                 else:
19109                     rec = _termsess.start_session(
19110                         pid, to_lane, seed_context=seed_context,
19111                         paste_prompt=paste,
19112                         parent_session_id=source)
19113             except _termsess.TerminalSessionError as exc:
19114                 handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, 400)
19115             else:
19116                 # The planning worktree now EXISTS (off main HEAD, which the
19117                 # keystone just committed the research docs to). Write BOTH
19118                 # durable artifacts into it: the real HANDOFF.md (lists the
19119                 # persisted upstream doc paths + the Crucible skill + the
19120                 # source's cached summary) AND NEXT-PROMPT.md (the reviewable
19121                 # pasted prompt). Then record the research->plan stage edge.
19122                 # All best-effort — a write hiccup never strands the advance.
19123                 new_wt = rec.get("worktree_path", "")
19124                 new_sid = rec.get("session_id", "")
19125                 if new_wt:
19126                     try:
19127                         _handoff.write_handoff_md(
19128                             new_wt, hk.get("doc_rels", []),
19129                             hk.get("skill", "") or "Crucible",
19130                             hk.get("summary_text", ""))
19131                     except Exception:
19132                         pass
19133                     if paste:
19134                         try:
19135                             _handoff.write_next_prompt(new_wt, paste)
19136                         except Exception:
19137                             pass
19138                 try:
19139                     _handoff.record_stage_link(
19140                         folder, pid, source, new_sid,
19141                         kind="research->plan")
19142                 except Exception:
19143                     pass
19144                 handler._send_json({"ok": True, "session": rec,
19145                                  "advanced_from": source,
19146                                  "to_lane": to_lane,
19147                                  "persisted": hk.get("persisted", [])})
19148

19150 def handle_advance_stage(handler, path, body):
19151     # v12 Wave 6: in-session "Advance" = relabel + save. Keeps the SAME
19152     # session (no new session minted, NOTHING injected into the PTY by
19153     # default): terminal_session.advance_stage persists+summarizes the
19154     # current stage (Wave 5, no reap) and flips current_stage to the next
19155     # trio stage. Auth is enforced by the do_POST token middleware above.
19156     session = (body.get("session", "")
19157                or body.get("session_id", "") or "").strip()
19158     to_stage = (body.get("to_stage", "") or "").strip() or None
19159     pid = (body.get("project_id", "") or body.get("id", "")).strip() or None
19160     if not session:
19161         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "session required"}, 400)
19162     elif _termsess.get_session(session) is None:
19163         handler._send_json({"ok": False,
19164                          "error": f"unknown session: {session}",
19165                          "reason": "unknown-session"}, 404)
19166     else:
19167         out = _termsess.advance_stage(
19168             session, to_stage=to_stage, mode="manual", project_id=pid)
19169         rec = out.get("record")
19170         # SAFE projection of the updated record — NEVER worktree_path /
19171         # branch (those must not leak into the page).
19172         safe = None
19173         if isinstance(rec, dict):
19174             safe = {
19175                 "session_id": rec.get("session_id", ""),
19176                 "project_id": rec.get("project_id", ""),
19177                 "lane": rec.get("lane", ""),
19178                 "status": rec.get("status", ""),
19179                 "label": rec.get("label", ""),
19180                 "kind": rec.get("kind", ""),
19181                 "current_stage": rec.get("current_stage", ""),
19182                 "effort_id": rec.get("effort_id", ""),
19183                 "effort_managed": rec.get("effort_managed", False),
19184                 # project stage_history to SAFE fields — drop baseline_ref
19185                 # (a git SHA) + store_lane (Reviewer W6-R2-05).
19186                 "stage_history": [
19187                     {"stage": e.get("stage", ""),
19188                      "state": e.get("state", ""),
19189                      "started_at": e.get("started_at"),
19190                      "ended_at": e.get("ended_at"),
19191                      "doc_count": e.get("doc_count", 0),
19192                      "summary_ref": e.get("summary_ref")}
19193                     for e in (rec.get("stage_history") or [])
19194                     if isinstance(e, dict)
19195                 ],
19196             }
19197         handler._send_json({"ok": bool(out.get("ok")),
19198                          "advanced": bool(out.get("advanced")),
19199                          "reason": out.get("reason"),
19200                          "from_stage": out.get("from_stage"),
19201                          "to_stage": out.get("to_stage"),
19202                          "session": safe},
19203                         200 if out.get("ok") else 400)

19206 def handle_handoff_to_fresh(handler, path, body):
19207     # v12 Wave 8: the context-relief valve. Continue the effort in a FRESH
19208     # session that JOINS the same effort (same effort_id / tile / lineage),
19209     # carrying the prior stage's docs + the real next prompt forward via the
19210     # v11.1 machinery — held as a PENDING PASTE (UNSENT; NOTHING
19211     # auto-submitted). The old session's stage is closed (done); its
19212     # worktree is NOT reaped. Auth is enforced by the do_POST token
19213     # middleware above (mutating).
19214     session = (body.get("session", "")
19215                or body.get("session_id", "")
19216                or body.get("effort_id", "")).strip()
19217     pid = (body.get("project_id", "") or body.get("id", "")).strip() or None
19218     if not session:
19219         handler._send_json(
19220             {"ok": False,
19221              "error": "session or effort_id required"}, 400)
19222     else:
19223         out = _termsess.handoff_to_fresh(session, project_id=pid)
19224         if not out.get("ok"):
19225             code = 404 if out.get("reason") == "unknown-session" else 400
19226             handler._send_json({"ok": False,
19227                              "reason": out.get("reason"),
19228                              "error": out.get("reason", "handoff failed")},
19229                             code)
19230         else:
19231             new_rec = out.get("new_session") or {}
19232             old_rec = out.get("old_session") or {}
19233 
19234             def _safe(rec):
19235                 # SAFE projection — NEVER worktree_path / branch.
19236                 if not isinstance(rec, dict):
19237                     return None
19238                 return {
19239                     "session_id": rec.get("session_id", ""),
19240                     "project_id": rec.get("project_id", ""),
19241                     "lane": rec.get("lane", ""),
19242                     "status": rec.get("status", ""),
19243                     "kind": rec.get("kind", ""),
19244                     "current_stage": rec.get("current_stage", ""),
19245                     "effort_id": rec.get("effort_id", ""),
19246                     "effort_managed": rec.get("effort_managed", False),
19247                     "parent_session_id": rec.get("parent_session_id", ""),
19248                     "chain_id": rec.get("chain_id", ""),
19249                     "pending_paste": rec.get("pending_paste", ""),
19250                     "paste_flushed": rec.get("paste_flushed", False),
19251                 }
19252 
19253             handler._send_json({
19254                 "ok": True,
19255                 "effort_id": out.get("effort_id", ""),
19256                 "new_session": _safe(new_rec),
19257                 "old_session": _safe(old_rec),
19258                 "persisted": out.get("persisted", []),
19259             })

19262 def handle_finish_to_build(handler, path, body):
19263     # v6 Wave 9 (polish 1): EXPLICIT, NON-DESTRUCTIVE plan→build advance.
19264     # Mirrors the term_kill auto-advance trigger, but WITHOUT reaping the
19265     # planning session's worktree: it stays a reopenable, finished tile
19266     # (close-to-tile philosophy). Steps:
19267     #   1. capture the plan set NOW (before any reap) via capture_plan_set;
19268     #   2. mark THIS planning session DONE via session_registry
19269     #      .update_session(status=STATUS_DONE) — NOT kill() (worktree kept);
19270     #   3. auto_advance_planning_to_build(..., plan_set=…) — idempotent on
19271     #      parent_session_id, so a second call never duplicates the build.
19272     # No plan set ⇒ {ok:true, auto_build:null, reason:"no plan set yet"} so
19273     # the UI can be honest (never a fabricated build). Auth is enforced by
19274     # the do_POST token middleware above (mutating).
19275     pid = (body.get("project_id", "") or body.get("id", "")).strip()
19276     session = (body.get("session", "")
19277                or body.get("source_session", "") or "").strip()
19278     if not pid or not session:
19279         handler._send_json(
19280             {"ok": False,
19281              "error": "project_id and session required"}, 400)
19282     else:
19283         rec = _termsess.get_session(session)
19284         if rec is None:
19285             handler._send_json({"ok": False,
19286                              "error": f"unknown session: {session}",
19287                              "reason": "unknown-session"}, 404)
19288         elif rec.get("lane") not in _termsess._PLANNING_LANES:
19289             handler._send_json(
19290                 {"ok": False,
19291                  "error": "finish→build applies only to a planning "
19292                           "session",
19293                  "reason": "not-planning"}, 400)
19294         elif rec.get("effort_managed"):
19295             # v12 Wave 7 — RETIREMENT MAP (Shark C2/C3): a v12 EFFORT
19296             # advances IN-SESSION via /api/rnd/advance_stage; the legacy
19297             # finish→build path must mint NOTHING for it. Early-return
19298             # (no persist-DONE-mark, no auto-advance) so the effort's
19299             # session-id set is unchanged. Gate on ``effort_managed``
19300             # ONLY (never lane/kind). Legacy records (False) fall through
19301             # to the full v6 finish→build path below, unchanged.
19302             handler._send_json(
19303                 {"ok": False, "auto_build": None,
19304                  "reason": "effort-managed-use-advance-stage"}, 409)
19305         else:
19306             # 0) v11 Wave 3 — route the persist through the SHARED keystone
19307             #    (:func:`prepare_stage_handoff`), unifying this path with
19308             #    research→plan + auto-advance. The keystone PERSISTS the
19309             #    planning session's produced docs into the MAIN project (copy
19310             #    + commit to main HEAD, session-tagged efforts — best-effort,
19311             #    idempotent, never raises) WITHOUT reaping the worktree, so the
19312             #    planning session stays a reopenable finished tile (v6
19313             #    non-destructive finish semantics preserved). This is the
19314             #    North-Star hole fix (the finish→build path marks the session
19315             #    DONE via update_session WITHOUT kill(), so persist is NOT
19316             #    otherwise run — the plan docs authored in the planning
19317             #    worktree would never reach main, and the build worktree
19318             #    created off main HEAD by auto_advance would lack the
19319             #    HANDOFF.md/NEXT-PROMPT.md referenced paths). It is ALSO what
19320             #    makes the just-authored plan set DISCOVERABLE to the
19321             #    capture_plan_set() below: discovery reads the session-tagged
19322             #    effort pointer-records the persist creates, so the persist
19323             #    MUST run here, before capture, on the worktree-only finish
19324             #    flow (the docs are not yet on main / not yet recorded as
19325             #    efforts otherwise). The build prompt itself is (re)built by
19326             #    auto_advance_planning_to_build through the SAME keystone
19327             #    (idempotent re-persist), so there is ONE persist+prompt
19328             #    mechanism across every advance path.
19329             try:
19330                 _termsess.prepare_stage_handoff(pid, session, "build")
19331             except Exception:
19332                 pass
19333             # 1) Capture the plan set AFTER persisting (so the just-authored
19334             #    plan docs are now on main HEAD and discoverable). No reap
19335             #    here, so the worktree survives either way.
19336             plan_set = _termsess.capture_plan_set(pid, session)
19337             if not plan_set:
19338                 # Honest: no plan set yet ⇒ no build (worktree untouched;
19339                 # the session stays exactly as it was — we do NOT mark it
19340                 # done if there is nothing to advance to).
19341                 handler._send_json({"ok": True, "auto_build": None,
19342                                  "reason": "no plan set yet"})
19343             else:
19344                 # 2) Mark the planning session DONE WITHOUT reaping its
19345                 #    worktree (non-destructive — reopenable finished tile).
19346                 try:
19347                     _sessreg.update_session(
19348                         session, status=_sessreg.STATUS_DONE)
19349                 except KeyError:
19350                     pass

19670 def handle_project_files(handler, path, body):
19671     if not handler._term_token_ok():
19672         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "unauthorized"}, 401)
19673         return
19674     q = parse_qs(urlparse(handler.path).query)
19675     project_id = (q.get("project_id", [""])[0] or "").strip()
19676     path_param = (q.get("path", [""])[0] or "").strip()
19677     recursive_param = (q.get("recursive", [""])[0] or "").strip().lower() == "true"
19678 
19679     if not project_id:
19680         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "project_id required"}, 400)
19681         return
19682     if _unsafe_path_seg(project_id):
19683         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "invalid project_id"}, 400)
19684         return
19685 
19686     proj = _rnd.get_project(project_id)
19687     if proj is None:
19688         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Unknown project"}, 404)
19689         return
19690 
19691     project_root = Path(proj["folder_path"]).resolve()
19692 
19693     # Traversal check
19694     p = Path(path_param) if path_param else Path(".")
19695     if p.is_absolute() or ".." in p.parts:
19696         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Path traversal detected"}, 400)
19697         return
19698 
19699     target_path = (project_root / p).resolve()
19700     if _provider_private_path(target_path):
19701         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "private_host_credentials"}, 403)
19702         return
19703     try:
19704         target_path.relative_to(project_root)
19705     except ValueError:
19706         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Path containment check failed"}, 400)
19707         return
19708 
19709     if not target_path.exists():
19710         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Path not found"}, 404)
19711         return
19712     if not target_path.is_dir():
19713         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Not a directory"}, 400)
19714         return
19715 
19716     patterns = _load_gitignore(project_root)
19717     dirs_list = []
19718     files_list = []
19719 
19720     if recursive_param:
19721         for root, dirs, files in os.walk(target_path):
19722             # Filter ignored directories in-place to prevent scanning them
19723             dirs_to_keep = []
19724             for d in dirs:
19725                 full_d = Path(root) / d
19726                 try:
19727                     resolved_d = full_d.resolve()
19728                     resolved_d.relative_to(project_root)
19729                     rel_d = full_d.relative_to(project_root)
19730                     if not _should_ignore_file(rel_d, patterns):
19731                         dirs_to_keep.append(d)
19732                 except (ValueError, OSError):
19733                     continue
19734             dirs[:] = dirs_to_keep
19735 
19736             for file in files:
19737                 full_f = Path(root) / file
19738                 try:
19739                     resolved_f = full_f.resolve()
19740                     resolved_f.relative_to(project_root)
19741                     rel_f = full_f.relative_to(project_root)
19742                     if not _should_ignore_file(rel_f, patterns):
19743                         stat = full_f.stat()
19744                         files_list.append({
19745                             "name": rel_f.as_posix(),
19746                             "path": rel_f.as_posix(),
19747                             "size": stat.st_size,
19748                             "mtime": stat.st_mtime
19749                         })
19750                 except (ValueError, OSError):
19751                     continue
19752 
19753             for d in dirs:
19754                 full_d = Path(root) / d
19755                 try:
19756                     rel_d = full_d.relative_to(project_root)
19757                     dirs_list.append(rel_d.as_posix())
19758                 except (ValueError, OSError):
19759                     continue
19760     else:
19761         try:
19762             for entry in sorted(target_path.iterdir(), key=lambda x: x.name.lower()):
19763                 try:
19764                     # Strict symlink containment check
19765                     resolved_entry = entry.resolve()
19766                     resolved_entry.relative_to(project_root)
19767                 except (ValueError, OSError):
19768                     continue
19769 
19770                 rel_entry = entry.relative_to(project_root)
19771                 if _should_ignore_file(rel_entry, patterns):
19772                     continue
19773 
19774                 if entry.is_dir():
19775                     dirs_list.append(rel_entry.as_posix())
19776                 elif entry.is_file():
19777                     try:
19778                         stat = entry.stat()
19779                         files_list.append({
19780                             "name": rel_entry.name,
19781                             "path": rel_entry.as_posix(),
19782                             "size": stat.st_size,
19783                             "mtime": stat.st_mtime
19784                         })
19785                     except OSError:
19786                         continue
19787         except PermissionError:
19788             handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "permission-denied"}, 403)
19789             return
19790         except OSError as exc:
19791             handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": f"os-error: {exc}"}, 500)
19792             return
19793 
19794     handler._send_json({
19795         "ok": True,
19796         "path": p.as_posix() if path_param else "",
19797         "dirs": sorted(dirs_list, key=lambda x: x.lower()),
19798         "files": sorted(files_list, key=lambda x: x["name"].lower())
19799     })
19800

19881     if not handler._term_token_ok():

20024 def handle_gandalf_status_all(handler, path, body):
20025     # BULK in-flight status for ALL projects with a live Gandalf run —
20026     # one request the dashboard polls instead of N single-project
20027     # calls. Returns {ok, statuses:{project_id: status_string}} for
20028     # every project currently in-flight; finished/absent projects are
20029     # simply omitted. Mirrors the single endpoint's token gate, ok/err

20038             if isinstance(rec, dict):

20048     # answer to "what is this blank new tile doing?", and it precedes the
20049     # Gandalf status the same run will report a moment later.
20050     for _pid, _msg in project_setup_statuses().items():

20052     handler._send_json({"ok": True, "statuses": statuses})
