20055 # Public same-origin mount for the ZH Node radar (Tailscale / remote safe).
20056 _ZH_PROXY_PREFIX = "/api/rnd/zombie_hunter_proxy"
20057 
20058 
20059 def _zh_extract_token(handler, qs=None):
20060     """Token from query or X-Anchor-Token (dashboard convention)."""
20061     try:
20062         if qs is None:
20063             qs = parse_qs(urlparse(getattr(handler, "path", "") or "").query or "")
20064         t = (qs.get("token") or [""])[0]
20065         if t:
20066             return str(t).strip()
20067     except Exception:
20068         pass
20069     try:
20070         return (handler.headers.get("X-Anchor-Token")
20071                 or handler.headers.get("x-anchor-token") or "").strip()
20072     except Exception:
20073         return ""
20074 
20075 
20076 def _zh_proxy_to_node(method, upstream_path, query="", headers=None, body=None, timeout=30):
20077     """Server-side fetch to 127.0.0.1:48484. Returns dict ok/status/headers/body."""
20078     import urllib.request
20079     import urllib.error
20080     q = f"?{query}" if query else ""
20081     url = f"{_zh_node_base()}{upstream_path}{q}"
20082     req_headers = dict(headers or {})
20083     # Never forward Host of the remote client
20084     req_headers.pop("Host", None)
20085     req_headers.pop("host", None)
20086     data = body if body is not None and method.upper() not in ("GET", "HEAD") else None
20087     req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=req_headers, method=method.upper())
20088     try:
20089         with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
20090             raw = resp.read()
20091             return {
20092                 "ok": True,
20093                 "status": getattr(resp, "status", 200) or 200,
20094                 "headers": {k: v for k, v in resp.headers.items()},
20095                 "body": raw,
20096                 "content_type": resp.headers.get("Content-Type") or "application/octet-stream",
20097             }
20098     except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
20099         try:
20100             raw = e.read()
20101         except Exception:
20102             raw = b""
20103         return {
20104             "ok": False,
20105             "status": int(getattr(e, "code", 502) or 502),
20106             "headers": {},
20107             "body": raw,
20108             "content_type": e.headers.get("Content-Type") if e.headers else "text/plain",
20109             "error": str(e),
20110         }
20111     except Exception as e:
20112         return {
20113             "ok": False,
20114             "status": 502,
20115             "headers": {},
20116             "body": b"",
20117             "content_type": "text/plain",
20118             "error": str(e),
20119         }
20120 
20121 
20122 def _zh_rewrite_html_for_proxy(html_text, token=""):
20123     """Rewrite Node radar HTML so browser stays on Anchor origin (Tailscale-safe)."""
20124     import re as _re
20125     text = html_text
20126     # Absolute loopback API → same-origin proxy mount
20127     text = _re.sub(
20128         r"https?://127\.0\.0\.1:\d+",
20129         _ZH_PROXY_PREFIX,
20130         text,
20131     )
20132     text = _re.sub(
20133         r"const API = ['\"][^'\"]+['\"]",
20134         f"const API = '{_ZH_PROXY_PREFIX}'",
20135         text,
20136         count=1,
20137     )
20138     if token:
20139         # Escape for JS single-quoted string
20140         safe = (
20141             str(token)
20142             .replace("\\", "\\\\")
20143             .replace("'", "\\'")
20144             .replace("\n", "")
20145             .replace("\r", "")
20146         )
20147         text = text.replace(
20148             "var ANCHOR_TOKEN='__ANCHOR_TOKEN__'",
20149             f"var ANCHOR_TOKEN='{safe}'",
20150         )
20151     return text
20152 
20153 
20154 def handle_zombie_hunter_proxy(handler, path, body):
20155     """GET|POST /api/rnd/zombie_hunter_proxy/* — reverse-proxy to ZH Node on loopback.
20156 
20157     Same pattern as tidy_idy_proxy: browser stays same-origin with Anchor (works
20158     over Tailscale); Anchor fetches 127.0.0.1:48484 server-side.
20159     """
20160     if not handler._term_token_ok():
20161         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "unauthorized"}, 401)
20162         return
20163 
20164     parsed = urlparse(path)
20165     if not parsed.path.startswith(_ZH_PROXY_PREFIX):
20166         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "bad proxy path"}, 400)
20167         return
20168     rest = parsed.path[len(_ZH_PROXY_PREFIX):] or "/"
20169     if not rest.startswith("/"):
20170         rest = "/" + rest
20171     # Only allow path chars that the Node radar actually serves
20172     if ".." in rest or "\\" in rest:
20173         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "bad path"}, 400)
20174         return
20175 
20176     _in_pytest = bool(os.environ.get("PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST"))
20177     if not _in_pytest:
20178         try:
20179             _ensure_zh_node_server(wait_s=8.0)
20180         except Exception:
20181             pass
20182     if not _zh_node_is_up(timeout=1.5):
20183         handler._send_json(
20184             {"ok": False, "error": "Zombie Hunter Node radar is not running on the Anchor host",
20185              "code": "zh-upstream-down"},
20186             502,
20187         )
20188         return
20189 
20190     method = (getattr(handler, "command", None) or "GET").upper()
20191     raw_body = None
20192     if method in ("POST", "PUT", "PATCH") and body is not None:
20193         if isinstance(body, (bytes, bytearray)):
20194             raw_body = bytes(body)
20195         else:
20196             raw_body = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
20197 
20198     fwd = {"Accept": handler.headers.get("Accept") or "*/*"}
20199     ctype = handler.headers.get("Content-Type")
20200     if ctype:
20201         fwd["Content-Type"] = ctype
20202     elif raw_body is not None:
20203         fwd["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
20204 
20205     result = _zh_proxy_to_node(
20206         method, rest, query=parsed.query or "", headers=fwd, body=raw_body,
20207         timeout=60 if rest.startswith("/api/sweep") else 30,
20208     )
20209     status = int(result.get("status") or 502)
20210     payload = result.get("body") or b""
20211     ctype_out = result.get("content_type") or "application/octet-stream"
20212 
20213     # Rewrite HTML so assets/API stay on the proxy
20214     if isinstance(payload, (bytes, bytearray)) and "text/html" in (ctype_out or ""):
20215         try:
20216             token = _zh_extract_token(handler)
20217             text = payload.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
20218             text = _zh_rewrite_html_for_proxy(text, token=token)
20219             payload = text.encode("utf-8")
20220             ctype_out = "text/html; charset=utf-8"
20221         except Exception as e:
20222             _logger.warning("zh_proxy: HTML rewrite failed: %s", e)
20223 
20224     try:
20225         handler.send_response(status)
20226         handler.send_header("Content-Type", ctype_out)
20227         handler.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
20228         handler.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
20229         # CORS not needed same-origin; allow for belt-and-suspenders
20230         handler.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
20231         handler.end_headers()
20232         if payload:
20233             handler.wfile.write(payload)
20234     except Exception as e:
20235         _logger.warning("zh_proxy: write failed: %s", e)
20236 
20237 
20238 def handle_zombie_hunter_report(handler, path, body):
20239     # Auth gate (defense-in-depth): the radar report exposes process
20240     # metadata (PIDs / session ids). Token-gated like the other
20241     # read-API GET routes; a no-op when ANCHOR_TOKEN is unset (local
20242     # single-user), enforced in remote mode. The dashboard button
20243     # passes ?token= via _anchorToken().
20244     if not handler._term_token_ok():
20245         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "unauthorized"}, 401)
20246         return
20247     import zombie_hunter
20248     import reaper
20249     import pty_manager
20250     import subprocess
20251     # NOTE: do NOT import json/sys/os/datetime function-locally here —
20252     # they are module-global (top of file). A function-local import
20253     # makes the name local to the ENTIRE do_GET method, so an earlier
20254     # branch referencing it before this line raises UnboundLocalError
20255     # -> a 500 on every page load. (rearch W8: the shadowing class is
20256     # structurally eliminated — route_import_scan proves it stays 0.)
20257     #
20258     # Operator path: prefer Node multi-engine radar, served via SAME-ORIGIN
20259     # reverse proxy (works over Tailscale). Never redirect the browser to
20260     # 127.0.0.1 — that is the host machine, not the remote client.
20261     # Pure-Python Cached Sweep Report is FALLBACK when Node is down.
20262     # Query ?legacy=1 forces the Python report.
20263     try:
20264         _qs = parse_qs(urlparse(getattr(handler, "path", "") or "").query or "")
20265         _force_legacy = str((_qs.get("legacy") or ["0"])[0]).strip() in ("1", "true", "yes")
20266         _tok = _zh_extract_token(handler, _qs)
20267     except Exception:
20268         _force_legacy = False
20269         _tok = ""
20270     # Never auto-spawn Node under pytest (frozen UX tests assert the Python HTML).
20271     _in_pytest = bool(os.environ.get("PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST"))
20272     if not _force_legacy and not _in_pytest:
20273         try:
20274             if _ensure_zh_node_server(wait_s=10.0) and _zh_node_is_up(timeout=1.5):
20275                 # Same-origin proxy to Node HTML (Tailscale-safe).
20276                 q = f"?token={url_quote(_tok)}" if _tok else ""
20277                 handler.send_response(302)
20278                 handler.send_header("Location", f"{_ZH_PROXY_PREFIX}/{q}")
20279                 handler.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
20280                 handler.end_headers()
20281                 return
20282         except Exception as _zh_exc:
20283             _logger.warning("zombie_hunter_report: Node radar unavailable (%s) — Python fallback",
20284                             _zh_exc)
20285 
20286     # Check if zombie_hunter_last.json exists and is not stale (within 60 seconds)
20287     report_path = zombie_hunter._last_report_path()
20288     is_stale = True
20289     report_data = None
20290 
20291     if report_path.exists():
20292         try:
20293             report_data = json.loads(report_path.read_text("utf-8"))
20294             swept_at = report_data.get("swept_at", 0)
20295             mtime = report_path.stat().st_mtime
20296             now = time.time()
20297             if abs(now - mtime) < 60 and abs(now - swept_at) < 60:
20298                 is_stale = False
20299         except Exception:
20300             is_stale = True
20301 
20302     # Observe phase: classify processes using the dry-run sweep (apply=False).
20303     # This is read-only (NO kills, NO registry updates) and writes/refreshes
20304     # zombie_hunter_last.json. Only refresh a STALE-but-PRESENT report; when the
20305     # report file is ABSENT we deliberately fall through to the live-process
20306     # fallback below (do NOT synthesize a cached report), so a fresh install with
20307     # no daemon sweep yet still shows real OS processes.
20308     if is_stale and report_path.exists():
20309         try:
20310             live_ids = pty_manager.live_sessions()
20311             report = zombie_hunter.sweep(live_session_ids=live_ids, apply=False)
20312             zombie_hunter._persist_report(report)
20313             report_data = report
20314             is_stale = False
20315         except Exception:
20316             pass
20317 
20318     handler.send_response(200)
20319     handler.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
20320     handler.end_headers()
20321 
20322     html = "<html><head><title>Zombie Hunter Report</title>"
20323     html += "<style>"
20324     html += "body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; background: #0a0a0c; color: #e4e4e7; padding: 30px; margin: 0; }"
20325     html += ".container { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; background: #18181b; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }"
20326     html += "h1 { margin-top: 0; color: #fafafa; font-size: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #27272a; padding-bottom: 12px; }"
20327     html += "h2 { color: #f4f4f5; font-size: 18px; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 12px; }"
20328     html += "table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 16px; }"
20329     html += "th { background: #27272a; color: #a1a1aa; font-weight: 500; text-align: left; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 14px; border-bottom: 2px solid #3f3f46; }"
20330     html += "td { padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #27272a; font-size: 14px; color: #d4d4d8; }"
20331     html += ".badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }"
20332     html += ".badge-info { background: #1e3a8a; color: #93c5fd; }"
20333     html += ".badge-warning { background: #78350f; color: #fde047; }"
20334     html += ".badge-danger { background: #7f1d1d; color: #fca5a5; }"
20335     html += ".badge-success { background: #064e3b; color: #6ee7b7; }"
20336     html += ".badge-secondary { background: #27272a; color: #d4d4d8; }"
20337     html += "pre { font-family: monospace; font-size: 13px; background: #09090b; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 6px; overflow-x: auto; max-height: 500px; color: #4ade80; }"
20338     html += ".meta { font-size: 13px; color: #71717a; margin-bottom: 20px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: #202024; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 6px; }"
20339     html += ".meta-label { font-weight: bold; color: #a1a1aa; }"
20340     html += "</style></head><body>"
20341     html += "<div class='container'>"
20342     html += "<h1><img src=\"/vendor/brand/zombie-hunter-radar.jpg\" style=\"width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:6px;vertical-align:middle;\" /> Zombie Hunter Radar</h1>"
20343 
20344     if not is_stale and report_data:
20345         swept_time_str = datetime.fromtimestamp(report_data.get("swept_at", 0)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
20346         html += f"<div class='meta'>"
20347         html += f"<div><span class='meta-label'>Source:</span> <span class='badge badge-success'>Cached Sweep Report</span></div>"
20348         html += f"<div><span class='meta-label'>Swept At:</span> {swept_time_str}</div>"
20349         html += f"</div>"
20350

20718     # Wave 1 (#12a): bounded LIVE auto-refresh of the radar so it

20720     # ZOMBIE_MAX_TICKS so it never churns forever; it SKIPS the

20723     html += "<script id='zombie-auto-refresh'>"
20724     html += """
20725 (function () {
20726   var ZOMBIE_REFRESH_MS = 6000;   // poll cadence
20727   var ZOMBIE_MAX_TICKS = 100;     // bounded: ~10 min then stop
20728   var ticks = 0;
20729   var timer = setInterval(function () {
20730     ticks += 1;
20731     if (ticks > ZOMBIE_MAX_TICKS) { clearInterval(timer); return; }
20732     var iframe = document.getElementById('terminal-iframe');
20733     if (iframe && iframe.style.display !== 'none') { return; }  // terminal open -> skip
20734     if (document.hidden) { return; }                            // tab hidden  -> skip
20735     window.location.reload();
20736   }, ZOMBIE_REFRESH_MS);
20737 })();

20746 def handle_zombie_terminal(handler, path, body):
20747     if not handler._term_token_ok():

20749         return

20758     html = """<!DOCTYPE html>
20759 <html>
20760 <head>
20761   <title>Zombie Hunter Terminal</title>
20762   <link rel="stylesheet" href="/vendor/xterm/xterm.css" />
20763   <script src="/vendor/xterm/xterm.js"></script>
20764   <style>
20765     body {
20766       background: #0c0e14;
20767       margin: 0;
20768       padding: 0;
20769       width: 100vw;
20770       height: 100vh;
20771       overflow: hidden;
20772     }
20773     #terminal {
20774       width: 100%;
20775       height: 100%;
20776     }
20777   </style>
20778 </head>
20779 <body>
20780   <div id="terminal"></div>
20781   <script>
20782     (function() {
20783       const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
20784       const sessionId = params.get('session');
20785       const token = params.get('token') || '';
20786 
20787       if (!sessionId) {
20788         document.getElementById('terminal').textContent = 'Error: session parameter required';
20789         return;
20790       }
20791 
20792       const term = new Terminal({
20793         convertEol: true,
20794         fontSize: 12,
20795         theme: { background: '#0c0e14' },
20796         scrollback: 5000
20797       });
20798       term.open(document.getElementById('terminal'));
20799 
20800       function fitTerminal() {
20801         const cols = Math.floor(window.innerWidth / 7.2) || 80;
20802         const rows = Math.floor(window.innerHeight / 17) || 24;
20803         term.resize(cols, rows);
20804 
20805         const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
20806         if (token) headers['X-Anchor-Token'] = token;
20807 
20808         const body = { session: sessionId, cols: cols, rows: rows };
20809         if (token) body.token = token;
20810 
20811         fetch('/api/rnd/term_resize', {
20812           method: 'POST',
20813           headers: headers,
20814           body: JSON.stringify(body)
20815         }).catch(err => console.error('resize error:', err));
20816       }
20817 
20818       window.addEventListener('resize', fitTerminal);
20819       setTimeout(fitTerminal, 100);
20820 
20821       // Ordering fix (2026-07-08): keystrokes used to fire independent, racing
20822       // POSTs (browser parallel connections + threaded server) → muddled typing.
20823       // Prefer the ordered WebSocket (single FIFO stream applied to the PTY in
20824       // frame order by the one server pump); fall back to a PROMISE-CHAINED POST
20825       // queue (one term_input2 POST in flight at a time) when the WS isn't OPEN.
20826       let activeWs = null;
20827       let _sendChain = Promise.resolve();
20828       function _sendInput(d) {
20829         if (d === '' || d == null) return;
20830         if (activeWs && activeWs.readyState === 1 /* OPEN */) {
20831           try { activeWs.send(d); return; } catch (e) { /* fall through */ }
20832         }
20833         const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
20834         if (token) headers['X-Anchor-Token'] = token;
20835         const body = { session: sessionId, data: d };
20836         if (token) body.token = token;
20837         _sendChain = _sendChain.then(function () {
20838           return fetch('/api/rnd/term_input2', {
20839             method: 'POST', headers: headers, body: JSON.stringify(body)
20840           });
20841         }).catch(err => console.error('input error:', err));
20842       }
20843       term.onData(function (d) { _sendInput(d); });
20844 
20845       const tq = token ? ('&token=' + encodeURIComponent(token)) : '';
20846       const wsProto = (location.protocol === 'https:') ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
20847       const wsUrl = wsProto + '//' + location.host + '/api/rnd/term_ws?session=' + encodeURIComponent(sessionId) + tq;
20848 
20849       let sseStarted = false;
20850       function startSSE() {
20851         if (sseStarted) return;
20852         sseStarted = true;
20853         const sseUrl = '/api/rnd/term_stream2?session=' + encodeURIComponent(sessionId) + tq;
20854         const es = new EventSource(sseUrl);
20855         es.addEventListener('output', function (ev) {
20856           try {
20857             const p = JSON.parse(ev.data);
20858             if (p.text) term.write(p.text);
20859           } catch (e) {}
20860         });
20861         es.addEventListener('done', function () {
20862           try { es.close(); } catch (e) {}
20863         });
20864       }
20865 
20866       try {
20867         const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
20868         activeWs = ws;  // ordered input channel (see _sendInput above)
20869         ws.onmessage = function (ev) { term.write(ev.data); };
20870         ws.onclose = function () {
20871           activeWs = null;
20872           if (!sseStarted) startSSE();
20873         };
20874         ws.onerror = function () {
20875           activeWs = null;
20876           try { ws.close(); } catch (e) {}
20877           startSSE();
20878         };
20879       } catch (e) {
20880         activeWs = null;
20881         startSSE();
20882       }
20883     })();
20884   </script>
20885 </body>
20886 </html>"""
20887     handler.wfile.write(html.encode("utf-8"))

20961 def handle_session_summary(handler, path, body):
20962     # Read-only structured SESSION summary as JSON (v3 Wave 6): the
20963     # in-place accordion fetches this instead of navigating to the
20964     # /summary page. If cached → return it. If NOT cached → kick off
20965     # background generation (run-once, runner seam) and return a
20966     # {status:"generating"} fallback so the panel can re-fetch. This
20967     # NEVER runs the model synchronously on the request thread.
20968     # /api/rnd/session_summary?pid=<id>&lane=<lane>&session=<sid>
20969     q = parse_qs(urlparse(handler.path).query)
20970     pid = (q.get("pid", [""])[0] or "").strip()
20971     lane = (q.get("lane", [""])[0] or "").strip()
20972     session_id = (q.get("session", [""])[0] or "").strip()
20973     if not pid or not lane or not session_id:
20974         handler._send_json({"ok": False,
20975                          "error": "pid, lane, session required"}, 400)
20976     elif _unsafe_path_seg(pid):
20977         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "bad pid"}, 400)
20978     elif _unsafe_path_seg(lane):
20979         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "bad lane"}, 400)
20980     else:
20981         proj = _rnd.get_project(pid)
20982         folder = (proj or {}).get("folder_path", "")
20983         store_lane = _eh._resolve_subdir(lane)
20984         cached = None
20985         try:
20986             cached = _summarizer.load_cached(
20987                 folder, pid, store_lane, session_id)
20988         except Exception:
20989             cached = None
20990         if isinstance(cached, dict) and not cached.get("error"):
20991             handler._send_json({"ok": True, "status": "ready",
20992                              "summary": cached})
20993         elif proj is None:
20994             # Unknown / unregistered project → TERMINAL status so a
20995             # polling panel STOPS (never an endless "generating").
20996             handler._send_json({"ok": True, "status": "unknown"})
20997         else:
20998             # Not cached (or a prior failed/uncached run): resolve the
20999             # session so generation can seed from its members. v8 Wave
21000             # 5 — a killed managed session's produced docs are persisted
21001             # tagged with its id (they GROUP elsewhere in list_sessions),
21002             # so resolve via _resolve_finished_session which TIES the
21003             # managed id to those exact docs. Unresolvable → TERMINAL
21004             # "unknown" (the panel stops polling); else kick off
21005             # background generation run-once and tell the panel to poll.
21006             # (2026-08-15) cache_only=1: the chamber's run tiles read
21007             # summaries in a fan-out (dozens per open). Uncached MUST answer
21008             # "unknown" instead of kicking off a background MODEL job per
21009             # tile — the 2026-07-14 usage-leak class wore exactly this shape.
21010             if (q.get("cache_only", [""])[0] or "").strip() in ("1", "true"):
21011                 handler._send_json({"ok": True, "status": "unknown"})
21012                 return
21013             session = None
21014             try:
21015                 session = _resolve_finished_session(
21016                     folder, pid, lane, session_id)
21017             except Exception:
21018                 session = None
21019             if session is None:
21020                 handler._send_json({"ok": True, "status": "unknown"})
21021             else:
21022                 _trigger_session_summary(
21023                     folder, pid, lane, session)
21024                 handler._send_json({"ok": True, "status": "generating"})

21027 def handle_session_narration(handler, path, body):
21028     # Read-only Layer-1 WARM NARRATION data (telemetry-resume W3): the
21029     # deterministic narration spine (done / produced / next) for ONE session
21030     # tile, rendered in the session-window terminal chrome as the first-click
21031     # 'warm terminal that narrates'. PURE render off durable local data —
21032     # NO PTY spawn, NO synchronous model call, NO network. Cites the North
21033     # Star amendment (click contract · first-click sentence · narration floor ·
21034     # endpoint auth rule).
21035     #
21036     # Lazy enrichment (the CHOSEN narration-floor path): the floor is ALWAYS
21037     # returned immediately; when the session has no cached summary yet, the
21038     # first open triggers the EXISTING v3 background generation (unmodified) and
21039     # the view carries an ``enrichment='generating'`` badge — a badge OVER
21040     # content, never a spinner instead of content. A failed/absent generation
21041     # leaves the floor standing (no loop; a later open may retry once).
21042     #
21043     # AUTH: ``?token=`` (401-before-substance, like session_summary /
21044     # session_doc_roles). The strangler applies the row's token gate FIRST; this
21045     # in-handler check is the belt-and-braces second line.
21046     #   /api/rnd/session_narration?pid=<id>&lane=<lane>&session=<sid>
21047     if not handler._term_token_ok():
21048         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "unauthorized"}, 401)
21049         return
21050     q = parse_qs(urlparse(handler.path).query)
21051     pid = (q.get("pid", [""])[0] or "").strip()
21052     lane = (q.get("lane", [""])[0] or "").strip()
21053     session_id = (q.get("session", [""])[0] or "").strip()
21054     if not pid or not lane or not session_id:
21055         handler._send_json({"ok": False,
21056                          "error": "pid, lane, session required"}, 400)
21057         return
21058     if _unsafe_path_seg(pid):
21059         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "bad pid"}, 400)
21060         return
21061     if _unsafe_path_seg(lane):
21062         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "bad lane"}, 400)
21063         return
21064     proj = _rnd.get_project(pid)
21065     folder = (proj or {}).get("folder_path", "")
21066     # Resolve the registry record (SAFE — never echoed to the client; only the
21067     # narration projection is returned).
21068     try:
21069         record = _termsess.get_session(session_id) or {}
21070     except Exception:
21071         record = {}
21072     # Finished ONE-SHOT JOB tile (no managed session record): the ``session`` is
21073     # a durable job_id. Render the effort record + its /report link directly —
21074     # the locked one-shot-job tile-class definition. Guarded; falls through to the
21075     # session floor if nothing resolves.
21076     if not record:
21077         try:
21078             eff = _eh.load_effort(folder, pid, _eh._resolve_subdir(lane),
21079                                   session_id)
21080         except Exception:
21081             eff = None
21082         if isinstance(eff, dict) and (eff.get("provenance") == "run"
21083                                       or isinstance(eff.get("cost"), dict)) \
21084                 and not (eff.get("session_id") or ""):
21085             try:
21086                 view = _narr.narrate_effort(pid, lane, eff, folder_path=folder)
21087                 handler._send_json({"ok": True, "narration": view})
21088                 return
21089             except Exception:
21090                 pass
21091     # Lazy enrichment: decide 'generating' vs floor WITHOUT ever blocking on the
21092     # model. Cache HIT → 'cached' (build_narration resolves it). Cache MISS on a
21093     # registered project → trigger the existing background generation ONCE and
21094     # badge 'generating'. Unknown project / unresolvable session → plain floor.
21095     enrichment = None
21096     store_lane = lane
21097     try:
21098         store_lane = _eh._resolve_subdir(lane)
21099     except Exception:
21100         store_lane = lane
21101     cached = None
21102     try:
21103         cached = _summarizer.load_cached(folder, pid, store_lane, session_id)
21104     except Exception:
21105         cached = None
21106     if not (isinstance(cached, dict) and not cached.get("error")) and proj is not None:
21107         session_obj = None
21108         try:
21109             session_obj = _resolve_finished_session(
21110                 folder, pid, lane, session_id)
21111         except Exception:
21112             session_obj = None
21113         if session_obj is not None:
21114             try:
21115                 _trigger_session_summary(folder, pid, lane, session_obj)
21116                 enrichment = _narr.ENRICH_GENERATING
21117             except Exception:
21118                 enrichment = None
21119     try:
21120         view = _narr.narrate_session(
21121             pid, lane, session_id, folder_path=folder, record=record,
21122             enrichment=enrichment)
21123     except Exception:
21124         # TOTAL fallback — the narration builder is pure/never-raises, but keep
21125         # the endpoint structurally-never-blank even under an unexpected error.
21126         view = {
21127             "session_id": session_id, "tile_class": "done", "lane": lane,
21128             "title": lane, "done": f"ran {lane}", "produced": [],
21129             "produced_note": "no recoverable documents",
21130             "next": {"text": "Resume this session to continue where it left "
21131                              "off.", "source": "stage_derived", "submit": False},
21132             "badges": [], "enrichment": "floor", "links_valid": True,
21133         }
21134     handler._send_json({"ok": True, "narration": view})
21135

21182 def _reconcile_sessions_tick(pid=None):
21183     """Reconcile the registry against the LIVE PTY set and run every advance that
21184     depends on it (restart recovery, reconcile->auto-advance, in-session stage
21185     progress, summarize-on-finish). Best-effort, fully guarded, idempotent.
21186 
21187     (2026-09-04, John: "the session should continue running in the background ...
21188     we should not be tied to whether a particular device is up and has an Anchor
21189     webpage active") This used to run ONLY inside the project window's session-list
21190     poll, so a planning session that finished while no browser was open did not
21191     advance until someone opened the page. The server now ticks it itself
21192     (``_start_reconcile_ticker``); the poll still calls it for immediacy.
21193     """
21194     with _RECONCILE_TICK_LOCK:
21195         # v6 Wave 9 (polish 3): wire the reconcile→auto-advance into the
21196         # project-window refresh/poll path. Before listing, reconcile the
21197         # registry against the LIVE PTY set: a managed planning session
21198         # whose process is gone is re-statused DONE and (idempotently)
21199         # auto-advanced to ONE linked build — so a planning session that
21200         # DIED (not just an explicit hard-kill) advances on the next
21201         # refresh. Idempotent on parent_session_id → repeated polls are
21202         # no-ops. Best-effort + fully guarded: an error here NEVER breaks
21203         # the (read-only) session list response. live_session_ids MUST be
21204         # passed (the function default treats NO session as live, which
21205         # would wrongly mark live ones stale).
21206         try:
21207             live = list(_termsess._pty.live_sessions())
21208             # v12 Wave 8 — restart recovery MUST run BEFORE reconcile
21209             # (Reviewer W8-R2-01): reconcile_and_advance blanket-marks every
21210             # RUNNING-but-PTY-gone session DONE (no effort exemption), and
21211             # recover only acts on RUNNING records — so recover has to claim
21212             # an ``effort_managed`` effort whose PTY is gone FIRST (persist
21213             # its active stage's worktree docs [no reap], mark the stage entry
21214             # 'interrupted' [≠ done/failed], re-status IDLE so it is honestly
21215             # not-running + reopenable; NEVER auto-spawns/advances) — otherwise
21216             # reconcile would mark it DONE and its uncommitted docs would be
21217             # LOST. Once recover sets it IDLE, the reconcile pass below leaves
21218             # it alone (it only re-statuses RUNNING-but-gone). Best-effort +
21219             # fully guarded: an error here NEVER breaks the read-only list.
21220             try:
21221                 _termsess.recover_interrupted_efforts(
21222                     live_session_ids=live)
21223             except Exception:
21224                 pass
21225             _rec_out = _termsess.reconcile_and_advance(
21226                 live_session_ids=live)
21227             # v12 Wave 7 — REWIRE: an ``effort_managed`` effort does NOT
21228             # use the legacy reconcile→auto_advance_planning_to_build mint
21229             # (which is gated off for it anyway). Instead, on the SAME
21230             # refresh poll, run the on-disk-only ``detect_stage_progress``
21231             # over the project's LIVE efforts — it auto-advances IN-SESSION
21232             # on a committed plan-set / build signal (ZERO PTY bytes,
21233             # idempotent, mints nothing). Legacy sessions stay on the
21234             # reconcile_and_advance path above. Best-effort + fully guarded
21235             # (never breaks the read-only session-list response).
21236             try:
21237                 for _er in _termsess.list_sessions(
21238                         project_id=pid or None):
21239                     if not isinstance(_er, dict):
21240                         continue
21241                     if not _er.get("effort_managed"):
21242                         continue
21243                     if _er.get("status") != _termsess._reg.STATUS_RUNNING:
21244                         continue
21245                     try:
21246                         _termsess.detect_stage_progress(
21247                             _er.get("session_id"),
21248                             project_id=_er.get("project_id") or None)
21249                     except Exception:
21250                         pass
21251             except Exception:
21252                 pass
21253             # v7 Wave 2: any session newly re-statused DONE by the
21254             # reconcile-dead path gets a background session-summary
21255             # scheduled (best-effort, non-blocking, idempotent — a cached
21256             # one is skipped, so repeated polls don't re-run the model).
21257             # Never breaks the read-only session-list response.
21258             try:
21259                 marked = ((_rec_out or {}).get("reconcile", {})
21260                           or {}).get("marked", []) or []
21261                 for _sid in marked:
21262                     _r = _termsess.get_session(_sid)
21263                     if _r is None:
21264                         continue
21265                     _trigger_session_summary_on_finish(
21266                         _r.get("project_id"), _r.get("lane"), _sid)
21267             except Exception:
21268                 pass
21269         except Exception:
21270             pass
21271         # reversible decisions proceed on John's silence: the one server clock sleeping stewards share
21272         try:
21273             from steward_cockpit import steward_routes as _scr_silence
21274             _scr_silence.proceed_on_silence_sweep()
21275         except Exception:
21276             pass
21277         # W3 of the steward revision (2026-09-28; his Q1 "yes, that one line only"): with no seat awake, every
21278         # record whose roadmap moved past its line's stamp gets its line re-derived from the plan — the same
21279         # server clock; at most a few per tick; the engine writes nothing when nothing changed
21280         try:
21281             from steward_cockpit import horizon as _horizon
21282             _roots, _skipped, _failed = _ecgberht_portfolio_roots()
21283             _horizon.sweep(_horizon.record_dirs(_roots))
21284         except Exception:
21285             pass
21286 
21287 
21288 _RECONCILE_TICK_LOCK = threading.Lock()
21289 _RECONCILE_TICK_DEFAULT_S = 60
21290 
21291 
21292 def _start_reconcile_ticker(interval_s=None):
21293     """Daemon thread: ``_reconcile_sessions_tick()`` every ``interval_s`` (env
21294     ``ANCHOR_RECONCILE_TICK_S``, default 60; ``0`` disables). Never raises."""
21295     try:
21296         interval = int(os.environ.get("ANCHOR_RECONCILE_TICK_S", "") or (interval_s or _RECONCILE_TICK_DEFAULT_S))
21297     except (TypeError, ValueError):
21298         interval = _RECONCILE_TICK_DEFAULT_S
21299     if interval <= 0:
21300         return None
21301 
21302     def _run():
21303         while True:
21304             time.sleep(interval)
21305             try:
21306                 _reconcile_sessions_tick(None)
21307             except Exception:
21308                 pass
21309 
21310     t = threading.Thread(target=_run, name="anchor-reconcile-tick", daemon=True)
21311     t.start()
21312     return t
21313

21315 def handle_term_sessions(handler, path, body):
21316     # Read-only: managed terminal sessions for a project — the
21317     # repopulate-from-registry hook the cockpit tiles row paints from
21318     # on load. Returns a SAFE projection of each registry record (NO
21319     # absolute worktree_path / branch — the UI has no need for them,
21320     # and they MUST NOT leak). Consistent with /api/rnd/projects
21321     # (GET, no mutation, no auth gate).
21322     #
21323     # v6 Wave 4: this projection now INCLUDES terminal-status
21324     # (done/failed) sessions too — finished tiles stay in the row as
21325     # greyed, reopenable tiles (newest-prominent + "previously done").
21326     # It also carries the Wave-2 lineage fields
21327     # (parent_session_id / chain_id) so the front end can group a
21328     # chain. Still SAFE: worktree_path / branch are NEVER included.
21329     q = parse_qs(urlparse(handler.path).query)
21330     pid = (q.get("project_id", [""])[0] or "").strip()
21331     _reconcile_sessions_tick(pid)
21332     try:
21333         recs = _termsess.list_sessions(project_id=pid or None)
21334     except Exception:
21335         recs = []
21336     safe = []
21337     for r in recs:
21338         if not isinstance(r, dict):
21339             continue
21340         # v10 Wave 5 (DEFECT-2 fix): a CONTAINED grass-workbench
21341         # develop session (research/plan, [grass-dev] label) must NOT
21342         # surface on the top strip. It is mounted by session id
21343         # directly in the workbench pane (developGrass), not via this
21344         # projection, so dropping it here keeps the contained promise
21345         # at the source (the JS top-strip guard is the belt-and-braces
21346         # second line). Nothing else consumes this projection for
21347         # grass-dev sessions (the chain breadcrumb uses chain_members).
21348         if _eh.is_grass_dev_label(r.get("label")):
21349             continue
21350         # Phantom-tile fix: a Gandalf run registers a lane='gandalf'
21351         # status/cancel record, and the Zombie-Hunter terminal runs
21352         # under lane='zombie' (legacy records: lane='general',
21353         # label='zombie-hunter'). NONE of these are cockpit terminals
21354         # — exclude them so they never paint a workstation tile. The
21355         # label clause clears ALREADY-PERSISTED zombie records that
21356         # still carry lane='general'. Real general-tab terminals
21357         # (lane='general', no zombie-hunter label) are unaffected.
21358         if (r.get("lane") in ("gandalf", "zombie")
21359                 or r.get("label") == "zombie-hunter"):
21360             continue
21361         # Doctor V3 W2: the reserved __doctor__ pseudo-project is FILTERED
21362         # from every dashboard/board surface (same pattern as __healthcheck__

21434 def handle_zombie_kill(handler, path, body):
21435     # Kill an orphaned swarm/terminal session by its SESSION id. The swarm
21436     # & owner view lists session_registry records, so it passes a
21437     # session_id (NOT a job_runner job_id) — cancel_job's _jr.load_record
21438     # would 404 on it. Here we tree-kill the recorded PID directly and mark
21439     # the registry record CANCELLED so it drops out of the running list and
21440     # never reappears on refresh. Idempotent; clean 404 for an unknown id.
21441     # Auth is enforced by the mutating-POST middleware above.
21442     import proc_probe
21443     sid = (body.get("session_id", "") or body.get("session", "")
21444            or body.get("job_id", "") or "").strip()
21445     rec = _sessreg.get_session(sid) if sid else None
21446     if rec is None:
21447         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": f"unknown session: {sid}",
21448                          "reason": "unknown-session"}, 404)
21449     else:
21450         pid = rec.get("pid")
21451         killed = False
21452         try:
21453             if pid not in (None, ""):
21454                 killed = bool(proc_probe.tree_kill(int(pid)))
21455         except Exception:
21456             killed = False
21457         try:
21458             _sessreg.update_session(sid, status=_sessreg.STATUS_CANCELLED)
21459         except Exception:
21460             pass
21461         try:
21462             import zombie_hunter
21463             zombie_hunter.forget_pid(pid)
21464         except Exception:
21465             pass
21466         handler._send_json({"ok": True, "session_id": sid, "killed": killed})
21467

21490 def handle_upload_batch(handler, path, body):
21491     """POST /api/rnd/upload_batch — write a batch of base64-encoded files into a
21492     project's folder (or the dashboard 'dev' dir), traversal-safe. Auth enforced by
21493     the do_POST middleware (the strangler runs after it).
21494     """
21495     project_id = body.get("project_id", "__dashboard__")
21496     files = body.get("files", [])
21497 
21498     if not isinstance(files, list):
21499         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "files must be a list"})
21500         return
21501 
21502     if project_id == "__dashboard__" or project_id == "dev" or not project_id:
21503         upload_dir = ANCHOR_DIR / "dev"
21504     else:
21505         entry = _rnd.get_project(project_id)
21506         if entry and entry.get("folder_path"):
21507             upload_dir = Path(entry["folder_path"])
21508         else:
21509             upload_dir = ANCHOR_DIR / ".anchor" / "projects" / project_id / "uploads"
21510 
21511     upload_dir = upload_dir.resolve()
21512 
21513     import base64
21514     import tempfile
21515 
21516     try:
21517         for file_info in files:
21518             rel_path_str = file_info.get("path", "")
21519             content_b64 = file_info.get("content_b64", "")
21520 
21521             if not rel_path_str or content_b64 is None:
21522                 handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "missing path or content_b64 for a file"})
21523                 return
21524 
21525             p = Path(rel_path_str)
21526             if p.is_absolute() or os.path.isabs(rel_path_str):
21527                 handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": f"Absolute paths not allowed: {rel_path_str}"})
21528                 return
21529 
21530             for part in p.parts:
21531                 if part == ".." or part == ".":
21532                     handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": f"Path traversal/invalid directory name: {rel_path_str}"})
21533                     return
21534 
21535             dest_path = (upload_dir / p).resolve()
21536             try:
21537                 dest_path.relative_to(upload_dir)
21538                 if dest_path == upload_dir:
21539                     handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "Cannot overwrite project root directory"})
21540                     return
21541             except ValueError:
21542                 handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": f"Path containment check failed for {rel_path_str}"})
21543                 return
21544 
21545             file_data = base64.b64decode(content_b64)
21546 
21547             parent_dir = dest_path.parent
21548             parent_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
21549 
21550             tmp_fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=str(parent_dir))
21551             try:
21552                 with os.fdopen(tmp_fd, 'wb') as tmp_file:
21553                     tmp_file.write(file_data)
21554                 os.replace(tmp_name, dest_path)
21555             except Exception:
21556                 if os.path.exists(tmp_name):
21557                     os.unlink(tmp_name)
21558                 raise
21559 
21560         handler._send_json({"ok": True, "message": f"Uploaded {len(files)} files successfully."})
21561     except Exception as e:
21562         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(e)})
21563 
21564 
21565 def handle_upload(handler, path, body):
21566     """POST /api/upload — write a single base64-encoded file into a project's
21567     folder (or the dashboard 'dev' dir). Auth enforced by the do_POST middleware.
21568     """
21569     project_id = body.get("project_id", "__dashboard__")
21570     filename = body.get("filename", "")
21571     content_b64 = body.get("content_b64", "")
21572 
21573     if not filename or not content_b64:
21574         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "missing filename or content"})
21575         return
21576 
21577     import base64
21578     try:
21579         file_data = base64.b64decode(content_b64)
21580         if project_id == "__dashboard__" or project_id == "dev" or not project_id:
21581             upload_dir = ANCHOR_DIR / "dev"
21582         else:
21583             entry = _rnd.get_project(project_id)
21584             if entry and entry.get("folder_path"):
21585                 upload_dir = Path(entry["folder_path"])
21586             else:
21587                 upload_dir = ANCHOR_DIR / ".anchor" / "projects" / project_id / "uploads"
21588 
21589         upload_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
21590         dest_path = upload_dir / filename
21591         dest_path.write_bytes(file_data)
21592 
21593         handler._send_json({"ok": True, "message": f"Uploaded {filename} successfully."})
21594     except Exception as e:
21595         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(e)})
21596

21598 def _reaper_control(handler, body, action):
21599     """Shared body for the reaper arm/advance/disarm control-plane handlers.
21600 
21601     Already token-gated by the do_POST middleware; the reaper module fns ALSO
21602     re-check paths.auth_ok(provided) (defense in depth), so the presented token is
21603     reconstructed here (mirroring the middleware's order) and passed through.
21604     """
21605     provided = _request_presented_token(handler, body)
21606     import reaper_arming as _arm
21607     try:
21608         out = getattr(_arm, action)(provided)
21609     except Exception as exc:
21610         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, 500)
21611     else:
21612         code = 200 if out.get("ok") else (
21613             401 if out.get("error") == "unauthorized" else 409)
21614         handler._send_json(out, code)
21615 
21616 
21617 def handle_reaper_arm(handler, path, body):
21618     """POST /api/rnd/reaper_arm — the reaper ARMING control plane (arm).
21619 
21620     Wave 11 (foundry-v2, safety before scale): the ARM rung (log->freeze) goes
21621     through the sanctioned Wave-11 path, which RE-CHECKS the 2026-07-05
21622     fail-deadly finding before delegating to the token-authed, receipt-gated
21623     ladder — an open finding refuses the arm with no state change. Targets
21624     FREEZE only; this endpoint can never arm KILL. Mirrors ``_reaper_control``'s
21625     token reconstruction + error/response handling (the middleware token-gates
21626     this row FIRST; the reaper module re-checks paths.auth_ok in depth)."""
21627     provided = _request_presented_token(handler, body)
21628     import foundry_safety as _fsafety
21629     try:
21630         out = _fsafety.arm_reaper_to_freeze(provided)
21631     except Exception as exc:
21632         handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, 500)
21633     else:
21634         code = 200 if out.get("ok") else (
21635             401 if out.get("error") == "unauthorized" else 409)
21636         handler._send_json(out, code)
21637
